story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Oi

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I just wanted to check in before I get busy again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Eu só queria dar uma conferida antes de ficar ocupado novamente.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: How are you feeling today, really?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Como você está se sentindo hoje, de verdade?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Still stiff, and it’s annoying not being able to get up whenever I want
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ainda estou rígido, e é irritante não poder me levantar sempre que quero.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: But you’re healing, and that’s what matters, even if it feels slow
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Mas você está se curando, e isso é o que importa, mesmo que pareça lento.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You also need to stop blaming yourself for everything
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Você também precisa parar de se culpar por tudo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You didn’t choose to get hurt, and you’re not a burden for needing help
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Você não escolheu se machucar, e você não é um fardo por precisar de ajuda.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m trying
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Estou tentando

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s just hard to feel useful when I’m stuck in bed all day
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: É difícil sentir que sou útil quando estou preso na cama o dia todo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Oi

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Eu sei

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: By the way, how does your new phone feel so far?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: A propósito, como está se sentindo com seu novo telefone até agora?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Does everything look like it transferred correctly from the old one?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Tudo parece ter sido transferido corretamente do antigo?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Yeah, surprisingly
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sim, surpreendentemente

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s fast, and everything seems to be in the right place
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: É rápido, e tudo parece estar no lugar certo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I barely had to redo my settings
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Eu mal precisei refazer minhas configurações.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Bom

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: The guy who sold it to me kept insisting it was a solid model
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: O cara que me vendeu insistiu que era um modelo sólido.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks again for getting it for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Obrigado novamente por conseguir isso para mim.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know you didn’t have to, but it really helps right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Eu sei que você não precisava, mas isso realmente ajuda agora.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Did I wake you up, or were you already drifting in and out?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Eu te acordei, ou você já estava indo e voltando?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Of course it helps
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Claro que ajuda

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You deserve nice things too, even if you don’t always believe that
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Você também merece coisas boas, mesmo que nem sempre acredite nisso.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: …Okay
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: …Certo

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Actually, there’s one thing I still need for the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Na verdade, tem uma coisa que eu ainda preciso para o novo telefone.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s asking for a clean contact photo, and the one I had is ancient
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Está pedindo uma foto de contato limpa, e a que eu tinha é antiga.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Oh
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Oh

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You want a new photo of me for your contacts?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Você quer uma nova foto minha para seus contatos?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Alright, give me a second
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Certo, me dê um segundo

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 2 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I was already awake, don’t worry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Eu já estava acordado, não se preocupe.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: A little, but it’s fine, I’m glad you texted
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Um pouco, mas está tudo bem, fico feliz que você tenha mandado mensagem

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: There
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Lá

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: If that one looks terrible, you’re not allowed to complain
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Se aquele parecer terrível, você não pode reclamar.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s perfect
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Está perfeito

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Try to rest
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Tente descansar

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’ll bring you something to eat later and check on you again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Vou trazer algo para você comer mais tarde e vou verificar como você está de novo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Obrigado, {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Bom

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I keep forgetting you can’t really do much besides stare at that screen right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Eu continuo esquecendo que você realmente não pode fazer muito além de olhar para essa tela agora.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m sorry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sinto muito

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Apenas verificando se você não desapareceu

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: I can hear you moving around
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Eu posso te ouvir se movendo.
É isso que você sempre diz

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me you needed a profile pic from me, right?
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:evelyn}} me disse que você precisava de uma foto de perfil minha, né?
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate.

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: Try not to ghost the world today
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Tente não fantasma o mundo hoje

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: You always have something to say
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Você sempre tem algo a dizer

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: A garota mais fofa que você conhece 💁‍♀️

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I actually needed a new contact photo for you
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Na verdade, eu precisava de uma nova foto de contato para você.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: So this is what I’m reduced to now 😭
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Então é isso que eu me reduzi agora 😭

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Are you awake, or are you doing that thing where you pretend you’re asleep? 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Você está acordado ou está fazendo aquela coisa de fingir que está dormindo? 😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I was just checking on you
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Eu só estava verificando como você está.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: You’ve got the same energy as a sad houseplant 🌱
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Você tem a mesma energia que uma planta de casa triste 🌱

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Maybe I was pretending. Depends who’s asking
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Talvez eu estivesse fingindo. Depende de quem está perguntando
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Text me if you need anything
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Me mande uma mensagem se precisar de algo

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I’m about to post a story and a new post
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Estou prestes a postar uma história e uma nova publicação.
É melhor você gostar de ambos.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I'm the cutest girl you know 💅
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Sou a garota mais fofa que você conhece 💅

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: Claro! Por favor, forneça o diálogo do jogo que você gostaria que eu traduzisse.

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: But you should at least respond to her texts
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: Mas você deveria pelo menos responder às mensagens dela.

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: You don’t have to prove it to me
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: Você não precisa provar isso para mim

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: Did you drink any water yet

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Well i’m okay though, at least not dead
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Bem, estou bem, pelo menos não estou morto.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I understand but it’s not your fault
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Eu entendo, mas não é sua culpa.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Rest and heal, you being alive is more important than the rest for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Descanse e se cure, você estar vivo é mais importante do que o resto para mim.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: And I’m here if you need me ❤️
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: E eu estou aqui se você precisar de mim ❤️

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Also part of why I’ve been slow to reply is the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Também parte do motivo pelo qual tenho demorado a responder é o celular novo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: By the way can you send me a profile picture?
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: A propósito, você pode me enviar uma foto de perfil?

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me your old one didn’t survive the accident
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: {{name:evelyn}} me contou que a sua antiga não sobreviveu ao acidente

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I’m just glad you even have a phone now
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Estou apenas feliz que você agora tenha um telefone.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Way smoother than the old one
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Muito mais suave do que o antigo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: It glitches a bit sometimes though
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Às vezes, ele apresenta alguns bugs.
Qual é o seu plano para hoje?

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I just wanted to make sure you’re okay 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Eu só queria ter certeza de que você está bem 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I didn’t mean to worry you
It’s just hard not to think sometimes
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: É só difícil não pensar às vezes

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: It’s just been a lot lately, getting stuck in bed for I don’t even know how long, missing all the good things with everyone, especially you
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Tem sido muito ultimamente, ficar preso na cama por eu nem sei quanto tempo, perdendo todas as coisas boas com todo mundo, especialmente você.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: If someone touched you, I want names
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Se alguém te tocou, eu quero nomes.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Probably some jealous idiots because you’re with {{name:lena}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Provavelmente alguns idiotas com ciúmes porque você está com a {{name:lena}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: She’s basically the prettiest girl on campus
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Ela é basicamente a garota mais bonita do campus.
Você acha que os caras não percebem? 😒

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: But if you remember anything later, you tell me
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Mas se você lembrar de algo depois, me avise.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: {{name:mason}} gave me your new number. How are you actually doing?
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:mason}} me deu seu novo número. Como você realmente está?
A tela pula um pouco às vezes.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Had a weird glitch earlier but nothing serious
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Tive um erro estranho mais cedo, mas nada sério.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: You’ve had it for two days 😂
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Você tem isso há dois dias 😂

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Send me a pic so I can set your profile properly
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Me envie uma foto para que eu possa configurar seu perfil corretamente.
Atualizando meu status de contato já
Vejo você esta noite no jogo

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: I’ll tell you if I play
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Eu te digo se eu jogar
Adivinha quem é o mais fofo hoje 💕

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Don’t brush it off. Tell me

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Você precisa de mais alguma coisa?

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: But I’ll see what I can do about snacks
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Mas eu vou ver o que posso fazer sobre os lanches.
{{name:evelyn}} vai trazer comida para você em breve

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: You better open your window before she walks in
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: É melhor você abrir a sua janela antes que ela entre.

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Your room probably smells like hospital and gamer sweat mixed together 🤢
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Seu quarto provavelmente cheira a hospital e suor de gamer misturados 🤢

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Air it out before the biohazard team shows up
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Areje antes que a equipe de biohazard chegue.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Portuguese.
Ainda

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Don’t leave me on read like that again 😅
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Não me deixe no vácuo assim de novo 😅
Notado
Eu vou me sair melhor
Bom

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: How are you actually feeling right now?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Como você realmente está se sentindo agora?
Um pouco cansado

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: My head feels kind of loud
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Minha cabeça está meio barulhenta.
Barulhento como?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Like your thoughts won’t slow down?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Como se seus pensamentos não fossem desacelerar?
Sem resposta 👀
Sim
Exatamente isso
Então vamos devagar

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I was thinking about you earlier at work
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Eu estava pensando em você mais cedo no trabalho.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: It was a calm shift for once
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Foi um turno calmo pela primeira vez.
Sem caos hoje?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Just one dramatic customer but I survived 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Apenas um cliente dramático, mas eu sobrevivi 😌
A universidade foi mais pesada, porém.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I have that presentation tomorrow and I keep replaying it in my head
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Eu tenho aquela apresentação amanhã e fico relembrando ela na minha cabeça.
Você vai se sair bem

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I swear I’m not trying to be heavy
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Eu juro que não estou tentando ser chato.
Espero que sim 🤞

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I just want things to move forward you know
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Eu só quero que as coisas avancem, você sabe.
Não se preocupe, vai dar tudo certo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: What else do you have planned for tomorrow?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: O que mais você tem planejado para amanhã?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Work in the morning, then the presentation and probably more studying
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Trabalho de manhã, depois a apresentação e provavelmente mais estudos
Nada emocionante
Ainda soa produtivo
Talvez

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: But right now I care more about you than my schedule 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Mas agora eu me importo mais com você do que com a minha agenda 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You don’t have to I’m okay
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Você não precisa, eu estou bem.
Desculpe
Eu te conheço

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You don’t have to act strong with me
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Você não precisa agir forte comigo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You already are in my eyes ❤️
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Você já está nos meus olhos ❤️

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: And it’s not your fault if you’re stuck in bed
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: E não é sua culpa se você está preso na cama

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Five weeks before our trip, of course

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ainda devo a você a prova de que realmente caminhei.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The weather is actually really nice today
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: O tempo está realmente muito bom hoje.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Okay I should go before they notice I'm smiling at my phone like an idiot
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ok, eu deveria ir antes que eles percebam que estou sorrindo para o meu telefone como um idiota.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My family is walking a little ahead of me right now
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Minha família está andando um pouco à minha frente agora.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: So I have one minute to bother you
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Então eu tenho um minuto para te incomodar
Talvez dois se você tiver sorte 🤍

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I hope I won't finish too late
If I get back at a decent time, I'll shower
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Se eu voltar a uma hora decente, vou tomar banho

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Then we can finally try that game
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Aí a gente pode finalmente tentar aquele jogo

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Can you grab a few things to eat after work?
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Você pode pegar algumas coisas pra comer depois do trabalho?
Uber Eats geralmente é mais rápido

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I can still come home with nothing
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ainda posso voltar pra casa de mãos vazias

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Because {{name:hailey}} is about to go next
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Porque a {{name:hailey}} está prestes a ir em seguida

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And she'll use all the hot water and stay in there for three hours
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: E ela vai usar toda a água quente e ficar lá por três horas

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Do you need help getting into the shower?
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Você precisa de ajuda para entrar no chuveiro?

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I think I'll manage for now
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Acho que vou conseguir por enquanto

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But if I need help, I'll call you
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Mas se eu precisar de ajuda, te chamo

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Please call me before you're naked then 😌
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Por favor, me chame antes de ficar pelada então 😌

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: If you need any clothes tomorrow, everything should be dry by then
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Se você precisar de roupas amanhã, tudo deve estar seco até lá
Além disso, vou começar a cozinhar em breve

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So if you're hungry, dinner should be ready in about twenty-five minutes
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Então, se você estiver com fome, o jantar deve estar pronto em cerca de vinte e cinco minutos

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: You should probably go take your shower now 😌
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Você provavelmente deveria ir tomar seu banho agora 😌

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Can you check one answer before I sleep?
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você pode checar uma resposta antes de eu dormir?

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: {{name:hailey}} sends you a picture of her homework answer
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: {{name:hailey}} te manda uma foto da resposta dela

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Then time to rest this huge brain
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Então é hora de descansar esse cérebro gigante

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That sounds like your kind of review
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Isso soa como a sua crítica

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I did two homework questions on the bus
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Fiz duas perguntas de lição no ônibus

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about next Saturday? And I make you dinner after the date
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Que tal no próximo sábado? E eu faço o jantar para você depois do encontro.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be really happy if we do that
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu ficaria muito feliz se fizéssemos isso.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now tell me about your day
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Agora me conte sobre o seu dia

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I moved around a bit like I said I would
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu me movi um pouco, como disse que faria.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And then I played for a while with {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E então eu brinquei por um tempo com {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Rehab and social life in the same day
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Reabilitação e vida social no mesmo dia

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really glad you moved around today
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou realmente feliz que você se movimentou hoje

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I'm glad you had a decent Sunday
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E estou feliz que você teve um domingo decente.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you should go to bed soon
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E você deve ir para a cama em breve.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I don't want you exhausted tomorrow
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu não quero que você esteja exausto amanhã.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm going to wash up and get in bed
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vou me lavar e ir para a cama.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I definitely got a little sunburned 😭
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Acho que definitivamente peguei um pouco de queimadura de sol 😭

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So you got cute and slightly toasted?
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então você ficou fofo e um pouco torrado?

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I really want to go back there with you
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Agora eu realmente quero voltar lá com você

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That game was actually really fun
It's a shame you're so bad at it 😂
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: É uma pena que você seja tão ruim 😂
O meu já tá começando a doer

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I think we'll be sore tomorrow
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Acho que vamos ficar doloridos amanhã
Espero que você esteja pronta pra perder

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll let the scoreboard do the talking
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Vou deixar o placar falar por mim

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Good morning 😊 Did you sleep well?
That would be a huge help

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Estou terminando o café da manhã
É pra isso que estou aqui

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: How is your leg feeling today?
Still annoying, but I think it's getting better
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ainda está chata, mas acho que está melhorando

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm going to open the windows and air out my room
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Vou abrir as janelas e arejar meu quarto

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Would you mind helping me clean it a little?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Você se importaria de me ajudar a limpar um pouco?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need my emergency audience alive
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Preciso da minha plateia de emergência viva
Mas nada de estudar pesado hoje
Meu cérebro tá uma sopa pós-festa
Mas você tem dever de casa do professor

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He sent a tiny correction list this morning
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele mandou uma lista de correções minúscula hoje de manhã

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Tiny in professor language means annoying
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Minúscula na linguagem do professor significa irritante

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why are you both using calm voices at me
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Por que vocês dois estão falando calminhos comigo?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because panic does not solve homework
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Porque pânico não resolve dever de casa

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mesma ideia, na maioria das vezes.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Move around a little for my leg
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mexa-se um pouco para a minha perna

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then today we both have one job
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Então hoje nós dois temos um trabalho

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I officially refuse to rush today
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu oficialmente me recuso a me apressar hoje.
Eu com toda a minha existência

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll probably clean a little, make something simple, and be useless on the couch
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Provavelmente vou limpar um pouco, fazer algo simples e ser inútil no sofá.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me later when you've done your little rehab walk
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me manda uma mensagem mais tarde quando você terminar sua pequena caminhada de reabilitação.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Someone has to make sure you don't lie about resting
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alguém tem que garantir que você não minta sobre descansar.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very committed to this role
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você está muito comprometido com este papel.
Eu levo meu trabalho a sério ❤️

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No shift, no running around, no pretending I have energy 😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sem mudança, sem correr por aí, sem fingir que tenho energia 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making coffee and moving like an old lady
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou fazendo café e me movendo como uma senhora idosa.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You're lying in bed judging someone who's actually trying
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Você está deitado na cama julgando alguém que realmente está tentando

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And somehow I'm still doing a better job
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: E de alguma forma eu ainda estou fazendo um trabalho melhor

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And my side of the kitchen is still clean
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: E meu lado da cozinha ainda está limpo
Vem ajudar ou cala a boca

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Get over here before I burn something
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Vem aqui antes que eu queime alguma coisa

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: If the kitchen catches fire, you'll have to move with that leg
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Se a cozinha pegar fogo, você vai ter que se mover com essa perna

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Don't touch anything until I get there
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Não toque em nada até eu chegar
Você precisa de ajuda para comer agora?
Mas isso não está indo bem

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How did you make that much mess?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I closed your window for you 😊
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu fechei sua janela pra você 😊

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You don't have to do that
I'm already downstairs in the kitchen
I need to move around a little
Otherwise I'm going to lose my mind staying in that room all day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Caso contrário, vou pirar ficando nesse quarto o dia todo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And it will save you from moving around too much to grab ingredients
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: E isso vai te poupar de se mover muito pra pegar os ingredientes

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You can tell me what you need and I'll get it
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Você pode me dizer o que precisa e eu pego

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I was going to do it after my shower
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu ia fazer isso depois do meu banho

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I thought I'd better close it now
You did the right thing then
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Você fez a coisa certa então

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am actually kind of proud of myself 😇
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Na verdade, tô meio orgulhosa de mim mesma 😇

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Okay okay not so nice teacher
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tá bom, tá bom, professora não tão legal

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Then time to go enjoy my last good time before prison😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Então é hora de aproveitar meu último momento bom antes da prisão😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe tiny chaos if popcorn betrays me
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Talvez um caoszinho se a pipoca me trair

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I am still quizzing you later
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas ainda vou te fazer um quiz depois

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Proof I left the house looking human
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Prova de que saí de casa parecendo humana

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You look like a decent human
You get two extra homework questions for that 😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você ganhou duas perguntas extras de lição por isso 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A friend from class wants to see a movie
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Uma amiga da aula quer ver um filme

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And she is coming to pick me up in 20 minutes
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: E ela vem me buscar em 20 minutos

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am going to the cinema with her and maybe another friend
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou ao cinema com ela e talvez mais uma amiga

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Tomorrow, back in the studying game
I will not let the responsible era die
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Não vou deixar a era responsável morrer

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um pouco mais longo do que ontem

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See, I can trust you sometimes
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Veja, eu posso confiar em você às vezes.
Eu não fiz absolutamente nada produtivo.
Você realmente merece a apreciação da prova

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I look like I haven't moved for hours
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parece que não me movi por horas.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like this version of you
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu gosto desta versão de você

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because this is exactly how I plan to stay for a few more hours
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque é exatamente assim que eu planejo ficar por mais algumas horas

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you after my movie ?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem depois do meu filme ?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I sat down and never really got back up
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então eu me sentei e nunca realmente me levantei de novo.
Estou muito orgulhoso de mim mesmo 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Você não está trabalhando hoje, certo?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: But I'm choosing the first game
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Mas eu escolho o primeiro jogo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Says the person who almost burned breakfast
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Diz a pessoa que quase queimou o café da manhã

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: That has nothing to do with games
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Isso não tem nada a ver com jogos

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: It says a lot about your decision-making
I'll remember this when you need help
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Vou lembrar disso quando você precisar de ajuda
Você precisou de mim esta manhã
E já me arrependo de ter perguntado
Você tem sorte de estar machucado

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And you're lucky I invited you
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: E você tem sorte de eu ter te convidado

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be there in ten minutes
Don't start getting used to that
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Não comece a se acostumar com isso

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: We could do a full gaming day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Podemos fazer um dia inteiro de jogos

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really have nothing better to do
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Você realmente não tem nada melhor pra fazer

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm choosing to waste my day

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Oi 😊
Ainda é o melhor. Por enquanto

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Anyway, I'm going to finish making dinner
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: De qualquer forma, vou terminar de fazer o jantar

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then I'll probably watch a few episodes of my series
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Depois provavelmente vou assistir a alguns episódios da minha série

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Do you want to join me?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Você quer se juntar a mim?
Não posso hoje à noite

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I still have a few things to do
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ainda tenho algumas coisas para fazer
Mas em outra ocasião, com certeza
Ok 😊

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Just don't stay up too late
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Só não fique acordada até tarde
Oi 😊
Você também
Vou tentar 😄
DIA 11

Eu tenho uma pergunta?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Well thanks I guess ?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bem, obrigada, eu acho? 🤔

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Also he just walked past and gave me the professor nod
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele só passou e me deu um aceno de professor

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good sign right ??
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bom sinal, né??

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Emotional regulation source shifting. Pressing too hard may cause defensive minimization.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Regulação emocional em mudança de foco. Apertar demais pode causar minimização defensiva.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ask if his attention helps her calm down
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pergunte se a atenção dele ajuda ela a se acalmar

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Let her focus before class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Deixe ela se concentrar antes da aula

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Does it help when he checks on you like that?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ajuda quando ele verifica você assim?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I am outside class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Estou do lado de fora da sala

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Maybe
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Talvez

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Do not make a psychology documentary about it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Não faça um documentário psicológico sobre isso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I just need to pass 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Só preciso passar 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Go focus. You can survive this.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Vai se concentrar. Você consegue sobreviver a isso.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is the correct supportive answer
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Essa é a resposta de apoio certa

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Gold star maybe
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Estrela de ouro, talvez

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I die, delete my search history
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se eu morrer, apague meu histórico de busca

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Pretending to be a girl who understands chapters
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Fingindo ser uma garota que entende os capítulos

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And tell my friends I was academically brave 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E diga aos meus amigos que fui academicamente corajosa 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You revised yesterday
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Você revisou ontem

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because he bullied me with structure
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Porque ele me atormentou com estrutura

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Respectfully
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Com todo respeito

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He told me to breathe and read the question twice
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele me disse para respirar e ler a pergunta duas vezes

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is good advice
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Isso é um bom conselho

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I know
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eu sei

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel a bit more useful there
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu me sinto um pouco mais útil lá

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I have actual things to take care of
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Agora eu tenho coisas reais para cuidar.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll probably stay longer than usual
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Provavelmente vou ficar mais tempo do que o habitual.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Be careful not to overdo it
I actually have a lot to do today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Na verdade, eu tenho muita coisa para fazer hoje.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since they gave me more responsibilities i need to be there more often
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Desde que me deram mais responsabilidades, preciso estar lá com mais frequência.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You might be the next one whith a cast
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Você pode ser o próximo a usar gesso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Don't trip on your first day back
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Não tropece no seu primeiro dia de volta

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll try not to embarrass you
You manage that without even trying
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Você consegue isso sem nem tentar

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Did the doctor finally put you out of your misery?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: O médico finalmente te livrou do sofrimento?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I should be able to walk again soon
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Devo conseguir andar de novo em breve

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I was getting tired of waiting for you every time we went somewhere
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Eu estava ficando cansado de esperar por você toda vez que íamos a algum lugar

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You make it sound like I'm slowing you down on purpose
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Você faz parecer que estou te atrasando de propósito

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: What time do you start at the bar today?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Que horas você começa no bar hoje?
Mais tarde do que o normal
E vou terminar mais tarde também

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'll make a little more money because of it !
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas vou ganhar um pouco mais por causa disso!

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Just make sure you don't get too tired
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Só não se esqueça de não ficar muito cansada

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But thank you for worrying about me ❤️
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas obrigada por se preocupar comigo ❤️

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That walk did me a lot of good
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Aquela caminhada me fez muito bem

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: We didn't exactly go very far
And we came back pretty quickly too 😄
But it was perfect for me
It didn't bother me at all
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Não me incomodou nem um pouco

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: We'll try to do it more often then
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Vamos tentar fazer isso mais vezes então

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sobrevivi à aula, mais ou menos 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: My professor wants me to come by his office before the next class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Meu professor quer que eu passe no escritório dele antes da próxima aula

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just five minutes to check what I missed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Só cinco minutos para checar o que perdi

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That is a lot of extra attention
He is taking it really seriously
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ele está levando isso muito a sério
Candidato a inconsistência na linha do tempo detectado

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject reports brief office review between classes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O sujeito relata uma breve revisão no escritório entre as aulas
Monitorando a persistência da localização real

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to believe this is just a quick review, so why am I already bracing for something else?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quero acreditar que é só uma revisão rápida, então por que já estou me preparando para outra coisa?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need a walk after this
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Preciso de uma caminhada depois disso
Caminhe primeiro. Entre em pânico depois.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor and you both making sense is unfair
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: É injusto que você e o professor façam sentido

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I read it twice like he said
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas eu li duas vezes como ele disse

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Which is better than guessing while internally screaming
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O que é melhor do que chutar enquanto grito internamente

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home a bit later
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Vou chegar em casa um pouco mais tarde

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: What time are you coming home?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Que horas você vai voltar pra casa?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: There's no reason for anything to go wrong
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Não há razão para nada dar errado

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll text you when I'm home
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem quando chegar em casa

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:evelyn}} needs your help with something in the attic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:evelyn}} precisa da sua ajuda com algo no sótão

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I prepared dinner for tonight 😊
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ei, eu preparei o jantar para hoje à noite 😊

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And you, don't go to bed too late
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: E você, não vá dormir muito tarde

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: If you can't go downstairs, just ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}} to bring it to you
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Se você não puder descer, é só pedir para {{name:hailey}} ou {{name:mason}} trazer pra você
Boa sorte para hoje à noite

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I hope it's going to be okay
My manager isn't supposed to be working tonight
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Meu gerente não deveria estar trabalhando hoje à noite

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then try to enjoy the shift with your coworkers
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Então tente aproveitar o turno com seus colegas

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can send him one answer tonight if I panic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ele disse que posso enviar uma resposta para ele hoje à noite se eu entrar em pânico

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: This is my exhausted victim face
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Esta é minha cara de vítima exausta

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Don't fall asleep in the couch
unless i close my eyes for a second
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: a menos que eu feche os olhos por um segundo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You keep texting me anyway, that should keep you awake
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Você continua me mandando mensagens, isso deve te manter acordada

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But yeah, i'm going straight to bed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mas sim, vou direto para a cama

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He noticed the exact part I messed up
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ele notou exatamente a parte que eu estraguei

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But not in a bad way
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas não de uma maneira ruim

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels good to be trusted with more things
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É bom ser confiado com mais coisas

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know it probably sounds boring from the outside
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei que provavelmente soa chato do lado de fora

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not if you're happy about it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não se você está feliz com isso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's strict, but he explains things clearly
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele é rigoroso, mas explica as coisas claramente.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't want today to become heavy
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu só não quero que hoje se torne pesado.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll text you after work if I'm not dead 😅
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem depois do trabalho se eu não estiver morto 😅

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But work is moving fast today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas o trabalho está avançando rápido hoje

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm still learning where everything is and what they expect from me
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda estou aprendendo onde tudo está e o que eles esperam de mim.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Você chegou em casa bem rápido

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You could still come sit with us
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Você ainda poderia vir sentar com a gente

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Am I really going to have to come drag you out of your room?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu realmente vou ter que vir te arrastar pra fora do seu quarto?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Good luck climbing the stairs with your leg
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Boa sorte subindo as escadas com sua perna

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Behavior change detected after gym session
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mudança de comportamento detectada após a sessão de ginástica

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Subject avoided shared dinner without clear explanation
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: O sujeito evitou o jantar compartilhado sem explicação clara

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Conversation pattern deviates from established baseline
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Padrão de conversa desvia da linha de base estabelecida

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: The joke sounds like {{name:mason}}, but the distance doesn't feel familiar.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: A piada é a cara de {{name:mason}}, mas essa distância não me parece familiar.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Straight to the shower and your room?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Direto para o chuveiro e seu quarto?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I don't know just making sure
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Não sei, só estou me certificando

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He's demanding but... it pushes me in a good way
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ele é exigente, mas... isso me impulsiona de uma boa maneira.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I like the way he works
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu gosto da maneira como ele trabalha

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I just want things to stay simple right now
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu só quero que as coisas fiquem simples agora.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm not trying to make things tense
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não estou tentando deixar as coisas tensas.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Everything feels heavier when I'm like this
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tudo parece mais pesado quando estou assim.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll probably just shower and go to bed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Provavelmente vou apenas tomar um banho e ir para a cama.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I wouldn't make it past ten minutes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu não conseguiria passar de dez minutos

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't expect to handle that much today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu não esperava lidar com tanto hoje.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Actually, things moved faster than expected
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Na verdade, as coisas aconteceram mais rápido do que eu esperava

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I received a lot of notifications last night and this morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Recebi muitas notificações ontem à noite e esta manhã

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: There are already enough requests for me to choose a good profile
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Já tem pedidos suficientes para eu escolher um bom perfil

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: If everything looks right, you might be able to do your first outing today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Se tudo estiver certo, você pode fazer sua primeira saída hoje

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: That is why we will start slowly
Maybe just one or two hours outside, nothing more
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Talvez só uma ou duas horas lá fora, nada mais

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Just enough for you to get used to it and see how it feels
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Só o suficiente para você se acostumar e ver como se sente

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I was afraid you were going to tell me it would be something long right away
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Eu estava com medo de você me dizer que seria algo longo logo de cara

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Then I will go get ready
Message me when you know more, okay?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Me manda uma mensagem quando souber mais, tá bom?
Como você está se sentindo hoje?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Please do not push yourself too much today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Por favor, não se force demais hoje

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Where are we with the work?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Mentally prepared to suffer for your grades
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mentalmente preparada para sofrer pelas suas notas

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But definitely ready to see my handsome {{name:tutor}} 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mas definitivamente pronta pra ver meu {{name:tutor}} gato 😌
