story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It was much more pleasant than I expected
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Foi muito mais agradável do que eu esperava

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You picked a really good person
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Você escolheu uma pessoa realmente boa

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: We spent most of the time talking
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Passamos a maior parte do tempo conversando

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And in the end I agreed to stay for two hours instead of one
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: E no final, eu concordei em ficar por duas horas em vez de uma

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm glad everything went well
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Fico feliz que tudo tenha dado certo

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You sounded really nervous this morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Você parecia realmente nervosa esta manhã

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I barely passed the last quiz
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eu mal passei no último quiz

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: So I asked for his number 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Então eu pedi o número dele 😌
Isso não é o que profissional significa

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But seriously, focus on studying first
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mas sério, foca nos estudos primeiro

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: The annoying part is that it actually worked
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: A parte chata é que funcionou de verdade

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I studied harder because I wanted the reward
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eu estudei mais porque queria a recompensa

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then I guess Ethan knows what he's doing
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Então eu acho que o Ethan sabe o que está fazendo

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:hailey}} shows increased responsiveness to Ethan's approval
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:hailey}} mostra maior responsividade à aprovação do Ethan

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Tutor-student boundary remains stable for now
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: A fronteira tutor-aluno permanece estável por enquanto

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Risk detected: relationship may not remain strictly academic
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Risco detectado: o relacionamento pode não permanecer estritamente acadêmico

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I wanted her to take studying seriously. I didn't expect his approval to matter this much.
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eu queria que ela levasse os estudos a sério. Não esperava que a aprovação dele importasse tanto.
O Ethan até teve uma ideia

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He gave me little quizzes during the session
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ele me deu pequenos quizzes durante a sessão

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: If I passed, I got a reward
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Se eu passasse, ganhava uma recompensa

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: If I failed, I got a punishment
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Se eu falhasse, ganhava uma punição

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little of both sounds right 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco de ambos soa certo 😌

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: One teacher kept repeating the same thing for 20 minutes
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um professor ficou repetindo a mesma coisa por 20 minutos.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I almost gave up on life halfway through
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu quase desisti da vida na metade do caminho.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for validating my struggle
My brain is starting to drift a little
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Minha cabeça está começando a divagar um pouco.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just resting and moving a little
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apenas descansando e me movendo um pouco

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay I should go back before I completely disconnect from reality
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, eu deveria voltar antes que eu me desconecte completamente da realidade.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself staring at nothing for a full minute earlier
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu me peguei olhando para o nada por um minuto inteiro mais cedo.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Hey, what did you do with my controller?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ei, o que você fez com meu controle?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're going to pay for that
You better find it or I'm considering it stolen
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: É melhor você encontrar ou vou considerar roubado

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: What would I even do with it?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: O que eu ia fazer com isso?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You think I hid it inside my cast or something?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Você acha que eu escondi dentro do meu gesso ou algo assim?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: With how desperate you are to finally beat me, I wouldn't put it past you
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Com a sua pressa de finalmente me vencer, eu não duvidaria

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I booked another coaching session for you tomorrow morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Marquei outra sessão de treino pra você amanhã de manhã

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Maybe it'll teach you something about life
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Talvez isso te ensine algo sobre a vida

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Blanket mode is not a joke
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: O modo cobertor não é uma piada

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But this is a very exclusive report
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mas este é um relatório muito exclusivo

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I think I needed this tonight
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Acho que eu precisava disso esta noite

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Peace, quiet, and you being sweet to me
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Paz, silêncio, e você sendo doce comigo

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're very good at it when you want to be ❤️
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você é muito bom nisso quando quer ser ❤️

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Only when I want to be?
Mostly when you're not trying to act tough
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Principalmente quando você não está tentando agir durão

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm going to stay wrapped up a little longer
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vou ficar enrolado um pouco mais.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then sleep before I become useless tomorrow
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Então durma antes que eu me torne inútil amanhã.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I feel like my social battery has filed a complaint
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sinto que minha bateria social apresentou uma reclamação.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am currently wrapped in a blanket and accepting no responsibilities
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Atualmente estou enrolado em um cobertor e não aceitando responsabilidades.

story/DAY12/DAY12_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Do not get used to it. I am giving you one calm message for free.
story/DAY12/DAY12_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Não se acostume com isso. Estou te dando uma mensagem calma de graça.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And if you want anything special for lunch, tell me
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: E se você quiser algo especial para o almoço, me avise

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I can make it for you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Eu posso fazer isso pra você

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I will message you if I need anything
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem se precisar de algo

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I will bring the clothes up in a minute
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Vou levar as roupas para cima em um minuto

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You need to be ready in case work starts
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Você precisa estar pronta caso o trabalho comece

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I still did not see any light in your room when I walked past
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ainda não vi nenhuma luz no seu quarto quando passei

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I will come upstairs and drop off your clean clothes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Vou subir e deixar suas roupas limpas

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Do well tonight and we can discuss benefits 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Se você se sair bem hoje à noite, podemos discutir os benefícios 😇

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Many chances to regret my choices
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Muitas chances de me arrepender das minhas escolhas

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I will probably need help after the second one
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Provavelmente vou precisar de ajuda depois da segunda

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Now I have no excuse to fail 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Agora não tenho desculpa para falhar 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Go to your classes, quickly before I heal completely
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Vai para suas aulas, rápido, antes que eu me cure completamente

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: The injured tutor threat level is rising 😔
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: O nível de ameaça do tutor ferido está aumentando 😔

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming you 💅
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Se eu aprender algo contra a minha vontade, vou te culpar 💅

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Blink twice if your leg is being dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Pisca duas vezes se sua perna estiver dramática
Menos dramática que sua lição de casa
Minha lição de casa tem treinamento de teatro

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I still need my favorite tutor functional
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ainda preciso do meu tutor favorito funcional

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I would have wanted that too
You would have had to protect me from the evil sky 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você teria que me proteger do céu maligno 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I take that responsibility very seriously
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu levo essa responsabilidade muito a sério.
Eu sou basicamente um especialista em tempestades.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Send me a picture of my brave survivor then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Envie-me uma foto do meu bravo sobrevivente então.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I haven't finished doing my makeup yet 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ainda não terminei de fazer minha maquiagem 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I didn't say full glam was required
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu não disse que era necessário estar totalmente glamouroso.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You get the almost ready version
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você recebe a versão quase pronta.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And don't forget your leg exercises today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E não se esqueça dos seus exercícios de perna hoje.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There was a storm during the night
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Houve uma tempestade durante a noite

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay maybe more than a little
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ok, talvez mais do que um pouco

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I really wanted to sleep with you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu realmente queria dormir com você

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: You say that like you're the responsible one
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Você fala isso como se fosse a responsável aqui
Ainda tô um pouco dolorida, mas tudo bem

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Maybe we do a small session today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Talvez a gente faça uma sessão leve hoje
Então nada que você planejou, né?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I'm trying to be responsible here

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm going to do some grocery shopping
Is there anything you want me to buy?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Tem algo que você quer que eu compre?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you get me a water bottle or a flask?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Você pode me trazer uma garrafinha de água ou um cantil?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Something I can keep in my room with clean water
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Algo que eu possa deixar no meu quarto com água limpa

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll see what I can find
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Vou ver o que consigo encontrar

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll try not to come back too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Vou tentar não voltar muito tarde
Estou ficando um pouco com fome

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Do you have time to bring me something to eat?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Você tem tempo para me trazer algo para comer?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll heat up your lunch and bring it to you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Vou aquecer seu almoço e trazer pra você

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm coming to pick up your plate
Do you need anything else while I'm here?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Você precisa de mais alguma coisa enquanto estou aqui?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Do not say it like that
Your bullying tutor method might be working
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Seu método de tutor bullying pode estar funcionando

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Can you ask {{name:mason}} if {{mason:he}} can come pick me up at university?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Pode perguntar para {{name:mason}} se {{mason:he|ele|ela}} pode me buscar na universidade?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I would ask {{mason:him}} myself but {{mason:he}} is less scary when you are involved
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Eu mesma perguntaria {{mason:him|a ele|a ela}}, mas {{mason:he|ele|ela}} dá menos medo quando você entra na conversa.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will take care of it
But if you get home early, you revise again
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Mas se você chegar em casa cedo, você estuda de novo

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I knew there was a trap
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Eu sabia que tinha uma armadilha

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You cannot say that after I survived class
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Você não pode dizer isso depois que eu sobrevivi à aula

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am way too cute to be forced to revise 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Eu sou fofíssima demais pra ser forçada a revisar 😇

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is discrimination against adorable people 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Isso é discriminação contra pessoas adoráveis 😭
Entendi mais do que o normal

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll destroy you on that game
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu vou te destruir naquele jogo.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I see you still have hope
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Vejo que você ainda tem esperança.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Go to work before you embarrass yourself more
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Vai trabalhar antes que você se envergonhe mais.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Enjoy the silence while it lasts
And why would that interest me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: E por que isso me interessaria?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Because your day is clearly empty without my updates
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Porque seu dia tá claramente vazio sem minhas atualizações.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Bold of you to assume that
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Corajoso da sua parte assumir isso.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I try to match the audience
If I don't get home too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Se eu não chegar em casa muito tarde hoje à noite

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I can already transfer you 300 dollars
So I already received money for the work I did
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Então já recebi dinheiro pelo trabalho que fiz

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I do not even know how to thank you for doing all this
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Nem sei como te agradecer por fazer tudo isso

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: How was your second day of work?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Como foi seu segundo dia de trabalho?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: A smile and a kiss, then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Um sorriso e um beijo, então

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I may have to send you more of them
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Então talvez eu tenha que te enviar mais delas

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Come eat before dinner gets cold
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Vem comer antes que o jantar esfrie

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And do not go to bed too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: E não vá dormir muito tarde hoje à noite

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It was calmer than yesterday too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Foi mais calmo do que ontem também

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I managed to buy everything we needed
We are almost out of money

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I have decided to be useful tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Decidi ser útil hoje à noite

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So I am repaying my debt
{{name:hailey}} comes into your room to bring you food and clean your room
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: {{name:hailey}} entra no seu quarto pra te trazer comida e limpar

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am a generous little angel 😇
But you unplugged my whole PC while cleaning
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mas você desligou meu PC todo enquanto limpava

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: How dare you take a picture of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Como você se atreve a tirar uma foto minha?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It clearly shows you touching the cables
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Está claramente mostrando você tocando os cabos

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thanks for asking {{name:mason}} to pick me up
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Obrigada por pedir pro {{name:mason}} me buscar

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It shows a hardworking innocent girl being framed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mostra uma garota inocente e trabalhadora sendo incriminada

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally holding the cable
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você está literalmente segurando o cabo

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Maybe the cable attacked me first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Talvez o cabo tenha me atacado primeiro

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You do not know the full story
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você não sabe toda a história

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And you are taking secret pictures of me
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E você está tirando fotos secretas de mim

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Go revise before you destroy more electronics
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Vá revisar antes de destruir mais eletrônicos

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But if the PC dies, it was already weak
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mas se o PC morrer, ele já estava fraco

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Pico de frequência cardíaca detectado durante interação privada recente

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Captura emocional relevante arquivada como Prova HAK

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Being close to {{name:hailey}} stayed with me, and I want more moments like that.
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Estar perto de {{name:hailey}} ficou na minha cabeça, e quero mais momentos assim.
Então você está em casa segura?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Alive, safe, and only mildly dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Viva, segura e só um pouco dramática

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I still need to get home
I finally collapsed on the couch
And I'm stealing snacks from the kitchen like a little rat
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E estou roubando lanches da cozinha como um ratinho.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really sorry I missed your calls
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sinto muito por ter perdido suas chamadas.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a very glamorous day of stress and minor disasters
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tive um dia muito glamouroso de estresse e pequenos desastres.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And one customer who acted like I personally ruined his life
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E um cliente que agiu como se eu tivesse arruinado a vida dele pessoalmente.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I kept thinking about being home and talking to you though
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu continuei pensando em estar em casa e conversar com você, no entanto.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That part you can do now
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Essa parte você pode fazer agora

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's why I wanted to stay here with you a little longer
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: É por isso que eu queria ficar aqui com você um pouco mais.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You still shouldn't go to bed too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você ainda não deveria ir para a cama muito tarde.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just wanted a little more of you first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu só queria um pouco mais de você primeiro

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have more of me tomorrow
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você terá mais de mim amanhã

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And hopefully tomorrow will be easier for you too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E, espero que amanhã seja mais fácil para você também.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always say the annoyingly right thing 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você sempre diz a coisa irritantemente certa 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Go take your shower when you're done eating
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vá tomar seu banho quando terminar de comer.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And send you a pic of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E te enviar uma foto minha?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But only because I've missed you all day
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mas só porque eu senti sua falta o dia todo

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Promise you won't show it to anyone
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Prometa que você não vai mostrar a ninguém.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm still in my work clothes 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ainda estou com minhas roupas de trabalho 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look so good ( and sexy ) I almost died
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você está tão bem (e sexy) que quase morri.
Certo, essa é uma boa resposta

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I won't be able to right now

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu imaginei que você estivesse sobrecarregado.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It felt like the whole day was just problem after problem
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Parecia que o dia inteiro era apenas um problema atrás do outro.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You took that loss pretty hard
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Você levou essa derrota bem a sério.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That's a lot of excuses for one evening
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Muita desculpa pra uma noite só.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Next time we should bet something
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Na próxima vez, deveríamos apostar algo.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Loser owes the winner a favor
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: O perdedor deve um favor ao vencedor.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I hope you don't lose too often then 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Espero que você não perca muito então 😏

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Come get your ass kicked in 5 minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Vem levar uma surra em 5 minutos.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I've been waiting all day to make you cry
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Tô esperando o dia todo pra te fazer chorar.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll try not to laugh too much
We'll see who's laughing in a few minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Vamos ver quem vai rir em alguns minutos.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Do you need a teddy bear to sleep tonight? 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Você precisa de um ursinho pra dormir hoje à noite? 😏

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, I made breakfast for you 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ei, fiz café da manhã pra você 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I had plenty of time, so I made breakfast
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tive bastante tempo, então fiz café da manhã

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have to deal with your manager every day
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Você tem que lidar com seu gerente todo dia

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It's the least I can do around the house
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: É o mínimo que posso fazer em casa
Isso é muito gentil da sua parte

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'll be downstairs when you're ready
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Estarei lá embaixo quando você estiver pronta

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Okay, give me a few minutes 😊
Take your time getting up and get some rest
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Leve seu tempo para se levantar e descanse um pouco

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You had a long night at work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Você teve uma noite longa no trabalho

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm so sorry, I slept way too much
I didn't even hear my alarm
You worked late, it's normal to be tired
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Você trabalhou até tarde, é normal estar cansada

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said to come by if the second class exposes my tragic gaps
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele disse para eu passar se a segunda aula expor minhas lacunas trágicas

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm sure his words were nicer
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tenho certeza de que as palavras dele foram mais gentis

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are relying on him a lot
He just happens to know how to make my brain behave
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele só sabe como fazer meu cérebro funcionar

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now I have no excuse to fail
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Agora não tenho desculpa para falhar

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming both of you 💅
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se eu aprender algo contra a minha vontade, vou culpar vocês duas 💅
Bom dia. Mais ou menos, sim 😔
Eu preciso de todo mundo funcional

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And probably professor rescue after the second one
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E provavelmente resgate do professor depois da segunda

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Part-time job from morning to evening
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Trabalho de meio período das manhãs até as noites
O que você está vestindo hoje?
Foto rápida antes de eu ir 😅

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I can
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem quando puder.
Mas eu me sinto bem agora
O que você está fazendo hoje?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ei, como você está se sentindo esta manhã?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I was starting to think the doctor had fixed your personality too
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Estava começando a achar que o médico tinha consertado sua personalidade também

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Not even medicine can save yours
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Nem a medicina pode salvar a sua
Preciso da sua ajuda mais tarde

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I need to reconnect a few things in my room
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Preciso reconectar algumas coisas no meu quarto

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: The console, the screen and some cables
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: O console, a tela e alguns cabos

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And you need me for that?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: E você precisa de mim pra isso?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You might actually be useful for once
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Você pode ser útil de verdade uma vez

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Then your console can stay broken
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Então seu console pode continuar quebrado
Você não vai ouvir isso duas vezes

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Can't I ask how you're doing?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Não posso perguntar como você está?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It was almost better when you kept your mouth shut
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Era quase melhor quando você ficava calado

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks again for this morning
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Obrigada de novo por esta manhã

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That looks delicious
Good 😊
Then it was worth the effort
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Então valeu a pena o esforço

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: By the way, are you working the same hours tonight?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: A propósito, você vai trabalhar no mesmo horário hoje à noite?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: No
Since my manager is working tonight, I'm back to my usual schedule
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Como meu gerente está trabalhando hoje à noite, estou de volta ao meu horário normal

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I'll leave a little earlier
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Então vou sair um pouco mais cedo

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Then make sure you take some time for yourself before work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Então, certifique-se de tirar um tempo para você antes do trabalho

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I will 😊
I'm going to watch some TV for a bit
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou assistir um pouco de TV

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It's nothing, really
And then I'll start getting ready
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: E então vou começar a me arrumar

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That sounds like a good plan 😊
Maybe for you
But I still think it was really sweet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas ainda acho que foi muito doce

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I made a cake for you
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Então eu fiz um bolo para você

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You didn't have to do that
But I'm definitely not complaining 😄
I hope you'll like it
Wow

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If you get home early, you revise
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Se você chegar em casa cedo, você estuda

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor said he can bring me home when he's done with work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O professor disse que pode me levar pra casa quando terminar o trabalho

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So I am waiting in the school office
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Então estou esperando no escritório da escola

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It is quieter than the hallway
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Está mais quieto do que no corredor

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And he said he's almost done
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: E ele disse que está quase terminando

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So I will just wait here
It actually went kind of well
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Na verdade, foi até que bem

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject accepted professor's offer instead of waiting for alternative pickup
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O sujeito aceitou a oferta do professor em vez de esperar por outra carona

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Pattern of one-on-one contact frequency continues to increase
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Padrão de contato um-a-um continua a aumentar

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavior remains explainable but trend analysis flagged for review
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Comportamento permanece explicável, mas análise de tendências sinalizada para revisão

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: His help is becoming part of her routine, and that makes me uneasy.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: A ajuda dele está virando parte da rotina dela, e isso me deixa inquieto.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor provided transportation following a private revision session. Interaction remains within a plausible academic context, though HAK notes a growing pattern of personal assistance and increased familiarity.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O professor forneceu transporte após uma sessão de revisão privada. A interação permanece dentro de um contexto acadêmico plausível, embora as notas do HAK indiquem um padrão crescente de assistência pessoal e maior familiaridade.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm leaving the school office now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estou saindo do escritório da escola agora
Entendi mais do que o normal

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Do not say it like a proud spreadsheet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Não fala isso como uma planilha orgulhosa

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I feel safer asking when you are involved
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Me sinto mais segura pedindo quando você está envolvido

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You're using that leg as an excuse for everything now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Você está usando essa perna como desculpa pra tudo agora
Se chama trabalhar de forma mais inteligente

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really should stop watching business videos
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Você realmente deveria parar de assistir vídeos de negócios

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: So... are you bringing the groceries?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Então... você vai trazer as compras?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: But only because I don't trust you to shop alone
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Mas só porque não confio em você pra fazer compras sozinho
Viu? No fundo você é legal

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Just because I'm outside doesn't mean I'm your personal delivery service
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Só porque estou fora não significa que sou seu serviço de entrega pessoal

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Can't you help a poor injured man? 😔
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Você não pode ajudar um pobre homem machucado? 😔

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I'm about to leave for work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Oi, estou prestes a sair para o trabalho

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: 2 HOURS LATER
Hey, I'm on my break
How is it going?
It's okay
But we got the new outfits my manager ordered
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mas recebemos as novas roupas que meu gerente pediu

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And honestly I don't like them at all
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: E, sinceramente, não gostei delas nem um pouco

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: What do the others think about them?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: O que os outros acham delas?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Most of them are pretty divided

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Foi muito bom ter você aqui

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I don't want today to be a one time thing
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Porque eu não quero que hoje seja uma coisa única.
E... obrigado pelo que aconteceu mais cedo

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I really hope you liked it too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu realmente espero que você tenha gostado também.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Talking together about what I like before
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Falando juntos sobre o que eu gostava antes

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And moving forward while making your partner feel good too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E avançando enquanto faz seu parceiro se sentir bem também

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That worked really, really well for me ❤️
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Isso funcionou muito, muito bem para mim ❤️

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes me very happy to hear
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Isso me deixa muito feliz em ouvir.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I want more of that with you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Porque eu quero mais disso com você

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I need to calm down a little before bed 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Agora eu preciso me acalmar um pouco antes de dormir 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I already miss you a little
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E eu já sinto sua falta um pouco

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you have a good time?
And seeing you move more easily made me so happy
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E ver você se mover com mais facilidade me deixou tão feliz

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} keeps getting more competitive.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: As provocações entre você e {{name:mason}} estão ficando cada vez mais competitivas.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Every game now feels like a personal challenge.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Cada jogo agora parece um desafio pessoal.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm starting to care more about being there with {{name:mason}} than winning.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Estar ali com {{name:mason}} está começando a importar mais para mim do que ganhar.
Não me diga que você tá se escondendo

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You'll get a free lesson on how to exercise properly
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Você vai ganhar uma aula grátis sobre como se exercitar direito

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Had to be clean before destroying you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Tinha que estar limpa antes de te destruir

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: Repeated cardiac anomalies detected during today's private interactions
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Anomalias cardíacas repetidas detectadas durante as interações privadas de hoje.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: Relevant moments have been archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Momentos relevantes foram arquivados na Evidência HAK.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: The little moments with {{name:lena}} are staying with me more than I expected.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Os pequenos momentos com {{name:lena}} ficam na minha cabeça mais do que eu esperava.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ela nunca mais vai fazer barulho

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I mean she promised to be quieter
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Quero dizer, ela prometeu ser mais quieta

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: For a second I was actually worried
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Por um segundo eu realmente fiquei preocupada

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Although {{name:hailey}} is making enough noise for the whole house right now 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Embora {{name:hailey}} esteja fazendo barulho suficiente para a casa toda agora 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Can you tell her to be a little quieter?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Você pode pedir pra ela ser um pouco mais quieta?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Otherwise I'll have to go upstairs and do it myself
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Caso contrário, vou ter que subir e fazer isso eu mesma

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Study is killing me 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Estudar está me matando 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He heard me talk about it whith my friends
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele me ouviu falando sobre isso com meus amigos

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Apparently I have to come revise with him after class instead
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Aparentemente, eu tenho que revisar com ele depois da aula

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Seriously?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sério?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yes 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sim 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But then he made a deal with me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mas então ele fez um acordo comigo

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I do well on the quiz tomorrow, he will personally take me shopping himself
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se eu me sair bem no quiz amanhã, ele vai me levar pessoalmente para as compras

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said that?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele disse isso?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: YES 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: SIM 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said I need motivation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele disse que eu preciso de motivação

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And that he heard shopping is apparently my natural habitat
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E que ele ouviu que compras são aparentemente meu habitat natural

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: My brain is swollen
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Meu cérebro tá inchado

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which is rude but accurate 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: O que é rude, mas verdadeiro 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Look at this face
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Olha essa cara

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Does this look like someone built for revision suffering?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Isso parece alguém feita para sofrer revisando?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Looks like someone trying to negotiate her way out of studying
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Parece alguém tentando negociar uma saída do estudo

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Correct 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Correto 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But honestly the shopping promise is kind of motivating me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mas honestamente, a promessa de compras está me motivando um pouco

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I hate that it is working
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eu odeio que isso esteja funcionando

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Reward-based attention from an authority figure is strengthening emotional attachment patterns.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: A atenção baseada em recompensas de uma figura de autoridade está fortalecendo padrões de apego emocional.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ask why he wants to take her shopping
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pergunta por que ele quer te levar pra fazer compras.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Focus on helping her survive the quiz
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Foca em ajudar ela a sobreviver ao quiz.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably illegal
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Provavelmente ilegal

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why does he want to take you shopping himself?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Por que ele quer te levar pra fazer compras pessoalmente?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because apparently stressed students need rewards
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Porque, aparentemente, estudantes estressados precisam de recompensas.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And because he thinks I work better when I have motivation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E porque ele acha que eu trabalho melhor quando tenho motivação.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are making this sound way more dramatic than it is 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Você tá tornando isso muito mais dramático do que realmente é 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Survive the quiz first. Shopping after.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sobreviva ao quiz primeiro. Compras depois.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: See 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Viu? 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You and him are bullying me together now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Vocês dois estão me zoando juntos agora.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Huge morning today 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Manhã pesada hoje 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Fine
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tá bom

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I become the smartest girl alive, somebody defenetly owes me clothes 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se eu me tornar a garota mais inteligente do mundo, alguém definitivamente me deve roupas 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now let me survive this horrible morning first 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Agora deixa eu sobreviver a essa manhã horrível primeiro 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Afternoon free though
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mas a tarde está livre

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which means shopping should legally happen
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: O que significa que compras devem acontecer legalmente

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's not a good idea
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Isso não é uma boa ideia

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: 15 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 15 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is exactly what my professor said 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Foi exatamente isso que meu professor disse 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He literally told me I am not allowed to go shopping today
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele literalmente me disse que eu não posso ir às compras hoje

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Universidade primeiro, depois trabalhar de novo

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I think it'll be fine 🙂
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas eu acho que vai ficar tudo bem 🙂
Não comece a se preocupar já.
Difícil não fazer isso depois de ontem.
Mas ontem foi apenas uma bagunça.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want every morning to feel like an interrogation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu não quero que todas as manhãs pareçam um interrogatório.
Eu só me importo com você

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I care about you too
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E eu me importo com você também

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I just need you to trust me a little
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu só preciso que você confie em mim um pouco.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have to get ready now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu tenho que me preparar agora

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I fell asleep fast after yesterday 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu adormeci rápido depois de ontem 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll make sure you're the one getting dragged out of bed tomorrow
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Vou garantir que você seja a que vai ser arrastada da cama amanhã

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Keep talking and you'll be late for work
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Continue falando e você vai se atrasar para o trabalho

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: If you don't get up soon
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Se você não se levantar logo

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll drag my cast all the way to your room just to wake you up 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Vou arrastar meu gesso até o seu quarto só para te acordar 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Hey, I was looking for you
And you took a photo of me? 😳
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: E você tirou uma foto minha? 😳

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry, I didn't mean to make you uncomfortable
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Desculpa, não queria te deixar desconfortável

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Besides, you're right to take care of your body
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Além disso, você está certa em cuidar do seu corpo

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That's sweet of you to say
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: É gentil da sua parte dizer isso

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I just want to be in shape for tonight
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu só quero estar em forma para hoje à noite

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I did a little workout before getting ready
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Então eu fiz um pouco de exercício antes de me arrumar
Eu não consegui te encontrar em lugar nenhum

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Just don't push yourself too hard
How about we do it tomorrow?
I have to go get ready now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu preciso ir me preparar agora

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I wanted to ask if you wanted to walk a little with me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Queria perguntar se você queria caminhar um pouco comigo

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I didn't think to look for you in the garden
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Não pensei em te procurar no jardim

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'm glad you started yoga again 🙂
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas fico feliz que você tenha voltado a fazer yoga 🙂

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Which is good because I need it
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O que é bom porque eu preciso.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: When I think about all the things I will be able to choose with professor money 💅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quando eu penso em todas as coisas que vou poder escolher com o dinheiro do professor 💅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Do not get your hopes up
I just want to be hopeful for once 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Só quero ser esperançosa uma vez 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have been so stressed about school that I have not allowed myself to be excited about anything else
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tô tão estressada com a escola que não me deixei ficar animada com mais nada.
Me manda mensagem quando você sair.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Unexpected emotional variance detected during private revision session
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Variação emocional inesperada detectada durante a sessão de revisão privada.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavioral analysis indicates discomfort but excitement from subject {{name:hailey}}
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Análise comportamental indica desconforto, mas empolgação da sujeita {{name:hailey}}.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Observed interaction pattern exceeds expected academic boundaries
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Padrão de interação observado excede os limites acadêmicos esperados.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That sounds more personal than a revision session. I need to understand what's happening.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Isso parece mais pessoal do que uma sessão de revisão. Preciso entender o que está acontecendo.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK detected repeated body language markers and emotional responsiveness inconsistent with a standard teacher-student revision session
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK detectou marcadores de linguagem corporal repetidos e uma responsividade emocional inconsistente com uma sessão padrão de revisão professor-aluno
O professor disse a mesma coisa.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Then he made me correct the one answer I guessed
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Então ele me fez corrigir a única resposta que eu chutei.
Tô tão orgulhosa, mas com papelada.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I know, I am so happy 😭
He said I have to come by after class to review the quiz and go over the material I missed
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ele disse que eu tenho que passar lá depois da aula pra revisar o quiz e ver o material que eu perdi.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, i have a small break at work 🙂
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ei, eu tenho uma pequena pausa no trabalho 🙂

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm still faking half of it

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O que você está vestindo hoje?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's one way to say it 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Essa é uma maneira de dizer 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Quick one before I go back
Finally sitting down for a minute
You're lucky I had a second
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tem sorte de eu ter tido um segundo

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go before I get in trouble
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu preciso ir antes que eu me meta em problemas.
Vou te mandar uma mensagem mais tarde.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you have a good morning?
But today is better than yesterday
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mas hoje é melhor do que ontem

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I actually know what I'm doing now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Na verdade, eu sei o que estou fazendo agora.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Conversation tone no longer appears relaxed
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: O tom da conversa não parece mais relaxado

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I need to know whether {{name:mason}} is okay before I decide what this means.
