I'll dry myself quickly and bring you something to eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Vou me secar rápido e te trazer algo para comer

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am proud of your non-empty page
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Estou orgulhosa da sua página não vazia
Comportamento de tutor maligno de novo 💅

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is the face of a soldier between battles
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Esta é a cara de uma soldada entre batalhas

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Wow i'm starting to believe youre actually at war
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Uau, estou começando a acreditar que você realmente está em guerra

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But i am cute enough to survive
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Mas sou fofa o suficiente para sobreviver

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Go win the next round then
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Vai lá e ganha a próxima rodada então

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am going back to the front
If I fall, avenge me with tomorrow's shopping money 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Se eu cair, me vinga com o dinheiro das compras de amanhã 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And then I have more tests 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: E depois eu tenho mais provas 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: How did the first ones go?
Maybe my brain invented a new academic language
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Talvez meu cérebro tenha inventado uma nova língua acadêmica

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But I did not leave the page blank at least 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Mas pelo menos não deixei a página em branco 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: You say that like you don't enjoy watching the chaos
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Você diz isso como se não gostasse de assistir ao caos.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I just hope I don't finish too late tonight
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Eu só espero não terminar muito tarde esta noite.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: But I really want to talk whith you tonight ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Mas eu realmente quero conversar com você esta noite ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Then as soon as you get home we will talk
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Então, assim que você chegar em casa, nós vamos conversar.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: That gives me something nice to look forward to
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Isso me dá algo bom para esperar.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Okay, I should get back before lunch break disappears
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Certo, eu deveria voltar antes que o intervalo para o almoço desapareça.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Boa sorte pelo resto do dia

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Don't forget to move your body and don't play to much game
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Não se esqueça de mover seu corpo e não jogue tanto.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Just long and a little boring
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Apenas longo e um pouco chato

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: So basically a classic university morning 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Então, basicamente, uma manhã clássica na universidade 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I'm eating with my friends right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Estou comendo com meus amigos agora mesmo.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: And {{name:aiden}} apparently found another group of girls to annoy
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: E o {{name:aiden}} aparentemente encontrou outro grupo de garotas para incomodar
Ele está sendo fiel a si mesmo

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: We'll settle it on the game tonight
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Vamos resolver isso no jogo de hoje à noite

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe we should train somewhere else
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Talvez devêssemos treinar em outro lugar
Vamos tentar uma sessão de yoga

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: If you can with your cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Se você conseguir com esse gesso

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I've already seen people swimming with a cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Já vi gente nadando com gesso

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: She's probably better than both of us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ela provavelmente é melhor que nós duas

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You were actually pretty impressive for once
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Você foi realmente impressionante dessa vez

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Try not to sound too surprised
Don't let it get to your head
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Não deixa isso subir à sua cabeça
Hoje eu terminei o trabalho mais cedo

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: If you've got a problem with me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Se você tem um problema comigo

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I'll come downstairs and help you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Depois vou descer e te ajudar

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I can't let you do everything alone
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Não posso deixar você fazer tudo sozinha

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Would you like to continue the series?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Você gostaria de continuar a série?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: You don't even need to ask
I'm waiting for you on the couch 😌
I just finished brushing my teeth
Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Captura emocional relevante arquivada como Evidência HAK

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So I'm not imagining how close we've become.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Então não estou imaginando o quanto nos aproximamos.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I actually enjoy what I'm doing
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Na verdade, eu gosto do que estou fazendo

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Did you already start making dinner?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Você já começou a fazer o jantar?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am really proud of you
Later, after you brought food to {{name:hailey}} in her room
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mais tarde, depois que você trouxe comida para {{name:hailey}} no quarto dela

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I still cannot believe my private professor brought me food in bed 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ainda não consigo acreditar que meu professor particular me trouxe comida na cama 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That is not an excuse to stare at me while I eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Isso não é desculpa para me olhar enquanto eu como
Você deixou migalhas por toda parte

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You took a picture of me 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você tirou uma foto de mim 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally a paparazzi pervert
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você é literalmente uma paparazzi pervertida

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The evidence shows a tired innocent girl being harassed in her natural habitat 😔
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: As provas mostram uma garota cansada e inocente sendo assediada em seu habitat natural 😔

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are lucky I am exhausted
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você tem sorte de eu estar exausta

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Otherwise I would destroy you verbally right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Caso contrário, eu te destruiria verbalmente agora

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Pico de frequência cardíaca detectado durante interação privada recente

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Captura emocional relevante arquivada como Prova HAK

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I keep looking forward to those moments with her, even when I have no clever line ready.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Continuo ansioso por esses momentos com ela, mesmo quando não tenho nenhuma frase esperta pronta.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Tomorrow I am sleeping for ten years
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Amanhã vou dormir por dez anos

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You survived the whole day though
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mas você sobreviveu o dia todo

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am taking a shower and collapsing into my bed after this
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Vou tomar um banho e me jogar na cama depois disso

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Em casa mais cedo do que o esperado 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But first I'm going to take a shower and eat something
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mas primeiro eu vou tomar um banho e comer algo.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And yet you still like me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E ainda assim você ainda gosta de mim

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Keep it to yourself, of course
She knows exactly how to catch me off guard. Even now.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ela sabe exatamente como me pegar de surpresa. Até agora.
Você está batendo cada vez mais forte

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How am I supposed to stay calm now?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Como eu devo ficar calmo agora?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But maybe that's exactly what I was going for 🤍
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mas talvez isso seja exatamente o que eu estava buscando 🤍

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now let me eat before I become dramatic
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Agora me deixe comer antes que eu fique dramático.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But I expect another one later
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mas eu espero outro mais tarde.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because now I'm fed, clean, comfy, and all yours for the rest of the evening 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Porque agora estou alimentado, limpo, confortável e todo seu pelo resto da noite 😌
Eu sabia que você ia gostar.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you're keeping me company all night
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então você está me fazendo companhia a noite toda.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just need to get into bed and warm up a little, then I'm all yours
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu só preciso me deitar e me aquecer um pouco, então estou todo(a) seu(sua).

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the day actually went better than I thought it would
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E o dia realmente foi melhor do que eu pensei que seria.
Eu não estou nem tão cansado assim.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I have the whole evening for you ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então eu tenho a noite toda para você ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now that's exactly what I wanted to hear
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Agora isso é exatamente o que eu queria ouvir

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The playful rivalry between you and {{name:mason}} keeps escalating, turning every game into another excuse to get closer.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: A rivalidade brincalhona entre você e {{name:mason}} só aumenta, transformando cada jogo em uma desculpa pra ficarem mais próximos.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I knew you were a sore loser
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Eu sabia que você era um péssimo perdedor

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: But jumping on me so I couldn't win?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Mas pular em cima de mim pra eu não ganhar?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Didn't look like you hated it that much 😉
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Não parecia que você odiou tanto assim 😉

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Can we pretend that never happened?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Podemos fingir que isso nunca aconteceu?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Go to bed before I smash this cast over your head
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Vai dormir antes que eu quebre esse gesso na sua cabeça

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm going to be even stronger tonight 😏
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Vou ficar ainda mais forte hoje à noite 😏

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I just got out of the shower
If you started without me, you're dead
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Se você começou sem mim, tá morto

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I wouldn't steal your only chance to win 😂
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Eu não ia roubar sua única chance de ganhar 😂

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} is becoming more personal.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: As provocações entre você e {{name:mason}} estão ficando mais pessoais.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Another game feels like an excuse to stay close, and I'm happy to take it.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Mais uma partida parece uma desculpa para continuar perto, e fico feliz em aproveitar.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And explore a little further together
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: E explorar um pouco mais juntos

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: By learning what the other person likes and what feels good to them ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Aprendendo o que a outra pessoa gosta e o que faz bem para ela ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: That's exactly what I want too
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Isso é exatamente o que eu quero também

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Us figuring it out together feels right
Because I want it to stay like that with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Porque eu quero que fique assim com você

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now you're making me think too much before sleep
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Agora você está me fazendo pensar demais antes de dormir.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Then maybe I should make it worse
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Então talvez eu devesse piorar isso.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And way too proud of yourself
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: E muito orgulhoso de si mesmo

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You're making it very hard to act normal right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Você está tornando muito difícil agir normalmente agora.
Já estamos aprendendo o que funciona 😌
Estou aprendendo muito rápido esta noite.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want a lot more of this with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Porque eu quero muito mais disso com você

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You have no idea how happy that makes me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Você não tem ideia de como isso me deixa feliz.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I'm really happy we had that talk the other day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Estou realmente feliz por termos tido aquela conversa outro dia.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now I really have to sleep before I keep getting worse
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Agora eu realmente preciso dormir antes que eu continue piorando.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And try not to haunt me with those pictures
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: E tente não me assombrar com essas fotos

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: It feels really good when we're that honest with each other
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Sinto-me muito bem quando somos tão honestos um com o outro.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I feel so much better now that things are clearer between us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Eu me sinto muito melhor agora que as coisas estão mais claras entre nós.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And I really can't wait for us to open up more and more
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: E eu realmente não posso esperar para nós nos abrirmos cada vez mais.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And I'm sorry I let you make breakfast again
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: E eu sinto muito por deixar você fazer o café da manhã de novo

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm happy to take care of you for once
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Estou feliz em cuidar de você dessa vez

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I don't even know what to say to that
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Eu nem sei o que dizer a isso

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Just come downstairs when you're ready
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Apenas venha para baixo quando estiver pronta
Eu fiz o café da manhã de novo

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And before you ask, I'm fine
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: E antes que você pergunte, estou bem

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: So don't worry about me and get some rest
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Então não se preocupe comigo e descanse um pouco

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Last night must have been exhausting
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: A noite passada deve ter sido cansativa

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: More like he already decided I am not allowed
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mais como se ele já tivesse decidido que eu não posso

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Do not make me analyze it before battle
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Não me faça analisar isso antes da batalha

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Professor voice and your voice are merging in my head
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: A voz do professor e a sua estão se misturando na minha cabeça

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: See you after the first battle 🤍
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Te vejo depois da primeira batalha 🤍

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is definitely a soldier face
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Isso é definitivamente uma cara de soldado

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Professor made me review until my soul left my body yesterday

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Então você gostaria de compartilhar esse momento comigo?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Maybe not knowing would make it stronger
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Talvez não saber tornaria isso mais forte.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So the mystery would be part of it?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Então o mistério faria parte disso?
Isso é uma informação muito perigosa 😳

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: You're really trying to understand this, huh
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Você realmente está tentando entender isso, né?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: And maybe I like the way you react 😌
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: E talvez eu goste da maneira como você reage 😌
Sobre essa sua coisa de chifrudo

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: But I feel safe doing this with you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Mas eu me sinto seguro fazendo isso com você

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Now I really need to stop before I go too far 😭
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Agora eu realmente preciso parar antes que eu vá longe demais 😭

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Yeah... same here, it's getting harder to keep it together
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Sim... aqui também, está ficando mais difícil manter a compostura.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Be ready for next time then 😏
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Esteja preparado para a próxima vez então 😏

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I'm trying to understand how it feels for you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Estou tentando entender como isso se sente para você

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Like… what exactly makes it exciting in your head
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Tipo... o que exatamente torna isso empolgante na sua cabeça?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: If you try to act tough and mess it up right away I will judge you loudly
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Se você tentar agir durão e estragar tudo na hora, eu vou te julgar em voz alta.
Claro! Por favor, forneça o diálogo do jogo que você gostaria que eu traduzisse.

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Only one week of classes left
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Falta apenas uma semana de aulas.

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: What are you planning to do
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: O que você está planejando fazer

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Any news on when that cast comes off?
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Alguma novidade sobre quando vão tirar esse gesso?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: And drag you with me once your leg is ready
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: E te arrastar comigo assim que sua perna estiver pronta

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: That's suppose to be a good thing?
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Isso deveria ser uma coisa boa?
O arco de férias começa em breve 😎

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: The doctor is checking my leg today, so I should know more after that
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: O médico vai examinar minha perna hoje, então depois vou saber mais

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Your leg has been in there long enough
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Sua perna já ficou aí dentro por tempo demais

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I hope so, but I'm waiting to hear what he says
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Espero que sim, mas vou esperar pra ver o que ele diz

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Even if it comes off, take it slow
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Mesmo que tirem, vai com calma

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: No celebrating with a sprint down the stairs
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Nada de comemorar descendo a escada correndo

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I'll ask him what I can do before I try anything
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Vou perguntar o que posso fazer antes de tentar qualquer coisa

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Bom dia 😊

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: But I think I got enough rest
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Mas acho que descansei o suficiente
Isso é bom

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: By the way, I sent you some money this morning
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: A propósito, te mandei um dinheiro essa manhã

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: For groceries, bills and everything else
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Para compras, contas e tudo mais
Sério?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I really don't know how to thank you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Eu realmente não sei como te agradecer

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You already do enough for me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Você já faz tanto por mim
Você já fez muito

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You deserve to rest and enjoy yourself a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Você merece descansar e se divertir um pouco

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And honestly, I'm happy I get to spend so much time with you lately
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: E, honestamente, estou feliz por passar tanto tempo com você ultimamente
Como você está se sentindo hoje?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: It feels like we've gotten a lot closer
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Parece que nos aproximamos bastante
Eu também estou feliz

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I like spending more time with you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Gosto de passar mais tempo com você
Mais do que eu esperava, na verdade 😌
De qualquer forma, não esquece

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: The doctor is coming after work today
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: O médico vem depois do trabalho hoje
Então se prepare pra isso
Isso deve ser tranquilo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Actually, I wanted to ask you something
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Na verdade, eu queria te perguntar uma coisa

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Would it be easier if I kept some food in my room for lunch?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Seria mais fácil se eu deixasse comida no meu quarto para o almoço?
Você não está muito cansada?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: That way I wouldn't have to bother you every day
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Assim eu não precisaria te incomodar todo dia
Você não me incomoda.
Nem um pouco.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I actually like taking care of you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Na verdade, eu gosto de cuidar de você

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: So whenever you're hungry, just tell me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Então sempre que você estiver com fome, é só me avisar

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And I'll bring you a hot meal
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: E eu trago uma refeição quentinha pra você
Obrigada, {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'll talk to you later then
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Falo com você mais tarde então
Boa sorte no trabalho 😊

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: We went to bed pretty late yesterday
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Fomos dormir bem tarde ontem
Estou bem.
Eu dormi muito bem, na verdade.
E você?
Você dormiu bem?
Eu dormi razoavelmente bem.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I woke up a few times during the night
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Acordei algumas vezes durante a noite.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Meu corpo heroico precisa de recuperação

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You cannot just skip because you are tired
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Você não pode simplesmente pular porque está cansado

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I can if I pay the tutor tax
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Posso sim, se eu pagar o imposto do tutor

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You earned a bit of rest
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Você merece um pouco de descanso

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I knew you were secretly reasonable 💅
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Eu sabia que você era secretamente razoável 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: The court has ruled in my favor 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: O tribunal decidiu a meu favor 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Besides, I need to be in top condition for shopping this afternoon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Além disso, preciso estar em ótima forma para as compras esta tarde

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Of course that is your priority
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Claro que essa é sua prioridade
A recuperação da moda é sagrada 😇

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I am still in bed and i don't plan on leaving
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ainda estou na cama e não pretendo sair

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And my bed is also holding me hostage
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: E minha cama também me mantém refém

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So what are you doing today?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então, o que você está fazendo hoje?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And I want to use that time to go shopping for our date tomorrow 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E eu quero usar esse tempo para fazer compras para o nosso encontro amanhã 😌
É melhor você me manter atualizado.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll send you the outfits so you can tell me which one you like most ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vou te enviar as roupas para você me dizer qual você mais gosta ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You in different outfits sounds dangerous already
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você em diferentes roupas já soa perigoso.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I'll make sure to send you the hardest choices
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então eu vou garantir que te envie as escolhas mais difíceis.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I need to thank you again for last night
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Preciso te agradecer novamente pela noite passada.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And for spoiling me that much
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E por me mimar tanto assim

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You spoil me too, you know
That's exactly how it should be
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: É exatamente assim que deve ser

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Still sore in a few places
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Ainda tô dolorido em alguns lugares

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Try not to complain too much

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Isso é engraçado vindo de você
Ainda tô dolorido em todo lugar

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: But I might get the cast off soon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Mas talvez eu consiga tirar o gesso logo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: After that I'll be able to move properly again
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Depois disso, vou conseguir me mover direito de novo
Então você vai ter menos desculpas

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Unlike you, I can get ready without turning it into a medical operation
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Diferente de você, eu consigo me arrumar sem transformar isso em uma operação médica

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: It's not exactly easy to put on with the cast
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Não é exatamente fácil de colocar com a gesso

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: So the cast is now losing against clothes too
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Então o gesso agora tá perdendo pra roupas também

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Let's go before you need a break from getting dressed
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Vamos antes que você precise de uma pausa pra se vestir

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Everything seems to be healing correctly
But he also made me do a lot of movements
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Mas ele também me fez fazer muitos movimentos

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: And now it's starting to hurt a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: E agora está começando a doer um pouco

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you bring me some ice?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Você poderia me trazer um pouco de gelo?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I think I'm just going to let it rest for an hour
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Acho que vou deixar descansar por uma hora

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Just let me know if you need anything
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Só me avise se precisar de algo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: He's about to come up and examine you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ele está prestes a subir e te examinar

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Let's start with the school outfits
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Vamos começar com os looks da escola
Agora é a rodada dos looks do dia 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You officially influenced my wardrobe now
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Você oficialmente influenciou meu guarda-roupa agora

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: If I look too good later, that is your fault 💅
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Se eu ficar muito boa depois, a culpa é sua 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will keep shopping a little

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: O campo de batalha tá lindo 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Meu chefe acabou de me mandar uma mensagem

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I meant settling it by fighting
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu quis dizer resolver isso lutando

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You can't hit someone who's already injured
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Você não pode bater em alguém que já tá machucado

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll kill you on the game instead
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou te matar no jogo em vez disso

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Try not to cry when you lose

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: E por que eu me importaria?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Because now you have more time to annoy me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Porque agora você tem mais tempo pra me irritar

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I've never seen someone so stiff
Even with a cast, I think I did better
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Mesmo com o gesso, acho que me saí melhor
Isso não é flexibilidade, isso é trapaça

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Turns out jump rope wasn't your only weakness
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Parece que pular corda não era sua única fraqueza

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I just chose not to look good doing it
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Só escolhi não parecer bem fazendo isso

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll wait for you on the game

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm just a little stuck in the shower
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Estou só um pouco preso no chuveiro
Ainda bem que meu celular estava por perto

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So you're telling me you're trapped in the shower? 😄
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Então você está me dizendo que está preso no chuveiro? 😄

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And you're still naked as a worm?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: E você ainda está pelado como um verme?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Significant emotional tension detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Tensão emocional significativa detectada durante a interação privada recente

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Elevated heartbeat and embarrassment markers recorded
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Batimentos cardíacos elevados e marcadores de embaraço registrados

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Captura emocional relevante arquivada como Evidência HAK

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm not the only one feeling this. That makes it harder to ignore.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Não sou o único sentindo isso. Assim fica mais difícil ignorar.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And sorry about the awkward situation
It's not the first naked man I've ever seen
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Não é o primeiro homem pelado que eu já vi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: That somehow doesn't make me feel less embarrassed
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Isso de alguma forma não me faz sentir menos envergonhada
Eu só não estava esperando... isso
Enfim, o jantar está quase pronto

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'll bring you something to eat soon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Vou te trazer algo para comer logo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'll come down a little later for dinner
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Vou descer um pouco mais tarde para o jantar

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Are you sure everything is okay?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Você tem certeza de que está tudo bem?
Diga a ela que você precisa de ajuda
Diga a ela que está tudo bem

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But tell me if you need anything
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Mas me avise se precisar de algo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm bringing you some ice for your leg
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Estou trazendo gelo para sua perna

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: You should rest as much as possible tonight
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Você deveria descansar o máximo possível esta noite

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It will help your leg recover properly
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Isso vai ajudar sua perna a se recuperar direito

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: DIA 15 — Depois de examinar sua perna, o médico retirou o gesso. Agora você pode se movimentar com mais liberdade, mas sua perna ainda precisa de repouso.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: O que você faria se estivesse em uma situação delicada com alguém

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But the lives of the people around you depended on that person?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas as vidas das pessoas ao seu redor dependessem dessa pessoa?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I don't think there's a right or wrong answer
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Não acho que haja uma resposta certa ou errada

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But you should choose what matters most to you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas você deve escolher o que mais importa para você

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He's just paying for my shopping
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ele só está pagando pelas minhas compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So today I am listening to the man who protects shopping
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Então hoje estou ouvindo o homem que protege as compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I will show you some of the outfits I'm trying on
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou te mostrar algumas das roupas que estou experimentando
Vamos começar com as roupas da escola

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: External preference contamination possible. Subject may ask for input while prioritizing a different authority.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Contaminação de preferência externa possível. O sujeito pode pedir opinião enquanto prioriza uma autoridade diferente.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm asking professor for fashion advice now
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estou pedindo conselhos de moda para o professor agora

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor said something like that color suits presentations
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O professor disse que essa cor combina com apresentações

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Your choice was unfortunately not the one I chose
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sua escolha, infelizmente, não foi a que eu escolhi

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe you will win the next one 😌
Because he has opinions about presentations
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Porque ele tem opiniões sobre apresentações

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And why is he the one who take pictures of you trying on clothes?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: E por que ele é quem tira fotos de você experimentando roupas?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because he's paying for my shopping, okay, there's nothing weird about that?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Porque ele está pagando minhas compras, tá, não tem nada de estranho nisso?
Agora é a rodada de roupas do dia

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Repeated reference to professor approval detected during clothing decisions.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Referência repetida à aprovação do professor detectada durante as decisões de roupas.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe a little too cute for serious student era
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Talvez um pouco fofo demais para a era de estudante séria

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The battlefield is beautiful and he's already here 😌
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O campo de batalha é lindo e ele já está aqui 😌

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why ask me if you want his approval?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Por que me perguntar se você quer a aprovação dele?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I wanted to be nice to you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu queria ser legal com você

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If you're going to be like that, I won't ask you anymore
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Se você vai ficar assim, não vou mais te perguntar

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry, I didn't mean to upset you
I'm so happy I passed the exam!!
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estou tão feliz que passei na prova!!

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Wait, your realy showing that to him?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Espera, você realmente vai mostrar isso pra ele?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Of course, he's paying for my shopping, I have to show him the options I'm considering
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Claro, ele está pagando minhas compras, preciso mostrar as opções que estou considerando

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don't start again, give me an answer or I won't ask you anymore
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Não comece de novo, me dá uma resposta ou não vou mais te perguntar

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Choice influence weakened. Subject is no longer considering your approval as a primary factor.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Influência da escolha enfraquecida. O sujeito não está mais considerando sua aprovação como um fator principal.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see what professor thinks about that one
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vamos ver o que o professor acha daquela

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see what professor thinks about that one
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vamos ver o que o professor acha daquela

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm continuing a little more shopping
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou continuar comprando mais um pouco

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I will be home in time for dinner
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estarei em casa a tempo para o jantar

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Yes, professor said I should be home for dinner
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sim, o professor disse que eu deveria estar em casa para o jantar

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Wardrobe decision dialogue contains repeated third-party approval references
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O diálogo sobre a decisão do guarda-roupa contém referências repetidas à aprovação de terceiros

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject response pattern shows delayed alignment with {{name:player}}'s input
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O padrão de resposta do sujeito mostra alinhamento atrasado com a entrada de {{name:player}}

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Metadata indicates three visual fragments captured inside the store changing room
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Os metadados indicam três fragmentos visuais capturados dentro do provador da loja

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It stings that she kept asking for my opinion while his was the one that counted.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Dói que ela tenha continuado pedindo minha opinião quando a dele era a que contava.
Lacuna na linha do tempo das compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived a visual fragment from the shopping session. Subject posture and proximity markers suggest emotional tension inconsistent with normal shopping assistance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK arquivou um fragmento visual da sessão de compras. A postura do sujeito e os marcadores de proximidade sugerem tensão emocional inconsistente com a assistência normal de compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recovered an unsent changing-room image from the shopping session metadata.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK recuperou uma imagem não enviada do provador a partir dos metadados da sessão de compras.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recovered a second unsent changing-room image from the same store session.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK recuperou uma segunda imagem não enviada do provador da mesma sessão de loja.
Segunda Imagem Não Enviada do Vestiário

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don't worry, I will be careful
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Não se preocupa, vou ter cuidado

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And professor is a good guy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: E o professor é um cara legal

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Some of us are actually competent
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Alguns de nós são realmente competentes

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember that when you're asking me for favors
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Vou lembrar disso quando você me pedir favores

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Do we let the front door unlocked tonight?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Deixamos a porta da frente destrancada hoje à noite?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Otherwise I'll just climb through your window
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Caso contrário, vou entrar pela sua janela
Te vejo hoje à noite então

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Your leftovers saved my lunch today
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Suas sobras salvaram meu almoço hoje

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: They even talked to me about a promotion
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Eles até falaram comigo sobre uma promoção

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Estou saindo para o trabalho agora

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I might not even get a break
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Eu talvez nem consiga uma pausa

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But if you really can't, then at least be careful and take care of yourself
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mas se você realmente não puder, pelo menos tenha cuidado e se cuide
Evento de resposta emocional alta detectado

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Alcohol exposure and elevated excitement levels observed
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Exposição ao álcool e níveis de excitação elevados observados

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Multiple interaction markers exceeded expected thresholds
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Múltiplos marcadores de interação ultrapassaram os limites esperados

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I hope she's all right. Those numbers don't tell me what she actually wants.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Espero que ela esteja bem. Esses números não me dizem o que ela realmente quer.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: HAK archived footage from a high-energy shift showing unusually elevated emotional engagement during service
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Imagens arquivadas do HAK de um turno de alta energia mostrando um engajamento emocional incomumente elevado durante o serviço

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Everything is ready in the kitchen if you need anything
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tudo está pronto na cozinha se você precisar de algo

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: DIA 15 — Depois de examinar sua perna, o médico retirou o gesso. Agora você pode se movimentar com mais liberdade, mas sua perna ainda precisa de repouso.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thank you for still taking care of me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Obrigada por ainda cuidar de mim

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You really don't have to do all this
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Você realmente não precisa fazer tudo isso

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I just want to take care of the people around me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Eu só quero cuidar das pessoas ao meu redor

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But make sure you take care of yourself too
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mas se certifique de cuidar de si mesma também

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Remember, tonight is going to be really busy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Lembre-se, a noite vai ser bem movimentada

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I wanted to thank you both
You don't have to thank me
I know that I have been a mess this week
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eu sei que fui um caos essa semana

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I feel bad about it
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: E me sinto mal por isso

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You don't have to feel bad about that
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Você não precisa se sentir mal por isso
Eu sei, mas eu me sinto

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Shopping session timeline contains unresolved gaps
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: A linha do tempo da sessão de compras tem lacunas não resolvidas

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Emotional stress pattern suggests a possible undisclosed event
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: O padrão de estresse emocional sugere um possível evento não revelado

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Review the previously archived shopping evidence
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Reveja as provas da sessão de compras arquivadas anteriormente

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Her guilt makes me anxious, but I still don't know what she hasn't told me.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: A culpa dela me deixa ansioso, mas ainda não sei o que ela não me contou.
Lacuna na linha do tempo das compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived a visual fragment from the shopping session. Subject posture and proximity markers suggest emotional tension inconsistent with normal shopping assistance

Não se preocupa, não é nada ruim

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway, I just wanted to say thank you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: De qualquer forma, só queria agradecer

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And tomorrow I need to see professor
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: E amanhã preciso ver o professor

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can come by
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ele disse que posso passar lá

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Just to return a book and talk about the next exam plan
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Só pra devolver um livro e falar sobre o plano da próxima prova

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I am fine, you're the one making it weird
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eu tô bem, você que tá deixando tudo estranho

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I have to be up early tomorrow
DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: DIA 15 — Depois de examinar sua perna, o médico retirou o gesso. Agora você pode se movimentar com mais liberdade, mas sua perna ainda precisa de repouso.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Are you sure everything is okay?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tem certeza de que tá tudo bem?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: My professor helped a lot too

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: New AlphaMana activity aligns with previous captures
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: Nova atividade AlphaMana se alinha com capturas anteriores

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: A captura relevante foi arquivada na Evidência HAK.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to worry about me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não precisa se preocupar comigo

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The doctor took the cast off today. I still need to take it easy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O médico tirou o gesso hoje. Ainda preciso me cuidar

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you sure your manager is treating you well?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você tem certeza de que seu gerente está te tratando bem?
Eu te disse que ele é

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What is that supposed to mean?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso não é o que eu disse

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm already having a bad day
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Já estou tendo um dia ruim

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't need this right now

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu pensei que você confiava em mim

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then believe me when I say things are fine
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então acredite em mim quando digo que as coisas estão bem

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I feel like everything just keeps piling up
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sinto que tudo continua se acumulando.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thank you, that means a lot

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas por favor, confie em mim

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DIA 15 — Depois de examinar sua perna, o médico retirou o gesso. Agora você pode se movimentar com mais liberdade, mas sua perna ainda precisa de repouso.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'll leave the back door unlocked for you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Vou deixar a porta dos fundos destrancada pra você

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Have fun with your imaginary friends
They're still more believable than yours
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eles ainda são mais críveis que os seus

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: That alert stings, but it doesn't tell me what {{name:mason}} wanted.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Esse alerta dói, mas não me diz o que {{name:mason}} queria.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:mason}} is seen being kissed during the late-night meeting after leaving the gym.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:mason}} foi vista sendo beijada durante a reunião noturna depois de sair da academia.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Uma piscina? Sério?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really had to bring that up again
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Você realmente teve que trazer isso de novo.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm going to kill you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Vou te matar.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good luck catching me from the deep end 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Boa sorte me pegando no fundo da piscina 😂.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Have fun
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Divirta-se.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: A little water will do you good
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Um pouco de água vai te fazer bem.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You do remember I can barely swim, right?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Você lembra que eu mal consigo nadar, né?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Não se preocupe

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Chris is a really good swimmer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: O Chris é um nadador muito bom.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And what the fuck is this swimsuit you prepared for me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: E que porra é esse maiô que você preparou pra mim?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Unfortunately, that's the only one I could find
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Infelizmente, foi o único que consegui encontrar.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm going to haunt you forever for this
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu vou te assombrar pra sempre por isso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And with that great ass of yours, you'll float no matter what so don't worry
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: E com essa bunda maravilhosa que você tem, você vai flutuar de qualquer jeito, então não se preocupe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I might come home late, so do not worry too much
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Posso chegar em casa tarde, então não se preocupe muito
Vou esperar por você de qualquer forma
Padrão de proximidade no final da noite atualizado

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Sustained intimate interaction exceeds previous date baseline
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Interação íntima sustentada excede a linha de base do encontro anterior

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Relevant capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Captura relevante arquivada como Evidência HAK

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Their evening clearly mattered to her. How do I feel about where this is going?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Aquela noite claramente foi importante para ela. Como me sinto com o rumo que isso está tomando?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:evelyn}} sharing a close late-evening kiss with her returning client after dinner
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de {{name:evelyn}} compartilhando um beijo próximo no final da noite com seu cliente que voltou após o jantar

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: DIA 15 — Depois de examinar sua perna, o médico retirou o gesso. Agora você pode se movimentar com mais liberdade, mas sua perna ainda precisa de repouso.
