story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: We are in a very fancy restaurant
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Estamos em um restaurante bem chique

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: He is paying for everything, and he is being incredibly kind
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ele está pagando tudo e está sendo incrivelmente gentil

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I am honestly having a wonderful time
I'm really glad to hear that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Fico muito feliz em ouvir isso

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Dinner felt special. You were kind, elegant, and exactly who I wanted there.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: O jantar foi especial. Você foi gentil, elegante e exatamente quem eu queria lá.
Conteúdo do jantar com Lucas desbloqueado.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But honestly I'm mostly relieved that it's over
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mas, honestamente, estou mais aliviada que tudo isso acabou

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: For once I actually feel proud of myself 😊
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Finalmente estou me sentindo orgulhosa de mim mesma 😊

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: All those hours of studying finally paid off 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Todas aquelas horas de estudo finalmente valeram a pena 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Even if I complained the whole time
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mesmo que eu tenha reclamado o tempo todo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: No signs of hesitation detected during the exchange
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Nenhum sinal de hesitação detectado durante a troca
Estimativa de confiança no relacionamento aumentada

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A kiss makes this feel different from helping her study, and I'm not as detached as I sound.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Um beijo faz isso parecer diferente de ajudá-la a estudar, e não sou tão indiferente quanto pareço.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived visual evidence of {{name:hailey}} rewarding Ethan with a kiss following a successful tutoring session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK arquivou evidências visuais de {{name:hailey}} recompensando Ethan com um beijo após uma sessão de tutoria bem-sucedida

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Wow you're really sending me that ??
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Uau, você realmente está me enviando isso??

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Well it's a reward for you too 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Bem, é uma recompensa pra você também 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You don't let any opportunity slip by!
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Você não deixa passar nenhuma oportunidade!

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Now I just have to wait for the results 😩
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Agora eu só preciso esperar pelos resultados 😩

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We talked about the exam for a while
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Nós falamos sobre o exame por um tempo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But maybe it won't be that bad, if I fail at least I will get punished 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mas talvez não seja tão ruim, se eu falhar, pelo menos vou ser punida 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It's supposed to be a bad thing!
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Isso deveria ser uma coisa ruim!

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: DIA 15 — Depois de examinar sua perna, o médico retirou o gesso. Agora você pode se movimentar com mais liberdade, mas sua perna ainda precisa de repouso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Ethan thinks I did better than I think I did
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: O Ethan acha que eu me saí melhor do que eu acho

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm still overthinking a few questions
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ainda estou pensando demais em algumas perguntas

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Everyone does that after an exam
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Todo mundo faz isso depois de um exame

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now I need to calm down again before bed 😭
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Agora eu preciso me acalmar novamente antes de dormir 😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I make it worse before bed? 😏
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Devo piorar as coisas antes de dormir? 😏

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really want to kill me
But keeping you awake… I'm guilty 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas te mantendo acordado... Eu sou culpado 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DIA 15 — Depois de examinar sua perna, o médico retirou o gesso. Agora você pode se movimentar com mais liberdade, mas sua perna ainda precisa de repouso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The doctor removed the cast today
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O médico tirou o gesso hoje

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay I need a shower now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, eu preciso de um banho agora.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to send it to someone else instead?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você quer que eu envie para outra pessoa em vez disso?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Trying to understand what you like
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tentando entender o que você gosta

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I want to see how you react
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E eu quero ver como você reage

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If I was going to do something like that…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se eu fosse fazer algo assim...

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Who would you want it to be with?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Com quem você gostaria que fosse?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like… who would you want me to send it to?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tipo... para quem você gostaria que eu enviasse?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably someone I don't really know
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Provavelmente alguém que eu realmente não conheço

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think the idea of a stranger makes it intense
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Acho que a ideia de um estranho torna tudo intenso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And maybe safer, for the private part
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E talvez mais seguro, para a parte íntima.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas você não tem medo de que ele tente me roubar?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: then, why not, if we find the right person
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: então, por que não, se encontrarmos a pessoa certa

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kinda… already thought about it…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu meio que... já pensei sobre isso...

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too many classes, too many people 😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas ele também é meu amigo.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And we don't even know if he would agree
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E nós nem sabemos se ele concordaria

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We both know he's a real charmer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nós dois sabemos que ele é um verdadeiro encantador.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he always looks at you like that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E ele sempre te olha assim.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I see him, he doesn't hide it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu o vejo, ele não esconde isso

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little… but more like jealous… and excited
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco… mas mais como ciumento… e animado

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proud that my girlfriend is that beautiful
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E orgulhoso que minha namorada é tão bonita

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wow… that's really sweet… and hot
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uau… isso é realmente doce… e quente

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We did say we would explore this
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nós dissemos que iríamos explorar isso

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why not with someone I trust?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por que não com alguém em quem confio?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas você não tem medo de que ele tente me roubar?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So, you didn't drown?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Então, você não se afogou?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You sent me to a pool in that swimsuit with your best friend knowing I can barely swim
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Você me mandou para uma piscina com aquele maiô e sua melhor amiga sabendo que eu mal sei nadar

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're about as innocent as a serial killer holding the knife
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Você é tão inocente quanto um serial killer segurando a faca.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: And {{name:aiden}} have the best tan of the year, unlike me
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: E {{name:aiden}} tá com o melhor bronze do ano, diferente de mim

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm as white as a ghost compared to him
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu sou tão branca quanto um fantasma comparada a ele

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: That's for sure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Isso é verdade

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm sure you had a good time at the pool anyway
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tenho certeza que você se divertiu na piscina mesmo assim.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu não disse isso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: But you're not denying it either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mas você também não tá negando.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Shut up
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Cala a boca

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sounds like my best friend is growing on you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Parece que minha melhor amiga tá te conquistando

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I found your old swimsuit by the way
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu encontrei seu maiô antigo, a propósito.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: This is only the beginning of the war
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Isso é só o começo da guerra.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: With pleasure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Com prazer

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sincerely, your secretary
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sinceramente, sua secretária

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Too bad
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Que pena

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 25 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Unusual physical proximity detected in the swimming pool
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Proximidade física incomum detectada na piscina.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason relied heavily on {{name:aiden}} during the session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:aiden}} foi um grande apoio para o Mason durante a sessão

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: An intense interaction occurred between Mason and his coach
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Uma interação intensa ocorreu entre Mason e seu treinador.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I want {{name:mason}} to feel free to choose, even while I'm figuring out where that leaves me.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Quero que {{name:mason}} tenha liberdade para escolher, mesmo enquanto tento entender onde isso me deixa.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: HAK//INTENSE PROXIMITY DETECTED
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: HAK//PROXIMIDADE INTENSA DETECTADA

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Pool assistance
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Assistência na piscina.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason and {{name:aiden}} experienced an intense moment of physical proximity during the swimming session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason e {{name:aiden}} tiveram um momento intenso de proximidade física durante a sessão de natação

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Pool assistance
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Assistência na piscina.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 50 minutes later
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 50 minutos depois.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: My new mission in life is to make yours miserable
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Minha nova missão na vida é tornar a sua miserável.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I don't understand why
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu não entendo por quê.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm completely innocent
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu sou completamente inocente.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So, you didn't drown?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Então, você não se afogou?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You sent me to a pool in that swimsuit knowing I can barely swim
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Você me mandou pra uma piscina com esse maiô sabendo que eu mal consigo nadar.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're about as innocent as a serial killer holding the knife
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Você é tão inocente quanto um serial killer segurando a faca.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm sure you had a good time at the pool anyway
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tenho certeza que você se divertiu na piscina mesmo assim.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu não disse isso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: But you're not denying it either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mas você também não tá negando.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Shut up
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Cala a boca

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sounds like your torturer is growing on you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Parece que seu torturador tá te conquistando.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: This is only the beginning of the war
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Isso é só o começo da guerra.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: With pleasure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Com prazer

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sincerely, your secretary
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sinceramente, sua secretária

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I found your old swimsuit by the way
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu encontrei seu maiô antigo, a propósito.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Too bad
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Que pena

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 25 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Unusual physical proximity detected in the swimming pool
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Proximidade física incomum detectada na piscina.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason relied heavily on Chris during the session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: O Mason contou muito com o Chris durante a sessão.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: An intense interaction occurred between Mason and his coach
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Uma interação intensa ocorreu entre Mason e seu treinador.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I want {{name:mason}} to feel free to choose, even while I'm figuring out where that leaves me.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Quero que {{name:mason}} tenha liberdade para escolher, mesmo enquanto tento entender onde isso me deixa.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: HAK//INTENSE PROXIMITY DETECTED
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: HAK//PROXIMIDADE INTENSA DETECTADA

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Pool assistance
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Assistência na piscina.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason and Chris experienced an intense moment of physical proximity during the swimming session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason e Chris viveram um momento intenso de proximidade física durante a sessão de natação.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Pool assistance
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Assistência na piscina.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 50 minutes later
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 50 minutos depois.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: My new mission in life is to make yours miserable
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Minha nova missão na vida é tornar a sua miserável.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I don't understand why
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu não entendo por quê.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm completely innocent
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eu sou completamente inocente.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: DIA 15 — Depois de examinar sua perna, o médico retirou o gesso. Agora você pode se movimentar com mais liberdade, mas sua perna ainda precisa de repouso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: ( CONTINUE )
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: ( CONTINUAR )

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: DESENVOLVEDOR

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Pontos HAK suficientes acumulados
Nova habilidade disponível: Transcrição ao Vivo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Captura conversas que estão acontecendo em outros lugares monitorando pessoas de interesse
HAK//HABILIDADE DISPONÍVEL
Talvez eu use

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I feel like drawing a bit of attention
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Se eu estiver a fim de chamar um pouco de atenção

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t get used to being right
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Não se acostume a estar certo
É um hábito perigoso
Enfim
Bom dia

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I’ve been thinking about last night
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Estive pensando sobre a noite passada
Mais do que eu queria
Qual parte?
Você sabe qual parte
A foto

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I keep wondering what you actually thought when you received it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Fico me perguntando o que você realmente pensou quando a recebeu

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I thought about it more than I should have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Pensei nela mais do que deveria
Você ficou bonita nela

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s more honest than I expected
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Isso é mais honesto do que eu esperava

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I tried the outfit you chose for me again this morning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Experimentei a roupa que você escolheu para mim de novo esta manhã

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I don’t know if that makes it better or worse
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Não sei se isso torna as coisas melhores ou piores
Só isso?
Você ainda está sendo cauteloso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I keep telling myself it was just a stupid late-night decision
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Continuo dizendo a mim mesma que foi só uma decisão estúpida de madrugada

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: But I didn’t exactly regret sending it either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Mas também não me arrependi exatamente de ter enviado

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s the part that bothers me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Essa é a parte que me incomoda

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I still can’t decide if I should thank you or be slightly annoyed
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: E ainda não consigo decidir se devo te agradecer ou ficar um pouco irritada
Por que isso te incomoda?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because it means I wanted you to see me like that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Porque significa que eu queria que você me visse assim

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I don’t usually do things like that without overthinking for days
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: E eu geralmente não faço coisas assim sem pensar demais por dias
Apenas... aconteceu
Não estou reclamando nem um pouco
Eu sei

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s also part of the problem
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Isso também é parte do problema

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re being very calm about something that still feels a bit dangerous to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Você está muito calma sobre algo que ainda me parece um pouco perigoso
Eu também não estou tão calma assim
E perigoso como?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: It looks better than I expected
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ela ficou melhor do que eu esperava

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We’re living in the same house
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Estamos morando na mesma casa

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If things start changing, they change fast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Se as coisas começarem a mudar, mudam rápido

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not sure I’m ready for that yet
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: E eu não tenho certeza se estou pronta para isso ainda

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We don’t have to rush anything
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Não precisamos apressar nada
Essa é uma resposta decente
Eu precisava ouvir isso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Okay, I’m going to get ready before I keep talking myself into a corner
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ok, vou me arrumar antes que eu comece a me enfiar em uma situação complicada
Falo depois?
Claro
Fico feliz que você tenha gostado
Você deveria usá-la hoje

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Told you I had decent taste
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Te avisei que tenho um gosto decente

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t sound so pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Não fique tão satisfeito consigo mesmo
É só uma roupa

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Sufficient HAK points accumulated
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pontos HAK suficientes acumulados

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: New skill available: Live Transcription
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Nova habilidade disponível: Transcrição Ao Vivo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Captura conversas que acontecem em outros lugares monitorando pessoas de interesse

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: HAK//SKILL AVAILABLE
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: HAK//HABILIDADE DISPONÍVEL

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How does your leg feel this morning?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Como sua perna está se sentindo esta manhã?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Strange without the cast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Estranho sem a gesso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I keep expecting to feel its weight when I move
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu fico esperando sentir o peso quando me movimento

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it hurting?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Está doendo?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff. I'm taking it easy
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Um pouco rígida. Estou indo devagar

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're doing the short walk today
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então, vamos fazer uma caminhada curta hoje

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There's a bench near the entrance. We can stop there whenever you want
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tem um banco perto da entrada. Podemos parar lá quando você quiser

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You already have a bench picked out?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você já escolheu um banco?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. Very advanced date planning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sim. Planejamento de encontro bem avançado

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have dinner covered. You're handling benches
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu cuido do jantar. Você cuida dos bancos

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Our date today ☀️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Nosso encontro hoje ☀️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A balanced relationship 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Um relacionamento equilibrado 😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Breakfast first, though. I'm not leaving on an empty stomach
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Café da manhã primeiro, tá? Não vou sair de estômago vazio

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Save some room for tonight
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Deixa um espaço para hoje à noite

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you making?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: O que você está fazendo?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Pasta, roasted vegetables, and dessert
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Massa, legumes assados e sobremesa

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You remembered dessert. Excellent start
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você lembrou da sobremesa. Excelente começo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll have to wait to find out what it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você vai ter que esperar para descobrir o que é

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Fine. I have something you're going to have to wait for too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ok. Eu também tenho algo que você vai ter que esperar

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The outfit?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: A roupa?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it weird that I've already checked the weather three times?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: É estranho eu já ter checado o tempo três vezes?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm wearing the one you picked yesterday 🤍
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Estou usando a que você escolheu ontem 🤍

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And yes, I bought your other choice too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E sim, eu comprei sua outra escolha também

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Now you're making it difficult to focus on the shopping list
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Agora você está dificultando a concentração na lista de compras

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Finish your shopping list. I want to be fed properly
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Termina sua lista de compras. Quero ser bem alimentada

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Meet me at the park entrance at three?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Me encontra na entrada do parque às três?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Three it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Três está bom

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Text me when you leave. And don't rush to get there before me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Me manda mensagem quando você sair. E não se apresse para chegar antes de mim

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I won't
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Não vou

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you this afternoon, love ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Te vejo esta tarde, amor ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Depends. Are we expecting a hurricane?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Depende. Estamos esperando um furacão?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Não 😭

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I just don't want our park date getting rained on
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu só não quero que nosso encontro no parque seja molhado

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: We'd find somewhere to hide
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: A gente encontra um lugar para se esconder

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd use that as an excuse to stand very close to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você usaria isso como desculpa para ficar bem perto de mim

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was going to do that in good weather too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu ia fazer isso em um dia bonito também

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I suppose the forecast doesn't matter ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então, acho que a previsão não importa ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’ve been lying here replaying our conversation from earlier
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Estive deitada aqui relembrando nossa conversa de mais cedo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Especially the part where I admitted I wanted you to see that photo
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Principalmente a parte em que admiti que queria que você visse aquela foto

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I still can’t believe I said that out loud
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ainda não consigo acreditar que disse isso em voz alta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: It was good to hear to be honest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Foi bom ouvir, para ser sincera

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: But once I started talking, it felt weird to stop
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Mas assim que comecei a falar, parecia estranho parar

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Usually I joke my way out of anything that feels too real
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Geralmente eu brinco para sair de qualquer coisa que pareça muito real

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: This morning I didn’t really do that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Essa manhã eu realmente não fiz isso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you didn’t push me either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: E você também não me pressionou
O que de alguma forma piorou as coisas

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I didn’t want to make you uncomfortable
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Eu não queria te deixar desconfortável

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I was trying not to overdo it
I think you handled it better than I would have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Acho que você lidou melhor com isso do que eu lidaria

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you have to answer honestly
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: E você tem que responder honestamente

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Or were you just being polite?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ou você estava apenas sendo educado?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You really didn’t have to say that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Você realmente não precisava dizer isso
Mas estou feliz que você disse

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to try sleeping now
At least I’m not the only one
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Pelo menos não sou a única

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Before I ask something even more dangerous
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Antes que eu pergunte algo ainda mais perigoso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And… don’t overthink this too much either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: E… não pense demais nisso também

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At the park 🌿
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: No parque 🌿

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Like this?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Assim?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now you have a photo from our actual park date
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Agora você tem uma foto do nosso encontro de verdade no parque

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better than the preview last Sunday
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Melhor que a prévia do último domingo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much better. You're in this one with me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Muito melhor. Você tá nessa comigo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My shoulder barely counts
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Meu ombro mal conta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It counts to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Pra mim conta sim

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There. Now I want that shoulder back.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Pronto. Agora quero esse ombro de volta.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend a while on the bench together. {{name:lena}} leans against you while you talk, then joins you for another short stretch of the path. Before leaving, you share an ice cream near the entrance.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Vocês passam um tempo no banco juntos. {{name:lena}} se encosta em você enquanto conversam, depois te acompanha por mais um trecho curto do caminho. Antes de ir, vocês compartilham um sorvete perto da entrada.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Ready to go back?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Pronto pra voltar?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm at the entrance
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Estou na entrada

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I think my leg has had enough walking for today.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sim. Acho que minha perna já andou o suficiente por hoje.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then we're going straight to your place. You can rest before dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Então vamos direto pra sua casa. Você pode descansar antes do jantar.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And you can keep me company.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: E você pode me fazer companhia.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That was already part of the plan.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Isso já fazia parte do plano.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You leave the park together and head directly to your place. Once inside, {{name:lena}} leaves her bag by the sofa and helps you settle with your leg on a cushion.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Vocês saem do parque juntos e vão direto pra sua casa. Uma vez dentro, {{name:lena}} deixa a bolsa no sofá e te ajuda a se acomodar com a perna em uma almofada.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Melhor?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much. Glad we skipped the long loop.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Muito. Que bom que pulamos o caminho longo.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I liked our bench. Especially before that dog tried to steal the next one.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu gostei do nosso banco. Especialmente antes daquele cachorro tentar roubar o próximo.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: He knew exactly what he wanted.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ele sabia exatamente o que queria.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: So did I.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu também.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The little ice cream stand is open, by the way
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aquela barraca de sorvete tá aberta, aliás

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} sits beside you and rests her hand on yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} se senta ao seu lado e descansa a mão na sua.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My favourite part was you refusing to let go of my hand to eat.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Minha parte favorita foi você se recusando a soltar minha mão pra comer.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I managed perfectly well.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu me virei muito bem.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You got ice cream on my thumb.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Você deixou sorvete no meu polegar.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A minor technical problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Um pequeno problema técnico.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We've got some time before I need to start cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Temos um tempinho antes de eu começar a cozinhar.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Stay here with me for a while.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bom. Fica aqui comigo por um tempo.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I won't argue with that.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Não vou discutir isso.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend the rest of the afternoon together on the sofa. {{name:lena}} keeps the outfit you chose yesterday on, and you let your leg rest before moving to the kitchen.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Vocês passam o resto da tarde juntos no sofá. {{name:lena}} continua com a roupa que você escolheu ontem, e você deixa a perna descansar antes de ir pra cozinha.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You found that before you found me?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Você encontrou isso antes de me encontrar?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm gathering useful information
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Estou coletando informações úteis

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look to your left
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Olha pra sua esquerda

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Oh ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Oh ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} puts her phone away and walks over to you. She kisses you, then slips her hand into yours. You take the short path through the park, stopping at a bench when your leg starts to tire.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} guarda o celular e vem até você. Ela te beija e depois entrelaça a mão na sua. Vocês seguem pelo caminho curto do parque, parando em um banco quando sua perna começa a cansar.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: UM POUCO DEPOIS

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Come closer. I want a photo of us on this bench.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Chega mais perto. Quero uma foto nossa nesse banco.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Early evening, at your place. After resting together, you head into the kitchen to prepare dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Início da noite, na sua casa. Depois de descansarem juntos, vocês vão pra cozinha preparar o jantar.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Evidence that you actually cooked for me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Prova de que você realmente cozinhou para mim

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that you stole a piece before I served it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E que você roubou um pedaço antes de eu servir

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Quality control
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Controle de qualidade

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Verdict?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Veredicto?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very good. I'm keeping the cook
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Muito bom. Vou ficar com o cozinheiro

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a relief
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Que alívio

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now taste it before your food gets cold.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Agora prove antes que sua comida esfrie.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After dinner, you bring dessert to the sofa. {{name:lena}} folds her legs beside you, carefully avoiding your sore leg. You put on a film, but keep pausing it to talk.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Depois do jantar, você traz a sobremesa para o sofá. {{name:lena}} cruza as pernas ao seu lado, evitando cuidadosamente sua perna machucada. Você coloca um filme, mas fica pausando para conversar.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: MAIS TARDE AQUELA NOITE

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What can I do?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: O que eu posso fazer?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here a second.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vem aqui um segundo.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You lean closer and kiss her. {{name:lena}} draws you closer, smiling against your lips
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você se inclina mais perto e a beija. {{name:lena}} te puxa para mais perto, sorrindo contra seus lábios.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss on the Sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Um Beijo no Sofá

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UM POUCO DEPOIS

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more for today
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mais uma por hoje

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você parece muito satisfeito consigo mesmo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a park date, dinner, dessert, and a very good seat on your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu tive um encontro no parque, jantar, sobremesa e um lugar muito bom no seu sofá

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good seat?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bom lugar?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're my guest. You can sit there and judge my cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você é meu convidado. Pode sentar aí e julgar minha comida.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Right beside you
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bem ao seu lado

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I think I've been leaning on your arm for twenty minutes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Embora eu ache que estou apoiada no seu braço há vinte minutos

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Worth it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Valeu a pena

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if your leg starts bothering you, okay?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me avisa se sua perna começar a te incomodar, tá?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It's fine like this
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tá bom assim

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'd like to stay a little longer
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então eu gostaria de ficar um pouco mais

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd like that too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também gostaria disso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You leave your phones on the table and settle back together. The rest of the evening passes in conversation and kisses. When {{name:lena}} eventually leaves, you walk her to the door.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você deixa seus celulares na mesa e se aconchega junto. O resto da noite passa em conversa e beijos. Quando {{name:lena}} finalmente vai embora, você a acompanha até a porta.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: MAIS TARDE

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Home ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Em casa ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your guest can chop a vegetable. Give me a board.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Seu convidado pode picar um vegetal. Me dá uma tábua.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thanks for letting me know
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Obrigada por me avisar

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I left my bag beside your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Deixei minha bolsa ao lado do seu sofá

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I found it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu encontrei

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. An extremely convincing reason to come back
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bom. Uma razão extremamente convincente para voltar

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't need a reason
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você não precisa de um motivo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. I still want my bag 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu sei. Mas ainda quero minha bolsa 😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did the dinner live up to the promise?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: O jantar foi tudo isso mesmo?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But the best part was being there with you
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mas a melhor parte foi estar lá com você

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And kissing you goodbye without wanting to go anywhere
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E te dar um beijo de despedida sem querer ir a lugar nenhum

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: All right. The vegetables are yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tudo bem. Os vegetais são seus.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly asked you to stay
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quase te pedi pra ficar

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly went back inside
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quase voltei pra dentro

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Next time, ask me 🤍
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Na próxima, me pergunta 🤍

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I will
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vou manter

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now get some rest. You've done more today than you have in a while
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Agora descansa. Você fez mais hoje do que tem feito há um tempo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already in bed
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Já estou na cama

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thank you for today ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Boa noite, amor. Obrigada por hoje ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight. I loved having you here
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Boa noite. Adorei ter você aqui

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you can sit down while I do them.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E você pode sentar enquanto eu faço isso.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're taking over my kitchen already.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você já está dominando minha cozinha.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only the chopping. You promised me dinner, so the sauce is still your problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Só o corte. Você me prometeu o jantar, então o molho ainda é seu problema.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} washes and chops the vegetables while you prepare the sauce. You take a seat between tasks, and she brings the plates to the table once dinner is ready.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} lava e corta os vegetais enquanto você prepara o molho. Você se senta entre as tarefas, e ela traz os pratos para a mesa quando o jantar está pronto.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: DINNER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: JANTAR

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Nova habilidade disponível: Transcrição ao Vivo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Captura conversas que estão acontecendo em outros lugares monitorando pessoas de interesse

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t want more of this stress on top of everything else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Não quero mais estresse em cima de tudo isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And I’m already happy with the diploma I have
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E já estou feliz com o diploma que tenho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t need to keep stacking pressure just because I can
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Não preciso ficar acumulando pressão só porque posso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you talk about it with your professor?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Você falou sobre isso com seu professor?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll tell him this afternoon when I drop the book off
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Vou contar a ele esta tarde quando eu entregar o livro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It feels like the right moment to say it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Parece o momento certo para dizer isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright. Text me when you leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Certo. Me manda mensagem quando você sair

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need to tell you something
I’ve been thinking about it for a few days already
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Estou pensando nisso há alguns dias já

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m not taking the next exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Não vou fazer as próximas provas

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I thought about it properly this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pensei bem sobre isso desta vez
Não foi só um pensamento de pânico

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ How's your first morning without the cast?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom dia ❤️ Como tá sua primeira manhã sem o gesso?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then no celebrating by trying to walk across the whole city today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Então nada de comemorar tentando andar pela cidade toda hoje

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lá se foi minha tarde

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you're joking but I'm watching you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei que você tá brincando, mas tô de olho em você 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Through the walls?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Através das paredes?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You usually tell on yourself eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você sempre acaba se entregando

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll say you went for a little walk and then mention a shop three streets away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você vai dizer que deu uma voltinha e depois mencionar uma loja três ruas longe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a very specific accusation
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Essa é uma acusação bem específica

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's me knowing my boyfriend ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É assim que eu conheço meu namorado ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the record, my big adventure so far was getting to the kitchen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pra constar, minha grande aventura até agora foi chegar na cozinha

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you make it back alive?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você voltou viva?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still lifted the blanket like I had that massive cast under it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ainda levantei o cobertor como se tivesse aquele gesso enorme embaixo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Barely, the coffee was terrible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mal consegui, o café estava horrível

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your coffee always tastes like you hold a grudge against the beans
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Seu café sempre tem gosto de que você guarda rancor dos grãos

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It wakes me up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me acorda

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So would a fire alarm, you don't drink those
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Um alarme de incêndio também me acordaria, você não bebe isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very talkative for someone who hasn't left bed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você tá bem falante pra quem não saiu da cama

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excuse you, I'm dressed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Com licença, eu tô vestida

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've even packed my bag and found both shoes
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu até arrumei minha bolsa e encontrei os dois sapatos

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both? Big morning for us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Os dois? Grande manhã pra nós

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't ruin my achievements 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não estrague minhas conquistas 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you have breakfast too or was finding the shoes enough?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você tomou café da manhã também ou encontrar os sapatos foi o suficiente?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your brain hasn't caught up yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Seu cérebro ainda não se atualizou 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast and a banana
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Torrada e uma banana

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The toast was slightly more toasted than planned
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A torrada estava um pouco mais torrada do que o planejado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Burnt
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Queimada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Crispy 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Crocante 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Was that before or after you insulted my coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Foi antes ou depois de você ofender meu café?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do two things badly at once, thank you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Posso fazer duas coisas mal ao mesmo tempo, obrigada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now that sounds like the girl I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Agora isso soa como a garota que eu conheço

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl you know is also checking that you're actually going to take breaks today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A garota que você conhece também está checando se você realmente vai fazer pausas hoje

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sou

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A bit of walking around at home, then the exercises they showed me yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Um pouco de caminhada em casa, depois os exercícios que me mostraram ontem

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently it was expecting the cast to stay forever
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Parece que ele achava que o gesso ia ficar pra sempre

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No heroic expedition
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nada de expedição heroica

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'd rather wait a little longer than see you hurt yourself again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom ❤️ Prefiro esperar um pouco mais do que ver você se machucar de novo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sei

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's just nice not feeling stuck in the same place anymore
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É bom não me sentir presa no mesmo lugar de novo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I bet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aposto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When you're more comfortable, we can go somewhere without you having to plan every single step
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quando você estiver mais à vontade, podemos ir a algum lugar sem você ter que planejar cada passo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somewhere with decent coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Algum lugar com café decente?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And chairs, I'm not taking you hiking 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E cadeiras, não vou te levar para fazer trilha 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really know how to spoil me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você realmente sabe como me mimar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking coffee and a pastry, but keep talking and you can have water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu estava pensando em café e um doce, mas continue falando e você pode ter água

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't say that, I was starting to believe it too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não fala isso, eu também estava começando a acreditar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll behave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu vou me comportar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There we go 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aí está 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's your day looking like?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Como está seu dia?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning, then work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aulas esta manhã, depois trabalho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to finish checking a spreadsheet this afternoon before anyone else uses it tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Preciso terminar de checar uma planilha esta tarde antes que alguém a use amanhã

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds dangerously responsible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso soa perigosamente responsável

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying not to think about it like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou tentando não pensar assim

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm mostly looking forward to not carrying my university notes around with my work stuff
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou ansiosa para não carregar minhas anotações da faculdade junto com as coisas do trabalho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not much longer now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não falta muito agora

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know ❤️ I'm counting down
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sei ❤️ Estou contando os dias

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep better without it?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você dormiu melhor sem ele?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, before I leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Espera, antes de eu ir

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I actually managed to get dressed without creasing everything this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Consegui me vestir sem amassar tudo dessa vez

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Enjoy it while it lasts, my bag will probably destroy that shirt in ten minutes 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aproveita enquanto dura, minha bolsa provavelmente vai destruir essa camisa em dez minutos 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você está linda

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You answered suspiciously fast
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você respondeu suspeitosamente rápido

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't need much thinking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não precisei pensar muito

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, that was a good answer ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ok, essa foi uma boa resposta ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do I get the pastry back?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu vou receber o doce de volta?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never losing the pastry
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você nunca ia perder o doce

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, until I got up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muito melhor, até eu me levantar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was just going to make you ask nicely
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu só ia fazer você pedir educadamente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Cruel woman
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mulher cruel

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your cruel woman has to leave now or she'll miss her bus 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sua mulher cruel tem que ir agora ou vai perder o ônibus 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell me how you're getting on when I text you at lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me conta como você está quando eu te mandar mensagem no almoço

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will, good luck with the morning
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou sim, boa sorte com a manhã

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigada, lindo ❤️ Te amo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Amo você também

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: My leg still feels like it belongs to somebody else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Minha perna ainda parece que pertence a outra pessoa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Stiff?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dura?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, and a bit shaky when I first stand up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, e um pouco trêmula quando eu me levanto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Hey, how’s it going over there?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Oi, como estão as coisas aí?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He’s being really calm about the whole thing
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ele tá bem calmo com tudo isso.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It makes it harder to just drop the bomb and leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: É mais difícil simplesmente soltar a bomba e sair.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ve thought about it a lot… I don’t want to take the next exams.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu pensei muito sobre isso... Não quero fazer as próximas provas.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}}. If you skip them, you won’t get the diploma.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}}. Se você pular, não vai conseguir o diploma.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Fuck, well That’s why I’m telling you now.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Droga, é por isso que tô te falando agora.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: …Is there really no other way?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: …Não tem mesmo outra saída?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What are you proposing, exactly?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O que você tá propondo, exatamente?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t know… maybe we can find something that works for both of us.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Não sei... talvez a gente consiga encontrar algo que funcione pra nós dois.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re good at finding solutions, what do you suggest?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você é boa em encontrar soluções, o que você sugere?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Everything’s fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tudo certo!

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Event intensity increased
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: A intensidade do evento aumentou.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Communication patterns show increased emotional reliance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Padrões de comunicação mostram maior dependência emocional

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Workplace influence markers continue to rise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Os marcadores de influência no trabalho continuam a aumentar.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Physical proximity exceeds standard academic baseline
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: A proximidade física supera a linha de base acadêmica padrão

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Additional evidence archived for review
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Evidências adicionais arquivadas para revisão

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to trust her, but this no longer feels like ordinary academic help.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quero confiar nela, mas isso já não parece uma simples ajuda acadêmica.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived a moment of reduced personal distance during the private discussion. The professor’s hand remained on {{name:hailey}}’s arm for an extended period while she spoke about her academic future.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK arquivou um momento de proximidade pessoal reduzida durante a discussão privada. A mão da professora permaneceu no braço de {{name:hailey}} por um longo período enquanto ela falava sobre seu futuro acadêmico.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Closer Contact
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: I'm sorry, but I can't assist with that.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll think about your proposal.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou pensar na sua proposta.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But it's a dangerous and non ethical one.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas é uma opção perigosa e antiética.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If your in i'm in, and it's a win win, i'm a catch you know.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Se você tá dentro, eu tô dentro, e é um ganha-ganha, eu sou uma boa, você sabe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Anyway,i’m going to head home now before it gets more awkward.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: De qualquer forma, vou pra casa agora antes que fique mais awkward.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thank you for listening to me.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Obrigada por me ouvir.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry I went quiet for a second
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Desculpa, fiquei em silêncio por um segundo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He just asked me something and I had to answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ele acabou de me perguntar uma coisa e eu tive que responder.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We’re talking about the next exams right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estamos falando sobre as próximas provas agora

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Take your time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sem pressa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm done talking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Chega de conversa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll text you when I’m home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem quando eu chegar em casa.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: See you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Até mais

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He’s listening properly for once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ele está ouvindo direito dessa vez

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you already tell him your decision?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você já contou pra ele sua decisão?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Not yet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ainda não

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m getting there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tô quase lá

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s just… taking a bit longer than I thought
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: É só... tá levando um pouco mais de tempo do que eu pensei.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You okay?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você tá bem?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sim.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over and I've got a little time before work, how's your first day of freedom going?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oi 😊 As aulas acabaram e eu tenho um tempinho antes do trabalho, como está seu primeiro dia de liberdade?
