story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And no spreadsheets
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E nada de planilhas

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that now. If you bring one, I'm leaving you there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você diz isso agora. Se você trouxer uma, eu te deixo lá

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave whenever you like
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você pode ir embora quando quiser

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, but I'd rather not spend my first evening out hearing about work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei, mas prefiro não passar minha primeira noite fora ouvindo sobre trabalho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just wanted to make sure you still wanted to go
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Só queria ter certeza de que você ainda queria ir

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu faço

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look very pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você parece muito satisfeito consigo mesmo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Should I not be?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não deveria estar?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não disse isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly awkward, I'm taking it slowly
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Principalmente estranho, estou indo devagar.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'll try not to overdo it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então vou tentar não exagerar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not trying very hard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não está se esforçando muito

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The manager moves closer and initiates a kiss
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O gerente se aproxima e inicia um beijo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He just kissed {{name:lena}}. My hands have gone cold, and for a second I can't even take in what I'm seeing.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele acabou de beijar {{name:lena}}. Minhas mãos ficaram frias, e por um segundo nem consigo assimilar o que estou vendo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Crossing the Line
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ultrapassando os Limites

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait... what are you doing?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera... o que você está fazendo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I shouldn't have done that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Desculpe. Eu não deveria ter feito isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, you shouldn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não, você não deveria

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll step back
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou dar um passo atrás

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have a boyfriend
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu tenho um namorado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you can't just kiss me like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então você não pode simplesmente me beijar assim

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você está certo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't expecting that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não esperava por isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My bad, your right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Foi mal, você está certo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to get back to work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Preciso voltar ao trabalho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you need to stop looking at me like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E você precisa parar de me olhar assim

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will try
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu vou tentar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should try harder
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você deveria se esforçar mais

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu vou

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How was your morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Como foi sua manhã?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Should I cancel tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Devo cancelar amanhã?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are you sure?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tem certeza?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to go. I just... I need a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu ainda quero ir. Só... preciso de um minuto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pegue um

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, preferably
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sozinho, de preferência

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll finish the last checks at my desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou terminar as últimas verificações na minha mesa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can send it over when you're ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você pode enviar quando estiver pronto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Let me get my phone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Deixa eu pegar meu celular

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The professor spent ages explaining something that wasn't even on the right slide
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O professor passou uma eternidade explicando algo que nem estava no slide certo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After her shift, at the bus stop...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Depois do turno dela, no ponto de ônibus...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Sorry, I thought I'd be able to text sooner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Saí ❤️ Desculpa, achei que conseguiria mandar mensagem mais cedo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you sort out the spreadsheet?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você resolveu a planilha?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, eventualmente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We started with the wrong printout, so that was a great use of everyone's time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Começamos com a impressão errada, então foi um ótimo uso do tempo de todos 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The expensive sandwich deserved a better afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O sanduíche caro merecia uma tarde melhor

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I was hungry again an hour later, so it didn't even do its job
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E eu estava com fome de novo uma hora depois, então nem cumpriu seu papel

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Heading home now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está indo pra casa agora?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Waiting for the bus, unless it decides not to exist again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esperando o ônibus, a menos que ele decida não existir de novo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it late?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está tarde?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone finally told him and he just went 'yes, that's for next week'
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alguém finalmente disse a ele e ele só respondeu 'sim, isso é para a próxima semana'.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It says four minutes. It also said four minutes when I got here
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Diz que faltam quatro minutos. Também dizia quatro minutos quando cheguei aqui

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least I found a seat
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pelo menos eu encontrei um lugar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Long afternoon?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tarde longa?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Longer than I expected, yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais longa do que eu esperava, sim

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tudo bem?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, just a lot going round in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, só muita coisa passando pela minha cabeça

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need food and a bit of time not looking at numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu preciso de comida e um tempo sem olhar para números

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can talk about something incredibly unimportant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Posso falar sobre algo incrivelmente sem importância

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please do 😭 How did your big trip around the house go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por favor, faça isso 😭 Como foi sua grande volta pela casa?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Muito tranquilizador.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I discovered the sofa was still where I left it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Descobri que o sofá ainda estava onde eu deixei

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A successful expedition then
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uma expedição bem-sucedida então

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I stopped when my leg started getting tired
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E eu parei quando minha perna começou a ficar cansada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you actually listening to me ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Olha você realmente me ouvindo ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't sound so surprised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não fique tão surpreso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm enjoying the moment, let me have it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou aproveitando o momento, me deixa 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel like watching something together later?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você quer assistir algo junto mais tarde?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Together as in us arguing about the same film from different houses?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Juntos como nós discutindo sobre o mesmo filme de casas diferentes?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exatamente isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I found a detective film that looks terrible and I don't want to suffer alone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Encontrei um filme de detetive que parece terrível e não quero sofrer sozinho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent ten minutes thinking I was the problem 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Passei dez minutos achando que eu era o problema 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make such a convincing offer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você faz uma oferta tão convincente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Say yes, I've already saved it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Diz sim, eu já salvei

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, we'll watch it when you're ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, vamos assistir quando você estiver pronta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good ❤️ My bus is finally here
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom ❤️ Meu ônibus finalmente chegou

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I get home, then I'll sort out dinner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te mando mensagem quando chegar em casa, aí eu resolvo o jantar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk to you in a bit
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Falo com você daqui a pouco

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you manage to get something to eat before work?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conseguiu comer algo antes do trabalho?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A sandwich from the place near the bus stop
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um sanduíche do lugar perto do ponto de ônibus.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It cost enough that I checked the bag for a second sandwich
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Custou tanto que eu verifiquei a bolsa por um segundo sanduíche.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've made it through two rooms and put a proper shoe on
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Consegui passar por duas salas e coloquei um sapato decente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was there one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tinha um?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, just a napkin and disappointment
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não, só um guardanapo e decepção.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least I've found somewhere to sit for a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pelo menos encontrei um lugar para sentar por um minuto.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't look that disappointed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não parece tão decepcionado.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't opened the sandwich yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu ainda não tinha aberto o sanduíche 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you enjoy your very expensive lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou deixar você aproveitar seu almoço caríssimo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd better eat something too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: É melhor você comer algo também.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Já comi.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, one less person to supervise 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom, uma pessoa a menos para supervisionar 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you, moving up in the world 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Olha você, subindo na vida 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You supervising people at work now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você está supervisionando pessoas no trabalho agora?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly a spreadsheet that refuses to add up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Principalmente uma planilha que se recusa a somar.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My manager wants to go through it with me when I get in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Meu gerente quer revisar isso comigo quando eu chegar.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you won't be stuck doing it on your own
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pelo menos você não vai ficar preso fazendo isso sozinho.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly, and then it can stop taking up space in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exatamente, e então pode parar de ocupar espaço na minha cabeça.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go, I'll text you when I'm out ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Preciso ir, te mando uma mensagem quando sair ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tenha uma boa tarde

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, in the manager's office...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais tarde naquela tarde, no escritório do gerente...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversa de escritório detectada perto de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A spreadsheet, that's what she said. I want this to be an ordinary afternoon at work, but I can't stop watching the screen.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uma planilha, foi o que ela disse. Quero que seja uma tarde normal de trabalho, mas não consigo parar de olhar para a tela.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//TRANSCRIÇÃO AO VIVO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that the version you sent me this morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: É essa a versão que você me enviou esta manhã?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Putting the shoe on was the hard part
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Colocar o sapato foi a parte difícil

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It should be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Deveria ser.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because this total is different
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque esse total está diferente.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, don't tell me I've printed the old one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera, não me diga que imprimi a antiga.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You tell me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você que me diz.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I changed it before class. Check the file on your screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu mudei antes da aula. Verifique o arquivo na sua tela.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esse?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, look at the bottom. The figure's right there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, olha embaixo. A figura tá bem ali

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So the spreadsheet is right and the printout isn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então a planilha tá certa e a impressão não

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly. Which means I've spent my lunch worrying about a problem I already fixed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exatamente. Ou seja, passei meu almoço preocupada com um problema que já resolvi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I've been writing notes on the wrong copy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E eu estive escrevendo anotações na cópia errada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you try doing it standing up?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tentou fazer isso em pé?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Well, yours is going straight in the bin with mine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom, a sua vai direto pro lixo junto com a minha

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before printing it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você poderia ter checado antes de imprimir

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before writing on every page
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você poderia ter checado antes de escrever em cada página

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair enough
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Justo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, I'm glad we've agreed this is a shared disaster
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom, fico feliz que concordamos que isso é um desastre compartilhado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come around here. Show me what you changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vem cá. Me mostra o que você mudou

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There, that line was included twice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Olha, essa linha foi incluída duas vezes

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I missed that yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não percebi isso ontem

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You told me to check my calculation again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei. Você me pediu pra checar meu cálculo de novo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E você fez

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uma vez

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Three times, because I thought you must know something I didn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Três vezes, porque achei que você sabia algo que eu não sabia

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should have told me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você devia ter me falado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu acabei de fazer isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little sooner would have saved you some time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um pouco mais cedo teria te economizado tempo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then next time I get to say 'I told you so' while you're still in the room
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então na próxima vez eu vou poder dizer 'eu te avisei' enquanto você ainda tá aqui

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think you've earned that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Acho que você merece isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to remember you said that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou lembrar que você disse isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects standing together beside the desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dois sujeitos parados juntos ao lado da mesa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're standing so close. I keep telling myself it's work, but seeing them together like that makes my stomach tighten.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eles estão tão perto. Fico dizendo a mim mesmo que é trabalho, mas vê-los juntos assim me dá um nó no estômago.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too Close
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Muito Perto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You seem more comfortable in here now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você parece mais à vontade aqui agora

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sabia!

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: With the work? A little
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Com o trabalho? Um pouco

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't exactly what I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso não era exatamente o que eu queria dizer

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe you should be more specific
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então talvez você devesse ser mais específica

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The first few days you stood by the door whenever you brought something in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nos primeiros dias você ficava na porta sempre que trazia algo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you always looked busy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque você sempre parecia ocupada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E agora?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I know half the time you're just looking at the same numbers I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Agora eu sei que metade do tempo você tá só olhando os mesmos números que eu

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'm less intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então eu sou menos intimidadora

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you were intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não disse que você era intimidadora

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You just didn't want to come any closer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você só não queria chegar mais perto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sat down before you could sense a disturbance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu me sentei antes que você pudesse sentir alguma coisa.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know, you notice a lot for someone with so much work to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sabe, você percebe muita coisa pra alguém com tanto trabalho pra fazer

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some things are hard not to notice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Algumas coisas são difíceis de não notar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing it again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tá fazendo isso de novo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Doing what?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fazendo o quê?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looking at me instead of the screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Olhando pra mim em vez da tela

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've finished explaining the spreadsheet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você terminou de explicar a planilha

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't an answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso não é uma resposta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't meant to be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não era pra ser

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really don't make this easy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você realmente não facilita as coisas

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Make what easy?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Facilitar o quê?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, I felt it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tarde demais, eu senti 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keeping a straight face when I'm supposed to be working
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Manter a cara séria quando eu deveria estar trabalhando

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little later, after the paperwork is finished...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um pouco mais tarde, depois que a papelada estiver pronta...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are we still on for tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ainda estamos de pé para amanhã?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The drink?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A bebida?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, the drink
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, a bebida

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I'd come, didn't I?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu disse que viria, não disse?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You also said you might be tired after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você também disse que poderia estar cansado depois do trabalho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I probably will be. I can still sit down somewhere that isn't this chair
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Provavelmente estarei. Posso ainda sentar em algum lugar que não seja essa cadeira

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a place a couple of streets over. Around seven?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tem um lugar a algumas ruas daqui. Por volta das sete?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seven should be fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sete deve estar bom

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, is it hurting or just awkward?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Falando sério, está doendo ou só está estranho?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It was the smart thing to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Foi a coisa certa a se fazer.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Even if it means more work
He’s going to help me deeply this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ele vai me ajudar de verdade dessa vez.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Thanks for checking on me earlier
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Obrigada por se preocupar comigo mais cedo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I kind of have to take the exams after all
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Acho que vou ter que fazer as provas afinal

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He made it pretty clear I won’t get the diploma otherwise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ele deixou bem claro que eu não vou conseguir o diploma de outra forma

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Okay… but you said you maybe had a solution?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Certo… mas você disse que talvez tivesse uma solução?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m going to have to spend more time with him for the exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Vou ter que passar mais tempo com ele para as provas
Sessões extras, esse tipo de coisa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That’s good actually. I’m glad you changed your mind
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Isso é bom, na verdade. Fico feliz que você tenha mudado de ideia.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home and attempting dinner before our very serious film night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ Cheguei em casa e estou tentando fazer o jantar antes da nossa noite de filme muito séria

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We don't need to discuss him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não precisamos discutir sobre ele

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He wasn't even in the second half
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele nem apareceu na segunda metade

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was working with the information available at the time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu estava trabalhando com as informações disponíveis na época 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were very confident
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você estava muito confiante

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I trusted the scarf too much
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Confiei demais no lenço

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A mistake any great detective could make
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um erro que qualquer grande detetive poderia cometer

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop laughing, at least the film was as bad as I promised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Para de rir, pelo menos o filme foi tão ruim quanto eu prometi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did deliver on that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você cumpriu com isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nicer watching it with you, though
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Foi melhor assistir com você, né

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even with my commentary?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mesmo com meu comentário?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Future You always finds something to complain about
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O Seu Futuro sempre encontra algo para reclamar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially with your commentary ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Especialmente com seu comentário ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed this, just talking about something silly with you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu senti falta disso, só conversando sobre algo bobo com você

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We should do it again, but you pick the next one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Devemos fazer isso de novo, mas você escolhe o próximo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't blame me for your detective career ending tonight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não pode me culpar pelo fim da sua carreira de detetive hoje à noite

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm retiring undefeated, thank you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou me aposentando invicto, obrigado 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not what happened
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não foi isso que aconteceu

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the story I'm sticking to
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa é a história que eu vou manter

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to bed before you talk me into watching a better one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou para a cama antes que você me convença a assistir um melhor

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Durma bem

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when Present Me leaves her washing up 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Só quando o Meu Presente deixa a louça para lavar 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ I'm glad today was a little easier for your leg
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você também, lindo ❤️ Fico feliz que hoje foi um pouco mais fácil para sua perna

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te amo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Amo você também ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How much have you created so far?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quanto você já fez até agora?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: One pan, one bowl, one spoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma panela, uma tigela, uma colher

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And a second spoon because I put the first one somewhere stupid
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E uma segunda colher porque coloquei a primeira em algum lugar idiota

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Impressive efficiency
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eficiência impressionante

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll be laughing less when you see my masterpiece
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você vai rir menos quando ver minha obra-prima

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There, actual food and not a fire in sight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Olha, comida de verdade e sem fogo à vista

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso parece bom

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Attempting doesn't sound promising
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tentando não soa muito promissor

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It tastes good too, I'm almost suspicious 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está gostoso também, estou quase desconfiada 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did the second spoon contribute?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O que a segunda colher contribuiu?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Moral support
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apoio moral

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll remember that next time I'm cooking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou lembrar disso da próxima vez que eu cozinhar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you eaten properly tonight?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você comeu direitinho hoje à noite?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I've eaten and I'm settled on the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, eu comi e estou confortável no sofá

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'll catch up once I've put the rest away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom ❤️ Vou te atualizar assim que eu guardar o resto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Meal prep now? You really have changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Preparando as refeições agora? Você realmente mudou

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't get used to it, I'm only doing this because I'm going out tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não se acostume, estou fazendo isso só porque vou sair amanhã

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I meant to tell you about that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ah, eu ia te contar sobre isso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly put the empty pan on and left the pasta in the cupboard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quase coloquei a panela vazia no fogo e deixei a massa no armário

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the coworker you mentioned the other night?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Com a colega de trabalho que você mencionou na outra noite?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My manager, actually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na verdade, meu gerente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Seu gerente?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, we talked about it again today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, falamos sobre isso de novo hoje

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said coworker before
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você disse colega de trabalho antes

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu fiz

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should've been clearer about who I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu deveria ter sido mais clara sobre quem eu quis dizer

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is anybody else going?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alguém mais vai?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, just us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não, só nós.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So we're having a strong start 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então estamos começando bem 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's just a drink after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É só um drink depois do trabalho.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Where?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Onde?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bar a couple of streets from the office
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem um bar a algumas ruas do escritório.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, so I'll go straight from work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por volta das sete, então vou direto do trabalho.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you want to go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você quer ir?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, quero sim.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent most of the week going from class to work to home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Passei a maior parte da semana indo de aula pro trabalho e pra casa.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to do something that isn't one of those three things
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quero fazer algo que não seja uma dessas três coisas.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I get wanting to go out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu entendo querer sair.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe start with the water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Talvez comece com a água

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Going out alone with your manager is a bit different from what I pictured
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sair sozinho com seu gerente é um pouco diferente do que eu imaginei.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know how it sounds
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei como isso soa.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially after what you said about him looking at you differently
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Especialmente depois do que você disse sobre ele te olhando de forma diferente.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I probably shouldn't have made such a thing of that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Provavelmente eu não deveria ter dado tanta importância a isso.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You told me because it bothered you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você me contou porque isso te incomodou.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It surprised me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso me surpreendeu.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I don't feel uncomfortable around him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas eu não me sinto desconfortável perto dele.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you're with someone?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele sabe que você está com alguém?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he knows
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, ele sabe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want to turn this into an argument
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não quero transformar isso em uma briga.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have water, I'm not completely lost
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu tenho água, não estou completamente perdida

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me neither
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também não.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't want to find out I've only been hearing half the story
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Só não quero descobrir que só ouvi metade da história.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm telling you where we're going and who it's with
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É por isso que estou te dizendo onde vamos e com quem.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te mando uma mensagem quando chegar lá.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And when you're home?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E quando você estiver em casa?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Beleza.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do want to spend time with you too, you know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também quero passar um tempo com você, sabe?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's for dinner?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O que tem para o jantar?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I miss seeing you instead of just waiting for messages
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Sinto falta de te ver em vez de só esperar mensagens.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I miss you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também sinto sua falta ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me check when I finish over the next few days and we'll work something out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deixa eu ver quando acabo nos próximos dias e a gente combina algo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gostaria disso.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I don't want our whole evening to disappear while I'm standing next to a pan
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E não quero que nossa noite inteira desapareça enquanto estou ao lado de uma panela.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to change and get comfortable, then I'm yours for this awful film
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou me trocar e ficar confortável, depois sou toda sua para esse filme horrível.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get it ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou preparar isso.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little later...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco mais tarde...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, I've put the leftovers away and changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, guardei as sobras e me troquei.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Pasta, tomato sauce and whatever cheese survived the week
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Massa, molho de tomate e qualquer queijo que sobreviveu à semana

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work clothes, no dishes in front of me, no numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sem roupas de trabalho, sem pratos na minha frente, sem números.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you find the first spoon?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você encontrou a primeira colher?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was in the bowl the entire time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estava na tigela o tempo todo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course it was
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro que foi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trusting you with that information, be kind 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou confiando essa informação a você, seja gentil 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've even claimed the good end of the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu até peguei a melhor parte do sofá

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where I'd want to be right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É onde eu gostaria de estar agora

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There'd be room for you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Teríamos espaço pra você

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've taken up half the sofa with that blanket
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você ocupou metade do sofá com esse cobertor

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A classic
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um clássico

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd share the blanket, not the good cushion 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu dividiria o cobertor, mas não a boa almofada 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A generous offer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma oferta generosa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'd take it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você aceitaria

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I would
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, eu aceitaria

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Soon ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Logo ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you at the beginning of the film?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está no começo do filme?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Paused at the first frame
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pausado no primeiro quadro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, three, two, one... play
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, três, dois, um... play

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the film...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois do filme...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So, about the man with the red scarf
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então, sobre o homem com o lenço vermelho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm making enough for tomorrow too, so Future Me can't complain
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou fazendo o suficiente para amanhã também, assim o Meu Futuro não pode reclamar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Nova habilidade disponível: Transcrição ao Vivo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Captura conversas que estão acontecendo em outros lugares monitorando pessoas de interesse

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm still stressed enough without your commentary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Já tô estressado o suficiente sem seus comentários

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yesterday you were sending me certain pictures
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ontem você me mandou certas fotos

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And today you're waiting for grades like a responsible student
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E hoje tá esperando notas como um estudante responsável

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'll text you when I get the results
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem quando eu receber os resultados

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I should get my grades today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hoje eu devo receber minhas notas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Having a private tutor who knows people has its advantages 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ter um tutor particular que conhece as pessoas tem suas vantagens 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But not as much as before

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 First morning without the cast, how does it feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oi 😊 Primeira manhã sem a gesso, como se sente?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I walked straight into it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E eu fui direto pra isso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for making this possible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigada por tornar isso possível

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome, unfortunately 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: De nada, infelizmente 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But seriously, are you comfortable?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas falando sério, você está confortável?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly. It still feels stiff when I get up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais ou menos. Ainda sinto um pouco rígido quando me levanto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not exactly ready to sprint down the street
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não estou exatamente pronto pra correr pela rua

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I wasn't going to chase you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom, porque eu não ia te perseguir

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not even a little?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nem um pouquinho?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd walk after you with a very disappointed expression
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu andaria atrás de você com uma expressão bem desapontada

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, this is the face you'd be getting
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Espera, essa é a cara que você ia ver

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Strange actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estranho, na verdade

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Terrifying
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Assustadora

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It works on you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Funciona em você

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It really does
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Realmente soa.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm just happy it's finally off ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou só feliz que finalmente saiu ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When I saw your message yesterday, I wanted to come over and hug you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quando vi sua mensagem ontem, eu queria ir aí e te abraçar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That offer still available?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Essa oferta ainda está de pé?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obviamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Although I also want an afternoon with you where neither of us spends half of it asking about your leg
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Embora eu também queira uma tarde com você onde nenhum de nós passe metade dela perguntando sobre sua perna

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We could find a small café somewhere, when I'm up to it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Podemos encontrar um café pequeno em algum lugar, quando eu estiver a fim

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up and moved the blanket like I still had to make room for it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Acordei e movi o cobertor como se ainda tivesse que fazer espaço pra ele

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu gostaria disso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I miss sitting across from you and stealing something off your plate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou com saudade de sentar na sua frente e roubar algo do seu prato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Beautiful. That's what you miss about me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Linda. É isso que você sente falta de mim

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Among other things
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entre outras coisas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But mostly your terrible habit of ordering something nicer than mine
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas principalmente seu péssimo hábito de pedir algo melhor que o meu

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always say you're not hungry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você sempre diz que não está com fome

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not hungry until your food arrives
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não estou com fome até sua comida chegar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Completely different situation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Situação completamente diferente 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Speaking of food, have you had breakfast?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Falando em comida, você já tomou café da manhã?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Café

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You got attached to it 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você se apegou a ele 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a drink
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso é uma bebida

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look who's suddenly responsible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Olha quem de repente ficou responsável

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I learned from a very strict woman
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aprendi com uma mulher bem rígida

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ela parece adorável

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Annoying. Very pretty though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Chata. Mas muito bonita

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That saved you ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso te salvou ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I'll prove I'm eating
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Espera, vou provar que estou comendo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast, coffee, and a woman who is definitely going to be late if she keeps texting you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Torrada, café e uma mulher que com certeza vai se atrasar se continuar te mandando mensagem

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent a lot of time together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Passamos muito tempo juntos

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você está linda

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were supposed to notice the toast
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você deveria ter notado a torrada

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I noticed both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu notei os dois

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll allow it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu deixo passar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes all day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aulas o dia todo?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: This morning, then some work with my group after lunch
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Essa manhã, depois um trabalho com meu grupo após o almoço.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent twenty minutes yesterday deciding who was supposed to send a document everyone already had
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ontem, passamos vinte minutos decidindo quem deveria enviar um documento que todo mundo já tinha.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Promising start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Começo promissor.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. I'm bringing snacks and lowering my expectations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exatamente. Vou trazer lanchinhos e baixar minhas expectativas.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sounds like you're the only one prepared
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Parece que você é a única preparada.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Should I be jealous?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Devo ficar com ciúmes?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Emotionally, absolutely not
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Emocionalmente, de jeito nenhum.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I haven't forgotten what we talked about last night
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E eu não esqueci do que conversamos ontem à noite.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to think about the first step properly, not while I'm trying to find my other shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quero pensar no primeiro passo direito, não enquanto estou tentando achar meu outro sapato.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd hate to compete with the shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu odiaria competir com o sapato.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's currently winning
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Atualmente, ele está ganhando.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Found it. Both shoes are on, so now I have no excuse
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Achei. Estou com os dois sapatos, então agora não tenho desculpa.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One last picture before I leave, since you can't be here to distract me in person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Uma última foto antes de eu ir, já que você não pode estar aqui para me distrair pessoalmente.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it very hard to encourage you to leave
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você está tornando muito difícil me incentivar a ir.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was a very supportive relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Foi uma relação muito apoiadora

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're supposed to wish me luck, not make me miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você deveria me desejar boa sorte, não me fazer sentir sua falta.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu consigo fazer os dois.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you can ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sei que você consegue ❤️.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me when you have a quiet moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me manda mensagem quando você tiver um momento tranquilo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu vou ❤️.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And keep some room in your schedule for that hug
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E deixa um espaço na sua agenda para aquele abraço.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll cancel my appointment with the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou cancelar meu compromisso com o sofá

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell it I'm sorry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Diz que eu sinto muito 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh my god
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Meu Deus

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've been saving that one since yesterday, haven't you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você estava guardando essa desde ontem, né?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since the doctor took it off
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Desde que o médico tirou isso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You also got some very interesting rewards along the way
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você também ganhou algumas recompensas bem interessantes no caminho

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I passed the most important exam
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu passei no exame mais importante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So technically I don't really need to keep studying that hard
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Então, tecnicamente, eu não preciso mais estudar tanto assim

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You should still pass the remaining exams to be safe. Keeping Ethan a bit longer is a win-win.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você ainda deve passar nos exames restantes pra ficar segura. Manter o Ethan um pouco mais é uma boa.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You worked hard enough. Maybe it's time to do something other than books for a while.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você trabalhou duro o suficiente. Talvez seja hora de fazer algo além de livros por um tempo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Is it really about the exams...
Or is it you who wants me to keep seeing Ethan? 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ou é você que quer que eu continue vendo o Ethan? 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm just thinking about your diploma
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Só tô pensando no seu diploma

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can be a good person sometimes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Às vezes eu posso ser uma boa pessoa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But when I am, I'm right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas quando eu sou, eu tô certa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep Ethan for the next exams
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou manter o Ethan para as próximas provas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You are the one who will be happy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você é quem vai ficar feliz
{{name:aiden}} começou a fazer treinos de novo
Você poderia se juntar a nós

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You've been stuck studying for weeks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você está preso nos estudos há semanas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Moving a bit wouldn't kill you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mexer um pouco não vai te matar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Especially if you want to keep your body in shape for the summer
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Especialmente se você quiser manter o corpo em forma para o verão

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Be careful, I may be small but I can still kick your ass 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Cuidado, posso ser pequena, mas ainda posso te dar uma surra 😌
Na verdade, você não está errado

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I do feel like I need to move again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu realmente sinto que preciso me mover de novo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oi, finalmente tenho tempo pra comer sem alguém me perguntando sobre nosso projeto em grupo 😮‍💨

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It certainly had more information available
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Com certeza tinha mais informações disponíveis

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Harsh
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cruel

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Accurate 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Preciso 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But it did help me work out something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mas me ajudou a entender uma coisa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to be able to talk to someone normally first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quero conseguir conversar com alguém normalmente primeiro

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to pick a person just because we're excited about trying something new
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não quero escolher alguém só porque estamos animados pra tentar algo novo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want you doing that either
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu também não quero que você faça isso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I want him to know I'm in a relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E quero que ele saiba que estou em um relacionamento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to get halfway through a conversation and feel like I've hidden the important part
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não quero chegar na metade de uma conversa e sentir que escondi a parte importante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Agreed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Concordo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not sure how to write that without making my profile sound like a very serious announcement
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não sei como escrever isso sem fazer meu perfil parecer um anúncio muito sério

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Start with hello. Probably leave out a formal introduction from your boyfriend
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comece com um olá. Provavelmente, deixe de fora uma introdução formal do seu namorado

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mean you haven't prepared one?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você quer dizer que não preparou um?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could include references
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu poderia incluir referências

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De jeito nenhum 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like you to read what I write, though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mas eu gostaria que você lesse o que eu escrevo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not to choose someone for me. Just because this is new and I'd rather not feel alone doing it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não para escolher alguém por mim. Só porque isso é novo e eu prefiro não me sentir sozinha fazendo isso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claro

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And when I said someone we don't know might be simpler, I didn't mean you have to trust the first person who answers
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E quando eu disse que alguém que não conhecemos pode ser mais simples, não quis dizer que você precisa confiar na primeira pessoa que responder

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You found somewhere sunny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você encontrou um lugar ensolarado

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less awkward around our friends doesn't automatically mean I'll feel comfortable with him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Menos constrangedor perto dos nossos amigos não significa automaticamente que eu vou me sentir confortável com ele

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tonight I'll write something and choose a normal photo
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então, hoje à noite eu vou escrever algo e escolher uma foto normal

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Amanhã eu posso decidir se estou feliz em postar e começar uma conversa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds like an actual plan
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso soa como um plano de verdade

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A slightly nervous plan, but yes
