story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um plano um pouco nervoso, mas sim

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's allowed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso é permitido

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also reserve the right to complain to you about terrible profiles
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu também me reservarei o direito de reclamar para você sobre perfis terríveis

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Essa parte nunca esteve em dúvida

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and my lunch hasn't asked a single question about the presentation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, e meu almoço não fez uma única pergunta sobre a apresentação

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought the difficult part would be admitting I was curious
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu pensei que a parte difícil seria admitir que estava curiosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'm thinking about how to start a conversation without sounding completely unlike myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Agora estou pensando em como começar uma conversa sem soar completamente diferente de mim mesma

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to suddenly become some incredibly confident person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não precisa de repente se tornar uma pessoa incrivelmente confiante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because I still rehearse phone calls before ordering food
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom, porque eu ainda ensaio ligações antes de pedir comida

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And then tell me to call instead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E então me diga para ligar em vez disso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you love me 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque você me ama 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Unfortunately for my phone bill
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Infelizmente para a minha conta de telefone

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do want to try this
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu quero tentar isso sim

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just want the first step to feel like something I chose, not something I rushed into because we had a good conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu só quero que o primeiro passo pareça algo que eu escolhi, não algo que eu fiz às pressas só porque tivemos uma boa conversa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent company
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ótima companhia

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we start there
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então começamos por aí

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. They've found another reason to discuss the slides
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu preciso voltar. Eles encontraram mais um motivo para discutir os slides

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stay strong
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fica firme

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm taking the rest of my lunch with me. It's the only thing I trust right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou levando o resto do meu almoço comigo. É a única coisa em que confio agora

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're invited next time. Provided you bring your own fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você está convidado da próxima vez. Desde que traga suas próprias batatas fritas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about yesterday
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estive pensando sobre ontem

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly about what I'd actually feel comfortable doing first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Principalmente sobre o que eu realmente me sentiria confortável fazendo primeiro

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did you get anywhere?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E você chegou a alguma conclusão?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. A little further than just sitting there wondering what you would like
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Um pouco além de apenas ficar sentado pensando no que você gostaria

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you escape?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você conseguiu escapar?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mentioning {{name:aiden}} has made very ordinary things feel less ordinary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você mencionar {{name:aiden}} fez coisas muito comuns parecerem menos comuns

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What things?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Que coisas?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if I had the notes from our last class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele perguntou se eu tinha as anotações da nossa última aula

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I would just send them
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalmente eu só enviaria

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I stared at the message for a stupid amount of time before remembering he was literally asking for class notes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hoje eu fiquei olhando para a mensagem por um tempo absurdo antes de lembrar que ele estava literalmente pedindo as anotações da aula

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please tell me you didn't send him a mysterious reply
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por favor, me diz que você não mandou uma resposta misteriosa pra ele

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Temporarily
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Temporariamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He got the notes. Very exciting development
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele pegou as anotações. Que desenvolvimento emocionante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Slow down, you're getting ahead of yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Calma, você tá se adiantando

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shut up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cala a boca

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But that's the thing. He's already part of my normal life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mas é isso. Ele já faz parte da minha vida normal

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If we talk about this and it feels strange afterward, I'll still see him around campus
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Se a gente falar sobre isso e ficar estranho depois, eu ainda vou vê-lo pelo campus

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. I hadn't really thought about the next ordinary lunch together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: É. Eu realmente não tinha pensado no próximo almoço normal juntos

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu tenho

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think that means we shouldn't talk to him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não acho que isso signifique que não devemos falar com ele

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just don't want to treat it like asking him to join us for a game
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu só não quero tratar isso como se estivesse convidando ele pra jogar com a gente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I understand
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu entendo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I needed lunch and someone asked if we could discuss the slides while I ate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu disse que precisava almoçar e alguém perguntou se poderíamos discutir os slides enquanto eu comia

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How would you want to bring it up?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Como você gostaria de trazer isso à tona?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, for a start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sozinha, pra começar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd rather have a slightly awkward conversation than try to explain something personal with my friends listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prefiro ter uma conversa um pouco awkward do que tentar explicar algo pessoal com meus amigos ouvindo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And probably offering advice nobody asked for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E provavelmente dando conselhos que ninguém pediu

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aguarde

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's coming over. I'll text you when I get a moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele tá vindo. Eu te mando uma mensagem quando eu tiver um momento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UM MOMENTO DEPOIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is anyone sitting here?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tem alguém sentado aqui?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Depends. Are you here to steal my lunch?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Depende. Você está aqui para roubar meu almoço?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you throw the slides at them?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você jogou os slides neles?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone joins the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alguém se junta à mesa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation in progress
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversa em andamento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unexpected Seat
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um Assento Inesperado

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was going to ask about the notes, but now that you've mentioned lunch...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu ia perguntar sobre as anotações, mas agora que você mencionou o almoço...

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got the notes. That's your gift for today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você pegou as anotações. Esse é seu presente de hoje

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Generous as always
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Generoso como sempre

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You okay? You looked miles away earlier
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tá bem? Parecia distante antes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Just thinking about something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Só pensando em algo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something I can help with?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Algo que eu possa ajudar?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe. I'd rather talk about it when it's quieter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Talvez. Prefiro falar sobre isso quando estiver mais tranquilo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A conversa continua

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Attention directed towards the other speaker
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Atenção voltada para o outro falante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I considered it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu considerei isso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something to Say
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Algo a Dizer

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh. Okay
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oh. Ok

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so worried, it's nothing bad
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não fique tão preocupado, não é nada ruim

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't worried until you said that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não estava preocupado até você dizer isso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Great, now I've made it sound dramatic
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ótimo, agora eu fiz parecer dramático

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can tell me when you're ready. I was only coming over to say thanks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você pode me contar quando estiver pronto. Eu só estava vindo agradecer

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For the notes?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Para as anotações?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For saving me from admitting I hadn't written any of that down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por me salvar de admitir que não escrevi nada disso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is. I was wondering why you were being so nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aí está ele. Eu estava me perguntando por que você estava tão legal

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can be nice without wanting something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu posso ser legal sem querer algo em troca

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But I found a table outside instead, so I'm choosing personal growth
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mas encontrei uma mesa do lado de fora, então estou escolhendo o crescimento pessoal

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then take your hand away from my fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então tira a sua mão das minhas batatas fritas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ponto justo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Playful exchange at the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Troca brincalhona na mesa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shared laughter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Risos compartilhados

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like knowing she's laughing, even if I'm still getting used to the thought of them together.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gosto de saber que ela está rindo, mesmo que ainda esteja me acostumando à ideia dos dois juntos.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Lunch Negotiations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Negociações do Almoço

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 20 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 20 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, I have my phone to myself again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok, eu tenho meu celular só para mim de novo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tudo bem?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We just had a normal conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Nós só tivemos uma conversa normal

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly brought it up, but there were people sitting right next to us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quase mencionei, mas tinha pessoas sentadas bem ao nosso lado

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows I want to talk about something. Not what it is
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele sabe que eu quero falar sobre algo. Não sabe o que é

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Proud of you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Orgulhoso de você

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Como foi isso?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Menos aterrorizante do que eu esperava

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although he did try to steal my lunch, so I couldn't take him too seriously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Embora ele tenha tentado roubar meu almoço, então eu não podia levá-lo muito a sério

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso soa familiar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I'll find a quieter moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Amanhã eu vou encontrar um momento mais tranquilo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to see whether we can actually talk about it before deciding anything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quero ver se conseguimos realmente falar sobre isso antes de decidir qualquer outra coisa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay. Tell me how you're feeling tonight
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok. Me conta como você está se sentindo hoje à noite

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu vou

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Obrigado 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I downloaded an app during my break
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu baixei um aplicativo durante meu intervalo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You did?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sério?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just to see what it was like. I haven't put a profile up or messaged anyone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Só pra ver como era. Não coloquei um perfil ou mandei mensagem pra ninguém

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hang on, I'm trying to remember how to get back to the profile screen
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera aí, tô tentando lembrar como voltar pra tela do perfil

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UM MOMENTO DEPOIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, found it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Beleza, achei

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was less intimidating when I stopped treating every man on the screen like some enormous life decision
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ficou menos intimidador quando parei de tratar cada homem na tela como uma decisão de vida enorme

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Any interesting discoveries?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alguma descoberta interessante?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One man had six pictures of himself next to the same car
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um cara tinha seis fotos dele ao lado do mesmo carro

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe the car has a good personality
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Talvez o carro tenha uma boa personalidade

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here's my very exclusive lunch spot
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aqui está meu lugar de almoço super exclusivo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: But I'm warning you right now
Even if she's family, she's getting the exact same treatment as everyone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Mesmo sendo da família, ela vai receber o mesmo tratamento que todo mundo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She needs someone to put her in her place
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Ela precisa de alguém pra colocar ela no lugar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: And while we're talking about people who need to get serious…
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: E já que estamos falando de pessoas que precisam ficar sérias…

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Your leg still isn't gonna fix itself if you keep being lazy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Sua perna ainda não vai se consertar sozinha se você continuar sendo preguiçoso
{{name:hailey}} acabou de me mandar uma mensagem 👀

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: The doctor only took my cast off yesterday, remember?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: O médico só tirou meu gesso ontem, lembra?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Just don't come crying when the real sessions start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Só não venha chorando quando as sessões reais começarem

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She wants to join the training sessions
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Ela quer se juntar aos treinos

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: I might have given her a little push
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Eu posso ter dado um empurrãozinho nela

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Did your grand expedition away from the sofa happen, or did the console win?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi 😊 Sua grande expedição longe do sofá aconteceu, ou o console venceu?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably not immediately
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Provavelmente não de imediato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's partly why I want to talk face to face. I can tell him to stop making jokes if I need to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É por isso que quero conversar pessoalmente. Posso dizer a ele para parar de fazer piadas se precisar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please don't tell him how quickly I said his name
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor, não diga a ele o quão rápido eu disse o nome dele

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You mean immediately?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você quer dizer imediatamente?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds worse when you say it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso soa pior quando você diz

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can leave that detail out 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso deixar esse detalhe de fora 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to show him our messages either. I can explain the situation myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não vou mostrar nossas mensagens para ele também. Posso explicar a situação eu mesma

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obrigado

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we'll see how he feels. I'm not inviting him anywhere before we've even managed that conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então vamos ver como ele se sente. Não vou convidá-lo para lugar nenhum antes de conseguirmos ter essa conversa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know how you're doing when you get a chance
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me avise como você está quando tiver uma chance

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I got home, made dinner, and realized I'd cooked enough pasta for a family of six
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aí cheguei em casa, fiz o jantar e percebi que cozinhei massa suficiente para uma família de seis

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu vou ❤️.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wrote a short introduction earlier. Want to read it?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu escrevi uma introdução curta mais cedo. Quer ler?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Send it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Manda

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm in a relationship, and my partner knows I'm here. I'd like to get to know someone, starting with a conversation and maybe a coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou em um relacionamento, e meu parceiro sabe que estou aqui. Gostaria de conhecer alguém, começando com uma conversa e talvez um café

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That says what you mean
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso diz o que você quer dizer

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't sound too formal?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não soa muito formal?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Add something about yourself that isn't about us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco. Adicione algo sobre você que não seja sobre nós

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like my impressive ability to cook six portions of pasta by accident?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como minha impressionante habilidade de cozinhar seis porções de macarrão por acidente?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's tomorrow sorted
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso já está resolvido para amanhã

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly, yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Honestamente, sim

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like quiet cafés, terrible films, and apparently cooking for people who don't exist
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto de cafés tranquilos, filmes ruins e, aparentemente, cozinhar para pessoas que não existem

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds much more like you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso soa muito mais como você

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're included in the pasta, don't worry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está incluído na massa, não se preocupa 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I want to try taking one now while the light's nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espera, eu quero tentar tirar uma agora que a luz está boa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to give you a completely unbiased opinion
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou tentar te dar uma opinião totalmente imparcial

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That would be a first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso seria uma novidade

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, this one actually looks like me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, esse realmente parece comigo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And possibly the rest of my life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E possivelmente o resto da minha vida

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the expression I get when you tell me you've only stolen one fry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa é a expressão que eu faço quando você me diz que só roubou uma batata frita

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I look innocent because I am
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu pareço inocente porque sou

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo is excellent. The legal defense needs work
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A foto está excelente. A defesa legal precisa de ajustes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the photo then 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou ficar com a foto então 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll use that one and read the introduction again tomorrow before I put anything up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou usar essa e ler a introdução de novo amanhã antes de postar qualquer coisa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I can see if there's someone I actually want to talk to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aí eu posso ver se tem alguém com quem eu realmente quero conversar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you don't owe anyone a conversation just because they message you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você não deve nada a ninguém só porque te mandou uma mensagem

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm curious, not accepting applications from the entire internet
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Estou curiosa, não aceitando candidaturas de toda a internet

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's a good profile title
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Agora isso é um bom título de perfil

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not helping anymore
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não está ajudando mais

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could bring some next time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você poderia trazer alguns da próxima vez

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm nervous about tomorrow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou nervosa para amanhã

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I like that it's a small thing I actually want to do, rather than some huge leap I'm trying to be ready for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas eu gosto que é uma coisa pequena que eu realmente quero fazer, em vez de um grande salto que estou tentando me preparar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me if it turns out to feel different than you expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode me contar se acabar sendo diferente do que você esperava

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você também

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you pretending you're fine just because you were the one who brought it up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não quero que você finja que está tudo bem só porque foi você quem trouxe isso à tona

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não vou

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now, very important question
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Agora, uma pergunta muito importante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Look at you solving my problems
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Olha você resolvendo meus problemas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou ouvindo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When I bring you pasta, are we watching something decent, or are you making me watch another film where nobody turns a light on?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quando eu te trouxer macarrão, vamos assistir algo decente ou você vai me fazer assistir outro filme onde ninguém acende a luz?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's atmosphere
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é atmosfera

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's two hours of me asking who's standing in the doorway
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso são duas horas eu perguntando quem está na porta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can pick this time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode escolher dessa vez

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sério?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. But I reserve the right to complain
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Mas eu me reservo o direito de reclamar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd be worried if you didn't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu ficaria preocupada se você não reclamasse

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that afternoon with you, you know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu quero aquela tarde com você, sabe

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not to have another serious discussion. Just to eat too much and sit next to you for a while
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não para ter outra conversa séria. Só para comer demais e ficar ao seu lado por um tempo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, let me get comfortable before you distract me again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espera, deixa eu me acomodar antes de você me distrair de novo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também quero isso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then don't forget. I'm still claiming my spot on the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então não esquece. Eu ainda estou garantindo meu lugar no sofá

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's yours
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É seu

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hang on, I'm moving from the sofa to bed before I fall asleep here
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espera aí, estou me mudando do sofá para a cama antes que eu durma aqui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. I'm saving you the other pillow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pronto. Estou guardando o outro travesseiro para você

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're really not helping with how much I miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você realmente não está ajudando com o quanto eu sinto sua falta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then come and claim it when you can
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então venha e pegue quando puder

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu vou ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite, lindo ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night. Save me some pasta
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite. Guarda um pouco de macarrão para mim

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is enough pasta to outlive both of us. Go to sleep 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem macarrão suficiente para nos sobreviver. Vá dormir 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Hair still damp, but I'm not moving again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pronto. Cabelo ainda úmido, mas não vou me mover de novo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to fall asleep
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você parece que vai dormir a qualquer momento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I made it to the kitchen and back several times
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu fui até a cozinha e voltei várias vezes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I've only just sat down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estou. Acabei de me sentar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's usually how it starts
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É assim que geralmente começa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very funny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muito engraçado

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to check before tomorrow, actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na verdade, tem algo que eu queria checar antes de amanhã

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go ahead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vai em frente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The other night, when I asked what you'd want to know if I sent a picture to someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na outra noite, quando perguntei o que você gostaria de saber se eu enviasse uma foto para outra pessoa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember your answer. I just don't want to assume it covers everything we might do
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu lembro da sua resposta. Só não quero assumir que cobre tudo que podemos fazer

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's fair
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é justo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An experienced traveler
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um viajante experiente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, and receive the picture too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você disse que gostaria de saber e receber a foto também

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. I like the idea of being included in what you choose to share
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Eu gosto da ideia de estar incluído no que você decide compartilhar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. But if I'm out talking to someone, I won't necessarily be looking at my phone the whole time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok. Mas se eu estiver conversando com alguém, não vou ficar olhando para o meu celular o tempo todo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to give me updates every five minutes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estou pedindo para você me dar atualizações a cada cinco minutos

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to see the picture if that's something you decide to share. A conversation is different
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gostaria de ver a foto se você decidir compartilhar. Uma conversa é diferente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I don't want you waiting for a message and thinking something's wrong because I'm not typing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Não quero que você fique esperando uma mensagem e pensando que algo está errado porque não estou digitando

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me when you're free, then we can actually talk
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me avisa quando você estiver livre, aí a gente pode realmente conversar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was also a little time outside
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Também teve um tempinho lá fora

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that better
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto mais disso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And don't get too excited about the pictures yet. I haven't even had the first conversation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E não fique muito animado com as fotos ainda. Eu nem tive a primeira conversa 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm being very patient
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou sendo muito paciente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're doing a convincing impression of it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está fazendo uma impressão convincente disso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, but wouldn't necessarily want the picture yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você disse que gostaria de saber, mas não necessariamente queria a foto para você

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That still fits
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Isso ainda se encaixa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to hear about it from you. I don't need you collecting things to show me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quero ouvir isso de você. Não preciso que você colecione coisas para me mostrar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's a relief, honestly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é um alívio, sinceramente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I sat down before I started regretting my ambition
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aí eu sentei antes de começar a me arrepender da minha ambição

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather tell you how something felt than worry about proving it happened
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prefiro te contar como algo me fez sentir do que me preocupar em provar que aconteceu

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not checking your homework
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estou checando seu dever de casa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough of that today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Já tive o suficiente disso hoje

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if you're busy, we can talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E se você estiver ocupado, podemos conversar depois

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I'll tell you when I've got a moment, rather than trying to keep up a second conversation on my phone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok. Vou te contar quando tiver um momento, em vez de tentar manter uma segunda conversa no meu celular

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You still get my ordinary pictures, by the way. You're not escaping my face that easily 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aliás, você ainda recebe minhas fotos normais. Você não vai escapar do meu rosto tão fácil assim 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't planning to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não estava planejando isso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That actually sounds sensible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso até parece sensato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you might not want to know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você disse que talvez não quisesse saber

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you mean not knowing about each individual thing, or not having updates while it's happening?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você quis dizer não saber sobre cada coisa individual, ou não ter atualizações enquanto está acontecendo?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hadn't really separated those in my head
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu realmente não tinha separado isso na minha cabeça

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm asking
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É por isso que estou perguntando

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can understand leaving room for a surprise. I just don't want us to mean two different things without realizing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu consigo entender deixar espaço para uma surpresa. Só não quero que a gente signifique coisas diferentes sem perceber

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let's agree on the limits, but leave some things as a surprise
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vamos concordar nos limites, mas deixar algumas coisas como surpresa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather have no updates during it, then talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prefiro não receber atualizações durante isso, e depois a gente conversa.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather agree on what we're trying first, then leave room for you not to tell me about every little thing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prefiro concordar sobre o que vamos tentar primeiro, e deixar espaço pra você não precisar me contar cada detalhe.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo. Uma surpresa dentro do que já conversamos, sem eu ter que adivinhar até onde vai essa resposta.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound surprised
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você parece surpreso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por enquanto, estamos só falando sobre fazer contato e ver se um primeiro encontro parece certo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Não estou tratando isso como se já tivéssemos concordado com tudo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E se algo parecer errado, eu vou te contar. Não vou guardar isso pra mim só pra manter o mistério.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Same for me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro. O mesmo vale pra mim.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. That makes more sense to me now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Beleza. Isso faz mais sentido pra mim agora.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Acho que prefiro não acompanhar tudo enquanto está acontecendo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas depois, eu gostaria de saber como foi e como você se sentiu.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então eu guardo meu celular, tenho a conversa e a gente fala quando eu estiver livre.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trying not to ruin the moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou tentando não estragar o momento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Isso parece mais com o que eu queria dizer.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I can do that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo. Eu consigo fazer isso.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E se eu precisar falar com você antes, eu vou falar.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obviamente. Você não precisa seguir um plano quando precisar de mim.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad we talked about that now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que a gente tenha falado sobre isso agora.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu ficava imaginando eu olhando pro meu celular, me perguntando se eu deveria estar te mandando algo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you worrying about that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não quero que você se preocupe com isso.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como foi o resto do seu dia?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. É mais fácil agora que a gente realmente falou sobre isso.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So what do you want to do tomorrow?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então, o que você quer fazer amanhã?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou perguntar ao {{name:aiden}} se podemos conversar por alguns minutos depois da aula

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quero explicar que estamos conversando sobre a ideia de eu sair com outra pessoa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E que ele é alguém com quem eu consideraria ter essa conversa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You think he'll believe you're serious?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você acha que ele vai acreditar que você está falando sério?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Terminamos nossa parte do projeto, então finalmente posso parar de pensar nisso

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re really trying to keep me busy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Você realmente está tentando me manter ocupada

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I just didn’t expect you to suggest something like that after last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Eu só não esperava que você sugerisse algo assim depois da noite passada
Mas você vai carregar as sacolas

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Don’t take too long or I’ll start without you and buy only junk food
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Não demore muito ou eu começo sem você e compro só besteira

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been staring at the same page for twenty minutes
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Estou olhando para a mesma página há vinte minutos
Podemos fazer tacos hoje à noite

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re offering to cook with me?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bom dia ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: She has a permanent invitation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ela tem um convite permanente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bom. Lembre-se disso 🤍

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How's your leg after yesterday?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Como está sua perna depois de ontem?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Um pouco dura quando levantei, mas melhorou depois que me movi um pouco

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm glad we stopped when we did
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Fico feliz que paramos quando paramos

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu também. Vou pegar leve esta manhã

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you planning?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: O que você está planejando?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Algumas coisas em casa esta manhã, depois provavelmente uns jogos

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What about you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E você?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm spending the afternoon with my family
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vou passar a tarde com minha família

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Fui pegar minha bolsa e lembrei onde estava

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Almoço primeiro. Depois, aparentemente, vamos jogar cartas

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Apparently?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Aparentemente?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Fui informada. Minha participação não era opcional 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Try to come back with your dignity intact
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tente voltar com sua dignidade intacta

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vou mirar mais alto. Vou ganhar

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's the spirit
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Esse é o espírito

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E então vou permitir que eles me admirem graciosamente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very gracious
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Muito graciosa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay, I need to get ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Beleza, preciso me arrumar

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: It's still beside the sofa
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ainda está ao lado do sofá

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Cuida da minha bolsa. Eu pego quando te ver

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Claro. Aproveita o dia hoje ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too love
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você também, amor

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pelo menos um de nós ficou na sua casa ontem à noite

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your bag was very quiet company
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sua bolsa foi uma companhia bem silenciosa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then don't get too attached to it 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então não se apegue demais a ela 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Too late. We've already had breakfast
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tarde demais. Já tomamos café da manhã

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Without me? Rude
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sem mim? Que rude

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Here's the person you should have invited instead
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Aqui está a pessoa que você deveria ter convidado

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Okay come help me in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ok, vem me ajudar na cozinha

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to just supervise
A while later, after cooking in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Um tempo depois, depois de cozinhar na cozinha
Você é até decente em picar

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m still the one in charge of the seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Eu ainda sou a responsável pelo tempero

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re also the one making the biggest mess
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você também é quem faz a maior bagunça

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I only bought three unnecessary things
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E eu só comprei três coisas desnecessárias

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você acabou de tirar uma foto minha?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: While I have sauce on my face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Enquanto eu tô com molho no rosto?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to say that while I’m covered in taco seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você não pode dizer isso enquanto tô coberta de tempero de taco
Mas eu vou ficar com essa foto
Depois de ontem, isso parece... mais leve

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Don’t get used to me being this calm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Não se acostume a me ver tão calma

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m only like this because the tacos are almost ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Eu só tô assim porque os tacos estão quase prontos

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now stop talking and help me finish plating
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Agora para de falar e me ajuda a terminar de servir

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The cookies were looking at me weird
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Os biscoitos estavam me olhando de um jeito estranho

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m giving us both a solid 8/10
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Eu dou pra nós duas um 8/10

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m saving the 10 for when we don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tô guardando o 10 pra quando a gente não quase ativar o alarme de fumaça

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You mean when you don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você quer dizer quando você não quase ativa o alarme de fumaça

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Enfim... Vou dar uma arrumada e depois dormir

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m exhausted in the best way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Estou exausta, mas de um jeito bom

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It helped more than I expected
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Me ajudou mais do que eu esperava

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I might start requesting weekly taco nights
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Eu posso começar a pedir noites de taco toda semana

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Enfim... Vou dar uma arrumada e depois dormir

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Proof I carried at least one bag
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Prova de que eu carreguei pelo menos uma sacola

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Atualização: o almoço foi ótimo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Say hello to your mom for me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Manda um oi pra sua mãe por mim

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: She sends you a kiss back 😘
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ela te manda um beijo de volta 😘
Me ajuda
O que está acontecendo?
Estou quase terminando minhas cartas

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: But every time I look pleased, someone makes me draw more
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mas toda vez que fico feliz, alguém me faz desenhar mais
Então para de parecer feliz

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Act like your hand is terrible
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Finge que sua mão está péssima
Esse é seu conselho brilhante?
Deixa eles te subestimarem
As cartas estão um desastre

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Fine. I'm trusting you with my reputation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Beleza. Estou confiando em você com minha reputação
ALGUNS MINUTOS DEPOIS
Perdi de novo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you keep a straight face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Você conseguiu manter a cara séria?
Por uns dez segundos

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then someone asked why I looked like I was hiding a crime
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aí alguém perguntou por que eu parecia estar escondendo um crime
Então o blefe precisa de trabalho

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I think I need a new adviser
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Acho que preciso de um novo conselheiro

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Harsh. I was working with limited information
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Cruel. Eu estava trabalhando com informações limitadas

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: They asked who I kept texting
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eles perguntaram quem eu estava sempre mandando mensagem
Já?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you tell them you were receiving expert assistance?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Você disse a eles que estava recebendo assistência de um especialista?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I said my boyfriend was helping me lose
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu disse que meu namorado estava me ajudando a perder
Isso dói
Só porque é verdade 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should give them a chance to miss you. Take a break
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Você deveria dar a eles uma chance de sentir sua falta. Tira um tempo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have. I'm getting another slice of cake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Já fiz. Estou pegando mais um pedaço de bolo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm winning at dessert
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Pelo menos estou ganhando na sobremesa
Uma recuperação forte

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home later this afternoon
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Vou estar em casa mais tarde esta tarde
Você está livre hoje à noite?
Eu perdi duas vezes
Sim. Por quê?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have an idea. I'll tell you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tenho uma ideia. Te conto quando chegar em casa ❤️
Agora estou curiosa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Let me finish my very important cake first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bom. Deixa eu terminar meu bolo muito importante primeiro

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Everyone suddenly becomes very competitive when I'm about to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Todo mundo fica super competitivo quando estou prestes a ganhar
Inclusive você?
Isso é diferente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look at the face of someone being treated unfairly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Olha a cara de quem está sendo tratado injustamente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You look like you're planning revenge
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Você parece estar planejando uma vingança

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: FIM DA NOITE — Você está de volta em casa e tem um momento de sossego.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Really?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sério?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd love to play with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim. Eu adoraria jogar com você

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always sound like you're having fun
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você sempre parece estar se divertindo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu pensei que gostaria de tentar com você em vez de apenas ouvir sobre isso

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then let's find something we can both enjoy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então vamos encontrar algo que possamos aproveitar juntos

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about that racing game you mentioned?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E aquele jogo de corrida que você mencionou?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That would work. We can do a private race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Isso funcionaria. Podemos fazer uma corrida privada

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ok. Mas você tem que explicar os controles primeiro

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Fechado. Vou te enviar um convite assim que você estiver pronto

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UM POUCO MAIS TARDE — Vocês dois iniciam o jogo de corrida. Antes de começar, você explica os controles e deixa {{name:lena}} tentar uma volta de prática.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou em casa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pronta. Por favor, aprecie minha concentração

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Muito profissional. Como está a volta de prática?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've met the same wall three times
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu bati na mesma parede três vezes

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Brake before the corner, then turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pise no freio antes da curva, depois vire

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're trying to do both at full speed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você está tentando fazer os dois a toda velocidade

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought speed was the point
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu pensei que a velocidade era o objetivo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ficar na pista ajuda também

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Certo. Mais uma volta de prática

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: DEPOIS DA PRIMEIRA CORRIDA

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I have a very serious question
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E eu tenho uma pergunta muito séria

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished so far ahead of me 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você terminou tão à frente de mim 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu joguei muito mais. Não compare sua primeira corrida com isso

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também fiquei presa virada para o lado errado

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mas você passou pela última curva direitinho

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Essa é a que você estava batendo na prática

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu percebi isso

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Viu? Você já tá pegando o tempo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Beleza. De novo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Same track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mesma pista?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I have unfinished business with it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim. Tenho assuntos inacabados com ela

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm listening
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou ouvindo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: APÓS A SEGUNDA CORRIDA — {{name:lena}} ainda termina atrás de você, mas completa a pista com menos batidas.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ainda perdi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Check your time, though
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Olha seu tempo, tá?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você terminou muito mais rápido que a primeira corrida

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E eu só girei duas vezes

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Exatamente. Você se lembrou de desacelerar antes das curvas fechadas

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu tava repetindo suas instruções na minha cabeça

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: They worked. That was a much better lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Funcionaram. Essa foi uma volta muito melhor

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você tá sendo legal porque eu sou sua namorada

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu te diria se você não tivesse melhorado

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você jogaria algo comigo hoje à noite?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A volta mais rápida é porque você dirigiu melhor

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Beleza, essa é uma boa resposta ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quer parar ou tentar uma pista diferente?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mais uma nessa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quero ver se consigo fazer isso sem bater

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: APÓS UMA ÚLTIMA CORRIDA

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly had it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quase consegui

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You only clipped the barrier at the end
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você só encostou na barreira no final

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I got excited and forgot to brake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Porque eu fiquei empolgado e esqueci de frear

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sua primeira metade foi muito boa. Continue assim e o resto vem junto

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Espera. Você está me pedindo para jogar?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
