story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quero uma revanche outra noite

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be very happy with that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu ficaria muito feliz com isso

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você ainda tá sorrindo por eu ter perguntado, né?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Um pouco

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu gosto de compartilhar isso com você

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também. Mesmo que você seja irritantemente difícil de pegar

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Agora você entende porque eu sempre quero mais uma rodada

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Infelizmente, sim 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you play games like this when you were little?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você jogava jogos assim quando era pequeno?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim. Eu me inclinava pro lado com o controle como se isso ajudasse a virar

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did that tonight 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu fiz isso hoje à noite 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you have excellent instincts
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então você tem instintos excelentes

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aparentemente, todo mundo exceto o carro entendeu o que eu queria

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vamos trabalhar pra fazer o carro colaborar na próxima vez

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Obrigada por ser paciente comigo hoje à noite

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu me diverti. Você não precisa ganhar para eu gostar de jogar com você

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também me diverti ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Certo. Preparando para amanhã, depois cama

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Boa noite, amor. Obrigado por me chamar para jogar

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Boa noite ❤️ Vamos fazer isso de novo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Why are you so surprised?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Por que você está tão surpreso?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você nunca sugere isso. Normalmente sou eu que falo sobre meus jogos

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really happy you asked, actually
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Na verdade, estou muito feliz que você perguntou

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Morning
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bom dia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Não

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today I’ve got the whole day free
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hoje eu tô com o dia todo livre.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Miraculously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Milagrosamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Want to come shopping with me then?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quer vir fazer compras comigo então?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shopping?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Compras?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need new pants. The doctor took my cast off two days ago, so I can finally wear pants that fit properly again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Preciso de calças novas. O médico tirou meu gesso há dois dias, então finalmente posso voltar a usar calças que sirvam direito.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Oh damn, finally
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ah, finalmente!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yes, with pleasure
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Claro, com prazer!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ve been waiting for an excuse to leave the house without academic guilt
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eu tava esperando uma desculpa pra sair de casa sem culpa acadêmica

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You up?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Acordou?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Give me thirty minutes to look less like a disaster
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Me dá trinta minutos pra eu parecer menos um desastre.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Take your time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Fica tranquila.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Don’t start without me 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Não começa sem mim 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yeah. How are you feeling today?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sim. Como você está se sentindo hoje?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Better than yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Melhor que ontem

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Still a bit tired but my brain isn’t completely soup anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ainda tô um pouco cansada, mas minha cabeça não tá completamente de molho mais

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good. When are you seeing your professor again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bom. Quando você vai ver seu professor de novo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably one day out of two
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Provavelmente um dia sim, um dia não

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Sometimes every day if he thinks I need it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Às vezes todo dia, se ele achar que eu preciso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He’s taking this whole “extra sessions” thing pretty seriously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele tá levando essa história de "sessões extras" bem a sério.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hoje também?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ decidi que nunca assistimos aquele filme e minha reputação ainda está intacta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, then it wasn't just me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ótimo, então não fui só eu

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What about you? Better night?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E você? Teve uma noite melhor?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muito melhor, e eu levantei e fiz café da manhã antes de olhar meu celular

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sem deixar um rastro de coisas que você deixou cair?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One spoon, but I picked it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Uma colher, mas eu peguei

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou orgulhosa da sua manhã tão ambiciosa ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've also put both shoes on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu também já coloquei os dois sapatos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sentada?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sentado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See, you can be taught 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Viu, você pode aprender 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning to you too, detective
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom dia para você também, detetive

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How's your breakfast going?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Como está seu café da manhã?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Está tudo bem, o problema é arrumar minha bolsa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou levando a massa de ontem à noite para não ser roubada por outro sanduíche

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Future You finally got something out of that dinner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: O Futuro Você finalmente tirou algo daquele jantar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She got food and an extremely full bag
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ela conseguiu comida e uma bolsa extremamente cheia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Put the food at the top
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Coloque a comida em cima

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I have to carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Então eu tenho que carregar o livro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Carregue o livro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você faz tudo parecer tão fácil quando não é você tentando fechar esse zíper 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could leave something at home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você poderia deixar algo em casa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não começa, eu nem tomei café da manhã ainda 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need all of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu preciso de tudo isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Incluindo o que está no fundo há três semanas?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't know what's at the bottom
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você não sabe o que tem no fundo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sabe?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's not the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esse não é o ponto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I think I've got it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Espera, acho que entendi

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por favor, valorize que estou vestida e pronta antes do último minuto possível

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look really good ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você está realmente bem ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigada, lindo 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would a red scarf make you feel better?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Um cachecol vermelho te faria sentir melhor?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A bolsa parece que vai perder uma briga

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Compliment the girl, not the luggage
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Elogie a garota, não a bagagem

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A garota é adorável. A bagagem tem minha simpatia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muito melhor 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aulas de novo essa manhã?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, then straight to work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, depois direto para o trabalho

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu gostaria de terminar tudo sem ficar olhando para o relógio na última hora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A reasonable goal
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Um objetivo razoável

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing with your day?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: O que você vai fazer hoje?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou limpar aquele armário da cozinha que tenho evitado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will hide your remote the next time I come over
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou esconder seu controle remoto da próxima vez que eu vier

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one where things fall on you when you open it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aquele em que as coisas caem em você quando você abre?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Prefiro pensar nisso como uma função surpresa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você também poderia colocar menos coisas nele 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou fazendo espaço para as boas canecas de café

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Importante, não quero que nosso primeiro café de verdade juntos saia de um medidor

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've ruined my entire presentation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você estragou toda a minha apresentação

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guarde o esforço para o café, não vou julgar muito a caneca ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather take you out for one soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Prefiro te levar para um café logo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu gostaria disso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo, preciso ir antes que chegar cedo vire perder o ônibus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like a confession
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso soa como uma confissão

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Provavelmente não vou ficar muito no celular esta tarde

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não esquece seu almoço depois de todo esse esforço

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Já está me machucando, eu não conseguiria esquecer se tentasse 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou te mandar mensagem quando chegar no bar hoje à noite, como eu disse

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, have a good day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ok, tenha um bom dia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você também, lindo ❤️ Te amo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Amo você também

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It sounds like a warning 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso soa como um aviso 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep well at least?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você dormiu bem pelo menos?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, uma vez que parei de tentar entender como o final realmente fazia sentido

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It didn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não aconteceu

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The second one looks less tragic
Thanks for the vote of confidence

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você tá certa, B é melhor

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I saw something quite nice near the entrance
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu vi algo bem legal perto da entrada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m still buying this one though
We can go pay and get food after
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Podemos ir pagar e pegar comida depois.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ Estamos no bar, e finalmente sentei em algum lugar que não é uma cadeira de escritório

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode continuar zombando das minhas recomendações, mas parece que você gostou dessa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do like it here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu realmente gosto daqui

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, that wasn't difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viu, isso não foi difícil

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você vai ser insuportável sobre isso a noite toda, não vai?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Só até você parar de agir surpresa que eu tenho bom gosto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not giving you that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não vou te dar essa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não precisa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você? O que você realmente faz quando não está naquele escritório?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sair, encontrar um lugar bom pra comer, dirigir pra algum lugar quando eu tiver um dia livre

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tell everyone where to sit when you get there?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E vai dizer a todo mundo onde sentar quando chegar lá?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nice, not too busy yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Legal, ainda não está muito cheio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Someone has to stop them choosing the table by the toilets
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alguém tem que impedir que escolham a mesa perto dos banheiros

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not even denying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você nem tá negando isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why would I?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por que eu faria isso?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can't decide whether that's confidence or a complete lack of shame
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não consigo decidir se isso é confiança ou uma total falta de vergonha

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know when you've made up your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me avisa quando você decidir

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As the musicians set up at the other end of the room...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Enquanto os músicos se preparam do outro lado da sala...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are they playing here tonight?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eles vão tocar aqui hoje à noite?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks like it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parece que sim

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought that was just equipment from another night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Achei que era só equipamento de outra noite

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your one drink is nearly finished
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sua única bebida tá quase acabando

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've got a little table near the side wall
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Temos uma mesinha perto da parede lateral

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you timing me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você tá me cronometrando?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm deciding whether to ask for the food menu
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou decidindo se peço o cardápio de comida

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's one right here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem um bem aqui

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você percebeu

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou carregando macarrão sobrando o dia todo. Deixa eu olhar outra coisa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your phone again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Seu celular de novo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm checking the time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou vendo as horas

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Seu namorado tá esperando notícias suas?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know what I was doing
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu disse que ia avisá-lo sobre o que eu estava fazendo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him the food's good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Diz pra ele que a comida é boa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por quê?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So he knows why you're staying
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Assim ele sabe por que você tá ficando

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I haven't said I'm staying yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda não disse que vou ficar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você tá olhando pra esse cardápio há cinco minutos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe I'm hungry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Talvez eu esteja com fome

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then stay and eat with me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então fica e come comigo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Beleza, quero ouvir um pouco da música também

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm choosing the food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas eu que vou escolher a comida

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd say that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sabia que você ia dizer isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me dá um minuto, vou avisá-lo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That does look nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso parece bom

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vamos comer alguma coisa antes de ir, tem uma banda começando aqui 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're staying a bit longer?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então você vai ficar mais um tempinho?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É, eu não tinha percebido que tinha música ao vivo hoje à noite

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you getting?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O que você vai pedir?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pão sírio e batata frita, nada muito sofisticado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Melhor do que carregar seu almoço o dia todo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aquele recipiente tá vazio agora, pode parar de julgar minhas decisões 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you were just going for a drink
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Achei que você só ia pra tomar uma bebida

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também, mas estamos nos divertindo e não como desde o almoço

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Beleza.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E a cadeira não está tentando destruir minhas costas, o que eu aprecio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou te mandar mensagem quando chegar em casa ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When the food arrives...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quando a comida chegar...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Jantar, antes que eu coma todas as batatas fritas 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parece bom

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está cheirando bem também, vou comer enquanto está quente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy your food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aproveita sua comida

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk in a bit ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Falo contigo já ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: As batatas fritas podem ser comidas agora?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you ordered?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você já pediu?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I took one photo, you'll survive
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tirei uma foto, você vai sobreviver

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They looked better without the phone between us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Elas estavam melhores sem o celular entre nós

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode ter minha atenção sem ser dramático sobre isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then put it down and try that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então coloca isso de lado e tenta assim

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The flatbread?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O pão sírio?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, the tablecloth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não, a toalha de mesa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Continue falando e eu vou comer a sua metade também

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ordered extra fries for a reason
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu pedi batatas fritas extras por um motivo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do have your uses
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você tem suas utilidades

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful, that's nearly another compliment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cuidado, isso é quase outro elogio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not yet, I'm still looking
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda não, estou olhando ainda

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few songs into the set...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Algumas músicas no set...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you say?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O que você disse?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mova sua cadeira pra cá, não vou gritar do outro lado da mesa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just asked me to sit next to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você poderia ter apenas me pedido pra sentar ao seu lado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Acabei de fazer isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In the most bossy way possible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Da maneira mais mandona possível

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you're moving the chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E mesmo assim você está movendo a cadeira

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Porque eu não consigo te ouvir, não fique tão satisfeito

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not stopping you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estou te impedindo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deixa eu mover minha bolsa antes que você coloque o pé em cima

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll let you get on with it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou deixar você se virar com isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is the book getting its own chair too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O livro também vai ganhar uma cadeira?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It has better manners than you, it deserves one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele tem melhores maneiras que você, merece uma

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} move a cadeira ao lado do gerente para ouvi-lo sobre a música

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela se inclina mais perto para responder, com a mão descansando brevemente em seu antebraço

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É a mão dela no braço dele que mexe comigo. Um gesto tão pequeno, e aqui estou me perguntando o quanto ainda vão se aproximar.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Little Closer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um Pouco Mais Perto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know this one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você conhece essa?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, não me peça pra cantar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to risk the evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não ia arriscar a noite

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excuse you, I might be very good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Com licença, eu posso ser muito boa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode. Estou gostando demais disso pra descobrir

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você é horrível

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the cupboard survive you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O armário sobreviveu a você?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você riu

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't make you less horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso não te torna menos horrível

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're different out here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você é diferente aqui fora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less tired than I was at six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Menos cansada do que eu estava às seis?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você realmente mantém meu olhar quando fala comigo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe you stare too much
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Talvez você olhe demais

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like looking at you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto de olhar pra você

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could try being subtle
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você poderia tentar ser sutil

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I could. I don't see the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu poderia. Não vejo a razão

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu percebi.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está atualmente em várias pilhas pela cozinha

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already an improvement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Já é uma melhoria

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the set, with the plates cleared...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois do show, com os pratos limpos...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should check the bus times
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu deveria checar os horários do ônibus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get the bill
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu vou pegar a conta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can pay for my food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu posso pagar pela minha comida

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I invited you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu te convidei

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't mean I can't pay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso não significa que eu não posso pagar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It means I'm paying tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Significa que eu vou pagar hoje à noite

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really are like this everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você realmente é assim em todo lugar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não teve uma noite chata, teve?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll give you that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não, eu te dou isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então você está naquele ponto em que se arrepende de ter começado 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu aceito

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in about twenty minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem um ônibus em cerca de vinte minutos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Plenty of time. Get your jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem bastante tempo. Pega sua jaqueta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get your jacket, please
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pega sua jaqueta, por favor

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, you can learn
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viu, você pode aprender

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Deeply
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Profundamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deixa pelo menos uma caneca usável pra mim, tá bom?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sem promessas

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou deixar meu celular de lado por um tempo, te mando mensagem quando chegar em casa ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, talk later
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, falamos depois

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At their table, a little later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na mesa deles, um pouco depois...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma conversa no bar foi detectada perto de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela disse que era uma bebida depois do trabalho. Quero acreditar que posso relaxar, mas continuo olhando para a tela.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//TRANSCRIÇÃO AO VIVO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está bem

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You saw me at work an hour ago
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você me viu no trabalho há uma hora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem comida também, então está ganhando de lavada 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You looked good then too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você estava bem então também

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that why you kept looking over?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É por isso que você ficou olhando?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você achou que eu estava verificando se você tinha terminado o relatório?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're supposed to be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você deveria estar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The report got finished, didn't it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O relatório foi terminado, não foi?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work talk tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nada de trabalho hoje à noite

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você que trouxe isso à tona

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Já posso ver que você vai ser cansativo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that how you speak to your boss ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É assim que você fala com seu chefe?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I remind you what my boss did to me ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Devo te lembrar o que meu chefe fez comigo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you finish on time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você terminou a tempo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ..what good weather we have today
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ..que tempo bom estamos tendo hoje

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah I thought so
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É, eu pensei assim

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been smiling since you sat down. I'll take my chances
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está sorrindo desde que se sentou. Vou arriscar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You always this pleased with yourself?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você sempre está tão satisfeito consigo mesmo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: On a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Em uma boa noite

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've barely started
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mal começamos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right, before your head gets any bigger, what are you having?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo, antes que sua cabeça fique ainda maior, o que você vai pedir?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get the ginger one, it's good here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Peça o de gengibre, é bom aqui

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you give instructions everywhere you go?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você dá ordens em todo lugar que vai?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just about, I had to put the lunch container back in my bag very carefully
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quase, tive que colocar o recipiente do almoço de volta na minha bolsa com muito cuidado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when I know what I'm talking about
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Só quando sei do que estou falando

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So in your opinion, everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então, na sua opinião, em todo lugar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're getting to know me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está começando a me conhecer

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unfortunately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Infelizmente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm having the orange one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou de laranja

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just to disagree with me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Só para discordar de mim?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I like it. Shocking, I know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Porque eu gosto. Chocante, eu sei

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fine, but don't ask for mine when you change your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tudo bem, mas não peça o meu quando você mudar de ideia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't worry, I wouldn't give you the satisfaction
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não se preocupe, eu não te daria essa satisfação

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After their drinks arrive...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois que as bebidas chegarem...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still carrying the book too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda está carregando o livro também?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, the table was a good choice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, a mesa foi uma boa escolha

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So was the bar
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O bar também foi

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can accept one compliment without collecting the rest
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode aceitar um elogio sem precisar coletar os outros

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why stop at one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por que parar em um?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you come here a lot?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você vem aqui com frequência?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Often enough to know which table isn't beside the speaker
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Frequentemente o suficiente para saber qual mesa não fica ao lado do alto-falante

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very strategic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muito estratégico

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought a friend here for his birthday last month. He'd invited six people and booked nowhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu trouxe um amigo aqui para o aniversário dele no mês passado. Ele convidou seis pessoas e não reservou nada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds organised
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso soa bem organizado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He called it being spontaneous. I called the owner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele chamou isso de ser espontâneo. Eu chamei o dono

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, it has experienced a full working day without being opened once
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, ele passou um dia inteiro de trabalho sem ser aberto uma vez

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So your story about saving the evening is actually a story about knowing someone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então sua história sobre salvar a noite é na verdade uma história sobre conhecer alguém

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We ate, didn't we?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nós comemos, não foi?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope he bought your dinner after that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espero que ele tenha pago seu jantar depois disso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. If I'm organising it and paying for it, we can celebrate my birthday instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro. Se eu estou organizando e pagando, podemos celebrar meu aniversário em vez disso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aí está

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O quê?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The part where you make yourself the main event
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A parte em que você se torna o evento principal

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're welcome to tell the next story
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode contar a próxima história

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't think I can compete with your heroic table reservation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não acho que posso competir com sua heroica reserva de mesa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode tentar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A useful contribution
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma contribuição útil

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, yesterday my professor explained the wrong slide for ten minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo, ontem meu professor explicou o slide errado por dez minutos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody said anything?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ninguém disse nada?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were all writing it down. I had half a page before someone finally asked
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estávamos todos anotando. Eu tinha meia página antes que alguém finalmente perguntasse

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You should have interrupted him
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você deveria ter interrompido ele

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy assuming he knew more than I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu estava ocupada assumindo que ele sabia mais do que eu

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You make that mistake with everyone in charge?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você comete esse erro com todo mundo que está no comando?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less and less lately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cada vez menos ultimamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That wasn't a compliment to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso não foi um elogio para você

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não levei como um

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Emotional support literature 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Literatura de apoio emocional 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes a change
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é uma mudança

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} laughs with her manager over their drinks
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} ri com a gerente dela enquanto tomam seus drinks

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That smile hurts more than I expected. I used to see it and feel like the person she wanted to be with.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esse sorriso dói mais do que eu esperava. Antes, quando eu o via, sentia que era a pessoa com quem ela queria estar.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Away From the Office
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fora do Escritório

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you doing when classes finish?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O que você vai fazer quando as aulas terminarem?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleeping until I don't hate my alarm anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dormindo até eu não odiar mais meu despertador

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois disso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want a day at the beach with a book and no timetable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quero um dia na praia com um livro e sem horários

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not some big organised thing, just enough time that I don't have to keep checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nada muito organizado, só tempo suficiente para eu não ter que ficar checando meu celular

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know a good stretch away from the main beach
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu conheço um bom trecho longe da praia principal

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro que você conhece

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's the place like?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como é o lugar?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I hope your professor gives you a ton of punishment exercises tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Espero que seu professor te dê um monte de exercícios de punição amanhã.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That doesn’t bother me at all
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Isso não me incomoda nem um pouco.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Extra work with him is… fine
Anyway I’m going to sleep before you start interrogating me again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: De qualquer forma, vou dormir antes que você comece a me interrogar de novo.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We went shopping for my pants and somehow you still ended up buying more stuff than me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Fomos às compras para eu comprar uma calça e, de alguma forma, você ainda acabou comprando mais coisas do que eu

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re a threat to the shopping industry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Você é uma ameaça para a indústria das compras

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And yet you still invited me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: E mesmo assim você ainda me convidou.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little after nine, outside the bar...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Um pouco depois das nove, do lado de fora do bar...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você soa como eu

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Someone has to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Alguém tem que fazer

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Fine, I'll get it in a minute 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tá bom, eu pego em um minuto 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: How did your afternoon go? Did you finish the cupboard?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Como foi sua tarde? Conseguiu terminar o armário?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Finished it and then somehow started on the drawer underneath
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Terminei e de alguma forma comecei na gaveta de baixo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's how it gets you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: É assim que te pega

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I found enough takeaway cutlery to open a restaurant
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Achei talheres de entrega suficientes para abrir um restaurante

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Please tell me you threw some of it away
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Por favor, me diz que você jogou alguns fora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: A maioria

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: A maioria?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't make me regret saying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não me faça arrepender de ter dito isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There might be a sudden fork emergency
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Pode haver uma emergência repentina de garfos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll keep that in mind if mine goes missing 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vou lembrar disso se o meu sumir 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It's actually nice having it sorted though
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Na verdade, é bom ter tudo organizado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Now you can find the mugs without something landing on you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Agora você pode encontrar as canecas sem algo cair em você

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll be impressed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você vai ficar impressionada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to ask about that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu ia perguntar sobre isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: My collection of forks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Minha coleção de garfos?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Coming over, idiot ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Estou indo aí, idiota ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I checked tomorrow's hours before I left today. I finish at five
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Verifiquei os horários de amanhã antes de sair hoje. Termino às cinco

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Can I come over after work? Around six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Posso ir aí depois do trabalho? Por volta das seis?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Too late, I'm keeping that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tarde demais, eu vou guardar essa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, of course
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Claro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You don't have somewhere else to be?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você não tem outro lugar para ir?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I'd like to spend the evening with you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não, eu quero passar a noite com você

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'd like that too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu também gostaria disso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We can make something to eat, and you can pick a film that doesn't insult both of us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Podemos fazer algo para comer, e você pode escolher um filme que não ofenda nenhum de nós

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sure you can cope without solving a crime?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tem certeza de que consegue ficar sem resolver um crime?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll investigate the kitchen cupboard instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vou investigar o armário da cozinha então

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A much more dangerous assignment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Uma missão muito mais perigosa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll bring protective equipment 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vou trazer equipamento de proteção 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed having you here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Senti falta de ter você aqui

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Obviously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Obviamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed it too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu também senti falta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And I want an actual hug, not another message about one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: E eu quero um abraço de verdade, não mais uma mensagem sobre isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That can be arranged
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Isso pode ser combinado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good ❤️ I'll text you when I leave work tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Bom ❤️ Vou te mandar uma mensagem quando sair do trabalho amanhã

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll be here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Estarei aqui

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'd better be, I'm not putting up with a full day just to find you've gone out 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: É melhor que esteja, não vou aguentar um dia inteiro só para descobrir que você saiu 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll make room on the sofa
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vou fazer espaço no sofá

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't take the good cushion
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não pegue a boa almofada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Still making demands from your own house
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ainda fazendo exigências da sua própria casa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Always ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sempre ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your stop is down here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sua parada é aqui embaixo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay, I'm going to bed before I fall asleep with the light on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ok, vou para a cama antes que eu adormeça com a luz acesa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you take the lunch box out?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você tirou a lancheira?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, it's in the sink. You can stop supervising me now 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sim, está na pia. Você pode parar de me supervisionar agora 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll consider it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vou considerar isso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Boa noite, gato, te amo ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Love you too, see you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Te amo também, até amanhã

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: See you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Até amanhã ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know where it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu sei onde é

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The music was good. I'd have stayed longer if I didn't have things to do tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: A música estava boa. Eu teria ficado mais tempo se não tivesse coisas pra fazer amanhã

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We'll know for next time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vamos saber para a próxima vez

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're already deciding there's a next time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você já está decidindo que vai ter uma próxima vez?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm saying I'd take you out again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Estou dizendo que te levaria de novo.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You could leave a little room for uncertainty
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você poderia deixar um pouco de espaço para a incerteza.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The conversation continues as the two subjects walk toward the bus stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: A conversa continua enquanto os dois caminham em direção ao ponto de ônibus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They're walking out together. I should be glad the evening is ending, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm waiting for something worse.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eles estão indo embora juntos. Eu deveria ficar feliz que a noite está terminando, mas não consigo afastar a sensação de estar esperando algo pior.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//TRANSCRIÇÃO AO VIVO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Why? I know what I want
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Por quê? Eu sei o que quero.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That must be nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Isso deve ser bom.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You weren't exactly rushing for the door either
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você também não estava exatamente correndo para a porta.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I wasn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não, eu não estava.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They stop on a quieter corner, with the bus stop visible farther along the street...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eles param em uma esquina mais tranquila, com o ponto de ônibus visível mais adiante na rua...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I've wanted to kiss you again all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu queria te beijar de novo a noite toda.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You really don't keep anything to yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você realmente não guarda nada para si.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Not that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não isso.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't get ahead of yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não se empolgue demais.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then stop looking at my mouth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Então para de olhar para a minha boca.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't realise how loud it was in there until we came outside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu não percebi o quão barulhento estava lá dentro até sairmos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I don't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu não.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I have a boyfriend. That hasn't changed since yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu tenho um namorado. Isso não mudou desde ontem.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know. I'm not pretending I only invited you out to talk about work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu sei. Não estou fingindo que só te convidei para falar sobre trabalho.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, you've made that very clear
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não, você deixou isso bem claro.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: For once, can you stop looking so smug?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Por uma vez, você pode parar de parecer tão convencido?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're making that difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você está tornando isso difícil.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: {{name:lena}} draws him closer by his jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: {{name:lena}} puxa ele mais perto pela jaqueta.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The manager leans in and kisses her; she returns the kiss
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: O gerente se inclina e a beija; ela retribui o beijo.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: She's pulling him closer this time. I can't tell myself this is only something he did to her anymore.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Desta vez é ela quem o puxa para perto. Já não posso dizer a mim mesmo que isso é apenas algo que ele fez com ela.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Before the Bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Antes do ônibus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't say it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não diz isso.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Say what?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Dizer o quê?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You were managing to make yourself heard
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você estava conseguindo se fazer ouvir

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Whatever smug thing you're about to say
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Qualquer coisa convencida que você está prestes a dizer.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to say I had a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu ia dizer que tive uma boa noite.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Somehow you still made that sound smug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: De alguma forma, você ainda fez isso soar convencido.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll get used to it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Você vai se acostumar com isso.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't push your luck
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Não tente a sorte.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Worth a try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vale a tentativa.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I need to go now
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu preciso ir agora.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your bus isn't here yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Seu ônibus ainda não chegou.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eu sei, mas vou esperar no ponto.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right. See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Certo. Te vejo amanhã.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
