story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We've been talking about it for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Estamos falando sobre isso há um tempo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Why? Did something happen between you two?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por quê? Aconteceu algo entre vocês dois?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, we're happy together. It's not about breaking up or finding someone to replace him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não, estamos felizes juntos. Não se trata de terminar ou encontrar alguém para substituí-lo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'm definitely missing something, because I'd be wondering why my girlfriend wanted to date somebody else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então eu definitivamente estou perdendo algo, porque eu ficaria me perguntando por que minha namorada queria sair com outra pessoa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He was the one who brought it up. He likes the idea of me being with someone else, with us deciding together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Foi ele quem trouxe isso à tona. Ele gosta da ideia de eu estar com outra pessoa, decidindo juntos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think we both grew as people
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Acho que nós dois crescemos como pessoas.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He brought it up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele trouxe isso à tona?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. And after talking about it, I realized I was curious too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. E depois de conversar sobre isso, percebi que eu também estava curiosa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're serious? This isn't you two trying to see what I'll say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você está falando sério? Não é vocês dois tentando ver o que eu vou dizer?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do I look like I'm having fun explaining this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu pareço estar me divertindo explicando isso?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm not laughing at you, I just really wasn't ready for that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Desculpa. Não estou rindo de você, só realmente não estava pronta para isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither was I when he first told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu também não estava quando ele me contou pela primeira vez

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, but why are you telling me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo, mas por que você está me contando isso?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I wanted to ask how you'd feel about being that person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque eu queria saber como você se sentiria sendo essa pessoa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me? Wait, you mean you want to go on a date with me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu? Espera, você quer dizer que quer sair comigo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, the man standing behind you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não, o homem que está atrás de você

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is where I'm hiding for five minutes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De qualquer forma, é aqui que eu tô me escondendo por cinco minutos.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't do that, I'm still trying to catch up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não faz isso, ainda estou tentando entender

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, you. That's why I asked you to meet me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, você. É por isso que eu pedi para você me encontrar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Holy shit. And he knows it's me? Not just some guy he doesn't know?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Caraca. E ele sabe que sou eu? Não só algum cara que ele não conhece?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you specifically, so this isn't something I'm bringing up behind his back
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nós falamos especificamente sobre você, então isso não é algo que estou trazendo às escondidas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So he knows you're here right now, asking me this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então ele sabe que você está aqui agora, me perguntando isso?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He knew I was going to talk to you after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Ele sabia que eu ia falar com você depois da aula

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you wanted advice about something. I wasn't expecting to be part of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu pensei que você queria conselhos sobre algo. Não esperava fazer parte disso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you understand why I spent all morning working out how to say it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Agora você entende por que passei a manhã toda pensando em como dizer isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I kept expecting him to tell me to stop flirting with you. This is a very different conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu estava esperando que ele me dissesse para parar de flertar com você. Esta é uma conversa bem diferente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could at least pretend to be less proud of yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você poderia pelo menos fingir que está menos orgulhoso de si mesmo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not even at proud yet. I'm still trying to believe you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ainda nem estou orgulhoso. Estou tentando acreditar em você

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} has been keeping a few surprises to himself, hasn't he?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} anda guardando umas surpresas, hein?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I had exactly the same look on my face when we first talked about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aparentemente. Eu tinha exatamente a mesma expressão no rosto quando falamos sobre isso pela primeira vez

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Poor guy. He finally tells you what's on his mind and now we're sitting here comparing our reactions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Coitado. Ele finalmente te contou o que estava pensando e agora estamos aqui comparando nossas reações

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're the one staring at me like I asked you to help me rob a bank
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você é quem está me encarando como se eu tivesse pedido pra você me ajudar a roubar um banco

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd have understood the bank faster
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu teria entendido o banco mais rápido

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't surprise me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso não me surpreende

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, I never thought I'd hear this kind of proposal from you two
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sério, eu nunca pensei que ouviria esse tipo de proposta de vocês dois

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. We like discovering new things together, but this one took a bit more talking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei. A gente gosta de descobrir coisas novas juntos, mas essa aqui exigiu um pouco mais de conversa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I would hope so
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu espero que sim

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're enjoying the silence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você parece estar curtindo o silêncio.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At first I wasn't sure what I thought. Then we talked more, and I found myself wanting to see how it could feel
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No começo eu não sabia o que pensar. Depois conversamos mais e eu percebi que queria ver como seria

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And that's where I came in?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E é aí que eu entrei?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Eventually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eventualmente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Whose idea was that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De quem foi essa ideia?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you. You're not getting the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nós falamos sobre você. Você não está pegando toda a conversa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm only asking whether I should thank you or him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Só estou perguntando se devo agradecer a você ou a ele

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither until you've actually answered my question
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nenhum dos dois até você realmente responder minha pergunta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're enjoying watching me struggle now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você está gostando de me ver se esforçar agora

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little. I've been nervous about this all morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um pouco. Estive nervosa com isso a manhã toda

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. Why me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo. Por que eu?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For once nobody can ask whether the next slide is important
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pela primeira vez, ninguém pode perguntar se o próximo slide é importante.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I really wasn't expecting her to show up like that 👀
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Eu realmente não esperava que ela aparecesse assim 👀

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She's always had a crush on you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ela sempre teve uma queda por você

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Now she's just taking full advantage of it 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Agora ela tá aproveitando isso ao máximo 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Bro it was actually hard to concentrate on the exercises 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Cara, foi realmente difícil me concentrar nos exercícios 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Everyone can do whatever they want
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Cada um pode fazer o que quiser

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Looking forward to the next sessions 🔥
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Mal posso esperar pelas próximas sessões 🔥

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: And you, take it easy on the leg
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: E você, se cuida com a perna
Você se saiu muito bem hoje 🔥

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: The doctor only took your cast off two days ago
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: O médico só tirou seu gesso há dois dias.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: First real session without the cast and you already handled most of the exercises
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Primeira sessão real sem a bota e você já fez a maioria dos exercícios

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: It was really hard to stay focused during the session 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Foi realmente difícil ficar focado durante a sessão 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've just put dinner on the table, have you eaten or are you still negotiating with that game?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ acabei de colocar o jantar na mesa, você já comeu ou ainda tá negociando com esse jogo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like talking to you like this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto de conversar com você assim

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even when you ask questions I can't answer with a joke?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mesmo quando você faz perguntas que não consigo responder com uma piada?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Especialmente então

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although I'm sure you'll make another attempt in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Embora eu tenha certeza de que você vai tentar de novo em um minuto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm waiting for an opening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou esperando uma oportunidade

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Predictable man
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Homem previsível

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Anyway, I wanted to try something on before I get too comfortable to move
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De qualquer forma, eu queria experimentar algo antes de ficar muito confortável para me mover

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Para amanhã?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I was going to wear whatever I pulled out first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, eu ia usar o que eu pegasse primeiro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I realized I actually wanted to choose something I liked
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então percebi que na verdade queria escolher algo que eu gostasse

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Show me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me mostra

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me dá um minuto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 6 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 6 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one, with the jacket if it's cooler
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esse aqui, com a jaqueta se estiver mais frio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gostei

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You answered very quickly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você respondeu muito rápido

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you prefer a slower compliment?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você prefere um elogio mais devagar?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd prefer one I believe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu prefiro um que eu acredite

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to enjoy your afternoon, not spend it worrying about your clothes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você parece que vai aproveitar sua tarde, não passar se preocupando com suas roupas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso parece bom

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's actually exactly what I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é exatamente o que eu queria

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you look beautiful
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você está linda

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That part helps too 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa parte ajuda também 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can walk in these shoes without thinking about every step, so they're staying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu consigo andar com esses sapatos sem pensar em cada passo, então eles vão ficar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A very practical fashion decision
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma decisão de moda bem prática

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I contain multitudes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu contenho multidões

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the outfit, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou ficar com a roupa, então

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner or me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O jantar ou eu?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I decide to send him a picture, you'll get that one too, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E se eu decidir mandar uma foto pra ele, você também vai receber essa, como combinamos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one was only for you, I haven't sent it anywhere else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa foi só pra você, não mandei pra mais ninguém

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like getting the preview
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto de ver as prévias

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then appreciate it, there was a very undignified struggle with the jacket before I took it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então aprecia, teve uma luta bem indigna com a jaqueta antes de eu conseguir colocar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame I missed that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma pena que perdi essa parte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You asked me about the dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você me perguntou sobre o jantar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just between us, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa é só entre nós, a propósito

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not turning tomorrow into a collection of things you have to look at
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não vou transformar amanhã numa coleção de coisas que você tem que olhar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd still have been disappointed to miss the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu ainda teria ficado decepcionado por perder o vestido

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your ordinary girlfriend pictures are not being discontinued 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Suas fotos normais de namorada não vão acabar 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is just for you, not a report of something I've sent him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa foto é só pra você, não é um relatório do que eu mandei pra ele

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can enjoy the dress and still let me keep some little things to myself tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode aproveitar o vestido e ainda me deixar guardar algumas coisinhas pra mim amanhã

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can live with that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu consigo lidar com isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'm enjoying not planning every single sentence in advance
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom, porque estou gostando de não planejar cada frase com antecedência

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You are allowed to show initiative
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode mostrar iniciativa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is only for you, I haven't sent it to him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa foto é só pra você, não mandei pra ele

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tomorrow I can leave my phone alone while we're talking, then tell you about it afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E amanhã posso deixar meu celular de lado enquanto estamos conversando, depois te conto sobre isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That still sounds right to me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso ainda parece certo pra mim

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I don't want to spend our first coffee looking down at a screen
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também, não quero passar nosso primeiro café olhando pra tela

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Something else happened while I was trying this on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aconteceu mais uma coisa enquanto eu experimentava isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O que?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner looks good, and I wish I was sitting opposite you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O jantar parece bom, e eu queria estar sentado na sua frente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself wondering if he'd like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me peguei pensando se ele ia gostar disso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then immediately wanting to see your face when you saw it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E então imediatamente querendo ver sua cara quando você visse isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you wanted both
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto que você quisesse os dois

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So do I, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também, na verdade

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought those feelings might get in each other's way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu pensei que esses sentimentos poderiam atrapalhar um ao outro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Instead I was just standing here wanting to show you the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na verdade, eu só estava aqui querendo te mostrar o vestido

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que você fez isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's better ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é melhor ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And our film afternoon is still happening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E nossa tarde de filme ainda vai rolar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I put the pasta container at the front of the fridge so I won't forget it when I come over
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Coloquei o pote de macarrão na frente da geladeira pra não esquecer quando eu for aí

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd let you in without it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu deixaria você entrar sem isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, but it's important that you understand what a generous visitor I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei, mas é importante que você entenda o quão generosa eu sou como visitante

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous with food, ruthless with the remote
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Generosa com comida, implacável com o controle remoto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You agreed I could choose
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você concordou que eu poderia escolher

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu lembro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, I've found something where you can actually see the actors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ótimo, eu encontrei algo onde você pode realmente ver os atores

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're never letting that go, are you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você nunca vai deixar isso pra lá, né?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not until I find out who was standing in that doorway
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não até eu descobrir quem estava naquela porta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although you'd have to stop making me laugh while I'm trying to eat
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas você teria que parar de me fazer rir enquanto estou tentando comer

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody knows, that's part of the film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ninguém sabe, isso faz parte do filme

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Terrible system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sistema terrível

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I'm getting changed before I end up falling asleep in tomorrow's outfit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espera, eu vou me trocar antes de acabar dormindo com a roupa de amanhã

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 8 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 8 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better, I'm keeping these clothes for absolutely no audience at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muito melhor, estou mantendo essas roupas para absolutamente nenhum público.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nem eu?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have a small exception
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode ter uma pequena exceção

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like this version too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também gosto dessa versão

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because this is the one you're getting during our film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ótimo, porque é essa que você vai ter durante o nosso filme

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises on that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sem promessas nessa parte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As long as I get to sit beside you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Desde que eu possa sentar ao seu lado

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's rather the point ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esse é o ponto ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my phone down before I find another reason to keep you awake
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou colocar meu celular de lado antes que eu encontre outra razão para te manter acordado

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite, garota bonita

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite, lindo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And eat breakfast before I have to ask tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E comer café da manhã antes que eu tenha que perguntar amanhã

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aí está ela

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I never left 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu nunca saí 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How's your leg after today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como está sua perna depois de hoje?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ate, and I actually played for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu comi e joguei um pouco, na verdade

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A bit tired, but I didn't push it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco cansado, mas não forcei muito

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked getting outside, even if it wasn't exactly an adventure
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gostei de sair, mesmo que não tenha sido exatamente uma aventura

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to be an adventure to be good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não precisa ser uma aventura para ser bom

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Listen to you being reasonable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Olha você sendo razoável

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've used a lot of courage today, I'm saving what's left
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Usei muita coragem hoje, estou economizando o que sobrou

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Speaking of which, tomorrow is arranged
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Falando nisso, amanhã está combinado

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the controls exactly where they were before?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Com os controles exatamente onde estavam antes?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} finishes early enough, so we're meeting at the café near campus at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} termina cedo o suficiente, então vamos nos encontrar no café perto do campus às três e meia

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The one with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aquele com as cadeiras diferentes

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did he seem different when he messaged you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele parecia diferente quando te mandou mensagem?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little more careful, maybe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco mais cuidadoso, talvez

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not awkward, just less determined to make a joke out of everything
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não é que seja estranho, só está menos determinado a fazer piada de tudo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might have surprised him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode ter surpreendido ele

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I definitely surprised myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu definitivamente me surpreendi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was putting my things away when I remembered what I'd actually asked him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu estava guardando minhas coisas quando lembrei do que realmente perguntei a ele

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I just stood in the hallway smiling at nothing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E então eu fiquei parada no corredor sorrindo à toa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd have liked to see that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu adoraria ter visto isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is no need to bring that up again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não precisa trazer isso de novo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you'd have asked what I was smiling about and made it worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não, você teria perguntado sobre o que eu estava sorrindo e piorado a situação

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost certainly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quase certeza

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The strange part is that I already know him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A parte estranha é que eu já o conheço

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow I'll be looking at someone familiar and wondering whether he's about to say something I haven't heard before
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Amanhã eu vou olhar para alguém familiar e me perguntar se ele vai dizer algo que eu ainda não ouvi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the part you're curious about?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É essa parte que você está curioso?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I think it is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, eu acho que é

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not trying to turn him into a different person, I just want to see what this feels like when we stop pretending it's an ordinary lunch
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estou tentando transformá-lo em outra pessoa, só quero ver como é quando paramos de fingir que é um almoço comum

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're meeting at the café by the main shopping street at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nós vamos nos encontrar no café perto da rua principal de compras às três e meia

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is a little need
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem um pouquinho de necessidade

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I picked it because I know where it is and I won't have to spend the first ten minutes looking lost
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu escolhi porque sei onde é e não vou perder os primeiros dez minutos parecendo perdida

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good choice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa escolha

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm going there on my own, no lifts from someone I haven't met yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E eu vou sozinha, sem carona de alguém que eu ainda não conheço

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you been talking much this evening?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vocês têm conversado muito esta noite?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little before dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco antes do jantar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I told him I was eating and would put the phone away
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então eu disse a ele que estava comendo e que ia guardar o telefone

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como ele reagiu a isso?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like a normal person who also has things to do
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como uma pessoa normal que também tem coisas a fazer

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It sounds like such a small thing, but I liked not having to explain myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pode parecer uma coisa pequena, mas eu gostei de não precisar me explicar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you think you'll get along in person?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você acha que vão se dar bem pessoalmente?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you make?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O que você fez?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope so, but that's why I want to meet instead of making up his entire personality from messages
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espero que sim, mas é por isso que quero me encontrar em vez de imaginar toda a personalidade dele só por mensagens

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't know whether he's quiet at first or talks with his hands or laughs at his own jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não sei se ele é quieto no começo, se fala com as mãos ou se ri das próprias piadas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already have someone who does the last one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você já tem alguém que faz a última

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, and he keeps insisting they're excellent jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, e ele continua insistindo que são piadas excelentes

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They are
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: São sim

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See? Completely unreasonable 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viu? Completamente irracional 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that there are things I don't know yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gosto que ainda há coisas que não sei

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not enough to invite him into my life all at once, just enough to want a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não o suficiente para convidá-lo para a minha vida de uma vez, só o suficiente para querer um café

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An omelet and a salad
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma omelete e uma salada

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, your turn
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, sua vez

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My turn for what?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Minha vez de quê?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What was the first thing you thought when I said I was actually meeting him tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qual foi a primeira coisa que você pensou quando eu disse que ia encontrá-lo amanhã?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not the very supportive answer, the first one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não a resposta super apoiadora, a primeira

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly? I smiled before I'd even finished reading
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sinceramente? Eu sorri antes mesmo de terminar de ler

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want this, but it suddenly feels much more real
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu quero isso, mas de repente parece muito mais real

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That quickly?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tão rápido?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, especially because you sounded happy when you told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, especialmente porque você parecia feliz quando me contou

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I tried to think of something less obvious to say than how much I was smiling
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então eu tentei pensar em algo menos óbvio para dizer do que o quanto eu estava sorrindo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just said that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você poderia ter apenas dito isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What happened to all the pasta?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O que aconteceu com toda a massa?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want to turn your entire afternoon into my reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não queria transformar sua tarde inteira na minha reação

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want to hear your reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda quero ouvir sua reação

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want your part in this to be only asking whether I'm okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não quero que sua participação nisso seja só perguntar se estou bem

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then yes, I'm excited, and I'm glad you wanted to ask him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então sim, estou animado, e fico feliz que você quisesse perguntar a ele

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu fiz

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I like knowing you're sitting there smiling at your phone too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E eu gosto de saber que você está aí sorrindo para o seu celular também ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Real in a bad way?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Real de uma forma ruim?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not bad, just different from talking about some imaginary afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nada ruim, só diferente de falar sobre uma tarde imaginária

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm taking a break before the pasta and I start resenting each other
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou fazendo uma pausa antes que eu e a massa comecemos a nos ressentir

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now there's an actual time, and tomorrow you'll get ready and go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Agora tem um horário real, e amanhã você vai se arrumar e ir

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had that same little moment when I put it in my calendar
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu tive esse mesmo momento quando coloquei no meu calendário

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want you to go, I just didn't expect to notice the difference so much
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda quero que você vá, só não esperava notar tanto a diferença

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me instead of trying to sound completely relaxed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obrigada por me contar em vez de tentar parecer completamente relaxada

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to talk me out of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estou pedindo para você me convencer a não ir

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not going to spend tomorrow trying to give you a perfect story about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E não vou passar amanhã tentando te dar uma história perfeita sobre isso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'd rather hear about your actual afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom, porque eu prefiro ouvir sobre sua tarde de verdade

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then that's what you'll get ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então é isso que você vai receber ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, here's proof I can make a different meal
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espera, aqui está a prova de que eu consigo fazer uma refeição diferente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Getting back into sports actually felt really good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Voltar a praticar esportes foi realmente bom

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Isn't it more the flirting with {{name:aiden}} that felt good?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Não é mais sobre flertar com o {{name:aiden}} que foi bom?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I have no idea what you're talking about 😇
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Não faço ideia do que você tá falando 😇

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I'm just happy both of you are having fun
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Só tô feliz que vocês dois estão se divertindo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And get ready to see even more 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: E se prepare pra ver ainda mais 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I had a really good session
I feel like I'm actually going to succeed
Succeed at getting Ethan into your bed, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Conseguir fazer o Ethan ir pra sua cama, né?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And yet you keep texting me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: E mesmo assim você continua me mandando mensagens

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I need to rest after today

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because if you do, you’re being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Porque se você tem, tá bem suspeito que você tá tão quieto

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Then why haven’t you complimented me yet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Então por que você ainda não me elogiou?
Tô começando a me sentir ignorada

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’m just extremely good at noticing when people are late with their compliments
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Eu só sou muito boa em notar quando as pessoas atrasam os elogios

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Anyway I’m bored out of my mind
Why aren’t you getting ready for university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Por que você não tá se preparando pra universidade?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because the year is basically over
I don’t technically need to show up anymore
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Eu não preciso tecnicamente aparecer mais

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: So I’m taking my well-deserved freedom very seriously
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Então tô levando minha liberdade merecida muito a sério

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: It’s not skipping if there’s nothing left to learn
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Não é pular se não há mais nada pra aprender

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And a free woman is currently very bored
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: E uma mulher livre tá bem entediada agora
Vem me fazer companhia mais tarde

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been in bed too long
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Eu fiquei na cama tempo demais

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Or I’ll start posting worse stories just to force you to react
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ou vou começar a postar histórias piores só pra te forçar a reagir

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: New day, same face, still cute 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Novo dia, mesma cara, ainda fofa 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I almost opened the racing game instead of my lecture notes 😭
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Quase abri o jogo de corrida em vez das minhas anotações 😭

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What's up?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E aí?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have a presentation to prepare for university
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu tenho uma apresentação para preparar para a universidade

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The slides are mostly done, but I keep losing my place when I practise out loud
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Os slides estão quase prontos, mas eu continuo perdendo meu lugar quando pratico em voz alta

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Come over after your day. You can practise with me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vem aqui depois do seu dia. Você pode praticar comigo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd sit through it?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você aguentaria isso?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. What is it about?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Claro. Sobre o que é?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Customer loyalty. Why people keep going back to the same business
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Fidelidade do cliente. Por que as pessoas continuam voltando para o mesmo negócio

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I can ask questions. Especially when you lose me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu posso fazer perguntas. Especialmente quando você me perde

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please do. I'd rather find the confusing parts with you than in front of everyone
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Por favor, faça isso. Eu prefiro descobrir as partes confusas com você do que na frente de todo mundo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then bring your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então traga suas anotações

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Already planning your comeback?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Já planejando seu retorno?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ok ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: University, work, then you. That's my Monday sorted
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Universidade, trabalho, depois você. Isso resolve meu Monday

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for the first part
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pronta para a primeira parte

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Looking very prepared
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Parecendo muito preparada

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The bag has the notes. I just have to remember to use them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: A bolsa tem as anotações. Eu só preciso lembrar de usá-las

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll be fine
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você vai ficar bem

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You have to listen properly tonight, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você tem que prestar atenção de verdade hoje à noite, viu

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No distracting me halfway through
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Nada de me distrair no meio

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll save it for after
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vou guardar isso para depois

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Maybe. But I remembered I actually have class this morning
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Talvez. Mas eu lembrei que na verdade tenho aula esta manhã

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I walked right into that one 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Cai direitinho nessa 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll let you know when I can get away from work
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu te aviso quando conseguir escapar do trabalho

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Have a good morning, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tenha uma boa manhã, amor

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você também ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The rematch can wait
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: A revanche pode esperar

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I really liked playing with you yesterday
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu realmente gostei de jogar com você ontem

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You didn't make me feel stupid when I kept crashing
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você não me fez sentir estúpida quando eu continuei batendo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You were learning. And you got better
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você estava aprendendo. E você melhorou

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. I want another try soon ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu sei. Quero outra chance em breve ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Any time
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: A qualquer hora

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Today I need a slightly different kind of help, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hoje eu preciso de um tipo de ajuda um pouco diferente

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: LATER THAT EVENING — {{name:lena}} has gone home. You have cleared the table before joining {{name:hailey}} on the sofa.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: MAIS TARDE AQUELA NOITE — {{name:lena}} foi para casa. Você limpou a mesa antes de se juntar a {{name:hailey}} no sofá.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just come already before I eat everything
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Só vem logo antes que eu coma tudo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A bit later on the couch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Um pouco mais tarde no sofá

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What if I need to steal food from your plate?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E se eu precisar roubar comida do seu prato?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You already stole half of it
The point is you’re being weirdly distant
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: O ponto é que você tá sendo estranhamente distante

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m literally right next to you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Eu tô literalmente bem ao seu lado

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Because I might fall asleep like this

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E aí você vai ficar preso
Você é basicamente meu prisioneiro agora 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I even left space for you
Why are you texting me if you’re already in the living room?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Por que você tá me mandando mensagem se já tá na sala?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Quick update before I start work: I should be out at six
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Atualização rápida antes de começar a trabalhar: devo sair às seis

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I've rewritten the introduction during lunch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Reescrevi a introdução durante o almoço

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It sounds less like I'm reading a textbook now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Agora parece menos que estou lendo um livro didático

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We'll try it out when you get here
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Vamos testar quando você chegar

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And I'll finally collect my other bag
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: E finalmente vou pegar minha outra bolsa

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: By bringing another one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Trazendo outra?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A bag full of notes. They're different categories
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Uma bolsa cheia de anotações. São categorias diferentes

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. I should have realised
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Claro. Eu deveria ter percebido

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry. I'll leave with both this time 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Não se preocupe. Vou sair com as duas desta vez 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll put the old one by the door
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Vou deixar a antiga perto da porta

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Thanks, love. I need to go now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Obrigada, amor. Preciso ir agora

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Want to come straight here?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Quer vir direto pra cá?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: See you tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Te vejo hoje à noite ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I'll stop for something to eat on the way
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sim. Vou parar pra comer algo no caminho

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll have the table cleared for your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Vou deixar a mesa livre para suas anotações

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My very exclusive rehearsal venue
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Meu local de ensaio super exclusivo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: One seat. Very selective audience
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Um lugar. Público bem seletivo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least the audience already likes me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Pelo menos o público já gosta de mim

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very much
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Muito

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Be useful as well as affectionate tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bom. Seja útil além de carinhoso esta noite ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I can manage both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Consigo fazer os dois

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Você tá me encarando de novo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one leaning on me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Você que tá se apoiando em mim

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to do something
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Se você continuar me olhando assim, eu vou fazer algo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re really not scared of me huh
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Você realmente não tem medo de mim, né?
Vou te mostrar que eu só falo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências do primeiro beijo consensual entre {{name:hailey}} e {{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I don't need HAK to tell me that kiss meant something to me.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Não preciso de HAK para saber que aquele beijo significou algo para mim.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências do primeiro beijo consensual entre {{name:hailey}} e {{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências do primeiro beijo consensual entre {{name:hailey}} e {{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Now you’re stuck with the consequences
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Agora você tá preso às consequências

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re not the one who just made the first move
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Você não é quem deu o primeiro passo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You pull her back for a longer kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Você a puxa para um beijo mais longo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de um beijo consensual prolongado

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I want to stay in this moment with her, without rushing whatever comes next.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Quero ficar neste momento com ela, sem apressar o que vier depois.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de um beijo consensual prolongado

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de um beijo consensual prolongado

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: We’re definitely not going back to normal after this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Definitivamente não vamos voltar ao normal depois disso

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: What can i do when you do that face
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: O que eu faço quando você faz essa cara

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re still bad at smooth answers
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Você ainda é ruim em respostas suaves

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to bed before I start something we won’t stop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Vou dormir antes de começar algo que não vamos parar

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Try not to miss me too much 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Tenta não sentir minha falta demais 😌
Posso começar a tirar vantagem disso

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de resposta emocional elevada durante o contato próximo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de resposta emocional elevada durante o contato próximo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de resposta emocional elevada durante o contato próximo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EARLY EVENING — It is half past six. You are at home, waiting to hear from {{name:lena}} after work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: INÍCIO DA NOITE — São seis e meia. Você está em casa, esperando notícias de {{name:lena}} depois do trabalho.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Without looking down once 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sem olhar pra baixo nenhuma vez 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's good. Keep the question at the start
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Isso é bom. Mantenha a pergunta no começo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already written in very large letters
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Já tá escrito em letras bem grandes

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Everything packed away. I'm done studying for tonight
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tudo guardado. Terminei de estudar por hoje

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You earned the break
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você merece essa pausa

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for tonight. The useful part AND the part on the sofa ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Obrigada pela noite. A parte útil E a parte no sofá ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I enjoyed both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu gostei das duas

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So did I. Especially the part after I closed the laptop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também. Especialmente a parte depois que fechei o laptop

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I'm getting ready for bed before I start rehearsing the whole thing again
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Agora tô me preparando pra dormir antes de começar a ensaiar tudo de novo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Understood. The floor is yours.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Entendido. O palco é seu.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Boa noite, amor

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Boa noite ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} opens her slides and starts her presentation. You listen as she explains how quality, convenience and personal service can encourage customers to return. Halfway through, she pauses and looks down at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} abre seus slides e começa sua apresentação. Você escuta enquanto ela explica como qualidade, conveniência e atendimento pessoal podem incentivar os clientes a voltar. No meio, ela pausa e olha para suas anotações.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is where I always get stuck.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: É aqui que eu sempre travo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I ask something?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Posso perguntar algo?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. That's what you're here for.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim. É pra isso que você está aqui.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If two places sell the same thing for the same price, what makes someone choose one over the other?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Se dois lugares vendem a mesma coisa pelo mesmo preço, o que faz alguém escolher um em vez do outro?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The experience. Whether it's easy to shop there, whether the staff help you...
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A experiência. Se é fácil comprar lá, se a equipe te ajuda...

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes sense. Why not start that section with the question?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Isso faz sentido. Por que não começar essa parte com a pergunta?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Instead of that long definition?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Em vez daquela longa definição?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. Give me an example first, then explain it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim. Me dá um exemplo primeiro, depois explica.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm out. Getting our food, then coming straight over ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou saindo. Pegando nossa comida e já venho pra cá ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. Let me write that down.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Espera. Deixa eu anotar isso.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She adds the question to her notes and tries the section again, using two neighbourhood cafes as an example. This time, she gets through it without stopping.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ela adiciona a pergunta às anotações e tenta a seção de novo, usando dois cafés do bairro como exemplo. Desta vez, ela consegue sem parar.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I followed all of that.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu entendi tudo isso.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Was it too simple?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Foi muito simples?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I understood what you meant. Then the definition made more sense.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Não. Eu entendi o que você quis dizer. Então a definição fez mais sentido.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. That's actually helpful.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ok. Isso foi realmente útil.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sério?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Don't ruin your good work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Não estrague seu bom trabalho.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} finishes the presentation, checks the time and closes her laptop. You ask one last question about her conclusion, and she answers without looking at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTOS DEPOIS — {{name:lena}} termina a apresentação, verifica a hora e fecha o laptop. Você faz uma última pergunta sobre a conclusão dela, e ela responde sem olhar para as anotações.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That felt much better.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Isso foi muito melhor.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was work?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Como foi o trabalho?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You looked up more on the second try, too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você olhou mais na segunda tentativa também.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were looking right at me every time I did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você estava olhando bem pra mim toda vez que eu olhei.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You asked for an attentive audience.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você pediu uma audiência atenta.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did. And I liked having one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu pedi. E eu gostei de ter uma.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for taking it seriously.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Obrigada por levar isso a sério.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} moves beside your chair and bends down to kiss you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} se move ao seu lado e se inclina para te dar um beijo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Rehearsal
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Depois do Ensaio

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were waiting for me to close that laptop, weren't you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você estava esperando eu fechar aquele laptop, né?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was following the rules. No kissing until you finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu estava seguindo as regras. Nada de beijos até você terminar.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very disciplined of you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Muito disciplinado da sua parte.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Busy enough that I didn't have time to worry about the presentation
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ocupada o suficiente pra não ter tempo de me preocupar com a apresentação

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I stop pretending I'm just someone in the audience now?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Posso parar de fingir que sou só alguém na plateia agora?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Please do.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Por favor, faça isso.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You didn't need a presentation to have a reason to come over.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você não precisava de uma apresentação pra ter um motivo pra vir aqui.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. But I did need to practise it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu sei. Mas eu precisava praticar.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I wanted to spend the evening with you. This worked out nicely.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E eu queria passar a noite com você. Isso funcionou bem.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Funcionou.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After eating, you move to the sofa. {{name:lena}} sits close beside you, leaving room for your recovering leg. Your arm settles around her shoulders, and she turns toward you for another kiss.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25 MINUTOS DEPOIS — Depois de comer, você se move para o sofá. {{name:lena}} se senta bem perto de você, deixando espaço para sua perna que está se recuperando. Seu braço se acomoda em torno dos ombros dela, e ela se vira para você para outro beijo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Much better than the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Muito melhor que a mesa.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The table wasn't that bad.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A mesa não era tão ruim.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I couldn't sit like this there.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu não conseguia sentar assim lá.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've got our sandwiches. See you in a little while
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Peguei nossos sanduíches. Te vejo em um pouco

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here, then.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vem aqui, então.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Sandwiches
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Depois dos Sanduíches

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your hand is wandering.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sua mão está perambulando.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can tell me to stop.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você pode me dizer para parar.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I didn't say stop. Higher.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu não disse para parar. Mais alto.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Hands Where She Put Them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mãos Onde Ela Colocou

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the other one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E a outra?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can have that too. Under. I already decided.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você pode ter isso também. Embaixo. Eu já decidi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making it very difficult to keep the evening polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você está tornando muito difícil manter a noite educada.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The presentation is over. I don't need polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A apresentação acabou. Não preciso de formalidades.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Até logo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My turn too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Minha vez também.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't have to.
