story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você não precisa.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. I want to. Open your jeans.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu sei. Eu quero. Abre o seu jeans.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Her Hand
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A Mão Dela

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if that's too much.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me diz se isso é demais.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It isn't.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Não é.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: On the Sofa
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: No Sofá

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. That was the point.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aí. Esse era o ponto.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased with yourself.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você parece bem satisfeito consigo mesmo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. You can thank me later
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou sim. Você pode me agradecer depois.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — {{name:lena}} arrives at your place with her notes and a bag of food. You greet her with a kiss, put the sandwiches in the kitchen and sit together at the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UM POUCO DEPOIS — {{name:lena}} chega na sua casa com suas anotações e uma bolsa de comida. Você a cumprimenta com um beijo, coloca os sanduíches na cozinha e se senta junto à mesa.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After cleaning up, she nestles against you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25 MINUTOS DEPOIS — Depois de limpar, ela se aconchega em você.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Comfortable?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Confortável?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. Are you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim. E você?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Muito.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then stop moving away to talk.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então para de se afastar pra falar.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was going to ask about your day.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu ia perguntar como foi seu dia.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Como foi a faculdade?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Though I spent lunch rewriting that introduction instead of eating properly.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Foi tranquilo. Mas passei o almoço reescrevendo aquela introdução em vez de comer direito.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So the sandwich was important.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então o sanduíche era importante.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very important. Thank you for helping with the presentation before I got distracted.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Muito importante. Obrigada por ajudar com a apresentação antes que eu me distraísse.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. I need you to pretend you're not my boyfriend for ten minutes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ok. Preciso que você finja que não é meu namorado por dez minutos.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You did most of the work before you came here.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você fez a maior parte do trabalho antes de vir aqui.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You helped me say it out loud. That's the part I needed.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você me ajudou a dizer em voz alta. Essa era a parte que eu precisava.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Later, {{name:lena}} checks the time and gathers her notes. She puts her laptop away, picks up both bags and joins you by the door.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTOS DEPOIS — Mais tarde, {{name:lena}} verifica a hora e reúne suas anotações. Ela guarda o laptop, pega as duas bolsas e se junta a você na porta.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both bags accounted for?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: As duas bolsas estão aqui?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I'm leaving you with absolutely no administrative reason to invite me back.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim. Estou te deixando sem nenhuma razão administrativa para me convidar de volta.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I'll manage without one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Acho que vou conseguir sem uma.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you would.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu estava torcendo pra você conseguir.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} sets the bags down for a moment and steps back toward you. She kisses you goodbye, one hand resting on your shoulder while your arm wraps around her waist.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} coloca as bolsas no chão por um momento e se aproxima de você. Ela te dá um beijo de despedida, com uma mão descansando no seu ombro enquanto seu braço envolve a cintura dela.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One More Before Leaving
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mais Uma Antes de Ir

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Now I'm really going.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ok. Agora eu realmente estou indo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a difficult opening request.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Esse é um pedido de abertura difícil.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Text me when you get home.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me manda mensagem quando chegar em casa.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I will. Love you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vou sim. Te amo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Love you too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te amo também.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} picks up both bags and leaves. You tidy the table and settle in for the rest of the evening.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} pega as duas bolsas e vai embora. Você arruma a mesa e se acomoda para o resto da noite.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTOS DEPOIS — {{name:lena}} ESTÁ EM CASA

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Home ❤️ Both bags made it
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Em casa ❤️ Ambas as bolsas chegaram

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Excellent. Any forgotten notes?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Excelente. Alguma anotação esquecida?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I checked twice
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Não. Eu conferi duas vezes.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I tried that difficult section again while I was unpacking
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E eu tentei aquela parte difícil de novo enquanto estava desempacotando.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How did it go?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Como foi?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: An ordinary person in the audience, then. Who isn't allowed to kiss me until I'm finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Uma pessoa comum na plateia, então. Que não pode me beijar até eu terminar.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have a session later this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tenho uma sessão mais tarde essa manhã

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He moved it earlier than usual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ele mudou pra mais cedo do que o normal

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Just that it worked better for his schedule
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Só que funcionava melhor pra agenda dele
Não tava com vontade de insistir
Não consegui dormir muito. E você?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm going to get ready slowly
I made some breakfast for you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eu fiz um café da manhã pra você também

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I kept waking up for no reason
Then I just stayed in bed staring at the ceiling like an idiot
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Aí fiquei deitada olhando pro teto como uma idiota

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It's just one of those mornings where the brain thinks too much
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: É só uma daquelas manhãs em que a cabeça pensa demais

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ Do you need me to pick anything up for tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ Precisa que eu traga algo para hoje à noite?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Kept waking up, but I'll be fine once I'm moving
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Acordei várias vezes, mas vou ficar bem assim que eu me mover

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E você?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, and I made it down to the mailbox and back this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bem, e consegui ir até a caixa de correio e voltar esta manhã

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bet it felt good not having to ask someone else
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aposto que foi bom não precisar pedir ajuda a ninguém

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It did, even if all I collected was junk mail
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Foi sim, mesmo que tudo que eu peguei tenha sido propaganda

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A disappointing prize for all that effort 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Um prêmio decepcionante por todo esse esforço 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll survive
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu vou sobreviver

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's on the menu tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: O que tem no menu hoje à noite?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Chicken and rice, nothing that needs an instruction manual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Frango com arroz, nada que precise de manual de instruções

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can manage that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu consigo lidar com isso

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just yourself, I've got the rest
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Só você, eu cuido do resto

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got the lemonade you like too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu trouxe a limonada que você gosta também

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você se lembrou?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always look for it when you're here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você sempre procura quando está aqui

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's really sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso é muito fofo ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm bringing dessert, let me do that part
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu vou trazer a sobremesa, deixa que eu cuido dessa parte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to argue with dessert
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não vou discutir com a sobremesa

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, one decision made without a fight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Excelente, uma decisão tomada sem briga

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still around six?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ainda por volta das seis?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I finish at five. I'll stop on the way and come straight over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, eu termino às cinco. Vou parar no caminho e vou direto para aí

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll be here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estarei aqui

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You didn't have to do everything
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você não precisava fazer tudo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad we're doing this tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou feliz que vamos fazer isso hoje à noite

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu também

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish getting ready before I manage to be late
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu preciso terminar de me arrumar antes que eu me atrase

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're not ready yet?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você ainda não está pronta?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Almost, I've been standing here with one earring in while talking to you 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quase, estou aqui com um brinco enquanto falo com você 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A few minutes later, before she leaves...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alguns minutos depois, antes de ela sair...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There, both earrings and everything 😊
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pronto, os dois brincos e tudo 😊

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você está linda

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigado ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's dinner, not a wedding 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É só um jantar, não um casamento 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tenha um bom dia

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too, and don't eat all the good bits before I get there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você também, e não come todas as partes boas antes de eu chegar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No promises about the crispy edges
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sem promessas sobre as bordas crocantes

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save me some or I'm keeping the dessert 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me guarda um pouco ou eu fico com a sobremesa 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, see you tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te amo, até mais tarde

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Amo você também

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, I just wanted to help
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sei, só queria ajudar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can help me eat it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você pode me ajudar a comer

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I'm very qualified for 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Essa parte eu sou super qualificada 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning, by the way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom dia, aliás

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning handsome ❤️ I went straight into planning mode
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom dia, gato ❤️ Já entrei no modo de planejamento

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você dormiu bem?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Quick important question before I go back: apple tart or chocolate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oi 😊 Rápida pergunta importante antes de eu voltar: torta de maçã ou chocolate?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you finish then
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou deixar você terminar então

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I leave ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te mando uma mensagem quando eu sair ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, in the manager's office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pouco antes das cinco, no escritório do gerente...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversa de escritório detectada perto de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm supposed to be looking forward to seeing {{name:lena}} tonight. Instead, every update from that office pulls me back to last night.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu deveria estar ansioso para ver {{name:lena}} esta noite. Em vez disso, cada atualização daquele escritório me leva de volta à noite passada.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//TRANSCRIÇÃO AO VIVO

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Terminou?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The updated totals are in your inbox, and the signed copies are in this folder
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Os totais atualizados estão na sua caixa de entrada, e as cópias assinadas estão nesta pasta

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Bring them over, I don't bite
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Traga elas, eu não mordo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can leave a folder on a desk without instructions
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu consigo deixar uma pasta em uma mesa sem instruções

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is. You've hardly said a word to me all day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aí está ela. Você mal disse uma palavra para mim o dia todo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about how last night ended
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estive pensando em como a noite passada terminou

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apple tart
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Torta de maçã

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So have I
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu também

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não desse jeito

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to tell me you didn't enjoy it?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você vai me dizer que não gostou?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's not the problem
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu gostei. Esse não é o problema

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I went home and talked to him like nothing had happened
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu fui pra casa e conversei com ele como se nada tivesse acontecido

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was a kiss, not a marriage proposal
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Foi um beijo, não uma proposta de casamento

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wouldn't see it that way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele não veria assim

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wasn't there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele não estava lá

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't make it better
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso não melhora a situação

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You weren't nearly this worried outside the bar
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não estava nem perto de tão preocupado fora do bar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, that's what I was hoping you'd say
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Boa, era isso que eu esperava que você dissesse

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I should've been
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu deveria ter estado

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I kissed you back that even worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E eu te beijei de volta, isso foi ainda pior

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop trying to talk yourself out of having enjoyed it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então para de tentar se convencer de que não gostou

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not. I just feel bad about what i did and that I'm keeping it from him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não estou. Só me sinto mal pelo que fiz e por estar escondendo isso dele

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Who cares what he thinks? You kissed me, and you liked it. That's all that matters
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quem se importa com o que ele pensa? Você me beijou, e gostou. Isso é o que importa

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to hurt him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não quero machucá-lo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You won't. You can still be with him and have a good time with me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não vai. Você ainda pode ficar com ele e se divertir comigo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know if I can do that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não sei se consigo fazer isso

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can. You just have to want to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você consegue. Só precisa querer

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come have a drink with me when you're done
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vem tomar um drink comigo quando você terminar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was this ever really a choice?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso realmente foi uma escolha?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I'm seeing him tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não, vou encontrá-lo hoje à noite

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jantar?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner and a film. I told him I'd be there around six
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jantar e um filme. Eu disse a ele que chegaria por volta das seis

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very domestic
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bem caseiro

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's something I want to do, you don't have to make it sound boring
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: É algo que eu quero fazer, não precisa deixar parecer chato

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can see me another night
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você pode me ver outra noite

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could try not deciding that for me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você poderia tentar não decidir isso por mim

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you'd have a good time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei que você se divertiria

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You never get tired of hearing yourself, do you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você nunca se cansa de ouvir a si mesmo, né?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not when I'm right
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não quando estou certo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were allowed to agree with me 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você podia concordar comigo 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou saindo agora

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know where to find me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você sabe onde me encontrar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I work here. It would be difficult not to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu trabalho aqui. Seria difícil não saber

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} picks up her bag and moves toward the office door
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} pega a bolsa e se dirige para a porta do escritório

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager look at her ass as she leaves
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O gerente dela olha para o traseiro dela enquanto ela sai

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: She's leaving, and I finally let out the breath I've been holding. Even now, I hate the way he watches her go.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ela está indo embora, e finalmente solto o ar que estava prendendo. Mesmo agora, odeio o jeito como ele a olha sair.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leaving on Time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Saindo na Hora

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At five, outside the office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Às cinco, do lado de fora do escritório...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five o'clock, I'm out ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cinco horas, estou fora ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tudo terminado?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enough for today, I've left the rest where it belongs
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Suficiente por hoje, deixei o resto onde pertence

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At work?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No trabalho?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's your afternoon going?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Como está sua tarde?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Where it can bother someone else for an hour 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Onde pode incomodar outra pessoa por uma hora 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stopping for the tart, then coming over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parando para pegar a torta, depois vou aí

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time, the food isn't on yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Leve seu tempo, a comida ainda não está pronta

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After a quick stop at the bakery...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Depois de uma rápida parada na padaria...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They had two slices left. I consider that excellent planning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eles tinham duas fatias sobrando. Eu considero isso um excelente planejamento

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got lucky
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você teve sorte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't ruin my very organised girlfriend image 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por favor, não estrague a imagem da minha namorada super organizada 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep the box upright, that's all I'm asking
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mantenha a caixa em pé, isso é tudo que estou pedindo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's getting a better seat on the bus than I am
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está conseguindo um lugar melhor no ônibus do que eu

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nearly through the last batch of paperwork
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quase terminando a última leva de papelada

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you around six ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te vejo por volta das seis ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Até logo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Still leaving at five, I'm not letting a folder steal our evening
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ainda saindo às cinco, não vou deixar uma pasta roubar nossa noite

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't started cooking yet, you've got time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ainda não comecei a cozinhar, você tem tempo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I just want to get out on time for once
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei, só quero sair na hora certa dessa vez

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What are you planning to do once the exams are finally over?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: O que você planeja fazer quando as provas finalmente acabarem?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I haven't really thought that far ahead yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ainda não pensei tão longe assim

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But the first thing will probably be sleeping until my body forces me to get up
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mas a primeira coisa provavelmente vai ser dormir até meu corpo me obrigar a levantar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That would be a nice change
I have spent so much time stressed that I almost forgot what free time is supposed to feel like
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Passei tanto tempo estressada que quase esqueci como é ter tempo livre

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You'll remember pretty quickly once it's over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Você vai lembrar rapidinho quando acabar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm kind of looking forward to being completely useless for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tô meio ansiosa pra ser completamente inútil por um tempo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:evelyn}} cooked something that actually smells decent
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: A {{name:evelyn}} fez algo que realmente tá com cheiro bom

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Vem comer antes que ela comece a me olhar assim

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Vem comer antes que ela comece a me olhar assim

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We are sitting down for dinner with {{name:evelyn}}. Are you joining us?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Estamos sentados para jantar com {{name:evelyn}}. Você vai se juntar a nós?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I've already eaten with {{name:lena}}. She's gone home now, so I'll come say hello.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Já comi com {{name:lena}}. Ela já foi pra casa, então vou passar pra te cumprimentar.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You're in a great mood tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Você tá num ótimo humor hoje à noite

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Just wanted to annoy you a little
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Só queria te irritar um pouco

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm downstairs, and your dessert survived the bus
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ Estou lá embaixo, e sua sobremesa sobreviveu ao ônibus

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her phone goes back into her bag. When you pull the blanket over her feet, she turns toward you instead of the screen. "What?" you ask. "Nothing. Come here." She rests her head against you and holds your hand under the blanket. It takes a nudge from you before she notices the film has already started.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O celular dela volta para a bolsa. Quando você puxa o cobertor sobre os pés dela, ela se vira para você em vez da tela. "O que?" você pergunta. "Nada. Vem cá." Ela apoia a cabeça em você e segura sua mão debaixo do cobertor. É preciso um empurrãozinho seu antes que ela perceba que o filme já começou.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 80 MINUTES LATER — You spend the film close together, occasionally arguing about whether the lead actor is meant to be funny. When the credits roll, she stays for another few minutes before getting her things. At the door, she gives you a longer hug, promises to text when she is home, and heads for the bus.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 80 MINUTOS DEPOIS — Você passa o filme perto um do outro, discutindo de vez em quando se o ator principal deveria ser engraçado. Quando os créditos sobem, ela fica mais alguns minutos antes de pegar suas coisas. Na porta, ela te dá um abraço mais longo, promete mandar uma mensagem quando chegar em casa e vai em direção ao ônibus.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTOS DEPOIS — {{name:lena}} ESTÁ EM CASA

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm home ❤️ Thank you for tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou em casa ❤️ Obrigada pela noite

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you get back okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você voltou bem?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, got a seat and almost fell asleep before my stop 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, consegui um lugar e quase dormi antes da minha parada 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You left your hair tie on the sofa
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você deixou sua faixa de cabelo no sofá

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it, I'll need an excuse to steal that cushion again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fica com ela, vou precisar de uma desculpa para roubar aquele travesseiro de novo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't need an excuse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não precisa de desculpa

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You went quiet a couple of times tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você ficou quieto algumas vezes hoje à noite

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, I had a lot on my mind
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Desculpa, eu estava com muita coisa na cabeça

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did I do something?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu fiz algo?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you didn't do anything wrong, your perfect
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não, você não fez nada de errado, você é perfeito

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was really happy to be there with you
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fiquei muito feliz de estar lá com você

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was happy you came
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fiquei feliz que você veio

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I'd missed being next to you instead of watching from my end of a screen
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também, senti falta de estar ao seu lado em vez de assistir do meu canto da tela

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much easier for you to steal the blanket
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muito mais fácil para você roubar o cobertor

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That too 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso também 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less impressive condition, but still edible
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Condição menos impressionante, mas ainda comestível

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I liked your film, even if I still don't think that man was meant to be funny
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E eu gostei do seu filme, mesmo que eu ainda não ache que aquele homem deveria ser engraçado

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed more than I did
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você riu mais do que eu

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly at you laughing at him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Principalmente de você rindo dele

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou aceitar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner was really good too ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O jantar também estava muito bom ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even without all my chicken on your plate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mesmo sem todo o meu frango no seu prato?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't start, I took one piece 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não começa, eu peguei só um pedaço 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get some sleep, you looked ready to fall asleep on me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vai dormir, você parecia pronto para dormir em cima de mim

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly did. It was nice not having to go anywhere for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quase fiz isso. Foi bom não ter que ir a lugar nenhum por um tempo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We'll do it again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vamos fazer isso de novo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AVAILABLE 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DISPONÍVEL 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gostaria disso

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite, gato, te amo ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too, sleep well
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Amo você também, durma bem

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm opening the door before you make it worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou abrindo a porta antes que você piore as coisas

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please do
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor, faça isso

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around six, you open the door. {{name:lena}} sets the pastry bag down and wraps both arms around you before you've finished saying hello. She kisses your cheek and stays against you for another moment, then steps inside.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por volta das seis, você abre a porta. {{name:lena}} coloca a bolsa de doces no chão e envolve os braços em torno de você antes que você termine de dizer olá. Ela beija sua bochecha e fica perto de você por mais um momento, depois entra.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTOS DEPOIS — Durante o jantar, você serve a limonada que comprou para ela. Ela olha para a garrafa, depois para você. "Você até colocou na geladeira," ela diz. "Achei que limonada morna poderia receber uma crítica negativa." Ela sorri, mas fica em silêncio por um momento antes de estender a mão sobre a mesa para você.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A conversa fica mais solta durante o jantar. Ela te conta sobre a manhã dela e rouba um pedaço de frango do seu prato enquanto você responde. Quando você percebe, ela insiste que o seu tinha a borda crocante que ela esperava. Quando você coloca as duas fatias de torta, ela ri da sua tentativa de decidir qual é maior.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTOS DEPOIS — Depois de ajudar você a limpar os pratos, ela deixa os sapatos ao lado do sofá e ocupa o bom travesseiro. Ela tira o laço do cabelo enquanto se acomoda ao seu lado. Antes do filme começar, ela se inclina contra seu ombro e tira uma foto dos dois. Ela te manda uma cópia para você guardar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have to go buy some revision books with {{name:ethan}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eu preciso ir comprar alguns livros de revisão com o {{name:ethan}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s just code for going to his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Isso é só um código pra ir pra casa dele

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No, I actually need the books
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Não, eu realmente preciso dos livros

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Funny how you only start working hard at the end of the year
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Engraçado como você só começa a trabalhar duro no final do ano

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s what happens when you have a professor who knows how to motivate 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: É o que acontece quando você tem um professor que sabe como motivar 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll probably just rot in bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Provavelmente vou só ficar deitado na cama

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:aiden}} won’t even want to hang out with you anymore
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: O {{name:aiden}} nem vai querer mais passar tempo com você

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I invited {{name:aiden}} over to hang out
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eu convidei o {{name:aiden}} pra passar um tempo
Você poderia ter me avisado antes

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: All sore, messy hair, looking half dead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Todo dolorido, cabelo bagunçado, parecendo meio morto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oi 😊 eu acordei antes do meu despertador e agora três e meia parece que está a uma semana de distância

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu só quero que você pare de tratar seus próprios sentimentos como se fossem a parte menos importante

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou tentando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu gosto que você queira que eu faça isso sendo eu mesma, e não alguma versão de mim que eu tenha que inventar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's the girl I'm in love with
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É essa a garota de quem eu estou apaixonado

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was unfairly sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso foi injustamente doce ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Agora eu esqueci o que estava procurando antes de você me fazer sorrir na mesa da cozinha

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Keys?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Chaves?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, actually
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, na verdade

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at me, useful and charming
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Olha pra mim, útil e encantador

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not ruin it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vamos não estragar isso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu te mando uma mensagem quando estiver me arrumando mais tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tenha uma boa manhã. E coma antes que a reunião engula seu intervalo para o almoço

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really are stealing my job today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você realmente está roubando meu trabalho hoje

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That looks considerably better than what I made
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso parece bem melhor do que o que eu fiz.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você poderia tentar colocar algo no prato em vez de comer em pé na pia.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You weren't here. You can't prove anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você não estava aqui. Não pode provar nada.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu te conheço

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tenho a reunião do grupo esta manhã, depois vou para casa e me trocar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ainda está com o vestido de ontem?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim. Estou me recusando a começar essa decisão de novo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to ask you something before I go, though
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas eu quero te perguntar uma coisa antes de ir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What is it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: O que é?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você pode voltar a dormir. Eu te acordo em junho

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About today. About limits, I suppose
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sobre hoje. Sobre limites, eu acho.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nós conversamos sobre o que você quer saber depois, mas não exatamente sobre isso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quando dissemos café, queríamos dizer café e nada mais?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não. Escolhemos um lugar para você se encontrar, não uma regra sobre onde a tarde deve parar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Então, se tudo correr bem e eu quiser ficar mais tempo, não devo voltar para casa só porque foi isso que mencionamos?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Claro que não.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want you to do what you feel like doing, not keep checking whether it was on a list we made this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quero que você faça o que tem vontade, não fique checando se estava na lista que fizemos esta manhã.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to kiss him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E se eu quiser beijá-lo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Então beije-o.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that very easily
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você fala isso com muita facilidade.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very helpful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muito útil

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Because I mean it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Porque eu estou falando sério.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to go further than that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E se eu quiser ir além disso?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to set a limit for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não vou colocar limites para você

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No limits from me. I want you to decide what you want, not what you think I want you to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sem limites da minha parte. Quero que você decida o que quer, não o que acha que eu quero que você faça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sério?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really. You don't have to ask me for permission at every step
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sério. Você não precisa me pedir permissão a cada passo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't know what I'll feel like yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ainda não sei como vou me sentir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't need to know already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você não precisa saber agora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Maybe you have one coffee and leave. Maybe you want to spend the rest of the afternoon together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Talvez você tome um café e vá embora. Ou talvez queira passar o resto da tarde juntos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you stopping yourself just to fit a plan, or pushing yourself to make the story more interesting for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não quero que você se impeça só para se encaixar em um plano, ou se force a tornar a história mais interessante para mim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was fine last night. Now I'm checking the time while the kettle boils
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu estava bem ontem à noite. Agora estou olhando a hora enquanto a chaleira ferve

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was the bit I was worried about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Essa era a parte que eu estava preocupada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coming home and feeling like I'd either done too much or disappointed you by not doing enough
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voltar para casa e sentir que fiz demais ou que te decepcionei por não ter feito o suficiente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There's no amount you have to do to make today a success
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não há nada que você precise fazer para que hoje seja um sucesso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So I decide what I actually want, and see what he wants too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Então eu decido o que realmente quero e vejo o que ele quer também

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I can still change my mind in the middle of it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E eu ainda posso mudar de ideia no meio disso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously. This isn't you promising anything to either of us
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obviamente. Isso não é você prometendo nada para nenhum de nós

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a much bigger answer than I was expecting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Essa é uma resposta muito maior do que eu esperava

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already had breakfast, before you ask
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu já tomei café da manhã, antes que você pergunte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Last night you said it suddenly felt much more real. Has that changed?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Na noite passada você disse que de repente parecia muito mais real. Isso mudou?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not entirely. I still notice it when I think about you actually being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não totalmente. Eu ainda percebo quando penso em você realmente estando lá

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But feeling nervous doesn't mean I want to make your decisions for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas sentir nervoso não significa que eu quero tomar suas decisões por você

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't turn being relaxed into another thing you have to perform for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não transforme estar relaxada em mais uma coisa que você precisa fazer por mim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I won't. I'll tell you if something feels different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não vou. Vou te contar se algo parecer diferente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want the real answer from you, even when it takes a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom. Quero a resposta verdadeira de você, mesmo que leve um tempinho

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você se lembrou ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you still smiling like you were last night?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você ainda está sorrindo como estava ontem à noite?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. A little distracted too, but I'm looking forward to hearing how you feel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim. Um pouco distraída também, mas estou ansiosa para saber como você se sente.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just don't decide how my entire afternoon goes before I've even left the house
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Só não decida como vai ser minha tarde inteira antes de eu sair de casa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying to concentrate on the girl who keeps texting me instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou tentando me concentrar na garota que continua me mandando mensagens.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ela parece adorável

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She is ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ela é ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could practically hear tomorrow's lecture before I went to bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu praticamente consegui ouvir a aula de amanhã antes de ir para a cama

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Even with {{name:aiden}}? Knowing we'll still see him around afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mesmo com {{name:aiden}}? Sabendo que ainda vamos vê-lo depois?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I haven't forgotten who we're talking about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim. Não esqueci de quem estamos falando.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I trust you. I'm not asking you to spend the whole date protecting me from finding it strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Confio em você. Não estou pedindo para você passar o encontro todo me protegendo de achar isso estranho.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might be the one who needs a minute today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ele pode ser quem precisa de um tempo hoje.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still trying to understand yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ainda tentando entender ontem?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Probably. I'm not sure the words "my boyfriend knows" have completely settled in yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Provavelmente. Não tenho certeza se as palavras "meu namorado sabe" já se acomodaram completamente.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let him order something before you surprise him again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Deixe ele pedir algo antes de você surpreendê-lo de novo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not giving a second presentation. He can cope 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não vou fazer uma segunda apresentação. Ele pode se virar 😌.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's called being a good influence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso se chama ser uma boa influência

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm still meeting someone I don't actually know yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E ainda estou conhecendo alguém que na verdade não conheço ainda.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. Being free to choose doesn't mean you suddenly have to trust him with everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exatamente. Ser livre para escolher não significa que você deva confiar nele com tudo de repente.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still want to see what he's like over a coffee first. That hasn't changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ainda quero ver como ele é primeiro tomando um café. Isso não mudou.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then that's where you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Então é por aí que você começa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I liked his messages. I don't want to spend the date wondering whether I'm matching the version I imagined
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu gostei das mensagens dele. Não quero passar o encontro me perguntando se estou combinando com a versão que imaginei.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find the real person more interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você pode achar a pessoa real mais interessante.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: As long as he leaves the cooking to the café, we have a chance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Desde que ele deixe a cozinha para o café, temos uma chance.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you eaten, or are you just supervising everyone else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você comeu, ou está apenas supervisionando os outros?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And when you said I could keep some things to myself, we'd only talked about a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E quando você disse que eu poderia guardar algumas coisas para mim, só tínhamos falado sobre um primeiro encontro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I wanted to say this part out loud before treating that answer like it meant anything more
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu queria dizer essa parte em voz alta antes de tratar essa resposta como se significasse algo a mais

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad you did. Now you know I want you to choose for yourself, rather than stop at the coffee because of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que você tenha feito isso. Agora você sabe que eu quero que você escolha por si mesmo, em vez de parar no café por minha causa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Some things can stay mine without us misunderstanding each other
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ok. Algumas coisas podem ficar comigo sem que a gente se entenda mal

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. And anything that worries either of us is still something we talk about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim. E qualquer coisa que preocupe um de nós ainda é algo que devemos conversar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought you were going to give me a very careful answer about what was allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu pensei que você ia me dar uma resposta bem cuidadosa sobre o que era permitido

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have food right here, thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu tenho comida bem aqui, obrigada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Buying the books took longer than expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Comprar os livros demorou mais do que eu esperava

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER – LIVING ROOM
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ALGUNS MINUTOS DEPOIS – SALA DE ESTAR

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} gives {{name:aiden}} a kiss on the cheek
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} dá um beijo na bochecha de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That greeting feels less casual every time, and I'm noticing my own reaction now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Esse cumprimento parece menos casual a cada vez, e agora estou percebendo minha própria reação.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:hailey}} initiating a cheek kiss upon {{name:aiden}}’s arrival
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de {{name:hailey}} iniciando um beijo na bochecha ao chegar {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Since when do you kiss him?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Desde que ele começou a me treinar 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He deserves a little reward for taking such good care of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ele merece uma recompensa por cuidar tão bem de mim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} deliberately walks slowly in front of the couch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} anda devagar na frente do sofá

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject deliberately walked in front of both males while wearing revealing clothes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sujeito andou intencionalmente na frente de ambos os homens usando roupas reveladoras

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t really know how to play though… 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas eu não sei jogar direito… 😇
Sujeito sentou no colo de Aiden

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can see the closeness increasing, but I still need to work out how comfortable I am with it.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vejo a proximidade entre eles aumentando, mas ainda preciso entender até que ponto me sinto à vontade com isso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded {{name:hailey}} sitting on {{name:aiden}}’s lap under the pretext of learning how to play
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK registrou {{name:hailey}} sentando no colo de {{name:aiden}} sob o pretexto de aprender a jogar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What? I need a good view of the screen 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O quê? Eu preciso de uma boa visão da tela 😌
Você tá fazendo isso de propósito

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don’t you dare come down dressed like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Não se atreva a descer vestida assim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Of course you’re not, you’re as bad as her
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Claro que não, você é tão ruim quanto ela

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a training session later
It was fun hanging out with you guys
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Foi divertido passar um tempo com vocês

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you two do that in private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vocês dois podem fazer isso em particular?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If it’s a dare then I’m doing it even harder 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Se é um desafio, então vou fazer isso ainda mais 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I warned you you’d pay for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu te avisei que você ia pagar por isso hoje de manhã

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I'm home and getting ready, and the dress has survived being reconsidered three times
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oi 😊 Estou em casa e me arrumando, e o vestido sobreviveu a ser reconsiderado três vezes

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I feel like I've missed an entire chapter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aparentemente. Sinto que perdi um capítulo inteiro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It took me a while too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Demorou um tempo para mim também

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you talk again before coming here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vocês conversaram de novo antes de vir pra cá?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This morning, yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esta manhã, sim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And? Am I allowed to ask how that went, or is that private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E aí? Posso perguntar como foi, ou é privado?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of it is private. But I asked whether coffee was supposed to be the limit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Algumas coisas são privadas. Mas perguntei se café deveria ser o limite

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked him that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você perguntou isso pra ele?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What did he say?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O que ele disse?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That he doesn't want to set a limit for me. He wants me to decide what I actually feel like doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Que ele não quer me colocar limites. Ele quer que eu decida o que realmente quero fazer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você está linda

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously? Just like that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sério? Assim, do nada?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked for longer than that. I'm giving you the useful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nós conversamos por mais tempo. Estou te dando a parte útil.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to imagine having that conversation and keeping a straight face
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tô tentando imaginar ter essa conversa e ficar sério.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't even manage the first sentence yesterday
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você nem conseguiu falar a primeira frase ontem.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ponto justo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's still strange to me. Not bad, but strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ainda é estranho pra mim. Não é ruim, mas é estranho.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It can be strange without us spending the whole date explaining it again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pode ser estranho sem a gente passar o encontro todo explicando de novo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tá certo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it doesn't mean I've arrived with a promise about how today ends
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E isso não significa que eu cheguei com uma promessa sobre como o dia vai acabar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. It means I should ask you, not try to guess what he agreed to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei. Significa que eu devo te perguntar, não tentar adivinhar o que ele concordou.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel good in it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou me sentindo bem com isso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. First question for you, then
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo. Primeira pergunta pra você, então.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Continue

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you actually want the window seat, or did you take the other one because I was already sitting here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você realmente quer o assento da janela, ou pegou o outro porque eu já estava aqui?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted the window seat
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu queria o assento da janela.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then swap with me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então troca comigo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sério?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. You're allowed to choose the chair too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Você também pode escolher a cadeira.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to be very annoying about this now, aren't you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você vai ser muito chato sobre isso agora, né?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only until you stop pretending you don't have preferences
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Só até você parar de fingir que não tem preferências.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was about to ask whether you thought it was too much, then I realized I actually liked it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estava prestes a perguntar se você achava que era demais, mas percebi que na verdade gostei.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subjects switch seats
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Os sujeitos trocam de assento.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Observed gaze lingers lower than intended
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O olhar observado se detém mais baixo do que o pretendido.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew there was curiosity here, but noticing their attention still catches me off guard.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sabia que havia curiosidade, mas perceber a atenção entre eles ainda me pega de surpresa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Caught Looking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pegos olhando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEIR COFFEE ARRIVES
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: DEPOIS QUE O CAFÉ DELAS CHEGA

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it good?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tá bom?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very. You're allowed to enjoy yours even if it's small
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Muito. Você pode aproveitar o seu mesmo que seja pequeno

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is good. Irritatingly good
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: É bom. Irritantemente bom
