story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's why you keep coming back
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: É por isso que você continua voltando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That and it's quiet if you miss the lunch rush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso e é tranquilo se você perder a hora do almoço

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think I've ever been here without watching the time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Acho que nunca estive aqui sem ficar de olho no tempo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You usually have somewhere else to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você geralmente tem outro lugar pra ir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then keep that answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então guarda essa resposta.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Classes, work, something I've forgotten to finish
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aulas, trabalho, algo que eu esqueci de terminar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I nearly brought my notes in my bag out of habit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hoje quase trouxe minhas anotações na bolsa por hábito

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave them there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você pode deixá-las aí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's what I'm trying to tell you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu deixei. É isso que estou tentando te dizer

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm enjoying the fact that you chose to be here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Desculpa. Estou gostando do fato de que você escolheu estar aqui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very inconveniently nice answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Essa é uma resposta muito inconvenientemente legal

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have those occasionally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu tenho essas de vez em quando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I just don't always hear them without three jokes afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei. Só não sempre ouço elas sem três piadas depois

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying not to hide behind those as much today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou tentando não me esconder atrás delas tanto hoje

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to stop being funny
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não precisa parar de ser engraçado

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu vou ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because being handsome and silent sounds exhausting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom, porque ser bonito e silencioso parece cansativo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aí está ele

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What would you do with a whole afternoon free? Not what you should do. What you'd actually do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O que você faria com uma tarde inteira livre? Não o que você deveria fazer. O que você realmente faria

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd go for a walk without counting how long I was taking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu iria dar uma volta sem me preocupar com o tempo que estou levando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe find somewhere to sit, listen to something, not answer the class group for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Talvez encontrar um lugar para sentar, ouvir algo, e não responder o grupo da turma por um tempo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a garden a couple of streets over
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tem um jardim a algumas ruas daqui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know the one. I always walk past the entrance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu conheço esse. Sempre passo pela entrada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We could go in this time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Podemos entrar dessa vez

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Eu gostaria disso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER, OUTSIDE THE CAFÉ
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: DEPOIS, FORA DO CAFÉ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling otherwise?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Como você está se sentindo, de resto?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Left here, isn't it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: É à esquerda aqui, não é?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Unless you plan to keep going around the same block
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. A menos que você planeje continuar dando voltas no mesmo quarteirão

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could pretend I was giving you a tour
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu poderia fingir que estou te dando um tour

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of the place where I go to university?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Do lugar onde eu vou à universidade?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It needs work
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Precisa de melhorias

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um pouco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você está estranhamente quieto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were worried I'd make a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você estava preocupado que eu fosse fazer uma piada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't ask you to stop speaking entirely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não pedi para você parar de falar completamente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm having a nice time. I don't want to ruin every quiet bit by filling it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou me divertindo. Não quero estragar cada momento de silêncio preenchendo com palavras

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nervous, but not wishing I'd cancelled
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nervosa, mas não me arrependendo de não ter cancelado.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's new
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso é novo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um pouco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu gosto disso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER, IN THE GARDEN
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UM POUCO MAIS TARDE, NO JARDIM

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is nicer than the path outside
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso é melhor do que o caminho lá fora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can hear yourself think in here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aqui você consegue ouvir seus próprios pensamentos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping to do less of that today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu esperava fazer menos disso hoje

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's it going?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Como estão as coisas?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better once we left the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Melhorou depois que saímos do café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was I that bad over coffee?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu fui tão ruim durante o café?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More like the ten minutes before you have to do something and your brain runs out of useful things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais como os dez minutos antes de você ter que fazer algo e sua cabeça fica sem coisas úteis para dizer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No. I stopped imagining what I was supposed to do next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não. Eu parei de imaginar o que deveria fazer a seguir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E agora?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'd like you to stop for a second
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Agora eu gostaria que você parasse por um segundo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aqui?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're about to say something dangerous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você parece que está prestes a dizer algo perigoso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu estava

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe I got impatient
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então talvez eu tenha ficado impaciente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subject initiates a kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A pessoa inicia um beijo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Contact reciprocated
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Contato retribuído

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A kiss makes this real in a way talking about it never could, and I need a moment with that.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um beijo torna isso real de um jeito que conversar nunca conseguiria, e preciso de um momento para assimilar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to fill all ten minutes with thinking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não precisa preencher os dez minutos pensando.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To Shut Him Up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Para Calá-lo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you could do that first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não disse que você poderia fazer isso primeiro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You stopped walking and looked at me like that. I took a risk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você parou de andar e me olhou assim. Eu arrisquei

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't a risk. That was you skipping ahead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso não foi um risco. Foi você se adiantando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I was right about where this was going
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então eu estava certo sobre onde isso estava indo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're really pleased with yourself right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você está bem satisfeito consigo mesmo agora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um pouco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were about to kiss me anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você estava prestes a me beijar de qualquer jeito

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep talking and see what happens
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Continue falando e veja o que acontece

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A radical suggestion
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uma sugestão radical.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you weren't starting that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu pensei que você não ia começar essa decisão de novo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What, you'll stop me again?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O que, você vai me parar de novo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Shhh

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tell me honestly, who kisses better? Me or him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então me diga honestamente, quem beija melhor? Eu ou ele?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What? It's a valid question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O que? É uma pergunta válida

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You turn everything into a competition. In games, in class, in life
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você transforma tudo em competição. Nos jogos, na aula, na vida

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now apparently in kissing too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E agora aparentemente em beijar também

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If you really want to know, for now you're still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Se você realmente quer saber, por enquanto você ainda está muito atrás

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wow. That's cold
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uau. Isso é frio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você perguntou

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I like it. Now it sounds like a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não, eu gosto. Agora parece um desafio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't supposed to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não era para ser

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late. I'm already taking it personally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tarde demais. Já estou levando para o lado pessoal

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're impossible
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você é impossível

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And yet you kissed me to shut me up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E mesmo assim você me beijou para me calar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which should tell you how effective words are with me right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O que deve te dizer o quão eficazes são as palavras comigo agora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to sit for a little while?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quer sentar um pouco?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Over there, in the shade
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Ali, na sombra

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at that. A seating preference without an interrogation
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Olha só. Uma preferência de assento sem interrogatório

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're one comment away from sitting by yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você está a um comentário de sentar sozinho

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: MAIS TARDE AQUELA TARDE

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shall I walk you back to the stop?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quer que eu te acompanhe até o ponto?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu gostaria disso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you want to make plans for another day now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quer fazer planos para outro dia agora?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not right this second. I want a little time to take today in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não agora. Quero um tempinho para processar o dia de hoje

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tudo bem

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't a polite way of saying no
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso não é uma maneira educada de dizer não

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não interpretei assim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. I'm glad we did this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom. Fico feliz que fizemos isso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu também

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me when you're home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me manda mensagem quando chegar em casa?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu vou

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEY SAY GOODBYE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: DEPOIS QUE ELES DIZEM ADEUS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home ❤️ That was a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou a caminho de casa ❤️ Foi uma boa tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad. How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fico feliz. Como você está se sentindo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy, and a bit quieter than I expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Feliz, e um pouco mais tranquila do que eu esperava

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd want to type everything at once. Mostly I just want to sit with it for a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Achei que ia querer digitar tudo de uma vez. Na verdade, só quero sentar com isso por um minuto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time. You don't have to turn the walk home into a report
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Leve o tempo que precisar. Você não precisa transformar a caminhada para casa em um relatório

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I still wanted to send you this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei. Mas ainda queria te mandar isso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a lovely smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Que sorriso lindo!

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel like I've had an actual afternoon off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sinto que realmente tive uma tarde de folga.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not just a gap between two things I needed to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não só um intervalo entre duas coisas que eu precisava fazer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you got that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fico feliz que você entendeu isso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Can we talk properly when I'm settled at home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Podemos conversar direito quando eu estiver em casa?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And tell me something from your day too. I don't want mine to take up all the space
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E me conta algo do seu dia também. Não quero que o meu ocupe todo o espaço.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Acabei de enviar uma foto rápida para dizer que estou a caminho.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before going in. I like how much light there is in there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tirei isso antes de entrar. Gosto de quanta luz tem lá dentro.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm at the café by the shopping street. I found a table by the big windows
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou no café perto da rua de compras. Achei uma mesa perto das grandes janelas.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm early, so naturally I'm pretending choosing a drink is a very complicated task
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cheguei cedo, então, claro, estou fingindo que escolher uma bebida é uma tarefa super complicada.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you'll have decided by the time he arrives
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pelo menos você já terá decidido quando ele chegar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You would think so
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você pensaria assim.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, he's outside. I recognize him from the photos
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera, ele está lá fora. Eu o reconheço das fotos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou guardar meu celular agora. Falo depois ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one, not the mirror one I sent you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Essa aqui, não a do espelho que te mandei.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ALGUNS MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ordered, and I asked if he'd be comfortable taking a photo together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nós pedimos, e eu perguntei se ele se sentiria à vontade para tirar uma foto juntos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He said yes. I told him I'd like to send it to you as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele disse que sim. Eu disse que gostaria de te enviar também.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look more relaxed already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você já parece mais relaxado.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Actually speaking to someone is easier than trying to imagine the first sentence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Falar com alguém é mais fácil do que tentar imaginar a primeira frase.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy your coffee. You can tell me how you're doing later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aproveita seu café. Você pode me contar como está depois.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will 😊
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou sim 😊

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: MAIS TARDE AQUELA TARDE

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Beyond the Coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Além do Café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UM POUCO MAIS TARDE

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unplanned Goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uma Despedida Não Planejada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: DEPOIS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home 😊 It went well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou a caminho de casa 😊 Foi tudo bem

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Como você tá se sentindo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. Better than I did when I was studying the drinks menu like there was going to be a test
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bom. Melhor do que eu fiz quando estava estudando o cardápio de bebidas como se fosse ter uma prova

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was nice not having to carry the whole conversation myself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Foi bom não ter que carregar toda a conversa sozinha

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like that smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Adoro esse sorriso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was he like you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele era como você esperava?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A bit quieter at first, actually. Which made me feel less silly for being nervous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um pouco mais quieto no começo, na verdade. O que me fez sentir menos boba por estar nervosa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then he said he'd promised himself not to spend the first ten minutes explaining the pizza photograph
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então ele disse que tinha prometido a si mesmo não passar os primeiros dez minutos explicando a foto da pizza

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did he manage it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E ele conseguiu?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For about four minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por cerca de quatro minutos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I asked because I wanted to hear the story, not because he'd run out of things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu perguntei porque queria ouvir a história, não porque ele tinha ficado sem coisas para dizer

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a better reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Essa é uma razão melhor

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ended up walking around afterward. I even came home with a secondhand book I wasn't planning to buy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Acabamos passeando depois. Eu até voltei para casa com um livro de segunda mão que não estava planejando comprar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A productive afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uma tarde produtiva

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took two. In the first one I looked like I was trying to remember whether I'd locked the door
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tirei duas. Na primeira, parecia que estava tentando lembrar se tinha trancado a porta.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A completely unnecessary purchase, but I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uma compra completamente desnecessária, mas eu gostei

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you enjoy being there, once the nerves settled?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você gostou de estar lá, depois que os nervos se acalmaram?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I stopped trying to decide whether it was going well and just had a nice time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim. Parei de tentar decidir se estava indo bem e apenas me diverti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details for myself, but I wanted you to know that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou guardando os pequenos detalhes para mim, mas queria que você soubesse dessa parte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fico feliz que você foi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu também ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this after we said goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu tirei isso depois que nos despedimos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Had you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tinha trancado?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not changing it. I'm just looking at it with unnecessary intensity
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não vou mudar. Só estou olhando com uma intensidade desnecessária.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você parece feliz

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am. And hungry again somehow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou. E de alguma forma, com fome de novo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to get home and eat before we talk properly, if that's okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quero chegar em casa e comer antes de conversarmos direito, se estiver tudo bem

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm not going anywhere
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claro. Não estou indo a lugar nenhum

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to hear about your day too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu também quero ouvir sobre o seu dia

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It doesn't have to compete with mine to be interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não precisa competir com o meu para ser interessante

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did the washing without starting an international incident with the machine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu lavei as roupas sem causar um incidente internacional com a máquina

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was still inside. So no 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu ainda estava dentro. Então não 😭.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's progress
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso é progresso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sock may have been lost in the process
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uma meia pode ter se perdido no processo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll remember its sacrifice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vamos lembrar do seu sacrifício

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd have complained if I hadn't done it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você teria reclamado se eu não tivesse feito isso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not complaining. I'm deciding how much praise you deserve
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não estou reclamando. Estou decidindo quanto elogio você merece

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pelo menos um pouco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then well done, handsome. I'll give you the longer version tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então, muito bem, lindo. Vou te contar a versão longa esta noite ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way, by the way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu mandei uma foto rápida pra dizer que estou a caminho, aliás

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just me at the door, nothing elaborate
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Só eu na porta, nada elaborado

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to send it twice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não precisa enviar duas vezes

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You've already had my full mirror inspection anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei. Você já teve minha inspeção completa no espelho mesmo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going now before I find another reason to stand in the hallway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou indo agora antes que eu encontre outra razão pra ficar no corredor

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Completely different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Totalmente diferente.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good time. We'll talk when you're free
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Divirta-se. Vamos conversar quando você estiver livre

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Obrigada por esta manhã

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to spend the date thinking about what I'd want next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não precisa passar o encontro pensando no que eu quero a seguir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm taking that part with me ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você parece confortável

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não precisa. Me conta como você está

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Feliz. Um pouco pensativa, mas não chateada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fiquei porque queria estar lá e saí quando senti que era hora de ir para casa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estava tentando fazer a tarde durar um certo tempo ou transformá-la em algo maior

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você se sentiu à vontade para dizer o que queria?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Fiquei mais à vontade assim que parei de ensaiar tudo na minha cabeça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Algumas coisas eu prefiro guardar para mim por enquanto, mas não tem nada me preocupando que eu esteja evitando te contar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what matters to me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é o que importa para mim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gosto de poder te dizer que gostei sem precisar explicar cada pequeno motivo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can be happy for you without knowing every detail
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso ficar feliz por você sem saber cada detalhe

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Extremely. Those shoes were a good decision, but I still wanted them off when I got in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Extremamente. Aqueles sapatos foram uma boa escolha, mas eu ainda queria tirá-los quando entrei.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Because I am happy ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Porque eu estou feliz ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What was today actually like on your side?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você? Como foi o seu dia na verdade?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I checked the time more than usual when I knew you'd be meeting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu olhei para o relógio mais do que o normal quando soube que vocês iam se encontrar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I put the phone down and got on with my afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então eu coloquei o telefone de lado e segui com a minha tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you worrying?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você estava preocupada?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you didn't choose the ones you can only walk five steps in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que você não escolheu aqueles que só dá pra andar cinco passos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly noticing that it was real, like we talked about last night
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Principalmente percebendo que era real, como conversamos ontem à noite

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I wasn't sitting here wishing I'd told you to cancel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas eu não estava aqui desejando ter te dito para cancelar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you're saying that instead of pretending you didn't feel anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que você esteja dizendo isso em vez de fingir que não sentiu nada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And hearing that you had a good time helps. I like that you sound like yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E saber que você se divertiu ajuda. Gosto que você esteja soando como você mesma

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am still me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu ainda sou eu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm looking forward to seeing you tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Estou ansioso para te ver amanhã

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? Was today what you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você? O dia de hoje foi o que você esperava?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't know exactly what to expect
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não sabia exatamente o que esperar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do occasionally learn from my mistakes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu às vezes aprendo com meus erros.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was glad you'd gone, then I found myself looking forward to your message more than the game I was playing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fiquei feliz que você tivesse ido, então me peguei ansioso pela sua mensagem mais do que pelo jogo que estava jogando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's quite an achievement
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é uma grande conquista

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An enormous one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma enorme

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly I liked how you sounded when you got back. You weren't just telling me things you thought I'd want to hear
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Principalmente gostei de como você soou quando voltou. Você não estava apenas me dizendo coisas que achava que eu queria ouvir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I wanted to talk to you because I'd had a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não. Eu queria falar com você porque tive uma boa tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what made me happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é o que me deixou feliz

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making me want to come over and hug you again ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está me fazendo querer ir aí e te abraçar de novo ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Before I tell you anything else, what you said this morning really helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Antes de te contar qualquer coisa, o que você disse esta manhã realmente ajudou.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you like the photo together from the café?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você gostou da foto que tiramos juntas no café?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. It was nice that you wanted to include me in that moment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gostei. Foi legal que você quisesse me incluir naquele momento

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I asked him first, by the way. About taking it and sending it to you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu perguntei a ele primeiro, a propósito. Sobre pegar e enviar para você

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, you told me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei, você me contou

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I put the phone away. I didn't want to spend the whole date trying to send the next thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E então eu guardei o celular. Não queria passar o encontro todo tentando enviar a próxima coisa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn't need to. I liked getting something you actually wanted to share
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não precisava. Eu gostei de receber algo que você realmente queria compartilhar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About choosing for yourself?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sobre escolher por si mesma?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad I could tell you about it in my own words afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que pude te contar sobre isso com minhas próprias palavras depois

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted. You didn't have to spend the date collecting things for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Era isso que eu queria. Você não precisava passar o encontro coletando coisas para mim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you still got a picture of your girlfriend on her way home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você ainda conseguiu uma foto da sua namorada a caminho de casa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I particularly liked that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu particularmente gostei dessa parte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your very ordinary privileges remain intact 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Seus privilégios bem comuns continuam intactos 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leaving my phone alone until we said goodbye helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deixar meu celular de lado até nos despedirmos ajudou

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not because I didn't want to talk to you. I just wasn't trying to be in two conversations at once
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não porque eu não quisesse falar com você. Eu só não queria estar em duas conversas ao mesmo tempo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I prefer getting to talk properly now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu prefiro poder conversar direito agora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I wanted your attention when I actually had time to enjoy it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também. Eu queria sua atenção quando realmente tinha tempo para aproveitar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that keeping some moments to myself doesn't mean I have to be distant with you tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto que guardar alguns momentos para mim não significa que eu tenha que ficar distante de você essa noite

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want distance. I wanted you to have room to be yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não queria distância. Eu queria que você tivesse espaço para ser você mesmo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now I've actually had that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Agora parece diferente, já que eu realmente tive isso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I still caught myself wondering what you'd think of whatever I did next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No começo, ainda me pegava pensando no que você acharia do que eu fizesse a seguir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. Did you get home okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou sim. Você chegou em casa bem?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you free after lunch tomorrow?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está livre depois do almoço amanhã?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a woman with a film and an unreasonable amount of pasta? Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Para uma mulher com um filme e uma quantidade absurda de macarrão? Sim

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I want to see you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ótimo. Eu quero te ver

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll bring the container, and you're not allowed to pretend you don't remember agreeing to my choice of film
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu vou trazer o recipiente, e você não pode fingir que não lembra de ter concordado com a minha escolha de filme

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember. I even made room on the sofa
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu lembro. Até fiz espaço no sofá

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For me or the pasta?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pra mim ou pra massa?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can discuss priorities when you arrive
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Podemos discutir prioridades quando você chegar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wrong answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Resposta errada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For you. The pasta can have a chair
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pra você. A massa pode ter uma cadeira

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muito melhor

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I remembered you weren't sitting at home waiting for me to follow instructions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então eu lembrei que você não estava em casa esperando eu seguir instruções.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed sitting next to you today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Senti falta de sentar ao seu lado hoje

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have as much of that as you like tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode ter quanto quiser disso amanhã

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I intend to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu pretendo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you tired now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está cansada agora?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Not the miserable kind, just ready to stop looking at a screen
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco. Não do tipo miserável, só pronta pra parar de olhar pra tela

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me get into bed before I end up sleeping here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deixa eu ir pra cama antes que eu acabe dormindo aqui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 7 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 7 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it. I even remembered to plug the phone in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cheguei. Até lembrei de plugar o telefone

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An organized woman
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma mulher organizada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Briefly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Brevemente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não estava.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just for you before I put it down
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esse é só pra você antes de eu desligar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wish I was there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Queria estar aí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow. And then you can hear my excellent commentary on the film in person
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Amanhã. E então você pode ouvir meu excelente comentário sobre o filme pessoalmente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that included in the visit?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso tá incluído na visita?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't switch it off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não pode desligar isso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não ia fazer isso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite, lindo ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl. I'm glad you had a good day
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite, linda. Fico feliz que você teve um bom dia.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também. Mal posso esperar para te ver.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked being able to want something without immediately turning it into a question for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gostei de poder querer algo sem imediatamente transformar isso em uma pergunta pra você.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted you to have
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Era isso que eu queria que você tivesse.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I wasn't trying to go further just because you'd said I could
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E eu não estava tentando ir mais longe só porque você disse que eu poderia.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That made a difference too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso também fez diferença.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. No limits from me wasn't supposed to become a target you had to reach
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Sem limites da minha parte, não era pra se tornar um alvo que você tinha que alcançar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It didn't. For once I wasn't trying to get the right answer 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não foi. Pela primeira vez, eu não estava tentando acertar a resposta 😌.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I put everything down and spent five minutes looking for the phone I'd just put in my pocket
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Eu coloquei tudo de lado e passei cinco minutos procurando o telefone que eu tinha acabado de colocar no meu bolso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the café, we went to the little garden a couple of streets away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois do café, fomos para o jardinzinho a algumas ruas de distância.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was he once you were actually on the date?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como ele estava quando vocês realmente estavam no encontro?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still himself. He complained about the cups before we'd even ordered
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda era ele mesmo. Ele reclamou das xícaras antes mesmo de fazermos o pedido.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But he was more honest than usual when he wasn't sure what to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas ele foi mais honesto do que o normal quando não sabia o que dizer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He admitted he'd spent so long expecting you to be annoyed with him that he was still trying to get used to this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele admitiu que passou tanto tempo esperando que você ficasse irritado com ele que ainda estava tentando se acostumar com isso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can imagine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu posso imaginar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't give him our whole conversation. Just told him I wasn't following a list of things you'd allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não contei a ele toda a nossa conversa. Apenas disse que não estava seguindo uma lista de coisas que você tinha permitido.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Distracted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Distraída?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como ele reagiu a isso?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He was surprised again. Then he understood that he should ask me what I wanted
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele ficou surpreso de novo. Então ele entendeu que deveria me perguntar o que eu queria.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We stopped talking about the situation after that and actually had a date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Paramos de falar sobre a situação depois disso e realmente tivemos um encontro.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you got past explaining it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que você tenha conseguido passar da explicação.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. He remembered a lot of little things about me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também. Ele lembrou de várias coisinhas sobre mim.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I got to hear him say something nice without immediately making it a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E eu consegui ouvir ele dizer algo legal sem imediatamente transformar em uma piada.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's worth a second coffee by itself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso já vale um segundo café só por isso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't tell him that. He'll start announcing every compliment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não conta isso pra ele. Ele vai começar a anunciar todo elogio.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we stopped in the garden, and {{name:aiden}} kissed me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então paramos no jardim, e {{name:aiden}} me beijou.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kissed you first?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele te beijou primeiro?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. Before I'd even finished deciding what I was going to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Antes mesmo de eu terminar de decidir o que ia dizer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I pushed him back a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu empurrei ele um pouco.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você estava bem?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he just caught me off guard
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, ele me pegou de surpresa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted a second. He stopped, then immediately started looking far too pleased with himself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu queria um segundo. Ele parou, e então começou a parecer muito satisfeito consigo mesmo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso soa como ele.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently he'd decided I was going to kiss him anyway, so he was only getting ahead of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aparentemente, ele decidiu que eu ia beijá-lo de qualquer jeito, então ele só estava se adiantando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he found a way to make himself right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro que ele encontrou uma maneira de se achar certo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Exatamente 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kept teasing me about it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele continuou me provocando sobre isso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the missing sock ever turn up?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A meia que estava faltando apareceu?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I kissed him myself to shut him up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então eu o beijei para calá-lo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And because you wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E porque você queria?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Annoyingly, those two things happened at the same time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Irritantemente, essas duas coisas aconteceram ao mesmo tempo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the shutting him up part work?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A parte de calá-lo funcionou?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For the duration of the kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Durante o beijo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he asked who kisses better, him or you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então ele perguntou quem beija melhor, ele ou você

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He actually asked you that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele realmente te perguntou isso?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently it was a very important question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Aparentemente, era uma pergunta muito importante

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told him he turns everything into a competition. Games, classes, apparently this too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu disse a ele que ele transforma tudo em competição. Jogos, aulas, aparentemente isso também

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that stopped him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E isso o parou?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Inside a sleeve. Nobody understands how it got there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dentro de uma manga. Ninguém entende como ela foi parar lá.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro que não

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I told him that for now he was still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então eu disse a ele que por enquanto ele ainda estava muito atrás

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por enquanto?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, don't you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, não comece você também

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent the afternoon with one competitive idiot. I don't need another tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu passei a tarde com um idiota competitivo. Não preciso de outro essa noite

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm just appreciating my lead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou apenas apreciando minha vantagem

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proving my point 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E provando meu ponto 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como ele reagiu?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He laughed and decided I'd just given him a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele riu e decidiu que eu tinha acabado de desafiá-lo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said it wasn't meant to be one. Apparently that didn't matter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu disse que não era pra ser um desafio. Aparentemente, isso não importou

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your washing machine has a very small sense of humor
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sua máquina de lavar tem um senso de humor bem pequeno.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds about right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso parece certo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd recognize the behavior
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sabia que você reconheceria esse comportamento

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know you don't have to make it sound worse for my benefit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você sabe que não precisa piorar as coisas pra me agradar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I liked kissing him, even if he was impossible afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estou. Eu gostei de beijá-lo, mesmo que ele tenha ficado impossível depois

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you can tell me that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que você possa me contar isso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the second time, I wasn't surprised or trying to work out what I should do. I just wanted to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E na segunda vez, eu não fiquei surpresa nem tentando descobrir o que fazer. Eu só queria

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was it strange afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Foi estranho depois?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only for a moment. Then he was talking too much again and I stopped overthinking it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Só por um momento. Depois ele começou a falar demais de novo e eu parei de pensar demais

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We sat in the shade for a while. I threatened to make him sit by himself if he kept commenting on everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nós sentamos na sombra por um tempo. Eu o ameacei de fazê-lo sentar sozinho se ele continuasse comentando sobre tudo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Romance is alive and well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O romance está vivo e saudável

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd appreciate the update
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Achei que você ia gostar da atualização.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You love the same woman. You know what you signed up for
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você ama a mesma mulher. Sabe no que se meteu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He asked about making plans again, but I didn't want to organize the next date while I was still on this one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele perguntou sobre fazer planos de novo, mas eu não queria organizar o próximo encontro enquanto ainda estava nesse

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes sense
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Faz sentido

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't a way of putting him off. I just wanted to get home and let today settle a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não era uma forma de afastá-lo. Eu só queria voltar pra casa e deixar o dia assentar um pouco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told you we went for a walk after the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu te disse que fomos dar uma volta depois do café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was a bookshop he'd wanted to look in, so we ended up browsing the secondhand shelves
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Havia uma livraria que ele queria visitar, então acabamos olhando as prateleiras de segunda mão

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where the book came from?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Foi de lá que veio o livro?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I picked it because the description sounded ridiculous and I wanted to know whether the story could possibly be worse
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Eu escolhi porque a descrição parecia ridícula e eu queria saber se a história poderia ser ainda pior.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. I'm interested in your very uneventful adventures too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto. Também estou interessada nas suas aventuras super tranquilas.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I’m not that kind of person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Eu não sou esse tipo de pessoa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re allowed to compliment me again by the way
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Você pode me elogiar de novo, aliás

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not getting up anytime soon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: E não vou me levantar tão cedo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Planning to stay there all day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Planejando ficar aí o dia todo?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Unless someone comes to bother me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: A menos que alguém venha me incomodar
Só pra garantir que você se lembre

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I was a little worried you’d wake up and pretend it never happened
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Eu tava um pouco preocupada que você acordasse e fingisse que nunca aconteceu

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm presenting today and suddenly my introduction looks unfamiliar 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hoje eu tô apresentando e de repente minha introdução parece estranha 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'd prefer having just you in the audience again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu preferiria ter só você na plateia de novo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I might be biased
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu posso estar sendo tendenciosa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're very biased. I like it ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você é bem tendencioso. Eu gosto ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I still listened properly
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu ainda prestei atenção

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You did. That's why I'm messaging you instead of rewriting the whole thing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você prestou. É por isso que tô te mandando mensagem em vez de reescrever tudo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready. Notes checked, laptop charged, no bags left at your place
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pronta. Anotações conferidas, laptop carregado, sem bolsas na sua casa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then you're already ahead of yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então você já tá à frente de ontem

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please don't remind me of the bag situation 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Por favor, não me lembre da situação das bolsas 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You look good. Now go show them you know your subject
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você tá ótima. Agora vai mostrar pra eles que você sabe do que tá falando

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The same one you got through without your notes last night?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: A mesma que você passou sem suas anotações ontem à noite?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll tell you how it goes later
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Depois te conto como foi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be waiting. Good luck, love ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Estarei esperando. Boa sorte, amor ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Thank you. Love you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Obrigada. Te amo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. My brain has chosen a very inconvenient time to doubt it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sim. Meu cérebro escolheu um momento bem inconveniente pra duvidar disso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You explained it clearly yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você explicou isso claramente ontem

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And you answered my questions without having to search through the slides
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E você respondeu minhas perguntas sem precisar procurar nos slides

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. It's just different with everyone looking at me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu sei. É só diferente com todo mundo me olhando

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Take a second before you start. You don't have to rush into the first sentence
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tire um segundo antes de começar. Você não precisa correr pra primeira frase

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I do rush when I'm nervous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu acabo correndo quando tô nervosa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then keep the cafe example in mind. You knew exactly how to explain that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então mantenha o exemplo do café em mente. Você sabia exatamente como explicar isso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay. Slow down and start with the example
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ok. Vá devagar e comece com o exemplo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Then I’ll come by later tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Então eu passo aí mais tarde hoje à noite.
Não. Eu vou passar mais tarde hoje à noite.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Fine. Can I come over later tonight?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Beleza. Posso passar mais tarde hoje à noite?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now you’re asking after already deciding
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Agora você tá perguntando depois de já ter decidido

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The door will be unlocked when you come over tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: A porta vai estar destrancada quando você passar aqui hoje à noite.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Text me when you’re ready to come over
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Me manda uma mensagem quando você estiver pronto para vir.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thinking about coming to your room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Pensando em ir pro seu quarto

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just so you know what you’re walking into
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Só pra você saber no que tá entrando

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Your not talking about the room are you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Você não tá falando do quarto, tá?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What happened to the calm version of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: O que aconteceu com a versão calma de você?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: He just decided to enjoy life too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ela só decidiu aproveitar a vida também

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It's done. And it went well 😭❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tá feito. E foi bem 😭❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very familiar 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Muito familiar 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I almost laughed because we'd talked about exactly that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu quase ri porque falamos exatamente sobre isso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I could answer without looking at my notes
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu consegui responder sem olhar para minhas anotações

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's great. You knew it already, you just needed to practise saying it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Isso é ótimo. Você já sabia, só precisava praticar dizendo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Apparently so
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aparentemente sim

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It wasn't flawless, though
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mas não foi perfeito

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: What happened?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: O que aconteceu?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I clicked to the next slide while I was still explaining the first one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu cliquei para o próximo slide enquanto ainda estava explicando o primeiro

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then clicked back too far
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Depois cliquei de volta muito longe

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A surprise tour of the presentation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Uma tour surpresa pela apresentação

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There she is. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Lá vem ela. Como você tá se sentindo?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Exactly. Everyone got to admire the title twice 😭
