story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Exatamente. Todo mundo pôde admirar o título duas vezes 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you find the right slide again?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Você encontrou o slide certo de novo?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I said the laptop was more impatient than I was
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sim. Eu disse que o laptop estava mais impaciente do que eu

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A few people laughed. Then I carried on
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Algumas pessoas riram. Então eu continuei

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's a pretty good recovery
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Essa foi uma boa recuperação

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I thought so too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu também pensei isso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I don't have the grade yet, but the professor said the examples were clear
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ainda não tenho a nota, mas o professor disse que os exemplos estavam claros

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should be pleased with that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Você deve estar feliz com isso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I am ❤️ And I'm glad you helped me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Estou ❤️ E estou feliz que você me ajudou ontem

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm happy it helped. You did the presentation yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Fico feliz que ajudou. Você fez a apresentação sozinho

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Relieved. I think I was holding my breath before I started
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aliviada. Acho que estava prendendo a respiração antes de começar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now I can stop rehearsing sentences every time I have a quiet minute
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Agora posso parar de ensaiar frases toda vez que tenho um minuto de silêncio

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Enjoy the quiet minute, then
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aproveite o minuto de silêncio, então

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: With lunch this time. A proper one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Com almoço desta vez. Um de verdade

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: An excellent follow-up to your academic success
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Um excelente acompanhamento ao seu sucesso acadêmico

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Talk tonight? I want to hear about your day too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Conversamos hoje à noite? Quero ouvir sobre o seu dia também

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. Enjoy your lunch, love
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Claro. Aproveite seu almoço, amor

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eu vou ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did the introduction come back to you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: A introdução voltou pra você?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I slowed down like you said
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sim. Eu desacelerei como você disse

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then once I got into the cafe example, it felt much easier
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Então, quando entrei no exemplo do café, ficou muito mais fácil

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. What about questions?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bom. E quanto às perguntas?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You'll like this
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Você vai gostar disso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The professor asked what would make someone choose between two places with similar products and prices
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: O professor perguntou o que faria alguém escolher entre dois lugares com produtos e preços semelhantes

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Isso soa familiar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: {{name:hailey}} lowers her phone and looks at you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: {{name:hailey}} abaixa o celular e te olha
Eu não tinha 100% de certeza que você viria.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate proximity in private room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de proximidade íntima em quarto privado

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one pressing against me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Você é quem está se pressionando contra mim

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to kiss you again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Se você continuar me olhando assim, vou te beijar de novo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Why are you still texting me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Por que você ainda está me mandando mensagem?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate kiss in private setting
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de beijo íntimo em ambiente privado

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: That one was even better than yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Esse foi ainda melhor que ontem

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If we keep going I won’t want to stop
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Se continuarmos, eu não vou querer parar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And if I don’t want to stop either?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: E se eu também não quiser parar?
Não quando você está tão perto

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Go back to your room before I change my mind
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Volta pro seu quarto antes que eu mude de ideia

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If I talk out loud right now I’m going to get all weird
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Se eu falar em voz alta agora, vou ficar toda estranha.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Just… let me text for a bit
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Só... me deixa mandar mensagem por um tempo.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re standing there like you don’t know what to do
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Você está parado aí como se não soubesse o que fazer.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home, and I'm putting those slides away for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou em casa e vou guardar esses slides para hoje à noite

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you come over and stay the night with me?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você vem aqui e passa a noite comigo?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Dinner, time together, and no having to leave at the end
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Jantar, tempo juntos e sem precisar ir embora no final

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sim ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: YesYesYesYesYesYesYes❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: SimSimSimSimSimSimSim❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd really like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu adoraria isso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought about asking yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pensei em perguntar ontem

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You should have. I would've been tempted
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você deveria ter perguntado. Eu teria ficado tentada

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow's better, though. I can bring what I need instead of improvising
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mas amanhã é melhor. Posso trazer o que preciso em vez de improvisar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: When can you come?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quando você pode vir?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My afternoon is free after university
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Minha tarde está livre depois da universidade

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Well earned. How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bem merecido. Como foi o resto do seu dia?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I can go home, get my things and come over around five
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Posso ir para casa, pegar minhas coisas e chegar aí por volta das cinco

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Five sounds good
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Cinco tá bom.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And this time, I get to stay when you ask me to come closer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E dessa vez, eu posso ficar quando você me pede pra chegar mais perto 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I'm looking forward to
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: É isso que estou ansiosa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. I'm getting my bag now, before I forget something
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Espera. Estou pegando minha bolsa agora, antes que eu esqueça de algo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ALGUNS MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Toothbrush, clean clothes for Thursday, charger
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Escova de dentes, roupas limpas para quinta, carregador

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very organised
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Muito organizada

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm trying. Can I borrow a t-shirt to sleep in?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou tentando. Posso pegar uma camiseta sua pra dormir?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Much easier once I wasn't thinking about presenting anymore
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Foi bom. Muito mais fácil quando não estava pensando em apresentar mais

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. You've looked good in mine before
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Claro. Você já ficou bem com a minha antes

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll let you choose one for me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então eu deixo você escolher uma pra mim

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Consider it ready
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Considere pronto

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I hope you know I might get attached to it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Espero que você saiba que eu posso me apegar a isso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vou correr o risco

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Almost packed
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pronto. Quase tudo arrumado

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased about that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você parece bem feliz com isso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. This bag is actually supposed to stay at your place tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou sim. Essa bolsa na verdade vai ficar na sua casa amanhã

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Along with its owner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Junto com a dona dela

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What did you do?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: O que você fez?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Especially its owner ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Especialmente a dona ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually, before I finish packing...
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Na verdade, antes de eu terminar de arrumar...

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What are you up to?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: O que você está fazendo?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Giving you a little preview 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te dando uma pequena prévia 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ALGUNS MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What do you think?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: O que você acha?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look gorgeous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você está linda

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that smile tells me you knew exactly what you were doing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E esse sorriso me diz que você sabia exatamente o que estava fazendo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to distract you a little 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Queria te distrair um pouco 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Some errands, a short walk, then a few things around the house
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alguns recados, uma caminhada curta e depois algumas coisas em casa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. Now I wish you were here
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Funcionou. Agora eu queria que você estivesse aqui

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What would you do if I was?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: O que você faria se eu estivesse?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Pull you close and kiss you before you even unpacked that bag
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te puxar pra perto e te beijar antes mesmo de você desempacotar essa bolsa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll leave the unpacking until later ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então vou deixar o desempacotar pra depois ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. One more before I change
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Espera. Mais uma antes de eu mudar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A MINUTE LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UM MINUTO DEPOIS

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Your last preview for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pronto. Seu último preview pra hoje à noite

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making tomorrow feel very dangerous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você tá fazendo amanhã parecer muito perigoso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing your face when I'm actually standing in front of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mal posso esperar pra ver sua cara quando eu realmente estiver na sua frente

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was the walk?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Como foi a caminhada?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come close enough and you won't have to guess how much I like it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Chega perto o suficiente e você não vai precisar adivinhar o quanto eu gosto disso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I intend to 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu pretendo 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Keep those pictures just for yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Guarde essas fotos só pra você

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. They're staying between us
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Claro. Elas ficam entre nós

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. Tomorrow you can put your phone down and pay attention to me in person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bom. Amanhã você pode largar o celular e prestar atenção em mim pessoalmente

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have my full attention
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você vai ter toda a minha atenção

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I wanted to hear ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Era isso que eu queria ouvir ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Should I worry about you stealing all the duvet?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Devo me preocupar com você roubando todo o edredom?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only if you plan to sleep very far away from me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Só se você planeja dormir bem longe de mim

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wasn't planning that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu não estava planejando isso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Still taking it slowly, but it felt good to get out
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Foi bom. Ainda estou indo devagar, mas foi bom sair

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then we'll be fine 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Então vai ficar tudo bem 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I can't promise I won't put my cold feet against you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mas não posso prometer que não vou colocar meus pés frios em você

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That wasn't in the invitation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Isso não estava no convite

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It comes with the girlfriend. You should have read the details
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Isso vem com a namorada. Você devia ter lido os detalhes

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll survive
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu vou sobreviver

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. I want you there when I wake up too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bom. Eu quero você lá quando eu acordar também

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have me there
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você vai me ter lá

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the part I keep thinking about
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Essa é a parte que eu fico pensando

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Getting comfortable with you and not having to check when I need to go home
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ficar confortável com você e não precisar ficar checando quando eu preciso ir pra casa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I liked having you beside me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu gostei de ter você ao meu lado ontem

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou feliz ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow we can stay like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Amanhã a gente pode ficar assim

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making the wait feel longer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você tá fazendo a espera parecer mais longa 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only until tomorrow afternoon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Só até amanhã à tarde

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll finish packing and try to stop looking at the time
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vou terminar de arrumar as coisas e tentar parar de olhar a hora

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if you want me to bring anything for dinner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me avisa se você quiser que eu traga algo pra janta

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Just yourself and your bag. I've got the food covered
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Só você e sua bolsa. Eu cuido da comida

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both will arrive together this time 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ambos vão chegar juntos dessa vez 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. I'm looking forward to tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Boa noite, amor. Estou ansioso(a) por amanhã

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também. Boa noite ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Queria te perguntar uma coisa sobre amanhã

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What's on your mind?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: O que você está pensando?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Is my hair tie still safe, or has your sofa claimed it?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom dia ❤️ Minha faixa de cabelo ainda está segura, ou seu sofá já a tomou?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was talking about you, idiot
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu estava falando de você, idiota

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, I don't have time to explain another one 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom, não tenho tempo para explicar mais um 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Class first, then work. I'm just getting ready
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Primeiro aula, depois trabalho. Estou só me arrumando

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Unless your guard is also delivering the hair tie
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A menos que seu segurança também esteja trazendo o elástico de cabelo
Está ao lado das minhas chaves

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ What are you doing today?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigada, lindo ❤️ O que você vai fazer hoje?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Laundry, then I want to finish that game I started
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Roupa, depois quero terminar aquele jogo que comecei

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hang the washing up before you start playing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pendure a roupa antes de começar a jogar

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather hear about your game than a machine full of damp clothes 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Prefiro ouvir sobre seu jogo do que sobre uma máquina cheia de roupas molhadas 😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish at five again, then straight home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Devo terminar às cinco de novo, e depois direto para casa

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too. I'd rather still be on your sofa, but the bus won't wait for me
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você também. Eu preferia ainda estar no seu sofá, mas o ônibus não vai esperar por mim

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And my hair tie 😌 Love you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E meu elástico de cabelo 😌 Te amo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put a guard on it
Thank you, it deserves proper treatment
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigada, ela merece um tratamento adequado

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, better than the night before
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, melhor do que na noite anterior

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could've stayed under that blanket another hour though
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu poderia ter ficado debaixo daquele cobertor mais uma hora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was comfortable, and I liked the company ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Foi confortável, e eu gostei da companhia ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or are you afraid of me?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ou você tá com medo de mim?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You're going to be punished for that.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você vai ser punido por isso.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Seeing how personal this has become makes my stomach drop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ver como isso se tornou pessoal me dá um aperto no estômago.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded the subject initiating digital penetration during the private session after questioning the need for continued revision.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK registrou o sujeito iniciando penetração digital durante a sessão privada após questionar a necessidade de continuar a revisão.
A reação do sujeito indica aceitação

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to know how she actually feels, because HAK's interpretation isn't enough.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Preciso saber como ela realmente se sente, porque a interpretação de HAK não basta.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the stimulation, the professor delivered a firm slap to the subject’s backside. Subject did not pull away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Após a estimulação, o professor deu um tapa firme na parte de trás do sujeito. O sujeito não se afastou.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just making sure you’re still paying attention.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Só tô garantindo que você ainda tá prestando atenção.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re enjoying this way too much.
I’m starting to actually like these private lessons.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tô começando a realmente gostar dessas aulas particulares.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why do I still have to revise if we already have… an arrangement?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Por que eu ainda tenho que revisar se já temos... um acordo?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Was in the middle of something

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Só demorou mais do que eu esperava

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because I still need to prove you’re working with me.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Porque eu ainda preciso provar que você está trabalhando comigo.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So it’s just for the paperwork?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Então é só por causa da papelada?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I've found a bench for lunch instead of eating next to the printer today
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oi 😊 Encontrei um banco para almoçar em vez de comer ao lado da impressora hoje

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is, before you ask for proof
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está sim, antes que você peça provas

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent, I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Excelente, estou orgulhosa de você ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. I'll text you when I'm out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Preciso voltar. Te mando mensagem quando sair

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Falo com você depois.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, while they check the next day's schedule in the manager's office...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais tarde naquela tarde, enquanto eles checam a programação do dia seguinte no escritório do gerente...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversa de escritório detectada perto de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yesterday felt so easy when we were together. Now I'm watching this office again, afraid that one good evening hasn't changed anything.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ontem tudo parecia tão fácil quando estávamos juntos. Agora estou olhando aquele escritório de novo, com medo de que uma boa noite não tenha mudado nada.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//TRANSCRIÇÃO AO VIVO

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look good with your hair down
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você fica bem com o cabelo solto

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that your contribution to this afternoon's work?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Essa é sua contribuição para o trabalho da tarde?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can admire you and read a schedule
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Posso te admirar e ler a programação

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then try doing the second one
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então tente fazer o segundo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A big improvement
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uma grande melhoria

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less interesting
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Muito menos interessante

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It'll take even longer if you keep looking at me instead
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vai demorar ainda mais se você continuar me olhando assim

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were hardly subtle
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não foi nada sutil

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't trying to be
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não estava tentando ser

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claro

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come over tomorrow. I'll make dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vem aqui amanhã. Eu vou fazer o jantar

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To your place?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Na sua casa?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's where my kitchen is
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: É lá que fica minha cozinha

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm asking
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você sabe por que estou perguntando

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you know I'm not inviting you over to discuss your work
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E você sabe que não estou te chamando pra discutir seu trabalho

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It makes much better background noise too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Faz um barulho de fundo muito melhor também

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about this yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nós falamos sobre isso ontem

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You had plans yesterday. I'm asking about tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tinha planos ontem. Estou perguntando sobre amanhã

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I meant the rest of that conversation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu me referia ao resto daquela conversa

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I had a really good evening with him
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu tive uma noite muito boa com ele

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sure you did
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tenho certeza que sim

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop acting like there's something missing that you're going to fix
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então para de agir como se tivesse algo faltando que você vai consertar

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not offering to fix anything. I want another evening with you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não estou oferecendo consertar nada. Eu quero mais uma noite com você

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make everything sound so simple
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você faz tudo parecer tão simples

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner is simple. You're thinking about everything after it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O jantar é simples. Você está pensando em tudo depois disso

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm thinking about whether I should be there at all
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou pensando se eu deveria estar lá mesmo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What have you got?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O que você trouxe?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You enjoyed the other night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você se divertiu na outra noite

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I felt awful afterwards. You keep leaving that part out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E eu me senti péssima depois. Você sempre esquece dessa parte

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked having you to myself for an evening. I'd like to do it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu gostei de ter você só pra mim por uma noite. Queria fazer isso de novo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving you an answer now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não vou te dar uma resposta agora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then think about it. Seven, if you decide you're coming
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então pensa nisso. Sete horas, se você decidir vir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let me finish this first
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Deixa eu terminar isso primeiro

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} turns back to the open schedule on the desk
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} volta para a agenda aberta na mesa

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager watches her ass from the other side, leaning back in his chair
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O gerente dela observa o corpo dela do outro lado, reclinando na cadeira

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's watching her instead of the work in front of him. I hate feeling like I'm the only person who needs this to stop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele está olhando para ela em vez de para o trabalho à sua frente. Odeio sentir que sou a única pessoa que precisa que isso pare.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Invitation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um Convite

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, with the schedule checked and the last page signed...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pouco antes das cinco, com a agenda conferida e a última página assinada...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's everything. I'll put these with the others
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso é tudo. Vou colocar esses com os outros

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A wrap and an apple. Nothing dramatic
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um wrap e uma maçã. Nada dramático

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leave them there, I'll take them out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Deixa aí, eu tiro eles

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have said that before I sorted them
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você poderia ter dito isso antes de eu organizá-los

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're sorted now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Agora estão organizados

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really do enjoy being in charge
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você realmente gosta de estar no controle

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at me a second
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Olha pra mim um segundo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O que?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want another kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu quero outro beijo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm hesitating
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você sabe por que estou hesitando

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm asking whether you want one too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei. Estou perguntando se você também quer um

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay... just a kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok... só um beijo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After her answer, the manager gets up and steps closer to {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Depois da resposta dela, o gerente se levanta e se aproxima de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He leans in to kiss her and draws her a little closer by the waist; she returns the kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ele se inclina para beijá-la e a puxa um pouco mais para perto pela cintura; ela retribui o beijo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another kiss, and she's returning it. The evening we spent together still matters to me, but right now it feels painfully far away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Outro beijo, e ela corresponde. A noite que passamos juntos ainda importa para mim, mas agora parece dolorosamente distante.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another Kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Outro Beijo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, that's enough
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok, já chega

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked that better than the paperwork
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu gostei mais disso do que da papelada

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent yesterday telling myself that wasn't happening again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Passei ontem me dizendo que isso não ia acontecer de novo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I preferred today's decision
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu preferi a decisão de hoje

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did. You're not the one going home feeling guilty
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claro que você preferiu. Você não é quem vai pra casa se sentindo culpado

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked kissing you. I'm not going to pretend I didn't
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu gostei de te beijar. Não vou fingir que não gostei

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou saindo agora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you about dinner later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem sobre o jantar depois

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looks peaceful
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parece tranquilo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still haven't agreed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ainda não concordei

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I heard you. Think about it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu ouvi você. Pense nisso

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After leaving work, on the way to the bus stop...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Depois de sair do trabalho, a caminho do ponto de ônibus...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Heading home now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou fora ❤️ Indo pra casa agora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything finished?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tudo terminado?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, tomorrow's schedule is finally done
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, a programação de amanhã finalmente está pronta

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something you won't have to worry about tonight then
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Algo com que você não vai ter que se preocupar hoje à noite então

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, one less thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, uma coisa a menos

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te mando uma mensagem quando eu entrar

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, talk in a bit
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok, falo contigo daqui a pouco

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is. I'm enjoying not being asked where something is for ten minutes
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: É sim. Estou gostando de não ser perguntada onde está algo por dez minutos

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Your washing supervisor is off duty then?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sua supervisora de roupas está de folga então?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only if it's actually hanging up
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Só se realmente estiver pendurada

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You seem really happy about these private lessons lately
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Você parece realmente feliz com essas aulas particulares ultimamente

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I even look forward to seeing him now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Eu até estou ansiosa para vê-lo agora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You used to complain about every extra session
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Você costumava reclamar de cada sessão extra

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Or maybe I just found a better way to study
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ou talvez eu só tenha encontrado uma maneira melhor de estudar

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Now stop interrogating me and go to sleep
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Agora para de me interrogar e vai dormir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You’re in a good mood and smiling when you come home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Você tá de bom humor e sorrindo quando chega em casa

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Someone sounds jealous of my professor
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Alguém parece com ciúmes do meu professor

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s just really good at what he does
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ele é realmente bom no que faz

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home. Did you manage to finish your game?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ Estou em casa. Você conseguiu terminar seu jogo?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very glamorous evening planned
You look comfortable
I am ❤️ Although your sofa had better company
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou ❤️ Embora seu sofá tivesse melhor companhia

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I saved that photo you took last night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu salvei aquela foto que você tirou ontem à noite

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So did I ❤️
It was nice having you here
It really was. I'd missed that
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Foi mesmo. Eu senti falta disso

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Next time I'll find something better to watch
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na próxima vez, vou encontrar algo melhor para assistir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't mind the film that much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não me importo tanto com o filme

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughing at the wrong parts was half the entertainment anyway
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você rindo das partes erradas foi metade da diversão mesmo assim

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not quite, I've been stuck on the same bit for an hour
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quase, estou preso na mesma parte há uma hora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently that's my role now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aparentemente, esse é meu papel agora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're very good at it 😌
A little later, her manager sends a message...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um pouco depois, a gerente dela manda uma mensagem...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Back in your conversation, a few minutes later...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De volta à sua conversa, alguns minutos depois...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I might be home a bit later tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ah, posso chegar em casa um pouco mais tarde amanhã

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few people from work are having dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Algumas pessoas do trabalho estão jantando

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager too?
Yeah
A group thing this time?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É um encontro em grupo dessa vez?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, a few of us
Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
All right, just let me know when you're back
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Beleza, só me avisa quando voltar

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
No need to keep checking your phone all evening
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não precisa ficar checando seu celular a noite toda

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't forget to text you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não vou esquecer de te mandar mensagem

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
And I did have a lovely time yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E eu realmente me diverti ontem

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already told me 😊
I know, I just wanted to say it again
Me too ❤️
I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou guardar meu prato e ir para a cama

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few things
Sleep well
You too handsome. Love you ❤️
Love you too
Including blaming the controller?
That was the first thing
Very thorough 😌
What are you doing?
Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Já troquei. Estou fazendo algo rápido, depois não vou me mover muito

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright, I’m coming to drag you out of bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Certo, estou indo te arrastar da cama

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:player}} dragged {{name:hailey}} out of bed after multiple ignored messages
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:player}} arrastou {{name:hailey}} da cama após várias mensagens ignoradas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you’re the one still in bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E mesmo assim você é quem ainda está na cama

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And put on a bit more clothes
Don’t make me come up there

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oi 😊 Sem despertador hoje, e decidi que me vestir pode esperar até depois do café da manhã ☕.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been guarding it all morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu estive guardando isso a manhã toda

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ANTES DELA SAIR DE CASA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Beleza, eu trouxe a comida, o filme e a tampa que realmente serve dessa vez

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've packed for a small expedition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você fez as malas para uma pequena expedição

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Só porque não dá pra confiar que você tem toalhas de papel suficientes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Traga você mesmo. O resto é negociável

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso foi legal o suficiente pra eu parar de reclamar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou aproveitar o silêncio enquanto dura

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não por muito tempo. Estou a caminho ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nos próximos vinte minutos, absolutamente 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Depois disso, vou ao mercadinho perto da padaria.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For something you need?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Para algo que você precisa?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu preciso sair de casa sem pegar o mesmo caminho dessa vez.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E eu preciso de algo gostoso para comer com você mais tarde ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought the pasta was something nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu pensei que a massa era algo gostoso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É sim. Mas a massa não conta como sobremesa, não importa o quanto você a elogie.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon plan
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lá se vai meu plano da tarde.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're getting the film I chose as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você vai ganhar o filme que eu escolhi também

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu lembro. Não organizei um corte de energia misterioso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds suspiciously like a day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso soa suspeitosamente como um dia de folga.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É melhor não. Finalmente encontrei um que você não me contou o final ainda

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso aconteceu uma vez

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você disse que o irmão parecia suspeito antes mesmo de falar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ele estava usando luvas dentro de casa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ele estava lavando louça 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Uma disfarce convincente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hoje você pode guardar seu trabalho de detetive só pra você

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É sim 😌 Sem turno, sem pressa para lugar nenhum esta manhã.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E estou ansiosa para ver seu rosto de verdade em vez de ficar me perguntando o que a pausa entre as mensagens significa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A pausa foi principalmente eu tentando encontrar as palavras certas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Hoje você pode falar com a boca cheia como uma pessoa normal

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso eu consigo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ótimo. Eu quero uma tarde legal com você, não mais uma reunião séria

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você parecia tão feliz ontem à noite que quase fui até aí só para ver a expressão que veio junto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você pode inspecionar isso esta tarde

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Abri a janela e estou tomando meu café enquanto ainda está quente ☕.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu pretendo. Bem de perto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou tentar não parecer muito convencida

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso seria uma mudança adorável 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você vai ficar em casa depois disso?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ainda não decidi a noite toda.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso é parte do que eu gosto sobre hoje.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Uma experiência desconhecida.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} me mandou uma foto de uma placa de fliperama mais cedo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ele descobriu outro lugar para reclamar de perder?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aparentemente, ele só estava fazendo uma sugestão útil para o meu dia de folga.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É assim que ele te pega.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu disse a ele que já tinha planos com você esta tarde.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ele disse para perguntar se a mesa de air hockey conta como terreno neutro.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Só até ele perder. Aí a mesa está envolvida em uma conspiração.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu posso ir mais tarde. Eu adoraria ver ele tentando explicar isso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não aceite um melhor de três depois que você já ganhou.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muito. Eu posso me tornar difícil de conviver se me acostumar com isso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou anotando isso 😌📝.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: O cara de ontem me mandou uma mensagem sobre aquele livro que olhamos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aquele da loja?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim. Aparentemente, a primeira página valia a pena voltar para casa.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu só li a contracapa, então eu disse a ele para não ficar convencido ainda.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Um começo promissor para um clube do livro.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É principalmente nós encontrando novas maneiras de evitar dizer que queremos continuar conversando.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você percebeu, então.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pode?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu posso parar de ser sutil mais tarde.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por enquanto, eu disse a ele que vou passar a tarde com você. A gente se fala mais tarde 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom. Eu odiaria ter que compartilhar meus comentários incríveis sobre filmes com um celular.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou deixar na minha bolsa. Para os comentários, não para você.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo, eu devia colocar roupas de verdade antes que a padaria venda tudo que eu quero 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você nem decidiu o que quer ainda.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: É por isso que eu preciso de opções.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou aguardar a investigação.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não come todos os seus lanches antes de eu chegar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cuidado, ainda estou decidindo o que te trazer.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: MAIS TARDE AQUELA MANHÃ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Atualização rápida: a mulher da padaria se lembrou de mim.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso soa bem

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ela se lembrou que eu sempre digo que só vou comprar pão.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Menos legal para a sua defesa.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ela já estava pegando uma bolsa maior.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso definitivamente não é só pão.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tem pão lá dentro. Em algum lugar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu peguei dois pastéis de maçã pra gente, e o suficiente de outras coisas pra valer a caminhada de volta 🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você parece feliz

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou sim. Passei dez minutos olhando flores sem calcular onde eu precisava estar a seguir.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não comprei nada. Apenas aproveitei estar lá.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Devíamos ter mais dias assim.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, deveríamos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou pra casa pegar o recipiente, depois vou pra aí depois do almoço como combinamos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Uma e meia ainda tá de boa?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Perfeito

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou colocar as bebidas na geladeira

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E deixa meu lado do sofá livre

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você parece que já fez as pazes com a ideia de não fazer nada.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você viu a bunda que eu fico com isso? 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Para a academia ou para o seu encontro com o treinador?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: É melhor você não estar procurando outra roupa indecente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou passar a tarde com alguns amigos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ Eu mal desci a rua e já pensei em outra razão pela qual sua teoria sobre o filme não faz sentido 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E agora, o que fazemos?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo booth is tempting 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A cabine de fotos é tentadora 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pra guardar a prova da minha derrota?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não, porque quero ver se você consegue tirar quatro fotos sem fazer careta.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Improvável. Isso é um desafio muito injusto.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ALGUNS MINUTOS DEPOIS, NA CABINE DE FOTOS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você sabe que eu vou estragar pelo menos uma dessas, né?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pelo menos uma? Isso é otimista.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Chega mais, então. Eu preciso de toda vantagem possível.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não é assim que as cabines de fotos funcionam.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought most of it with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você trouxe a maior parte com você

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. The countdown has started
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tarde demais. A contagem regressiva começou.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Subjects enter the photo booth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Os participantes entram na cabine de fotos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Series of personal photographs captured
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Série de fotos pessoais capturadas.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quero que ela aproveite a noite, e posso admitir que tenho curiosidade sobre o quanto estão se aproximando.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tira de Fotos I

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip II
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tira de Fotos II

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You pulled a face in the first one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você fez careta na primeira.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você sorriu em todas, então ainda acho que ganhei.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não é assim que se ganha.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then explain the last picture
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então explica a última foto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você me beijou antes do flash 😳

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E agora está preservado para sempre. De nada

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu me referia à parte em que paramos de falar e apenas sentamos juntos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você é impossível 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda vai escolher pinball depois disso?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. E ainda não vou passar a noite toda contando pontos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem literalmente uma pontuação naquela também

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep yours to yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode guardar a sua para você

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER, OUTSIDE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DEPOIS, DO LADO DE FORA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu tinha esquecido como a rua pode parecer silenciosa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Meus ouvidos ainda estão lá dentro jogando o jogo de corrida

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sua dignidade também está lá dentro em algum lugar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu me diverti

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não percebi o quanto senti sua falta até estar lá ao seu lado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mesmo eu tendo ganhado?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mesmo você nunca deixando isso pra lá

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também me diverti

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shall I walk with you for a bit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso andar com você um pouco?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Eu estava pensando em fazer um chá quando voltar
