story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds sensible
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso parece sensato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was almost an invitation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso foi quase um convite

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quase?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quer vir aqui para tomar um chá? Ainda temos aquele doce que você se recusou a comer antes da sua grande apresentação.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu adoraria!

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também gostei disso. Mesmo quando seu cotovelo encontrou minhas costelas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E nada de perguntar onde eu guardo o segundo controle.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nem vou mencionar isso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou indo pra casa e vou ficar com o sofá pra mim por um tempo 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Já tá sentindo falta dos comentários do filme?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu vou sobreviver. Tenho um livro e alguém que aparentemente leu mais do que eu.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Seu novo contato?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Temos trocado mensagens desde que saí da sua.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele lembrou que eu estava te vendo e esperou até eu dizer que estava livre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você estava ocupando muito do travesseiro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Eu ia reclamar dele interromper a importante disputa dos travesseiros.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ninguém teria entendido sem várias fotos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma pena que não tenha um documentário.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't encourage me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não me incentive.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: BACK AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DE VOLTA EM CASA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Encontrei meu lugar no livro. Era ainda o marcador que colocaram na loja 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso não é muito progresso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu progredi mais na conversa do que na leitura.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou responder a ele direito em vez de fingir que consigo fazer as duas coisas.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Falo contigo depois, então

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim ❤️ Essa foto era pra você, a propósito. Ele ainda não merece a história embaraçosa do marcador 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: MAIS TARDE AQUELA NOITE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An Answer in Pictures
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma Resposta em Imagens

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu tenho duas fotos que você pode gostar. Ele disse que podia te mostrar a dele também.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vocês têm trocado fotos?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. This is the smile he asked for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Este é o sorriso que ele pediu.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Seja legal. Eu te deixei sobras de verdade desta vez

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E esta é a foto que ele tirou na cozinha dele. Estou encaminhando, não estou reivindicando o trabalho da câmera 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O avental era pra mostrar as qualificações dele?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aparentemente, o jantar não conseguiu sorrir para a câmera.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa é uma resposta que você iria gostar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Foi sim. Eu ri antes de conseguir fingir que não.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sua foto está linda, a propósito.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sabia que você ia notar essa primeiro ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E sua colher

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Guarde-a bem. Vou esperar um reencontro dramático

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você teve duas horas pra me contar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou me encontrar com {{name:aiden}} depois de deixar o recipiente em casa 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O fliperama?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Ele disse que seria uma pena deixar seus conselhos de especialista irem para o lixo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele não sabe nem metade

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele já me avisou que uma das máquinas come moedas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Útil. Uma desculpa preparada antes de você chegar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou permitindo que ele tenha exatamente uma

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu estava ocupada tentando assistir enquanto você acusava todo mundo de algo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Generoso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu queria vê-lo de novo, e fazer algo parecia melhor do que mais uma conversa cuidadosa com café.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vai se divertir. Você não precisa de mais um briefing meu.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Já tive instruções demais do detetive no sofá 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: FINAL DE TARDE, DO LADO DE FORA DO ARCADE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cheguei 🎮 Você consegue ouvir esse lugar da calçada.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não deixe ele escolher todos os jogos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele acabou de chegar e apontou para uma máquina de corrida.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro que sim.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was right about one person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu acertei sobre uma pessoa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou guardar meu celular. Me deseje sorte 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não vai precisar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: INSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DENTRO DO ARCADE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came prepared
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você veio preparado.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Para quê?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sapatos confortáveis. Isso é de alguém que espera ganhar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é de alguém que andou pelo mercado esta manhã.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na verdade, eu trouxe algo pra você.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A consolation prize already?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um prêmio de consolação já?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um doce. Eu ainda posso comer isso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois de acusar todos os sete

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não, vou aceitar a desculpa antecipadamente.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está tornando muito difícil ser atencioso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obrigado. Foi muito gentil da sua parte

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aí está. Viu como foi fácil?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você vai supervisionar cada frase esta noite?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Só as que são irritantes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é a maior parte do meu material

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você vai ter que improvisar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DEPOIS DO PRIMEIRO JOGO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That first point didn't count
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aquele primeiro ponto não valeu

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thorough detective work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Trabalho de detetive completo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The machine disagrees
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A máquina discorda

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você acertou antes de eu estar pronto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você estava explicando como isso ia ser fácil

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu estava sendo acolhedor

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd go easy on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você disse que ia pegar leve comigo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E claramente isso foi um erro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então você admite que eu ganhei?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu admito que há espaço para um segundo jogo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não. Você escolheu a primeira máquina. Eu escolho a próxima

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Jogo terminado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} wins the first round
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} ganha a primeira rodada

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E mesmo assim você não percebeu que eu roubei a última mordida do seu doce

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um Perdedor Muito Amargo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:player}} put you up to this
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:player}} te colocou nessa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele me avisou que você pediria outra rodada se perdesse

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou ter uma conversa com ele

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About knowing you too well?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sobre te conhecer bem demais?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About coaching the opposition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sobre treinar o time adversário

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Consegui acertar um disco sem a ajuda de vocês dois

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você conseguiu. A última jogada foi boa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Desculpa, você pode repetir? A máquina estava fazendo barulho

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não exagera

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed. I let you have it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu percebi. Eu deixei você ficar com isso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I might need a moment to appreciate it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Talvez eu precise de um momento para apreciar isso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll give you five seconds
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou te dar cinco segundos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really do count everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você realmente conta tudo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso tirar uma foto com você? Eu gostaria de enviar uma pra ele

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro. O placar vai estar na foto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estava. Excelente sugestão

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pelo menos me dê um segundo pra parecer menos derrotado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É nisso que estou decidindo acreditar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muito tarde. Essa é a cara que eu quero

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UM MOMENTO DEPOIS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele concordou em tirar uma foto. A expressão é totalmente obra dele

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu reconheço essa cara

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's blaming you for warning me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele está te culpando por me avisar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Diga a ele que estou aproveitando minha aposentadoria de ouvir as desculpas dele

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou deixar essa pra lá por enquanto 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DEPOIS QUE ELA GUARDA O CELULAR

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for this afternoon ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obrigada por esta tarde ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Eu sei que você não vai machucá-la

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But isn’t it weird for you?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Mas não é estranho pra você?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: All of this… in front of you

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Na verdade, isso facilita as coisas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Não consegui me segurar e tirei uma foto 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wants cardio more than anything 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ela quer cardio mais do que qualquer coisa 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Estou realmente feliz com como foi 🔥
Então vou dar isso pra ela 🔥

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Aconteceu algo no vestiário quando estávamos saindo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ela queria continuar a sessão mais um pouco

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: So I had to take care of her 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Então eu tive que cuidar dela 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Feliz com a sessão ou com {{name:hailey}}? 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Cara, nunca pensei que teria esse tipo de conversa com você sobre {{name:hailey}} 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Mas mesmo que seja estranho… é meio legal

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Vou passar aí amanhã pra uma tarde de jogos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Eu sei que vocês dois têm uma quedinha um pelo outro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oi 😊 eu te devo uma tampa de recipiente. De alguma forma, consegui trazer isso pra casa também 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Isso é bem menos barulho do que a arcade.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você não tem ideia. Quase recuperei minha audição. Outras partes de mim estão menos calmas.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você parece feliz

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu estou ❤️ Vamos deixar os celulares de lado por um tempo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Falo com você depois.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: DEPOIS QUE ELA GUARDA O CELULAR

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: MAIS TARDE AQUELA NOITE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Se eu ficar assim por mais tempo, vou esquecer que pretendia ir embora.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Isso não é um acidente.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your shirt has ridden up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sua camisa subiu.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu percebi. Você pode deixar sua mão aí.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você está tornando muito difícil ser o primeiro a se levantar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Então me beija mais uma vez e levanta. Não vou te levar pra cama hoje à noite.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu não ia perguntar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você estava pensando nisso. Eu também. É por isso que estou dizendo agora.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Um último beijo profundo no sofá.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: A mão dele na cintura dela, a dela sob a barra da camisa dele.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Isso está avançando rápido, e quero que continuemos conversando com sinceridade sobre o que nos faz sentir bem.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I liked tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu gostei da noite de hoje.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The quieter part too?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: A parte mais tranquila também?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: UM POUCO DEPOIS, EM CASA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Principalmente essa parte. Sua boca. Suas mãos. Tudo isso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você pode sair sem tentar fazer uma última observação inteligente, sabia?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to say I'd like to see you again
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu ia dizer que gostaria de te ver de novo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can keep that one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você pode ficar com essa.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Me manda uma mensagem amanhã. A gente se organiza.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I will
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu vou.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E leva a caixa de doces. Se você deixar aqui, eu vou acabar comendo o resto.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very difficult responsibility
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Uma responsabilidade bem difícil.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Somehow I think you'll cope
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: De alguma forma, acho que você vai dar conta.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER HE LEAVES
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: DEPOIS QUE ELE SAI

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:player}}?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:player}}?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ele foi pra casa. Acabamos ficando no sofá muito mais tempo do que planejamos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tea was a successful idea, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Então, o chá foi uma ideia bem-sucedida.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Muito. Nós conversamos, ficamos perto um do outro, e então eu o puxei para mais perto.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: As mãos dele estavam debaixo da minha blusa. As minhas estavam debaixo da camisa dele. Nós nos beijamos até eu ter que dizer que não íamos mais longe esta noite.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ele finalmente parou de perguntar se estava indo melhor que você.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a major breakthrough
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Isso é um grande avanço.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não transforme não competir em uma competição 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm learning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estou aprendendo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Foi diferente esta noite. Menos como se estivéssemos tentando descobrir o que deveria acontecer.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sim. Eu acidentalmente trouxe pra casa a tampa do recipiente dele

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu queria as mãos dele em mim, então eu as coloquei lá. Não precisava de mais um discurso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound comfortable with that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você parece confortável com isso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estou. Um pouco corada. E estou feliz por ter passado esta tarde com você também.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estou sozinha de novo. Foi uma noite adorável.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound pleased
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você parece satisfeito.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estou. Cansada de um jeito bom, ainda um pouco quente, e muito feliz por não ter passado o dia todo olhando para o relógio.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Guarde os detalhes que você quer guardar. Fico feliz que você tenha se divertido.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Obrigada. Eu ainda quero alguns minutos com você antes de dormir ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You two are going to need an inventory
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vocês dois vão precisar de um inventário

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: MAIS TARDE AQUELA NOITE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Reason to Smile
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Uma Razão para Sorrir

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I finally put the app down 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Finalmente coloquei o app de lado 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you manage to read any of the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Conseguiu ler algum trecho do livro?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Um pouco. Muito pouco depois que começamos a falar sobre ontem. E ainda menos depois das fotos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ele me disse que estava procurando uma desculpa para não sair da livraria. E que queria me tocar de verdade.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E você estava tentando pensar em uma razão para ficar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He has my spoon. We're negotiating
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ele tem minha colher. Estamos negociando

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Exatamente. Parece que resolvemos esse mal-entendido 😌❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The messages got much less cautious tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: As mensagens ficaram muito menos cautelosas esta noite.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você não precisava continuar fingindo que estava apenas discutindo o livro?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não. Eu disse a ele que queria vê-lo de novo. E não apenas conversar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E nós trocamos mais algumas fotos. Depois, algumas que eram menos inocentes.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ele concordou que eu poderia te mostrar essas duas. As outras ficam entre ele e eu.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I could mediate
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu poderia mediar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esse é o sorriso que geralmente significa que você está fingindo que não fez nada.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ele percebeu também. Muito inconveniente para mim. A alça não estava ajudando a minha situação

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And this is the one he took and sent back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E este é o que ele pegou e devolveu

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vocês dois parecem estar curtindo a conversa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estávamos sim. Nenhum de nós leu muito depois disso. Eu guardei as últimas fotos pra mim

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The poor book
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: O pobre livro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ele vai se recuperar. Não tenho certeza se eu vou antes de amanhã

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Was it easier talking in messages?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Foi mais fácil conversar por mensagens?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você contestou uma pontuação exibida em números. Não acho que você esteja qualificado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: In some ways. I could think for a second without worrying that the silence looked strange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: De certa forma. Eu podia pensar por um segundo sem me preocupar que o silêncio parecesse estranho

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But I also caught myself wanting to hear how he'd say something, not just read it. And wanting his hands instead of another photo
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mas eu também me peguei querendo ouvir como ele diria algo, não apenas ler. E querendo as mãos dele em vez de outra foto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That sounds like a reason for another date
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Isso parece uma razão para outro encontro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It is. We'll talk tomorrow and choose a time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: É sim. Vamos conversar amanhã e escolher um horário

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: For tonight, I'm done changing between conversations
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Para hoje à noite, já cansei de trocar de conversa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'd like a little time with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu gostaria de um tempinho com você antes de dormir ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm done messaging for tonight. I had a really nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Já terminei de mandar mensagens por hoje. Tive uma noite muito legal

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did the book get much attention?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: O livro recebeu muita atenção?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Do you want sugar?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você quer açúcar?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not enough to pretend I've become a serious reader
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não o suficiente para fingir que me tornei uma leitora séria

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll reserve judgment until you reach the next chapter
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vou reservar meu julgamento até você chegar no próximo capítulo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I'm keeping the rest of the details for myself tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Obrigada. Vou guardar o resto dos detalhes pra mim esta noite

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's fine. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tudo bem. Como você está se sentindo?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Happy. A little too warm to sleep immediately. And ready to just talk to you for a minute ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Feliz. Um pouco quente demais para dormir imediatamente. E pronta para só conversar com você por um minuto ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One, please
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Um, por favor

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Is that your way of arranging another visit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: É assim que você está tentando marcar outra visita?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: How was your evening after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Como foi sua noite depois que eu fui embora?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Quiet. I finished tidying up, then played for a while
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Foi tranquilo. Terminei de arrumar, depois joguei um pouco.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you get stuck thinking again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você ficou pensando de novo?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A little, but this afternoon helped more than sitting here trying to predict everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Um pouco, mas essa tarde ajudou mais do que ficar aqui tentando prever tudo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We still argued about the film, you still stole my food. Nothing felt forced
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ainda discutimos sobre o filme, você ainda roubou minha comida. Nada parecia forçado.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It wasn't. I was exactly where I wanted to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não foi. Eu estava exatamente onde queria estar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know. You nearly fell asleep on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu sei. Você quase dormiu em cima de mim.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That was a compliment to the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Isso foi um elogio ao sofá.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Obviously
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Obviamente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: See? A preference. Very impressive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Viu? Uma preferência. Muito impressionante

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound like you've had a very good day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você parece ter tido um dia muito bom.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I have. Was yours all right after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tive sim. E o seu, foi tranquilo depois que eu fui embora?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. Quieter, but I liked having the afternoon with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sim. Mais tranquilo, mas eu gostei de passar a tarde com você.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I keep remembering you trying to move my arm without admitting you wanted to lean on it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu fico lembrando de você tentando mover meu braço sem admitir que queria se apoiar nele.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your elbow was taking up a completely unreasonable amount of space
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Seu cotovelo estava ocupando um espaço completamente irracional.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll arrange it more conveniently next time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vou arranjar de uma forma mais conveniente da próxima vez.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Please do. I'm a demanding guest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Por favor, faça isso. Eu sou uma convidada exigente.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm glad today wasn't just yesterday with different clothes
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estou feliz que hoje não foi apenas ontem com roupas diferentes.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You saved that one all the way from yesterday
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você guardou essa desde ontem

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We should put that in the calendar. Occasionally do something else
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Devemos colocar isso no calendário. Fazer algo diferente de vez em quando.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You could even let me choose the next film without a formal appeal
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você poderia até me deixar escolher o próximo filme sem um pedido formal.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Let's not get carried away
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vamos com calma.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I love you, you know ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu te amo, você sabe ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I love you too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu também te amo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Now I'm going to get into bed before I start typing with my eyes closed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Agora vou para a cama antes que eu comece a digitar com os olhos fechados

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ALGUNS MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Made it 😊 This one is just for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Consegui 😊 Esse é só para você

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's my favorite end to the day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esse é meu final favorito para o dia

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I've been waiting for the right moment
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estive esperando o momento certo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Seeing me finally stop talking?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ver eu finalmente parar de falar?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Seeing you look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ver você feliz

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Oh. Now I have to be nice instead of making another joke
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oh. Agora eu tenho que ser legal em vez de fazer outra piada

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can manage one message
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você consegue mandar uma mensagem

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good night, handsome ❤️ Thank you for today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Boa noite, lindo ❤️ Obrigada por hoje

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good night. I'll keep your side of the sofa ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Boa noite. Vou deixar seu lado do sofá pronto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And my spoon 😌 Don't forget my spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E minha colher 😌 Não esquece da minha colher

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER THEY SIT DOWN WITH THEIR TEA
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: DEPOIS QUE ELES SE SENTAM COM SEU CHÁ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is much nicer than shouting over a machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Isso é muito melhor do que gritar por cima de uma máquina

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were the one doing most of the shouting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você foi quem mais gritou

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I got involved
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu me envolvi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You explained your strategy to a puck
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você explicou sua estratégia para um disco

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And it refused to listen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E ele se recusou a ouvir

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I had a nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tive uma noite agradável

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No 😌 I was going to do that without stealing your kitchen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não 😌 Eu ia fazer isso sem roubar sua cozinha

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: So did I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu também

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm not only saying that because I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não estou dizendo isso só porque ganhei

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu sei

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You get easier to talk to when you stop trying to win the conversation as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Fica mais fácil conversar com você quando para de tentar ganhar a conversa também

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't aware there were points for that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu não sabia que havia pontos para isso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You'd find some
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você acharia alguns

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: All right. No points tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tudo bem. Sem pontos hoje à noite

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't say it like you're doing me a favor
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não fala isso como se estivesse me fazendo um favor

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm not. I'm enjoying sitting here
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não estou. Estou gostando de estar aqui sentado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Me too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu também

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You already left a spoon here. We could call it an exchange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você já deixou uma colher aqui. Podemos chamar de troca

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Cold?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Frio?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Only my hands
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Só minhas mãos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: There's a blanket beside you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tem um cobertor ao seu lado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know. Your arm is in the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu sei. Seu braço está no caminho

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Should I move it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Devo movê-lo?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not that way. Here
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não assim. Aqui

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:lena}} moves onto his lap side of the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:lena}} se move para o lado do colo dele no sofá

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand settles at her waist under the blanket
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: A mão dele se acomoda na cintura dela debaixo do cobertor

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: They're getting closer, and I need to notice my own limits as well as respect hers.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eles estão se aproximando, e preciso reconhecer meus próprios limites, além de respeitar os dela.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Quieter Evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Uma Noite Mais Tranquila

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Better?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Melhor?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. Stay there. Your hand can stay too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sim. Fica aí. Sua mão também pode ficar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very domestic hostage situation 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Uma situação de refém bem doméstica 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I can do that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eu consigo fazer isso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're tracing the edge of my top like you're asking permission
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você está passando a mão na borda da minha blusa como se estivesse pedindo permissão

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am asking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estou pedindo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You already have it. Come here
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você já tem. Vem aqui

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Here?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Aqui?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You know what I mean
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Você sabe do que eu estou falando

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:lena}} pulls him into a longer kiss
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:lena}} o puxa para um beijo mais longo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand slides under her top along her back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: A mão dele desliza por baixo da blusa dela, ao longo das costas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No Score to Keep
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sem Pontuação a Manter

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't stop just because I made a noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não para só porque eu fiz barulho

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That wasn't a complaint
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Isso não foi uma reclamação

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll keep it safe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vou mantê-la segura

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It wasn't. Higher. No — there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Não foi. Mais alto. Não — ali

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your tea is going to go cold
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Seu chá vai esfriar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Put the cup down. Carefully. Then come back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Coloca a xícara para baixo. Com cuidado. Depois volta

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Cups set aside
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Xícaras de lado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Kissing continues on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Os beijos continuam no sofá

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His mouth at her neck, her fingers in his hair
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: A boca dele no pescoço dela, os dedos dela no cabelo dele

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tell me if that's too much

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Clothes stay on, hands do not stay still

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's okay. No scoreboard this time?
