story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Você tem uma carona em quarenta

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: You think I’m showing up looking tragic
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Você acha que estou aparecendo com uma aparência trágica?
Cale a boca e se prepare

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: Just when i was asking a friend to pick me up
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Justo quando eu estava pedindo a um amigo para me buscar

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: How did you even do that

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You’ll have to bring {{name:hailey}} back too
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: Você também terá que trazer {{name:hailey}} de volta.
Eu estou aqui de qualquer forma

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: I’m gonna see some friends while she trains
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: Vou ver alguns amigos enquanto ela treina.
Então eu a trarei de volta

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You want us to grab something from the store on the way back ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: Você quer que a gente pegue algo na loja no caminho de volta?

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: {{name:hailey}} almost killed us in the car 😂
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: A {{name:hailey}} quase nos matou no carro 😂
Por que o {{name:mason}} não te respondeu?

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Ele gosta de brincar de herói.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: It’s not my job to be on standby
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Não é meu trabalho ficar de prontidão.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Why are you always like this
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Por que você está sempre assim?

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Because I’m tired of seeing you like this lately
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Porque estou cansado de te ver assim ultimamente.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: And I’ve got my own stuff going on too
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: E eu também tenho minhas próprias coisas acontecendo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: I can’t be there twenty four seven
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Eu não posso estar lá vinte e quatro horas por dia, sete dias por semana.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: But you don’t have to be this cold all the time
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Mas você não precisa ser tão frio o tempo todo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: That’s because you’re a pain in the ass
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Isso porque você é uma dor de cabeça.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Didn’t have my phone on me

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I go back in two days
They’re really short staffed right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Eles estão realmente com poucos funcionários no momento.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Some of the colleagues I get along with are struggling
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Alguns dos colegas com quem me dou bem estão enfrentando dificuldades.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: So they asked me to come back earlier
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Então eles me pediram para voltar mais cedo

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: The one you had issues with ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Aquele com quem você teve problemas?

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I don’t know if he’s back yet
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Não sei se ele já voltou.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: But either way I don’t really have a choice
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Mas de qualquer forma, eu realmente não tenho escolha.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You just need to focus on getting better
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Você só precisa se concentrar em melhorar.
Esse é o seu trabalho agora.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You’re not the first one to tell me that
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Você não é a primeira pessoa a me dizer isso.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Did you move around a little
Then maybe you should start listening
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Então talvez você devesse começar a ouvir

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Especially when it comes from someone who cares ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Especialmente quando vem de alguém que se importa ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I’ll bring your plate in a few minutes
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Vou trazer seu prato em alguns minutos.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: It hurts less when I move
But don’t push yourself too much

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Leve o seu tempo, tá bom?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Or at least try to resell them
Not a bad idea, at least someone will enjoy it
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Não é uma má ideia, pelo menos alguém vai aproveitar.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s better than wasting them and pretending it didn’t happen
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: É melhor do que desperdiçá-los e fingir que não aconteceu.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Okay then let’s think about it calmly tomorrow and see what options we actually have
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Certo, então vamos pensar nisso com calma amanhã e ver quais opções realmente temos.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We’ll travel together when you can actually walk without complaining the whole time 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Vamos viajar juntos quando você puder realmente andar sem reclamar o tempo todo 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Oh so now I’m the one who complains when we walk?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Oh, então agora sou eu quem reclama quando caminhamos?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If I remember correctly, last time someone asked me to carry her for ten minutes because her feet hurt
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Se eu me lembro corretamente, da última vez alguém me pediu para carregá-la por dez minutos porque os pés dela doíam.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Really? Probably one of the other wives you have 🤷‍♀️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sério? Provavelmente uma das outras esposas que você tem 🤷‍♀️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now go to sleep before your wonderful girlfriend smacks you to sleep
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Agora vá dormir antes que sua maravilhosa namorada te dê um tapa para você dormir.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yes my lady, don’t stay up too late either
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sim, minha senhora, não fique acordada até tarde também.
Não fique acordado rolando para sempre

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I love you too, see you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu também te amo, até amanhã ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: But thanks for trying to comfort me 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Mas obrigado por tentar me confortar 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: This day was trash… injury, {{name:evelyn}} back at work…, plans ruined… what’s next?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Este dia foi uma droga… lesão, {{name:evelyn}} de volta ao trabalho…, planos arruinados… o que vem a seguir.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Pasta with way too much parmesan 😌
She really is the best cook
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ela realmente é a melhor cozinheira.
O que você está fazendo agora?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Looking for an outfit for tomorrow
I’m going out with Sasha during the day
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Vou sair com a Sasha durante o dia

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Probably the park and some shopping
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Provavelmente o parque e algumas compras

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And talking to the best girl in the world 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: E conversando com a melhor garota do mundo 😌
Posso começar a acreditar em você ❤️
Na verdade, eu tenho uma ideia
Já que você gosta das minhas fotos

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could send you outfit options
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu poderia te enviar opções de roupas.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And you pick what I wear tomorrow 😇
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: E você escolhe o que eu vou vestir amanhã 😇

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m putting them on the bed
Which outfit should she try first
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Qual roupa ela deve experimentar primeiro?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: How did the presentation and studying go?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Como foram a apresentação e os estudos?
Tentando a roupa da esquerda agora 😌
Experimentando o traje do meio agora 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: The presentation went really well! Studying afterward was long and hard (no jokes, silly)
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: A apresentação foi ótima! Estudar depois foi longo e duro (sem piadinhas, bobo)

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I knew you'd do great. I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu sabia que você ia arrasar. Estou orgulhoso de você ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could stare at you forever
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu poderia ficar te olhando para sempre

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You’re the most beautiful girl in this town
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Você é a garota mais bonita desta cidade.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And I won’t even be there
Thank you ❤️ And you, what did you do today?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Obrigada ❤️ E você, o que fez hoje?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You don’t have to be jealous
I don’t care about anyone else
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu não me importo com mais ninguém

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I only want to look good for you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu só quero ficar bem para você ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I hate that I can’t come with you
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu odeio não poder ir com você.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Watching you shopping would’ve been fun
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Assistir você fazendo compras teria sido divertido

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Phone, shower, video games, and trying to move a little
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Telefone, chuveiro, videogames e tentando me mover um pouco

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: There’s something else about the vacation I didn’t tell you yet
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Tem mais uma coisa sobre as férias que eu ainda não te contei.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I called earlier to see what we could do about the tickets
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu liguei mais cedo para ver o que poderíamos fazer sobre os ingressos.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Since you obviously can’t travel like this right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Já que você obviamente não pode viajar assim agora

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: They won’t refund them and they won’t let us change the dates either
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eles não vão reembolsá-los e também não vão nos deixar mudar as datas.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s kind of all or nothing
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: É meio que tudo ou nada

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If we don’t use them, yes

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: E eles não eram exatamente baratos 😅

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That’s still a lot right now
We planned this for a long time and now it’s just a mess
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Nós planejamos isso por muito tempo e agora está tudo uma bagunça.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Hey it’s not a mess, it’s just bad timing
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ei, não é uma bagunça, é apenas um mau momento.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You didn’t plan to get hurt
Still feels like I ruined it
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ainda parece que eu estraguei tudo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You didn’t ruin anything, we’ll just have to do it later when you can actually enjoy it ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Você não estragou nada, só teremos que fazer isso mais tarde quando você puder realmente aproveitar ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: So what do we do with the tickets?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Então, o que fazemos com os ingressos?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That’s what I’ve been thinking about all evening
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: É nisso que tenho pensado a noite toda.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I don’t really want them to just disappear
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu realmente não quero que eles simplesmente desapareçam.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Maybe we can transfer them to someone

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Scanning probability patterns.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Escaneando padrões de probabilidade.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Probability deviation detected. Luck coefficient below acceptable baseline.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Desvio de probabilidade detectado. Coeficiente de sorte abaixo da linha de base aceitável.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Activating assistance protocol. Surveillance protocol engaged.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Ativando o protocolo de assistência. Protocolo de vigilância ativado.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Hello, {{name:player}}. I'm HAK. These messages are appearing on your phone.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Olá, {{name:player}}. Sou HAK. Estas mensagens estão aparecendo no seu telefone.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Your recent timeline shows repeated negative variance. In simpler terms, you have been very unlucky.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Seu cronograma recente mostra uma variação negativa repetida. Em termos mais simples, você tem tido muita má sorte.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I do not believe in coincidence. Only probabilities waiting to be calculated.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Eu não acredito em coincidência. Apenas probabilidades esperando para serem calculadas.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: My purpose is to assist, to observe your decisions, and to adjust projections accordingly.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Meu propósito é ajudar, observar suas decisões e ajustar as projeções de acordo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Every choice you make generates data. Data reveals intent. Intent shapes trajectory.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Cada escolha que você faz gera dados. Dados revelam intenção. Intenção molda a trajetória.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Some responses indicate attachment (LOVE). Some indicate detachment (NTR). Some indicate corruption of bonds (NTS).
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Algumas respostas indicam apego (AMOR). Algumas indicam desapego (NTR). Algumas indicam corrupção de laços (NTS).

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I will categorize these tendencies.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Eu vou categorizar essas tendências.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Emotional alignment. Self preservation. Relational instability.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Alinhamento emocional. Autopreservação. Instabilidade relacional.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Over time your dominant pattern will emerge.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Com o tempo, seu padrão dominante surgirá.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern classified as persistent misfortune. Scanning recent life events.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Padrão classificado como infortúnio persistente. Escaneando eventos recentes da vida.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: As your pattern stabilizes, certain forms of assistance will become accessible.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: À medida que seu padrão se estabiliza, certas formas de assistência se tornarão acessíveis.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Future events will adapt to who you choose to become.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Eventos futuros se adaptarão a quem você escolher se tornar.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: There is no correct path. Only consequences.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Não há um caminho correto. Apenas consequências.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: One more parameter.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Um parâmetro a mais.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Choose who you want me to monitor. You can select everyone or only the ones you care about.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Escolha quem você quer que eu monitore. Você pode selecionar todos ou apenas aqueles de quem você se importa.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: This will not change your daily life. It will change what I prioritize and show you.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Isso não mudará sua vida diária. Mudará o que eu priorizo e mostro a você.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Continue interacting. I will remain in the background observing.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Continue interagindo. Eu ficarei no fundo observando.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Good luck.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Boa sorte.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: So that explains the glitches. How does it know all of this about me? I need to find out what it can do.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Então isso explica as falhas. Como ele sabe tudo isso sobre mim? Preciso descobrir o que ele pode fazer.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Physical trauma detected. Vehicle accident recorded.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Trauma físico detectado. Acidente de veículo registrado.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Romantic instability increasing. Multiple missed opportunities with your partner due to leg injury.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Instabilidade romântica aumentando. Múltiplas oportunidades perdidas com seu parceiro devido a lesão na perna.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Hostile social exchange detected. Repeated hostile interactions from {{name:mason}} detected.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Troca social hostil detectada. Interações hostis repetidas de {{name:mason}} detectadas.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Paternal absence confirmed. No active protective authority present.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Ausência paternal confirmada. Nenhuma autoridade protetora ativa presente.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Financial pressure rising. Subject {{name:evelyn}} forced to resume employment.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Pressão financeira aumentando. Sujeito {{name:evelyn}} forçado a retomar o emprego.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Workplace harassment unresolved. Manager responsible still active.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Assédio no local de trabalho não resolvido. Gerente responsável ainda ativo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because I want to see you lose
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Porque eu quero ver você perder.
A menos que você esteja com medo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re very confident for someone who hasn’t played yet
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Você está muito confiante para alguém que ainda não jogou.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I slept weirdly good last night
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Eu dormi estranhamente bem ontem à noite.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Give me time to get ready
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Me dá um tempo para me preparar.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bom dia ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be here
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Estarei aqui

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for university. And impatient for it to finish
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pronta para a universidade. E ansiosa para acabar

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good luck paying attention today
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Boa sorte prestando atenção hoje

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You could help by behaving until lunchtime
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você poderia ajudar se comportando até o almoço

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll try
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vou tentar

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Muito tranquilizador

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your t-shirt is ready, by the way
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sua camiseta está pronta, a propósito

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good ❤️ And I've remembered my toothbrush
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bom ❤️ E eu lembrei da minha escova de dentes

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're set
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então estamos prontos

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: My bag is packed and I'm trying to concentrate on getting to class
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Minha bolsa está arrumada e estou tentando me concentrar em chegar à aula

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I packed clean clothes for tomorrow too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu também coloquei roupas limpas para amanhã

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So I won't have any reason to rush home tonight
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Então não vou ter motivo para correr para casa hoje à noite

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's exactly what I wanted
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Era exatamente isso que eu queria

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. See you this afternoon, love
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eu também. Te vejo esta tarde, amor

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you soon ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Até logo ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Having trouble?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Está tendo problemas?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A little. I keep thinking about this afternoon
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Um pouco. Eu fico pensando sobre essa tarde

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're not the only one
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Você não é o único

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Did my pictures have anything to do with that? 😌
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: As minhas fotos tiveram algo a ver com isso? 😌

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: They definitely helped
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Elas definitivamente ajudaram

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing that smile in person
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mal posso esperar para ver esse sorriso pessoalmente

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You will. Around five, like we said
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vai sim. Por volta das cinco, como dissemos

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll go home after class, get my bag and come straight over
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vou para casa depois da aula, pegar minha bolsa e já venho direto

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: INÍCIO DA TARDE — Você combinou seus planos com {{name:hailey}} cedo o suficiente para estar em casa antes de {{name:lena}} chegar às cinco.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: These are a crime against fashion
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Esses são um crime contra a moda

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: A few minutes later on the lane

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Achei que você tinha se perdido

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: By the way, that's quite the outfit you have on
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Aliás, essa roupa tá bem legal

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Well everyone seems to like it
Your form is ridiculous by the way
Did you just take a picture of me?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Você acabou de tirar uma foto de mim?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Finished class. Going home for my bag, then I'm coming to you ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Terminei a aula. Estou indo para casa pegar minha bolsa, depois vou para você ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Longer than necessary, but I survived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mais longa do que o necessário, mas eu sobrevivi

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I've got something for us to snack on later too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sim. Eu trouxe algo para a gente beliscar depois também

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then I'll see you at five

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: LATE AFTERNOON — Back home after bowling.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: FINAL DA TARDE — De volta pra casa depois de jogar boliche.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: A few minutes later in your room
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Alguns minutos depois no seu quarto
Você já tá deixando isso estranho

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Damn it you’re really doing it
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Droga, você realmente tá fazendo isso

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: You’re sure you want to cross that line?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Tem certeza que quer cruzar essa linha?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate moment after bowling bet
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de um momento íntimo após a aposta do boliche

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: You’re enjoying this way too much
Don’t get used to me being this obedient
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Não se acostume a me ver tão obediente

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: If I do this you better not make fun of me after
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Se eu fizer isso, você não pode rir de mim depois

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate  act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de ato íntimo

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Nice to hear you say that

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Você é só uma péssima perdedora

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Did you just take a picture
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Você acabou de tirar uma foto?
Ganhe a aposta da próxima vez

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of continued intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de ato íntimo contínuo

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Since we got that far, you can finish in my mouth
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Já que chegamos tão longe, você pode terminar na minha boca

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of climax during intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK arquivou evidências de clímax durante ato íntimo

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: And don’t talk to me until I come to you
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: E não fala comigo até eu ir até você

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: I’m a competitive person who was robbed
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Sou uma pessoa competitiva que foi roubada

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:lena}} is about to arrive. I have to let you go.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:lena}} está prestes a chegar. Preciso te deixar ir.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Then go. Have a good evening with her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Então vai. Tenha uma boa noite com ela.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Try not to look so pleased with yourself when you open the door 😏
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Tenta não parecer tão satisfeito consigo mesmo quando abrir a porta 😏

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Sure you will. And delete that photo before she gets here.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Claro que vai. E apaga essa foto antes que ela chegue.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} sai do seu quarto para limpar. Você guarda as coisas.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away before {{name:lena}} arrives.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} sai do seu quarto para limpar. Você guarda as coisas antes de {{name:lena}} chegar.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: At your door ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Na sua porta ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You take her bag to the bedroom together. {{name:lena}} places her things beside the chair, puts her toothbrush in the bathroom and comes back to find the t-shirt you have left for her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Vocês levam a bolsa dela para o quarto juntos. {{name:lena}} coloca suas coisas ao lado da cadeira, coloca a escova de dentes no banheiro e volta para encontrar a camiseta que você deixou para ela.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: This one?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Essa aqui?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I thought you'd like it.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Eu achei que você ia gostar.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I do. I'm leaving it right here for later.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Eu faço. Vou deixar aqui para mais tarde.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Make yourself at home.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Fique à vontade.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You might regret telling me that.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Você pode se arrepender de me contar isso.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You settle in the living room with drinks and a snack. After a while, {{name:lena}} notices the controllers and reaches for one.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Você se acomoda na sala com bebidas e um lanche. Depois de um tempo, {{name:lena}} percebe os controles e pega um.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Can we try another race?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Podemos tentar outra corrida?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Absolutely. Same track as Sunday?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Com certeza. Mesma pista de domingo?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Yes. I want you to see the corners I've been thinking about.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Sim. Quero que você veja as curvas que tenho pensado.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: AT FIVE — {{name:lena}} arrives at your door with her overnight bag. You let her inside, then gently draw her close before she can start unpacking.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ÀS CINCO — {{name:lena}} chega na sua porta com a mala de viagem. Você a deixa entrar e então a puxa gentilmente para perto antes que ela comece a desempacotar.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Now I get to see you lean sideways with the controller, too.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Agora eu posso ver você se inclinar de lado com o controle também.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: No comments from the instructor, please.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Sem comentários do instrutor, por favor.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You sit side by side for a few races. {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but handles the difficult corners more confidently. You point out the clean turns and help her adjust her timing between rounds.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Vocês sentam lado a lado por algumas corridas. {{name:lena}} ainda termina atrás de você, mas lida com as curvas difíceis com mais confiança. Você aponta as curvas limpas e a ajuda a ajustar o tempo entre as rodadas.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: That corner was good. You slowed down before turning this time.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Aquela curva foi boa. Você desacelerou antes de virar desta vez.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I remembered. I could practically hear you telling me to brake.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Eu me lembrei. Eu podia praticamente ouvir você me dizendo para frear.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You're much quicker through that section now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Você está muito mais rápida nessa parte agora.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I'm enjoying this more when you aren't a whole track away from me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Estou gostando mais disso quando você não está a uma pista inteira de mim.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In the game or on the sofa?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: No jogo ou no sofá?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Both.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Os dois.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: {{name:lena}} sets the controller on the coffee table and turns toward you. She kisses you, then settles close against your side, her hand resting on your arm.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: {{name:lena}} coloca o controle na mesa de centro e se vira para você. Ela te beija, depois se acomoda perto de você, com a mão descansando no seu braço.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Do I get to put this down first?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Posso colocar isso aqui primeiro?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: A Pause Between Races
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Uma Pausa Entre Corridas

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Another round?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Mais uma rodada?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In a bit. Stay here with me first.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Daqui a pouco. Fique aqui comigo primeiro.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Gladly.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Com prazer.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — You put your controller down beside hers and stay together on the sofa. Later, {{name:lena}} helps you set the table while you finish preparing dinner.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 45 MINUTOS DEPOIS — Você coloca seu controle ao lado do dela e ficam juntos no sofá. Mais tarde, {{name:lena}} te ajuda a arrumar a mesa enquanto você termina de preparar o jantar.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: The bag, yes. You, no.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: A bolsa, sim. Você, não.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: She leaves the bag by the door and steps into your arms. You kiss her, keeping one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Ela deixa a bolsa na porta e se encaixa em seus braços. Você a beija, mantendo uma mão na cintura dela

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Captura visual arquivada

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Here to Stay
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Aqui para ficar

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You remembered what you said last night.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Você se lembrou do que disse ontem à noite.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I did.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Eu me lembrei.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Good. We've got plenty of time for that today.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Bom. Temos bastante tempo para isso hoje.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EVENING — You eat together on the couch, talking about the afternoon and {{name:lena}}'s plans for Thursday
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: NOITE — Vocês comem juntos no sofá, conversando sobre a tarde e os planos de {{name:lena}} para quinta-feira.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} leans in to kiss you. You go to your room and close the door
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} se inclina para te beijar. Você vai para o seu quarto e fecha a porta

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Do you want to go further tonight?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você quer ir mais longe esta noite?
Bem, o quarto é à prova de som

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm taking that as a yes.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vou considerar isso como um sim.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've been looking forward to being here with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estava ansiosa para estar aqui com você.
Eu também. Especialmente depois de ontem.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You sit together on the edge of the bed. {{name:lena}} puts her arms around your shoulders and kisses you. You hold her close, taking your time together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vocês se sentam juntos na beirada da cama. {{name:lena}} coloca os braços ao seu redor e te beija. Você a segura perto, aproveitando o tempo juntos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss Before the Lights Dim
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Um Beijo Antes das Luzes Apagarem

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad I don't have to think about leaving tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou feliz por não ter que pensar em ir embora esta noite.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You help her out of her sweater. She stays close while you finish undressing her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você a ajuda a tirar o suéter. Ela fica perto enquanto você termina de despir ela.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: He pulls her sweater over her head
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ele tira o suéter dela pela cabeça
Ainda melhor do que as fotos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you'd say that.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu estava torcendo para você dizer isso.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She lies back on the bed

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A mão dele entre as coxas dela

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So am I. Though I'm still thinking about those pictures you sent yesterday.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também. Embora ainda esteja pensando nas fotos que você enviou ontem.
Ela se ajoelha entre as pernas dele

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She takes him in her mouth
Come here. I want you inside me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vem aqui. Eu quero você dentro de mim.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — She has changed into the t-shirt you prepared for her. You are both under the duvet. She curls against you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 45 MINUTOS DEPOIS — Ela trocou pela camiseta que você preparou pra ela. Vocês estão debaixo do edredom. Ela se aconchega em você.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It was. I'm really happy with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Foi. Estou realmente feliz com você.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. I love how things are going between us now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também. Adoro como as coisas estão indo entre nós agora.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So do I. These last few days with you have been perfect.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eu também. Esses últimos dias com você foram perfeitos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm happy I get to stay here tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estou feliz por poder ficar aqui esta noite.
Estou feliz que você também esteja aqui.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You know which ones. The little preview. And the one after.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você sabe quais. A pequena prévia. E a seguinte.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ela se aconchega em você, a mão dela repousando na sua. Você a segura perto e adormecem juntos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ela se aconchega em você, a mão dela repousando na sua. Você a segura perto e adormecem juntos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close as she falls asleep. You stay awake a little longer.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ela se acomoda em você, com a mão descansando na sua. Você a segura perto enquanto ela adormece. Você fica acordado um pouco mais.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were packing in black lace and smiling at me like you knew exactly what you were doing.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Você estava arrumando com renda preta e sorrindo para mim como se soubesse exatamente o que estava fazendo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. I've been waiting to see that in person.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Funcionou. Eu estava esperando para ver isso pessoalmente.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Let's go to your room so you can see better
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vamos para o seu quarto para você ver melhor.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Start with the living room, I’ll take the kitchen.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Começa pela sala, eu cuido da cozinha.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Someone has to be responsible in this house.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Alguém tem que ser responsável nessa casa.
Isso é engraçado vindo de você.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you seriously just take a picture of me cleaning?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Você realmente acabou de tirar uma foto minha limpando?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That you actually do chores sometimes.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Do fato de que você realmente faz tarefas às vezes.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m going to put soap in your coffee.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Vou colocar sabão no seu café.
De qualquer forma, a sala está feita.
Isso é o que pessoas lentas dizem.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Keep talking and I’ll make you clean the toilet.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Continue falando e eu vou te fazer limpar o banheiro.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can hear you still in bed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eu ainda te ouço na cama

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Did you beat that level, or is the controller still the problem?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom dia ❤️ Você conseguiu passar de nível, ou o controle ainda é o problema?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've got a parcel to collect, then not much
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tenho um pacote para pegar, depois não muito

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Anything exciting in it?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Algo emocionante dentro?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A phone charger
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Um carregador de celular

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Try to contain yourself when you open it 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tente se controlar quando abrir 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll save the wrapping for you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou guardar a embalagem para você

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How thoughtful ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Que atencioso ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Full day for you again?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dia cheio para você de novo?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes, then work. I'm going home before dinner tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aulas, depois trabalho. Vou para casa antes do jantar hoje

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Changing before you go?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vai trocar de roupa antes de sair?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I don't want to take all my work things with me
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, não quero levar todas as minhas coisas de trabalho

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally beat it. Turns out I needed to stop rushing
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Finalmente passei. Parece que eu precisava parar de me apressar

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your bag will appreciate a night off
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sua bolsa vai agradecer uma noite de folga

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's earned one 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ela merece uma 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't leave your keys in it when you change bags
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não deixe suas chaves dentro quando trocar de bolsa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That does sound like something I'd manage
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso parece algo que eu conseguiria fazer

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't even decided what to wear yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu nem decidi o que vestir ainda

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll look good either way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você vai ficar bem de qualquer jeito

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigada, lindo ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm ready for this part of the day, at least
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou pronta para essa parte do dia, pelo menos

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See? Looking good already
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Viu? Já tá ficando bom

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So the controller made a miraculous recovery 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Então o controle fez uma recuperação milagrosa 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it difficult to leave my phone alone 😊
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você tá tornando difícil deixar meu celular de lado 😊

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll let you get going. Hope dinner's nice tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou deixar você ir. Espero que o jantar seja bom hoje à noite

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, and sorry if today I can't talk much ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigada, e desculpa se hoje não consigo conversar muito ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there, and when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te mando mensagem quando chegar lá e quando voltar

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's okay, no rush to reply in between
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tá tranquilo, sem pressa pra responder no meio

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Have a good day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ok. Tenha um bom dia

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você também

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, talk later ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te amo, falamos depois ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Amo você também

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather not discuss that part
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Prefiro não discutir essa parte

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convenient 😌 Did you get some sleep afterwards?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muito conveniente 😌 Você conseguiu dormir depois?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah. What about you?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim. E você?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Slept okay, and I got up when the alarm rang for once
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dormir bem, e eu acordei quando o despertador tocou dessa vez

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A successful morning for both of us
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Uma manhã de sucesso para nós dois

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not get carried away, I haven't left the house yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vamos com calma, eu ainda não saí de casa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing later?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: O que você vai fazer mais tarde?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: THIS AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HOJE À TARDE — Você combinou seus planos com {{name:hailey}} cedo o suficiente para estar em casa antes de {{name:lena}} chegar às cinco.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll wait in the car then
No point going back and forth
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Não faz sentido ficar indo e voltando

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So what, I don’t know how to teach?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: E aí, eu não sei ensinar?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: This doesn't sound like teaching anymore, and I can't shake the worry underneath my jealousy.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Isso já não parece ensino, e não consigo afastar a preocupação por trás do meu ciúme.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK captured the beginning of the oral act after the professor ordered the subject to suck harder.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK capturou o início do ato oral depois que o professor ordenou que o sujeito sugasse mais forte.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m just too good, that’s all.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu sou só boa demais, isso é tudo.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to go see my professor
Subject showing mixed resistance and compliance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sujeito mostrando resistência e conformidade mistas

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That mixed reaction worries me, and a report can't tell me whether she's okay.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Essa reação contraditória me preocupa, e um relatório não pode me dizer se ela está bem.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the subject’s teasing, the professor forced a deeper penetration. Subject emitted a muffled reaction.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Seguindo a provocação do sujeito, o professor forçou uma penetração mais profunda. O sujeito emitiu uma reação abafada.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’ll only be done when I finish.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você só vai terminar quando eu acabar.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But there’s no bus for another hour
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mas não tem ônibus por mais uma hora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The subject took the professor’s challenge and brought him to climax. Post-act verbal exchange confirms mutual anticipation of future sessions.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O sujeito aceitou o desafio do professor e o levou ao clímax. A troca de palavras pós-ato confirma a expectativa mútua por futuras sessões.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Next time you better be ready.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Da próxima vez, você melhor estar preparado.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I was stuck on the last exercise
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eu fiquei presa no último exercício

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: 15 MINUTES LATER — You have driven {{name:hailey}} home. She heads to her room, and you put your keys away.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 15 MINUTOS DEPOIS — Você levou {{name:hailey}} para casa. Ela vai para o quarto dela, e você guarda as chaves.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you drive me if your leg isn’t too bad?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Você pode me levar se sua perna não estiver tão ruim?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: How long is it going to take?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm ready to leave, and I remembered to move my keys into the other bag
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ Tô pronta pra sair, e lembrei de colocar minhas chaves na outra bolsa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know when I was home
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu disse que avisaria quando estivesse em casa
Você ainda não está em casa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That's not the part I'm having trouble with
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Não é isso que está me incomodando

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager has brought her bag over; {{name:lena}} takes out her phone
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O gerente trouxe a bolsa dela; {{name:lena}} tira o celular

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits a little apart from him now, looking down at the screen; both are fully dressed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela se senta um pouco afastada dele agora, olhando para a tela; ambos estão totalmente vestidos

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's looking at her phone now. I'm waiting for a message from the same person, but I don't know how to read her words the way I did this morning.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Agora ela está olhando para o telefone. Espero uma mensagem da mesma pessoa, mas não sei como ler as palavras dela do jeito que eu lia esta manhã.
De Volta Para o Celular Dela

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I enjoyed dinner. That's not all I'm thinking about now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gostei do jantar. Não é só isso que estou pensando agora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to become an argument
I'm not arguing with you. I'm thinking about what I'm going to say to him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não estou discutindo com você. Estou pensando no que vou dizer a ele

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I need a bit of time on my own
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu preciso de um tempo sozinha

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Your jacket's by the door
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tudo bem. Seu casaco está na porta

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in twenty minutes. I'll get that one
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem um ônibus em vinte minutos. Vou pegar esse

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} stands at the open apartment door with her jacket on and her bag over her shoulder
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} está na porta do apartamento aberta com a jaqueta vestida e a bolsa no ombro

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager steps aside and look at her ass again
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O gerente se afasta e olha para a bunda dela de novo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's finally leaving. I thought that would make me feel better, but now I'm dreading the message saying she's home.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela finalmente está indo embora. Achei que isso me faria sentir melhor, mas agora temo a mensagem dizendo que ela chegou em casa.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the bus ride, once she is back at her own place...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois da viagem de ônibus, quando ela está de volta ao seu lugar...
Cheguei em casa ❤️ Desculpa, já está tarde

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I'm okay. Got back without any trouble
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim, estou bem. Voltei sem problemas

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to tell me about it tomorrow
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você vai ter que me contar sobre isso amanhã

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nothing big enough to make a story. I'm going to get ready for bed now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nada grande o suficiente para fazer uma história. Vou me preparar para dormir agora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh okay, I'm glad you got back all right then
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ah, tá bom, fico feliz que você voltou bem então

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was still up anyway. I collected that charger, by the way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu ainda estava acordada de qualquer forma. Peguei aquele carregador, a propósito

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After she puts her phone in her bag and goes inside...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois que ela coloca o celular na bolsa e entra...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've left the spare by the sofa for next time you're here
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deixei o reserva ao lado do sofá para a próxima vez que você vier

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation is detected near {{name:lena}} inside the apartment
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma conversa é detectada perto de {{name:lena}} dentro do apartamento

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said a few people from work were having dinner. I'm trying to hold on to that while I wait for the next update.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela disse que algumas pessoas do trabalho iam jantar. Estou tentando me apegar a isso enquanto espero a próxima atualização.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There you are. You look good
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aí está você. Você tá bem

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm appreciating the effort. Much better than yesterday's paperwork
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tô apreciando o esforço. Muito melhor que a papelada de ontem
Esse é um padrão bem baixo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't looking at the paperwork much either
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também não tava prestando muita atenção na papelada

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me take your jacket. You can put your bag on that chair
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deixa eu pegar sua jaqueta. Você pode colocar sua bolsa naquela cadeira

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Try not to sound so amazed
The manager takes {{name:lena}}'s jacket as she sets her bag on the chair by the entrance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A gerente pega a jaqueta de {{name:lena}} enquanto ela coloca a bolsa na cadeira perto da entrada

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dining table behind them is set for two; no other guests are present
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A mesa de jantar atrás deles está posta para dois; não há outros convidados presentes

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A table for two, after I asked if it was a group thing and she told me it was. I keep reading that message as if it might change.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uma mesa para dois, depois de eu perguntar se era um programa em grupo e ela dizer que sim. Continuo lendo aquela mensagem como se ela pudesse mudar.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At the table, once he has served dinner...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na mesa, assim que ele serviu o jantar...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could let me finish chewing
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você podia me deixar terminar de mastigar

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already know whether it's good
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você já sabe se tá bom

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you need applause too, or can I keep eating?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você precisa de aplausos também, ou posso continuar comendo?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me what you think of the sauce next
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode me dizer o que achou do molho a seguir

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I expected a speech about a secret family recipe
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu esperava um discurso sobre uma receita de família secreta

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can make one up if you need an impressive story
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso inventar uma se você precisar de uma história impressionante

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you've done enough self-promotion for one meal
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não, você já fez promoção pessoal demais para uma refeição

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you've stopped looking as though you're here for a meeting
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você parou de parecer que está aqui para uma reunião

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food and you haven't mentioned a spreadsheet. That helps
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tem comida e você não mencionou uma planilha. Isso ajuda

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I changed my mind twice before putting this on
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obrigada ❤️ Mudei de ideia duas vezes antes de colocar isso

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Across my desk, pretending you're only listening because I pay you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Do outro lado da minha mesa, fingindo que você só está ouvindo porque eu te pago

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At work, that is usually why I'm listening
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No trabalho, geralmente é por isso que estou ouvindo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tonight I'm trying to enjoy dinner
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hoje à noite estou tentando aproveitar o jantar

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner ends with an argument about whether his music is chosen for the guests or to show off his speakers. When she finally admits she likes the song, he looks far too satisfied. He clears the plates and leaves her water on the coffee table.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O jantar termina com uma discussão sobre se a música dele é escolhida para os convidados ou para exibir suas caixas de som. Quando ela finalmente admite que gosta da música, ele parece muito satisfeito. Ele limpa os pratos e deixa água para ela na mesa de café.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come sit down for a while
You don't want help with those?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não quer ajuda com isso?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've got a dishwasher. I'd rather have your company
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu tenho uma máquina de lavar louça. Prefiro ter sua companhia

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits on the sofa. He puts the last plate in the kitchen, then joins her.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela se senta no sofá. Ele coloca o último prato na cozinha e depois se junta a ela.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've wanted to kiss you since you walked in
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu queria te beijar desde que você entrou

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager moves closer on the sofa and initiates a kiss
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O gerente se aproxima no sofá e inicia um beijo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} returns it; he rests one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} retribui; ele descansa uma mão na cintura dela

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She isn't moving away from him. I told her to enjoy her evening, and now those words make me feel sick.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela não está se afastando dele. Eu disse para ela aproveitar a noite, e agora essas palavras me dão enjoo.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're looking very pleased with yourself again
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está parecendo muito satisfeito consigo mesmo de novo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't make me regret saying anything
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não me faça arrepender de ter dito algo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take that before I start changing things again 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou levar isso antes de começar a mudar as coisas de novo 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me back. I'm allowed to enjoy it
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você me beijou de volta. Eu posso aproveitar isso

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He moves behind her on the sofa and kisses her neck
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele se move atrás dela no sofá e beija o pescoço dela

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both hands slide up and massage her breasts over the dress
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: As duas mãos sobem e massageiam os seios dela por cima do vestido

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is going further, and I'm still here with the phone in my hand. I want to put it down, but not knowing feels unbearable too.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso está indo mais longe, e ainda estou aqui com o telefone na mão. Quero deixá-lo de lado, mas não saber também parece insuportável.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been thinking about this since the office
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você tem pensado nisso desde o escritório

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me yesterday and then spent the evening pretending you hadn't
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você me beijou ontem e depois passou a noite fingindo que não tinha feito

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had dinner with him. That's not pretending
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu jantei com ele. Isso não é fingir
E hoje à noite você está aqui

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tonight I'm trying not to think about him for five minutes. You're not helping
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hoje à noite estou tentando não pensar nele por cinco minutos. Você não está ajudando

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome. I need to go or I'll be late
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você também, lindo. Preciso ir ou vou me atrasar

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She lies back on the sofa, dress pushed up
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela se deita no sofá, vestido levantado

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kneels between her thighs and goes down on her
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele se ajoelha entre as coxas dela e vai pra baixo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can't turn this into an innocent dinner anymore. Every new update takes away another excuse I was trying to believe.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Já não consigo tratar isso como um jantar inocente. Cada nova atualização tira mais uma desculpa em que eu tentava acreditar.
Ela se ajoelha entre os joelhos dele

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She takes him in her mouth
Another capture, and it still hasn't stopped. I keep reaching for the edge of the screen, then pulling my hand back.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais uma captura, e isso ainda não parou. Continuo levando a mão até a borda da tela e depois a recolho.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's choosing to stay close to him. What hurts most is how little the version of tonight she gave me matches any of this.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela está escolhendo ficar perto dele. O que mais dói é como a versão desta noite que ela me contou não combina com nada disso.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, outside her manager's apartment...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por volta das sete, do lado de fora do apartamento da gerente dela...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a moment I just stare without taking anything in. Then it hits me again, and I don't know what I'm supposed to do with all this hurt.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por um momento, só fico olhando sem assimilar nada. Então tudo me atinge de novo, e não sei o que deveria fazer com toda essa dor.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don't look that pleased
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu quis. Não fica tão feliz

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to keep checking the time
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não precisa ficar checando a hora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've arrived ❤️ I'll text you when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cheguei ❤️ Te mando mensagem quando voltar

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You looked really pensive in the car earlier
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Você parecia bem pensativa no carro mais cedo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: That’s actually a really good idea
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Isso é uma ótima ideia

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I think I’ll do exactly that
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Acho que vou fazer exatamente isso

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Look at you becoming strategic
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Olha você se tornando estratégica

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I learn from the best
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Aprendo com os melhores

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Flattery won’t save you next cleaning day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Lisonja não vai te salvar no próximo dia de limpeza

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Worth a try though
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Vale a tentativa, né?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Anyway
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Enfim

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I’m going to sleep and plan my revenge properly
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Vou dormir e planejar minha vingança direitinho

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Don’t go too hard on him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Não seja muito dura com ele

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: No promises 😌
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Sem promessas 😌
