story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Did I?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Eu estava?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Boa noite

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Boa noite

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Depois de colocar o telefone de lado, você se acomoda ao lado de {{name:lena}} e adormece junto com ela.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Yeah
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Sim.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Is everything going okay with your professor?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Está tudo bem com seu professor?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: It is
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Está sim

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: But he put me in difficulty with some exercises today
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Mas ele me deixou em dificuldade com alguns exercícios hoje

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I kind of want revenge
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Eu meio que quero me vingar

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Then do the same thing to him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Então faça o mesmo com ele

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Give him an exercise just as hard
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Dê a ele um exercício tão difícil quanto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why do you want to know?
By the way, did you hear {{name:mason}} last night?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Aliás, você ouviu o {{name:mason}} ontem à noite?
Só por causa de um filme de terror.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shut up and come eat before it gets cold
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Cala a boca e vem comer antes que esfrie.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Too bad I’m already awake though
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Uma pena que eu já estou acordada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can’t come drag me out of bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Você não pode vir me arrastar pra fora da cama

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Before my day gets away from me, did you sleep well?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oi 😊 Antes que meu dia fuja de mim, você dormiu bem?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: High praise
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Altos elogios.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking about yesterday at your place while I made breakfast
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estava pensando em ontem na sua casa enquanto fazia o café da manhã.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you finally admitted I was right about the film?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você finalmente admitiu que eu estava certo sobre o filme?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. The bit where I had my head on your shoulder
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Não. A parte em que eu coloquei a cabeça no seu ombro.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh. I liked that bit too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ah, eu também gostei dessa parte.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You went quiet for once. It was very nice ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você ficou quieta dessa vez. Foi muito bom ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could offer that service again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Posso oferecer esse serviço de novo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please do. I'd like another afternoon like that soon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por favor, faça isso. Eu adoraria ter outra tarde assim em breve.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We'll find one. Have you actually eaten yet?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vamos encontrar uma. Você já comeu?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, before you start. Look
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, antes que você comece. Olha.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I did. How about you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sim. E você?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você está linda

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you 😊 The breakfast is just out of frame, but I promise it exists
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigada 😊 O café da manhã está fora do quadro, mas prometo que existe.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll take your word for it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou acreditar em você.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to ask you before I leave
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tem algo que eu queria te perguntar antes de ir.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} messaged me this morning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} me mandou uma mensagem esta manhã.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, considering I set an alarm and then argued with it twice 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bem, considerando que eu coloquei um despertador e depois briguei com ele duas vezes 😭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's asked if I'd like to come over to his place tonight, just the two of us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ele perguntou se eu gostaria de ir na casa dele hoje à noite, só nós dois.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No arcade rematch attached to the invitation?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sem revanche de arcade anexada ao convite?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I checked. Apparently he can spend an evening without a scoreboard 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu verifiquei. Aparentemente, ele consegue passar uma noite sem placar 😌.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Is that okay with you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu gostaria de ir. Tudo bem para você?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He messaged me about meeting again tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ele me mandou uma mensagem sobre nos encontrarmos de novo hoje à noite

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from the café?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: O cara do café?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes 😊 He's invited me to have dinner at his place
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim 😊 Ele me convidou para jantar na casa dele

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he's ready to defend his cooking in person
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Parece que ele está pronto para defender a comida dele pessoalmente

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you win?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você ganhou?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like an evening worth surviving the workday for
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso parece uma noite que vale a pena enfrentar o dia de trabalho

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Are you okay with me going to his place?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu gostaria de ir. Você se importa de eu ir para a casa dele?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, sweetheart. I am ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, querida. Eu estou ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I meant what I said. I'd like you to do what you feel like doing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu quis dizer o que disse. Quero que você faça o que quiser fazer

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. I still wanted to ask how you felt about tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Eu ainda queria perguntar como você se sente sobre hoje à noite

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm glad you did. You don't need to talk yourself out of something you want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E eu fico feliz que você fez. Você não precisa se convencer a não fazer algo que quer

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay 😊 I'll go home and get ready first, then head over around eight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ok 😊 Vou para casa me arrumar primeiro e depois vou para lá por volta das oito

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Take care of yourself, though. Keep your phone charged and text me when you get there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cuide de si mesma, tá? Mantenha seu celular carregado e me manda mensagem quando chegar lá

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got up. Interpret that however you like
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu levantei. Interprete isso como quiser

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will. I've got the address, and I can get a taxi back whenever I need to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu vou. Tenho o endereço e posso pegar um táxi de volta quando precisar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: If I decide to stay instead, I'll let you know too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Se eu decidir ficar, eu te aviso também

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I don't need a message every five minutes. I just want to know you're okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom. Não preciso de mensagem a cada cinco minutos. Só quero saber que você está bem

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I can promise ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Essa parte eu posso prometer ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And you can tell me if you're feeling nervous again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E você pode me dizer se estiver se sentindo nervosa de novo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A little. But that doesn’t mean I wish you weren’t going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Um pouco. Mas isso não significa que eu gostaria que você não fosse

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Work today?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Trabalho hoje?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yesterday helped. I liked knowing we could still just be ourselves together
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ontem ajudou. Eu gostei de saber que ainda podemos ser nós mesmas juntas

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can. Including me stealing your cushion ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Podemos. Inclusive eu roubando seu travesseiro ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Essa parte nunca esteve em dúvida

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're being very calm about this
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Você está sendo muito calmo sobre isso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm smiling at my phone, actually 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estou sorrindo para o meu celular, na verdade 🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. Then we have matching stupid faces
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom. Então temos caras idiotas combinando

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yours is prettier
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A sua é mais bonita

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now you're just trying to keep me here ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Agora você só está tentando me manter aqui ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Until six, then I need to pick up a couple of things on the way home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Até às seis, depois preciso pegar algumas coisas no caminho de casa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I need to leave before my quiet morning becomes me running down the street
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo, preciso ir antes que minha manhã tranquila se transforme em eu correndo pela rua

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day. Eat something proper during your break
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tenha um bom dia. Coma algo decente durante seu intervalo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at you taking over my job 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Olha você assumindo meu trabalho 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somebody has to remind you when you’re busy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alguém tem que te lembrar quando você está ocupado

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I love you. I'll text you when I'm home and getting ready ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu te amo. Vou te mandar uma mensagem quando chegar em casa e estiver me arrumando ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too. Speak tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Amo você também. Falo com você à noite

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going to be busy for most of the day, so don't be surprised if I'm quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou estar ocupada a maior parte do dia, então não se surpreenda se eu ficar quieta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to take being abandoned for a shopping list personally
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou tentar não levar para o lado pessoal ser deixado de lado por uma lista de compras.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It has considerably less interesting things to say than you 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tem coisas bem menos interessantes para dizer do que você 😌.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: INÍCIO DA TARDE — Você combinou seus planos com {{name:hailey}} cedo o suficiente para estar em casa antes de {{name:lena}} chegar às cinco.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just don’t react to her nonsense
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Só não reaja às besteiras dela.
{{name:hailey}} chega e pula nos braços do {{name:aiden}}.
O sujeito pulou nos braços de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: They make this look easy, while I'm still trying to name the knot in my stomach.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eles fazem isso parecer fácil, enquanto eu ainda tento dar nome ao nó no meu estômago.
{{name:hailey}} pulou nos braços do {{name:aiden}} ao chegar.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Come on, at least put on an underwear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vamos, pelo menos vista uma calcinha
{{name:aiden}} desliza a mão enquanto segura ela

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not pull out another crazy outfit
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: É melhor você não aparecer com outra roupa maluca.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s the reward for the best coach 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: É a recompensa para o melhor treinador 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Alright, let’s play before he nags at us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Certo, vamos jogar antes que ele comece a nos encher
{{name:hailey}} senta no colo de {{name:aiden}} de novo
Ela não para de se mexer

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see if you can stay focused too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vamos ver se você também consegue manter o foco
O sujeito se movendo intencionalmente no colo de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} kept moving on {{name:aiden}}’s lap during the games
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} continuou se mexendo no colo de {{name:aiden}} durante os jogos

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: LAST GAME – FIRST TO FINISH WINS EVERYTHING
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ÚLTIMO JOGO – PRIMEIRO A TERMINAR GANHA TUDO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m telling {{name:aiden}} not to look at you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vou dizer pro {{name:aiden}} não olhar pra você.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject claiming victory under unusual circumstances
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sujeito alegando vitória em circunstâncias incomuns

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} claimed {{name:aiden}} finished first during the last game
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} alegou que {{name:aiden}} terminou primeiro no último jogo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: These are honestly the best game afternoons
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Essas são, honestamente, as melhores tardes de jogo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Looking forward to the next one

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} dá um beijo de despedida em {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm glad she isn't hiding what she wants, but I need to be honest about my feelings too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Fico feliz que ela não esconda o que quer, mas também preciso ser honesto sobre meus sentimentos.
Ele vai olhar de qualquer jeito.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Man I was really looking forward to playing again 🔥
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Cara, eu estava realmente ansiosa pra jogar de novo 🔥

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:ethan}} already came to pick me up
Do you want me to wait for you for dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quer que eu espere por você pra jantar?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: At least I won’t have to eat alone with {{name:mason}} like last time
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pelo menos não vou ter que comer sozinha com o {{name:mason}} como da última vez.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:lena}} is staying over tonight. I'll leave you a plate for when you get back.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:lena}} vai ficar aqui hoje à noite. Vou deixar um prato pra você quando voltar.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks. Save me some dessert too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Obrigada. Guarda um pouco de sobremesa pra mim também.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Finally home, and I'm getting ready to leave in a little while. How was your day?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi 😊 Finalmente em casa, e estou me preparando para sair em um tempinho. Como foi seu dia?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not tonight. I came over, I didn’t come to sleep here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não hoje. Eu vim aqui, não vim pra dormir aqui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a shame. He gets you after this?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Que pena. Ele fica com você depois disso?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He gets a message that I got home. You get to message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele recebe uma mensagem de que eu cheguei em casa. Você pode me mandar mensagem amanhã

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll take that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou aceitar isso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Walk me to the door without a clever last remark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Me leva até a porta sem uma última observação inteligente

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DEPOIS QUE ELA CHEGA EM CASA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay the night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ Cheguei em casa. Não passei a noite

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obrigado por me contar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen, rather than leave you guessing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nós não fomos até o fim. Eu queria te contar o que aconteceu, em vez de deixar você adivinhando

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está linda

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed on the sofa. Then he put his hand under my dress and fingered me until I came
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois do jantar, nós nos beijamos no sofá. Então ele colocou a mão debaixo do meu vestido e me tocou até eu gozar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I went down on him after. He came in my mouth. I swallowed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu fiz sexo oral nele depois. Ele gozou na minha boca. Eu engoli

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I came home. That was the whole of it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois eu voltei pra casa. Isso foi tudo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como você tá se sentindo?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A little flushed. Glad I went, and glad I left when I meant to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Feliz. Um pouco envergonhada. Boa que fui, e boa que saí quando eu queria

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was my decision. I wasn’t trying to get to some next step because I thought I should
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Foi minha decisão. Não estava tentando chegar a algum próximo passo porque achava que deveria

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you know how you feel about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que você saiba como se sente sobre isso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. He spent half the evening trying to work out whether he was doing better than you. I didn’t answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Ele passou metade da noite tentando descobrir se estava indo melhor que você. Eu não respondi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s probably kinder than a ranking
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é provavelmente mais gentil do que uma classificação

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the idea 😌 And I wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa era a ideia 😌 E eu queria um minuto com você antes de dormir ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the answer I was hoping for ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa era a resposta que eu esperava ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the rest of the details to myself tonight, like we talked about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou feliz. Vou guardar o resto dos detalhes para mim esta noite, como conversamos

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s okay. Knowing you’re home and comfortable is enough
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tudo bem. Saber que você está em casa e confortável é o suficiente

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. I still wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou sim. Ainda queria um tempinho com você antes de dormir ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UM POUCO MAIS TARDE, NA CASA DELE

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm here 😊 Found the right building and everything's fine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou aqui 😊 Encontrei o prédio certo e está tudo bem

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. How’s the evening looking?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Como está a noite?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were there other acceptable answers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Havia outras respostas aceitáveis?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells like dinner rather than smoke, so I’m choosing to be optimistic 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está cheirando a jantar em vez de fumaça, então estou optando por ser otimista 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please tell me you didn’t open with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor, me diga que você não começou com isso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I said hello first
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não. Eu disse olá primeiro

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very diplomatic
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muito diplomático

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s setting the table. Here, your promised proof that I arrived
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele está arrumando a mesa. Aqui está a prova prometida de que eu cheguei

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, smiling, and not about to be poisoned by a burnt pizza 😊
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Segura, sorridente e não prestes a ser envenenada por uma pizza queimada 😊

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m reassured about at least two of those things
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou tranquila em relação a pelo menos duas dessas coisas

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t start 😭 I’m good, really
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não começa 😭 Estou bem, de verdade

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy yourself, sweetheart. I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aproveita, querido. Estou aqui se precisar de algo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Several. Yours was the best one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Várias. A sua foi a melhor.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I’ll check in later. I’m putting my phone away now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obrigada ❤️ Vou dar uma olhada mais tarde. Estou guardando meu celular agora

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DEPOIS QUE ELA GUARDA O CELULAR

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You found it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você encontrou

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: First try. Of course
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Primeira tentativa. Claro

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I would have come down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu teria descido

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That’s why I didn’t text you from the pavement
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. É por isso que não te mandei mensagem da calçada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks much better than the dinner you carefully left out of your photograph
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso parece muito melhor do que o jantar que você cuidadosamente deixou de fora da sua foto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was going to lead with an apology
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu ia começar com um pedido de desculpas

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m joking. You can stop apologizing for one burnt pizza
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou brincando. Você pode parar de se desculpar por uma pizza queimada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I’ll stop. Sit. I set your side already
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então eu vou parar. Senta. Já preparei seu lado

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get there safely, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Chega lá em segurança, meu bem.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My side. We’ve had one bookshop and a lot of messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Meu lado. Tivemos uma livraria e muitas mensagens

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was paying attention
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu estava prestando atenção

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DURANTE O JANTAR

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How have you been?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como você tem estado?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than I expected to be. Work was busy. This is the first part of today that feels like mine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Melhor do que eu esperava. O trabalho foi corrido. Esta é a primeira parte do dia que parece minha

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your boyfriend?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E o seu namorado?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s all right. Quieter than he lets on. He spends a lot of time deciding what he’s allowed to want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele está bem. Mais quieto do que parece. Ele passa muito tempo decidindo o que pode querer.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds tiring
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso parece cansativo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It is, for him. He used to plan everything so nothing could surprise him. He’s trying not to do that with me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É, pra ele. Ele costumava planejar tudo pra nada o surpreender. Ele está tentando não fazer isso comigo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you’re here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele sabe que você está aqui?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. You'll get your arrival message, I haven't forgotten
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou sim. Você vai receber a mensagem quando eu chegar, não esqueci.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I told him I arrived. He doesn’t need a transcript of the dinner
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Eu disse a ele que cheguei. Ele não precisa de um resumo do jantar.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fair. I wouldn’t want one of his evenings either
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Justo. Eu também não gostaria de uma das noites dele.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’d be surprised what you’d recognize
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você ficaria surpresa com o que reconheceria.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Desculpa?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nothing. The sauce. This is actually recognizable. I’m impressed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nada. O molho. Isso é realmente reconhecível. Estou impressionada.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t sound so surprised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não fique tão surpresa.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m allowed to be surprised. You sent me a picture of your face instead of the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu posso ficar surpresa. Você me mandou uma foto da sua cara em vez da comida.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The food didn’t know what to do with its face
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A comida não sabia o que fazer com a cara dela.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If you’re going to stare, you can at least feed me the next bite
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se você vai ficar olhando, pelo menos me alimenta com a próxima garfada.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Open, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Abre, então.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Now we’re even with last night’s photos
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pronto. Agora estamos quites com as fotos de ontem à noite.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don’t think we’re even
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não acho que estamos quites.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so proud. You still have sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não fique tão orgulhoso. Você ainda tem molho no seu polegar.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could deal with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você pode lidar com isso.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat first. You’re very easy to distract
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Coma primeiro. Você é muito fácil de distrair.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came over. I’m allowed to be distracted
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você veio aqui. Eu posso me distrair.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I came over for dinner. The rest can wait until the plates are clear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu vim aqui para o jantar. O resto pode esperar até que os pratos estejam limpos.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DEPOIS DO JANTAR

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought the book
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você trouxe o livro.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought the book. I’ve even made it past the bookmark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu trouxe o livro. Eu até passei do marcador.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s more than I expected
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso é mais do que eu esperava.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t get used to it. I read one page on the way here and then thought about you instead
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não se acostume com isso. Eu li uma página no caminho e depois pensei em você.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a better review than the book was going to get
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa é uma avaliação melhor do que o livro ia receber.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here, I marked the page I wanted to talk to you about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aqui, eu marquei a página que queria conversar com você.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can talk about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Podemos falar sobre isso.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actually, the book can wait. I didn’t come here just to compare notes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na verdade, o livro pode esperar. Eu não vim aqui só para comparar anotações.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vem cá

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Beyond the Messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Além das Mensagens

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s what I was trying to say without typing it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Era isso que eu estava tentando dizer sem precisar digitar.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit. I want my hand on you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Senta. Eu quero minha mão em você.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so surprised. Last night’s photos were the warning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não fique tão surpresa. As fotos de ontem à noite foram o aviso.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her Hand
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A Mão Dela

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Slower. Yes, like that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais devagar. Isso, assim mesmo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your turn. I want your mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sua vez. Eu quero sua boca.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: His Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A Boca Dele

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pronto. Não pare.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou perto.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She Comes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ela Vem

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. That was really good
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok. Isso foi realmente bom.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still got it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu ainda tenho isso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Quiet. I got outside for a bit, then came back to the incredibly demanding task of doing nothing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quieto. Saí um pouco, depois voltei para a tarefa incrivelmente exigente de não fazer nada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shut up
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cale a boca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not staying the night. I should go while I still mean that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não vou ficar a noite. É melhor eu ir enquanto ainda estou falando sério

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me manda uma mensagem amanhã

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Talvez

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DEPOIS QUE ELA CHEGA EM CASA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oi ❤️ Cheguei em casa. Não fiquei

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Thank you for letting me know
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tudo bem. Obrigado por me avisar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A gente não foi até o fim. Queria te contar o que aconteceu

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed by the window. I used my hand on him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois do jantar, a gente se beijou na janela. Eu usei minha mão nele

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UM POUCO MAIS TARDE, NA CASA DELE

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he went down on me until I came. I came home after that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Depois ele me deu prazer até eu chegar lá. Voltei pra casa depois disso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling about it?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como você se sente sobre isso?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Happy I went, and happy I didn’t keep everything behind a screen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Fico feliz que fui, e feliz que não deixei tudo só na tela

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We talked over dinner first. By the time I decided, I knew that was what I wanted. I also knew I wanted to sleep in my own bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A gente conversou durante o jantar primeiro. Quando decidi, sabia que era isso que eu queria. Também sabia que queria dormir na minha própria cama

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you felt comfortable with him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fico feliz que você se sentiu à vontade com ele

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. The dinner was good too, in case you were still worried about that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu me senti. O jantar estava bom também, caso você ainda estivesse preocupado com isso 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll stop preparing the restaurant rescue plan, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou parar de preparar o plano de resgate do restaurante, então

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep the plan. We could use it for ourselves sometime ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Guarde o plano. Podemos usá-lo para nós mesmos algum dia ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm at {{name:aiden}}'s 😊 All good, as promised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou na casa do {{name:aiden}} 😊 Tudo certo, como prometido.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the details to myself tonight, but I wanted you to know I got home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou feliz. Vou guardar os detalhes pra mim hoje à noite, mas queria que você soubesse que cheguei em casa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s fine. You don’t have to tell me more than that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tudo bem. Você não precisa me contar mais do que isso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ It was a good decision to go
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obrigada ❤️ Foi uma boa decisão ir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você? Como você está?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found it easily?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Achou fácil?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I needed a second before answering, but I’m okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu precisei de um segundo antes de responder, mas estou bem

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now we’re actually here. I’d rather say that than pretend I never get nervous
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É diferente agora que estamos realmente aqui. Prefiro dizer isso do que fingir que nunca fico nervoso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’d rather you said it too. Would you like me to call?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu preferiria que você dissesse também. Você gostaria que eu ligasse?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I’m glad we’re talking. I just needed a moment
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não, estou feliz que estamos conversando. Eu só precisava de um momento.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. You can tell me if that changes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok. Você pode me contar se isso mudar ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. I’m glad you had a good evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu vou. Fico feliz que você teve uma boa noite.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E você? Como você está?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I liked seeing your message come in
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Eu gostei de ver sua mensagem chegando.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He opened the door holding two plates
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Ele abriu a porta segurando dois pratos.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re very sweet tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está muito doce hoje à noite.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have my moments 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu tenho meus momentos 🙂.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do. More than I give you credit for sometimes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você tem. Mais do que eu te dou crédito às vezes ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll try not to ruin this one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou tentar não estragar esse.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu te amo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you too ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu também te amo ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll message you in the morning, before you start making plans to keep my spoon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem de manhã, antes de você começar a fazer planos para ficar com minha colher.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought it was mine now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu pensei que agora era minha.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Absolutely not. Neither is my side of the sofa 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De jeito nenhum. Nem meu lado do sofá 😌.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actual plates. I was mentally preparing to eat straight from a takeaway box 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pratos de verdade. Eu estava me preparando mentalmente para comer direto da caixa de entrega 😭.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both are safe. Get some sleep, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ambos estão seguros. Vá dormir, querida.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thanks again for all of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E obrigada de novo por tudo isso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't thank me. We both wanted it. I’m glad we’re doing this together ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não precisa me agradecer. Nós dois queríamos isso. Estou feliz que estamos fazendo isso juntos ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Boa noite ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s making an effort, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele tá se esforçando, então.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently. One quick picture while he puts them down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parece que sim. Uma foto rápida enquanto ele coloca os pratos.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, indoors, and about to be fed 😊 You can stop wondering whether I got lost
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Segura, dentro de casa, e prestes a ser alimentada 😊 Pode parar de se perguntar se eu me perdi.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for letting me know. Enjoy your evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obrigada por me avisar. Aproveite sua noite.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please accept my sympathy 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor, aceite minha simpatia 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️ I’m putting my phone away now. Speak later
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou sim ❤️ Vou guardar meu celular agora. Falo depois.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou aqui se precisar de algo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DEPOIS QUE ELA GUARDA O CELULAR

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have I passed the inspection?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Passei na inspeção?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I arrived. I wasn’t writing a review of your home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu disse que cheguei. Não estava escrevendo uma crítica da sua casa.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. The chair with everything piled on it would lose me a star
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. A cadeira com tudo empilhado nela me faria perder uma estrela.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu percebi.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you did
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro que você percebeu.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He told me to have a good evening. You could start by feeding me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele me disse para ter uma boa noite. Você poderia começar me alimentando

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I bought dinner on the way home. I’m not pretending I suddenly learned to cook
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu comprei o jantar no caminho para casa. Não estou fingindo que de repente aprendi a cozinhar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was work?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Como foi o trabalho?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honest and organized. That’s an unexpected combination
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Honesto e organizado. Essa é uma combinação inesperada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful. Another compliment and I’ll think you like being here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cuidado. Mais um elogio e eu vou achar que você gosta de estar aqui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. You can accept that without building a whole speech around it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto. Você pode aceitar isso sem precisar fazer um discurso sobre

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll get the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu vou pegar a comida

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excellent decision
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Excelente decisão

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DURANTE O JANTAR

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re watching my mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está olhando minha boca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re taking too long. Open
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está demorando demais. Abre

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he get fed like this, or is this a special service?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele é alimentado assim, ou isso é um serviço especial?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re stalling
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está enrolando

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Busy enough that I kept finding my coffee cold whenever I remembered it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ocupado o suficiente para sempre encontrar meu café frio quando me lembrava dele

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now you’ve got sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E agora você está com molho no polegar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then deal with it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Então lida com isso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Gladly. He doesn’t get this part, does he?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Com prazer. Ele não recebe essa parte, né?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat. Then you can be annoying somewhere more useful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Come. Depois você pode ser chato em algum lugar mais útil

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DEPOIS DO JANTAR

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, is that the strip from the photo booth?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espera, é aquele strip da cabine de fotos?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It looked better there than in my pocket
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parecia melhor lá do que no meu bolso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You put the one with your eyes closed at the front
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você colocou a que está com os olhos fechados na frente

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn’t looking at the camera
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu não estava olhando para a câmera

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu lembro

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But everything on my list is done, and my phone is charged
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas tudo na minha lista está feito, e meu celular está carregado

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to turn it around?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você quer que eu vire?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. Leave it there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não. Deixa aí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’ve gone quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você ficou quieto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you kept it somewhere you’d see it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gosto que você guardou em um lugar que você veria

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked the evening. Keeping the pictures seemed obvious
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu gostei da noite. Manter as fotos parecia óbvio

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was a nice answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essa foi uma boa resposta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can occasionally manage one. Better than a briefing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu consigo fazer um de vez em quando. Melhor do que um briefing?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here before you spoil it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vem cá antes que você estrague tudo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aqui?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know what I mean
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você sabe do que eu estou falando

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound pleased to have the evening back
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você parece feliz por ter a noite de volta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No Need for a Score
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sem necessidade de pontuação

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was that the reward for a nice answer?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Isso foi a recompensa por uma boa resposta?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. That was because I wanted to kiss you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não. Isso foi porque eu queria te beijar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even better. Does he get kissed like that after dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda melhor. Ele recebe beijo assim depois do jantar?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop talking. Sit, and keep your hands where I put them
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Para de falar. Senta, e mantém suas mãos onde eu coloquei

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the dress?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Debaixo do vestido?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ON THE SOFA
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: NO SOFÁ

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Two fingers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dois dedos?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Slow, then less slow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sim. Devagar, depois menos devagar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very. Let me show you something before I put my shoes on
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muito. Deixa eu te mostrar uma coisa antes de colocar meus sapatos

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me if I’m doing better than he does
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me diz se eu estou indo melhor do que ele

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not answering that. Keep going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Não vou responder isso. Continua

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the Dress
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Debaixo do Vestido

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t you dare keep score of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aí. Não ouse contar isso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você está perto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Não para

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sound. Does he get that too?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esse som. Ele sente isso também?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit back. My turn
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deita. Minha vez

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HER TURN
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A VEZ DELA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don’t have to—
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não precisa—

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I want to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei. Eu quero

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is this the part where I lose to him on purpose?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: É aqui que eu perco dele de propósito?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is the part where you stop talking. Hands in my hair. Don’t pull me off unless I say
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Agora é a parte em que você para de falar. Mãos no meu cabelo. Não me puxe pra longe a menos que eu diga

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Between His Knees
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entre os Joelhos Dele

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou perto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Stay there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bom. Fica aí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In Her Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Na Boca Dela

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn’t have to swallow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Você não precisava engolir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don’t look that pleased
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu queria. Não fica tão satisfeito

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fica

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There 😊 I managed to look like I had longer than twenty minutes to get ready
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Olha 😊 Consegui parecer que tive mais de vinte minutos para me arrumar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It’s to reward me for being so attentive to my studies 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: É para me recompensar por estar tão atenta aos meus estudos 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I still have the rest of the reward to enjoy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ainda tenho o resto da recompensa pra aproveitar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You really sent that to him?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Você realmente mandou isso pra ele?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: How did the practice test go?
She seems sure of herself here, and I'm still learning what that means for me.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ela parece segura de si aqui, e ainda estou aprendendo o que isso significa para mim.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:ethan}} giving cunnilingus as a reward after the successful practice test
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:ethan}} dando prazer como recompensa depois do teste prático bem-sucedido

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Careful… if you finish too early you’ll get penalty points
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Cuidado… se você terminar muito cedo, vai levar pontos de penalidade
{{name:ethan}} aumentando a intensidade apesar do aviso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not only good at studies…
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Você não é só boa nos estudos…

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: For the next lessons… what’s the objective?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Para as próximas aulas… qual é o objetivo?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we’ll have to go deeper into the subjects
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mas vamos ter que aprofundar mais nos assuntos

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then I’m really looking forward to going deeper into all of that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Então eu tô realmente ansiosa pra mergulhar em tudo isso 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But I passed it with flying colors 😌
Not too disappointed you didn’t get the punishment?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Não tá muito desapontada por não ter levado a punição?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Did you enjoy this little day?
The part where you watched everything during the game session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: A parte em que você assistiu tudo durante a sessão de jogo 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Looking forward to the next training session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ansiosa pela próxima sessão de treino 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: If you admit properly I’ll show you something even better
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Se você admitir direito, eu vou te mostrar algo ainda melhor

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Look what your best friend left me like when he left
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Olha como seu melhor amigo me deixou quando saiu

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: The part where I sent you a photo of my reward 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: A parte em que eu te mandei uma foto da minha recompensa 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And that’s the kind of crazy you love
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: E esse é o tipo de loucura que você ama

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Be ready to see even more
I don’t know what you’re talking about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Não sei do que você tá falando

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Too bad… I had another surprise for you if you liked it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Que pena... Eu tinha outra surpresa pra você se você gostou

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: For finally admitting it, you get a reward too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Por finalmente admitir, você também ganha uma recompensa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Depois de colocar o telefone de lado, você se acomoda ao lado de {{name:lena}} e adormece junto com ela.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Good morning ☀️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Bom dia ☀️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Trying to wake up slowly
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tentando acordar devagar

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course you are 😏
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Claro que você é 😏

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I swear you never rest your thumbs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu juro que você nunca descansa os polegares.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're happy when my fingers are used to text you, no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Você fica feliz quando meus dedos são usados para te enviar mensagens, não?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Isso é verdade ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: By the way…
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: A propósito…

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: About the tickets for our trip
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Sobre os ingressos para a nossa viagem

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't even know what to do with them now
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu nem sei o que fazer com eles agora.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What do you think I should do?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: O que você acha que eu deveria fazer?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Give them to someone who really needs a break
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Dê-os a alguém que realmente precisa de uma pausa.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and why not go with {{name:aiden}}?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mantenha-os e por que não ir com {{name:aiden}}?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and find someone else to go with
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mantenha-os e encontre outra pessoa para ir junto.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Hey you 🙂
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Oi você 🙂

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's actually really kind of you 😊
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Isso é realmente muito gentil da sua parte 😊

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You always try to do the right thing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Você sempre tenta fazer a coisa certa

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course I am, look at how much luck I have these days thanks to karma 😅
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Claro que sim, veja quanta sorte eu tenho esses dias graças ao karma 😅

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Well having me as your girlfriend is not good enough?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Bem, ter-me como sua namorada não é bom o suficiente?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It is! I'm the luckiest man in the world ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: É! Eu sou o homem mais sortudo do mundo ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Really?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Sério?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I swear
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu juro

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm also the luckiest girl in the world
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu também sou a garota mais sortuda do mundo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Como você está se sentindo esta manhã?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: For having a vegetable as your man? Not sure about that 😄
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Por ter um vegetal como seu homem? Não tenho certeza sobre isso 😄

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You know how much I love vegetables 😉
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Você sabe o quanto eu amo vegetais 😉

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're too sweet
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Você é muito doce

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: With {{name:aiden}}?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: With {{name:aiden}}?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Why?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Por quê?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: He always wanted to go to that island and at least he has his two legs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ele sempre quis ir para aquela ilha e pelo menos ele tem suas duas pernas.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't think I will be very comfortable going alone with him
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu não acho que vou me sentir muito confortável indo sozinho com ele.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm okay
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Estou bem

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Even if he is my friend and your best friend, it feels weird no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mesmo que ele seja meu amigo e seu melhor amigo, parece estranho, não?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Now that you said it like that I guess it does
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Agora que você disse assim, eu acho que faz sentido.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But I trust you both and I don't want you to miss the trip just because of me and at the same time he will finally have the trip to the island he wanted so much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mas eu confio em vocês dois e não quero que vocês percam a viagem só por minha causa e ao mesmo tempo ele finalmente terá a viagem para a ilha que tanto queria.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're right I'm thinking too much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Você está certo, estou pensando demais.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And it is in more than a month so I got time to think about it
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: E está a mais de um mês, então tenho tempo para pensar sobre isso.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Exactly
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You won't be jealous?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Você não vai ficar com ciúmes?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course I will
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Claro que sim!

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: My best friend going to the vacation we prepared and spending time with my girlfriend in my place, who on earth won't be jealous!
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Meu melhor amigo indo para as férias que preparamos e passando tempo com minha namorada na minha casa, quem na terra não ficaria com ciúmes!

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true, and sweet it shows that you care a lot about me ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Isso é verdade, e é doce que você se importe tanto comigo ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What about you?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: E você?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's called love
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Isso se chama amor

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're too much of a sweet talker
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Você é muito bom de lábia.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Only with you ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Somente com você ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You better 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: É melhor você 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Someone else?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Alguém mais?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That feels a little cold 😕
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Isso parece um pouco frio 😕

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Sorry I didn't mean it that way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Desculpe, não quis dizer dessa forma.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm good 😊
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Estou bem 😊

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It's more like you need to find someone else who would like to go to the island with you so you can enjoy the trip even if it's not with me
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: É mais como se você precisasse encontrar alguém que gostaria de ir à ilha com você para que você possa aproveitar a viagem, mesmo que não seja comigo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Yeah…
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Sim…

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're upset?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Você está chateado?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: No
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Não

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I mean I just wasn't expecting you to say something like that
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Quer dizer, eu simplesmente não esperava que você dissesse algo assim.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Why? I did not mean it in a bad way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Por quê? Eu não quis dizer de uma maneira ruim.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know sorry I made a big deal out of nothing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu sei, desculpe, eu fiz um grande alarde por nada.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It's just that I'm sad that I won't go with you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: É só que estou triste por não ir com você.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Me too and you know it
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu também e você sabe disso

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But next time as soon as I'm healed we will go together ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mas da próxima vez, assim que eu estiver curado, iremos juntos ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Still in bed actually 🛌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ainda na cama, na verdade 🛌
