story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I hope so
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu espero que sim

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Promise
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Promessa

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Also
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Claro! Por favor, forneça o diálogo do jogo que você gostaria que eu traduzisse.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I’m coming over today
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Estou indo aí hoje

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Sasha and I postponed our plans, so I can spend the day with you 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Sasha e eu adiamos nossos planos, então posso passar o dia com você 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You really don’t have to come all the way here on your only day off
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Você realmente não precisa vir até aqui no seu único dia de folga.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don’t want you to feel like you have to
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu não quero que você sinta que precisa

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu sei

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But I want to
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mas eu quero fazer isso.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I miss you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eu sinto sua falta

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And I’d come anyway even if you tried to stop me 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: E eu viria de qualquer jeito, mesmo que você tentasse me parar 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Thank you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Obrigado

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That really means a lot
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Isso realmente significa muito

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: See you in half an hour ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Te vejo em meia hora ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 5 MINUTOS DEPOIS

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Guardando a roupa de ontem à noite para o passeio remarcado com Sasha. Os planos mudam, as boas escolhas ficam.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Guardando a roupa de ontem à noite para o passeio remarcado com Sasha. Os planos mudam, as boas escolhas ficam.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And what are you doing?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: E o que você está fazendo?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Guardando a roupa de ontem à noite para o passeio remarcado com Sasha. Os planos mudam, as boas escolhas ficam.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Playing on the PlayStation
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Jogando no PlayStation

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Are you awake?
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Você está acordado?

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: It’s going to be okay. Don’t overthink it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Vai ficar tudo bem. Não pense demais.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: And if something happens, we’ll figure out a solution together
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: E se algo acontecer, vamos encontrar uma solução juntos.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Yes..  you're right
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Sim.. você está certo

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: By the way, {{name:lena}} is coming over today
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: A propósito, {{name:lena}} vem aqui hoje.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: That’s good
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Isso é bom

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You shouldn’t stay alone too much
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Você não deveria ficar sozinho por muito tempo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: I’ll come by later and air your room a little
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Vou passar mais tarde e arejar seu quarto um pouco.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: It needs fresh air anyway
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Precisa de ar fresco de qualquer forma.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Thank you
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Obrigado

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You’re welcome
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: De nada

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: How is the leg this morning?
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Como está a perna esta manhã?

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: It’s okay. Still a little stiff
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Está tudo bem. Ainda um pouco rígido.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: That’s normal
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Isso é normal

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Just don’t try to be brave and overdo it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Apenas não tente ser corajoso e exagerar.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: How are you?
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Como você está?

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: I’m alright
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Estou bem

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Stress is starting to get to me about going back to work, but I’ll manage
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: O estresse está começando a me afetar sobre voltar ao trabalho, mas eu vou conseguir.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You don’t need to worry about me
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Você não precisa se preocupar comigo

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Are you sure?
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Você tem certeza?

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do one chill match later, no ranked sweat
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Faz uma partida tranquila mais tarde, nada de suar em ranqueada.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: One game later if you want. Doctor mode orders
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Um jogo depois, se você quiser. Ordens do modo médico.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Ping me if your leg hurts later
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Me avise se sua perna doer mais tarde.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How are you actually doing this morning?
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Como você está realmente esta manhã?

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Head is still heavy from yesterday
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: A cabeça ainda está pesada desde ontem.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I almost called because your replies were slow
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Eu quase liguei porque suas respostas estavam lentas.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: If those guys ever show up again, I swear I'll break their...
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Se aqueles caras aparecerem de novo, eu juro que vou quebrar a...

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Forget it, bad idea. I am trying to stay calm
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Esqueça, má ideia. Estou tentando manter a calma.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Onde está {{name:hailey}}?
Você é a polícia da academia agora? 🙄

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Stop acting like everything is an attack
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Pare de agir como se tudo fosse um ataque.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I was just asking because I've seen you going more often lately
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Eu só estava perguntando porque eu tenho te visto indo mais frequentemente ultimamente.
Não me dê lição.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I'm getting in shape and it takes work
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Estou me colocando em forma e isso dá trabalho.
Você também deveria tentar.
Olhe para você agora mesmo

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: And don't blame the leg for all of it
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: E não culpe a perna por tudo isso.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I know what my body looks like
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Eu sei como meu corpo é.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Right now I can't do any sport
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Neste momento, não posso praticar nenhum esporte.
Preciso do meu carregador reserva de volta.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: But when I'm healed, I'll get back in shape
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Mas quando eu estiver curado, vou voltar a ficar em forma.
Vamos ver
Ela já foi?
Não a vejo desde o café da manhã.
Ótimo

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: If you see her, tell her I want it back before lunch
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Se você a ver, diga a ela que eu quero de volta antes do almoço.
Entendi 👍

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: You're going to the gym today?
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Você vai para a academia hoje?
Talvez
Por quê?

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: In my '{{name:hailey}} owes me one' book
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: No meu livro '{{name:hailey}} me deve uma'

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: Thanks for dealing with my rugby mess yesterday 🏉
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Obrigado por lidar com a minha confusão de rugby ontem 🏉

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: I know I kind of dropped it on you like a little menace 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Eu sei que meio que joguei isso em você como uma pequena ameaça 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: You made it sound like a house emergency
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Você fez parecer uma emergência em casa.

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: Or I'll climb through the window
story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.translation: Ou eu vou subir pela janela

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: I'm really fast when I want something
story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.translation: Eu sou realmente rápido quando quero algo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: And I want to see youuu

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: And I can move a little by myself already
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: E eu já consigo me mover um pouco sozinho.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: I just don’t want you to push it and hurt yourself because nobody is around
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Eu só não quero que você se force e se machuque porque ninguém está por perto.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So ask if you need anything
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Então pergunte se você precisar de algo

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Everything is folded. I’ll give it to you when {{name:lena}} is gone
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Está tudo dobrado. Eu te entrego quando a {{name:lena}} for embora

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Also, don’t forget. I start work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Além disso, não se esqueça. Eu começo a trabalhar novamente amanhã.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So in the afternoon I won’t be here to help you
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Então à tarde eu não estarei aqui para te ajudar.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: But {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} will be here to help me
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Mas {{name:hailey}} e {{name:mason}} vão estar aqui pra me ajudar.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Did you hurt yourself when you came to open the door?
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Você se machucou quando veio abrir a porta?
Da próxima vez, não faça isso.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’ll call {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} if they’re there
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Vou ligar para a {{name:hailey}} ou a {{name:evelyn}} se elas estiverem lá
Hmm… tenha cuidado da próxima vez

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Anyway, I’m sending you the photos I took today 📸
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: De qualquer forma, estou te enviando as fotos que tirei hoje 📸

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: And send me the ones you took 😏
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: E me envie os que você pegou 😏

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: And if I did… I’d keep them for myself 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: E se eu fizesse... Eu os manteria para mim 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I don’t care 😤 Send them or I curse you forever
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Eu não me importo 😤 Envie-os ou eu te amaldiçoo para sempre

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Oh wow 😳 You took more than I thought
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Oh uau 😳 Você levou mais do que eu pensei

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I look ugly… you should delete them
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Eu estou feio... você deveria deletá-los

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: You’re the most beautiful girl I know ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Você é a garota mais linda que eu conheço ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: But thank you… that means a lot 🥺
Thank you for taking care of me today
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Obrigado por cuidar de mim hoje.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Stop… that’s too many compliments 😅, but i feel the same
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Pare... são elogios demais 😅, mas eu sinto o mesmo

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’m going to take a shower now 🚿

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Me manda uma selfie do chuveiro? 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: In the shower? You never stop!

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Descanse enquanto eu estiver fora, tudo bem?

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: It was the best part of my week
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Foi a melhor parte da minha semana

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: But seriously, if you need water, food, or someone to reach a shelf because your leg is being dramatic, just say it 🤍
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Mas sério, se você precisar de água, comida, ou de alguém para alcançar uma prateleira porque sua perna está sendo dramática, é só dizer 🤍

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Try not to abuse the service though 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Tente não abusar do serviço, ok? 😌
Ou eu vou te fazer pagar 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me she starts work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: A {{name:evelyn}} me disse que começa a trabalhar de novo amanhã

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: So if you need something while she's out, she said you'll have to beg for my help 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Então, se você precisar de algo enquanto ela estiver fora, ela disse que você vai ter que implorar pela minha ajuda 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: That sounds surprisingly unlike something {{name:evelyn}} would say
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Isso soa surpreendentemente diferente de algo que {{name:evelyn}} diria.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: She said it, I was there 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Ela disse isso, eu estava lá 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Alright, alright, maybe she didn't say anything about begging 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Certo, certo, talvez ela não tenha dito nada sobre implorar 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Wow, how quick of you to turn to the truth
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Uau, quão rápido você se voltou para a verdade

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Please appreciate how much personal growth this is 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Por favor, aprecie o quanto isso é um crescimento pessoal 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_10_MASON_EVELYN_FOOD_LEG.translation: Movimente-se com cuidado para a {{name:evelyn}} parar de se preocupar
Quer um prato lá em cima?

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I need to pick an outfit for tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Eu preciso escolher uma roupa para amanhã.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: You look good in all of them
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Você fica bem em todos eles

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I don’t want to look out of place
I feel a little better now
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Eu me sinto um pouco melhor agora

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Yes, see you and good luck
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Sim, até logo e boa sorte

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: It’s been so long that I don’t even know what to wear anymore
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Faz tanto tempo que eu nem sei mais o que vestir.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Just tell me which one makes me look the least ugly
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Apenas me diga qual deles me faz parecer menos feio.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Show me and I’ll tell you which one looks best
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Mostre-me e eu direi qual parece melhor.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Talk nicely or I delete the photo 😈
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Fale gentilmente ou eu excluo a foto 😈

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I feel clean and sleepy 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Agora me sinto limpo e sonolento 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: But I may have a little gift for you
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Mas eu posso ter um pequeno presente para você.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I need to see it
You don't even know what it is 😶
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Você nem sabe o que é 😶

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If it's from you it's already perfect
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Se é de você, já é perfeito.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And don't show them to anyone
So now I can talk to you until I fall asleep 💤
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Então agora posso falar com você até eu adormecer 💤

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Emotional reassurance strengthens trust and intimacy
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: A reafirmação emocional fortalece a confiança e a intimidade

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Playful ambiguity detected, tension may increase attraction
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ambiguidade lúdica detectada, a tensão pode aumentar a atração.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Critical moment detected, distancing may weaken emotional security
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Momento crítico detectado, o distanciamento pode enfraquecer a segurança emocional.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That's why I sent them to you
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: É por isso que eu os enviei para você
É só para os seus olhos

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I loved having you here with me
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu amei ter você aqui comigo

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: When you're better we should go somewhere together
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Quando você estiver melhor, deveríamos ir a algum lugar juntos.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We'll do it when you're completely healed
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Faremos isso quando você estiver completamente curado.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: To make up for the missed trip
She has to go back to work tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ela tem que voltar ao trabalho amanhã.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Money is getting tight and they need her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: O dinheiro está ficando apertado e eles precisam dela.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I just hope it's not like last time
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu só espero que não seja como da última vez.
Mesmo de pijama você é linda.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And when you're better you'll be able to help her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: E quando você estiver melhor, poderá ajudá-la.
Foque em se recuperar, tudo bem.
Uma foto de boa noite, por favor?

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m removing my makeup before bed
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Estou tirando minha maquiagem antes de dormir.

story/DAY4/DAY4_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Estou me preparando para a faculdade.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I'm sure they'll feel the same so don't worry
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Tenho certeza de que eles sentirão o mesmo, então não se preocupe.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I made breakfast and it's ready
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Eu preparei o café da manhã e está pronto.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Do you want me to bring it to you?
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Você quer que eu traga para você?

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Are you going to take a shower this morning?
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Você vai tomar banho esta manhã?
Se você fizer isso, tenha cuidado.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: How are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Como você está se sentindo esta manhã?
{{name:hailey}} conseguiu espalhar água por todo lado

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: The store doesn't want to take her back
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: A loja não quer aceitá-la de volta.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So we will have to endure her mess until we die
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Então teremos que suportar a bagunça dela até morrer.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Or we find some crazy guy who wants her
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Ou encontramos algum cara maluco que a queira.
Apenas cuide dos seus passos, ok?

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I will be a bit busy this morning
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Estarei um pouco ocupado esta manhã

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I need to prepare everything for going back to work
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Eu preciso preparar tudo para voltar ao trabalho.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: My bag my clothes and a few documents
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Minha bolsa, minhas roupas e alguns documentos

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So if you need something ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}}
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Então, se precisar de algo, pergunta pra {{name:hailey}} ou {{name:mason}}

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Just do what you have to do
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Apenas faça o que você tem que fazer

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Thank you for taking care of me
The same stress as a first day I guess
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: O mesmo estresse de um primeiro dia, eu acho.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: But I'm happy to see my colleagues!
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Mas estou feliz em ver meus colegas!

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Hello mister secretary 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Olá, senhor secretário 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: (I'm a grown woman, I'm a grown woman 😌)
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: (Eu sou uma mulher adulta, eu sou uma mulher adulta 😌)

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: ( Don't kill him 😇)
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: ( Não o mate 😇)

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: How many of you are there in your head?
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Quantos de vocês estão na sua cabeça?

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Enough to bury you in the garden 🌸
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Suficiente para te enterrar no jardim 🌸

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Anyway
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: De qualquer forma

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: How are you doing today?
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Como você está hoje?

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Better than yesterday
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Melhor do que ontem

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Still slow though
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Ainda está lento, porém.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Slow is fine, or more like your normal speed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Devagar está bom, ou mais como a sua velocidade normal 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: You better train to run fast
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: É melhor você treinar para correr rápido.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Random warning 😇
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Aviso aleatório 😇

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: You'll see what happens to bad frogs when I'm fully healed
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Você vai ver o que acontece com as rãs más quando eu estiver totalmente curado.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Threats don't reach my princess ears
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Ameaças não chegam aos ouvidos da minha princesa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Goodbye peasant 😇
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Adeus camponês 😇

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: I need either {{name:aiden}} or {{name:mason}} to take me to rugby on Wednesday
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Preciso que {{name:aiden}} ou {{name:mason}} me levem pro rugby na quarta

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: I'm planning ahead because apparently that's what mature women do 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Estou planejando com antecedência porque aparentemente é isso que mulheres maduras fazem 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Who are you?
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Quem é você?

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: What have you done to my {{name:hailey}}
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: O que você fez com o meu {{name:hailey}}?

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: How dare you say that 😤
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Como você se atreve a dizer isso 😤

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: That's not how a proper majordomo is supposed to behave 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Não é assim que um bom mordomo deve se comportar 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Are you a princess?
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Você é uma princesa?

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: More like a frog to me
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Mais como um sapo para mim

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: You can stay if you want

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Elas estão tendo uma conversa de garotas.
Não é muito interessante para mim 🙄
Eles não param de falar do {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: They say he's the most handsome guy at uni
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Dizem que ele é o cara mais bonito da faculdade.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: We both know how he really is
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Nós dois sabemos como ele realmente é

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: Still, it's true that he's handsome
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Ainda assim, é verdade que ele é bonito

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: But I only look at you so I don't care 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Mas eu só olho para você, então não me importo 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: I only look at you too ❤️
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Eu só olho para você também ❤️
Falo com você depois da aula

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: I'll let you enjoy lunch with your friends
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Vou deixar você aproveitar o almoço com seus amigos.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Like caring about each other a little
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Como se importar um pouco um com o outro

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Since when do you care what I do
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Desde quando você se importa com o que eu faço?

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It's just hard to have a conversation with you without you getting mad
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: É apenas difícil ter uma conversa com você sem que você fique bravo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just wish we could talk a little less aggressively
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Eu só gostaria que pudéssemos conversar de forma um pouco menos agressiva.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And care about each other a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: E se importassem um pouco mais uns com os outros

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It was in the living room
So I don't care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Então eu não me importo com você
Isso não é o que eu disse

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I stayed with you the whole time at the hospital
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Eu fiquei com você o tempo todo no hospital

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I even carried you to your bed when we got home
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Eu até te carreguei para a sua cama quando chegamos em casa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And that's just about the accident
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: E isso é sobre o acidente.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Never mind the rest of the year
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Deixe pra lá o resto do ano

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And thank you again for that
I just want us to talk for reasons other than needing something
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Eu só quero que a gente converse por razões além de precisar de algo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Don't you have a girlfriend for that
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Você não tem uma namorada para isso?
Não se trata de te namorar.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just want to know you better
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Eu só quero te conhecer melhor.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And have a good time with you sometimes
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: E ter um bom tempo com você às vezes

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I'll try to be less aggressive
Then {{name:hailey}} took it or the couch ate it
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Então {{name:hailey}} pegou ou o sofá comeu

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Is it too hard for you to text me for anything other than complaints?
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: É muito difícil para você me mandar uma mensagem sobre qualquer coisa além de reclamações?

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I can carry ranked later if you are up for it
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Posso jogar ranqueada mais tarde se você estiver a fim.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Keep laughing, I am dropping 30 tonight
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Continue rindo, vou fazer 30 hoje à noite

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Before you roast me, yes my hair looks stupid
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Antes de você me zoar, sim, meu cabelo está ridículo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Say that louder, I need motivation
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Fala isso mais alto, eu preciso de motivação!
Melhor do que na semana passada

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do your rehab and stop trying to be a hero
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Faça sua reabilitação e pare de tentar ser um herói.

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It can get busy in the evening

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Me mande uma mensagem quando puder
Isso é tudo que eu quero

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: I checked your medication and your food
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Eu verifiquei sua medicação e sua comida
Por favor, não pule o almoço.

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Try not to stress too much okay
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Tente não se estressar muito, ok?

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It still feels a little strange going back
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Ainda parece um pouco estranho voltar

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You look like the kind of person who would file a very sad complaint from bed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Você parece o tipo de pessoa que faria uma reclamação muito triste da cama 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: A very bad one if it's really late, so hurry 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Um muito ruim se estiver realmente tarde, então se apresse 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Let me just buy some rat poison on the way home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Deixa eu só comprar um veneno para ratos no caminho de casa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't starve before I get there mister rat🤍
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Não morra de fome antes de eu chegar aí, senhor rato🤍

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: How no, what about your limousine?
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Como não, e a sua limusine?

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't you dare make fun of me 😒
Since you're broken and no one is home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Como você está quebrado e não há ninguém em casa

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: I'm coming back with a friend instead
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Estou voltando com um amigo em vez disso.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Which means your food is getting delivered to your room a little later than planned 😇
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: O que significa que sua comida será entregue no seu quarto um pouco mais tarde do que o planejado 😇

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You say that like I'm about to file a complaint
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Você diz isso como se eu estivesse prestes a fazer uma reclamação.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then I went straight to the shower 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Então eu fui direto para o chuveiro 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So now you look unfairly pretty?
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Então agora você parece injustamente bonita?

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Pretty enough that I need proof with my own eyes
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Bonita o suficiente para que eu precise de provas com meus próprios olhos

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm tired and now I'm blushing
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Estou cansado e agora estou corando
Melhor uma vez que você me mandou uma mensagem
Você está muito meloso esta noite

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So you don't have to worry
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Então você não precisa se preocupar

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But I want to talk to you a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Mas eu quero conversar com você um pouco mais

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want to stay and talk to you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Eu quero ficar e conversar com você

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Go rest, you need it after your long day
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Vá descansar, você precisa disso depois do seu longo dia.
Você não pode fazer bico para mim

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But it's true, so that makes me even more annoyed 🙄
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Mas é verdade, então isso me deixa ainda mais irritado 🙄

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm only saying it because I care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Estou dizendo isso só porque me importo com você

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want you in good shape tomorrow
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Eu quero que você esteja em boa forma amanhã.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then go sleep if you understand
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Então vá dormir se você entender

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I made something quick when I got back
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Eu fiz algo rápido quando voltei.

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Stopped at the gym on the way back
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Parou na academia no caminho de volta

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: A couple idiots there tried to waste my time
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Um casal de idiotas lá tentou desperdiçar meu tempo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Didn't want you wondering where I was
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Não queria que você ficasse se perguntando onde eu estava.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: Or maybe he just understood boundaries this time
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Ou talvez ele apenas tenha entendido os limites desta vez.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I was a little slow at first
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Eu estava um pouco lento no começo

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: But muscle memory comes back quickly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Mas a memória muscular volta rapidamente.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: And you, how was your day?
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: E você, como foi seu dia?

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I'm going to prepare dinner earlier today, tell me when you're hungry, I will bring it to you directly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Vou preparar o jantar mais cedo hoje, me avise quando estiver com fome, eu vou levar para você diretamente.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I had forgotten how exhausting it can be
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Eu tinha esquecido como pode ser exaustivo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: But it felt good to be back
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Mas foi bom estar de volta

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I saw him during the evening
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Eu o vi durante a noite
Ele foi na verdade muito educado.

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Would have been better with you next to me
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Teria sido melhor com você ao meu lado

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: And you, eat something this morning
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: E você, comeu algo esta manhã?
Vou te mandar uma mensagem no almoço 💕

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: So thank you for forcing me to go to bed early 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Então, obrigado por me forçar a ir para a cama cedo 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Eu tenho boas ideias às vezes.

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: But yes, this one was good

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Como está sua perna esta manhã?

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Better I think, i can move around more
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Melhor, eu acho, posso me mover mais.

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And how he's going to drag you outside the second you can walk again
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: E como ele vai te arrastar para fora no segundo em que você puder andar de novo

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And the girls are drinking his every word 🙄
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: E as garotas estão bebendo cada palavra dele 🙄

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: At this point I think the girls would eat him alive if they could
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Neste ponto, acho que as garotas o devorariam vivo se pudessem.
Adivinha quem se juntou a nós

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He just sat down like he owns the table 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Ele simplesmente se sentou como se fosse o dono da mesa 😭
Ele está falando sobre você agora
E o seu jogo, é claro

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'm thinking about you a lot today
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Estou pensando muito em você hoje

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I wish I could just leave and come lay next to you for ten minutes
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Eu gostaria de poder apenas sair e vir deitar ao seu lado por dez minutos.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Ten minutes would turn into two hours
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Dez minutos se transformariam em duas horas.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Uni is finally over for today
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: A universidade finalmente acabou por hoje.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: And then I would fail everything because of you
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: E então eu falharia em tudo por sua causa.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Text me if you need anything okay?
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Me mande uma mensagem se precisar de algo, tá bom?

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I have to go back now
Now I still have work until 14
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Agora eu ainda tenho trabalho até as 14.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Then my part time job until 18 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Então meu trabalho de meio período até 18 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do not get used to it
I just want your brain occupied for a bit
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Eu só quero que sua mente esteja ocupada por um tempo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Send me one word later: alive
Or are you pretending to be productive today?
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Ou você está fingindo ser produtivo hoje?

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Liar, but I respect the confidence
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Mentiroso, mas eu respeito a confiança

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Then we do chill games, no screaming
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Então fazemos jogos tranquilos, sem gritar.

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: And if you do not feel it, we skip
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: E se você não sentir, nós pulamos.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Ocupado? 😌
O que trouxe isso?

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: A girl in class is losing her mind over some guy she barely knows
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Uma garota na aula está perdendo a cabeça por um cara que ela mal conhece.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So now everyone is doing that whole crush autopsy 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Então agora todo mundo está fazendo essa autópsia de crush 😭
E você se juntou?
Só um pouco 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I said people like confidence and good timing
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Eu disse que as pessoas gostam de confiança e bom timing.
Isso não é um mau conselho.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I know, what would your advice be?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Eu sei, qual seria o seu conselho?

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Just be yourself, be funny, be kind, be honest, that's probably all
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Apenas seja você mesmo, seja engraçado, seja gentil, seja honesto, isso é provavelmente tudo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So all I need is a sparkling personality? 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Então tudo que eu preciso é de uma personalidade brilhante? 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Do you have five minutes or are you pretending to be very important?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Você tem cinco minutos ou está fingindo ser muito importante?
Não exatamente o que eu disse
Isso soa exatamente como eu 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Okay, that's enough emotional labor for your afternoon 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Ok, isso é trabalho emocional suficiente para a sua tarde 😇
Obrigado por responder de forma séria 🤍
De nada

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: If you need more help for your monologue, I'm here 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Se você precisar de mais ajuda para o seu monólogo, estou aqui 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I can make time for the small people
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Eu posso arranjar tempo para as pessoas pequenas
Resposta ruim 😌
Eu estava apenas me perguntando uma coisa

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Do you fall for people fast or do you act difficult first?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Você se apaixona rápido pelas pessoas ou age de forma difícil primeiro?
Isso depende da pessoa

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Why? Are you planning on jumping from the roof onto someone? 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Por quê? Você está planejando pular do telhado em cima de alguém? 😌
Cuzão 🖕

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Then soda and a few biscuits 😌
Want me to change your clothes and brush your teeth too
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Quer que eu troque suas roupas e escove seus dentes também?

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Might grab food too if the line doesn't piss me off
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Talvez eu pegue comida também se a fila não me irritar.

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: A drink and whatever is easiest 🙂
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Uma bebida e o que for mais fácil 🙂

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: You asked a guy with one busted leg
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Você perguntou a um cara com uma perna quebrada

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Your leg's hurt, you're not sick, asshole
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Sua perna está machucada, você não está doente, idiota.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I will pretend i didnt see that
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Vou fingir que não vi isso.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I knew keeping you around had value
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Eu sabia que te manter por perto tinha valor

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Don't get emotional, you still haven't seen the options yet 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Não fique emocional, você ainda não viu as opções 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I have a party on Saturday night
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Eu tenho uma festa no sábado à noite

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: So I may need your opinion on hair tomorrow
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Então eu posso precisar da sua opinião sobre cabelo amanhã.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: And if it goes badly, you are legally required to save me
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: E se der errado, você é legalmente obrigado a me salvar.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Or you will have to pay for the damage
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Ou você terá que pagar pelos danos.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: How am I saving you from hair?
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Como estou te salvando do cabelo?

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: By telling me when I look insane before I leave the house 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Dizendo-me quando pareço louco antes de sair de casa 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: That seems hard, you will hear me everyday
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Isso parece difícil, você vai me ouvir todos os dias.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: I'm going to sleep early tonight
Then don't stay up for me
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Então não fique acordado por minha causa.
Nada que valha a pena falar sobre

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: At least you didn't skip dinner
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Pelo menos você não pulou o jantar

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Look at you sounding all responsible now 🙄
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Olha você soando tão responsável agora 🙄

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: I still need to finish one thing for tomorrow
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Ainda preciso terminar uma coisa para amanhã.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Just don't drag it out too long
Uni and both jobs in one day
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Uni e ambos os empregos em um dia

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Listen to you ordering me around 😒
Someone has to protect your last brain cell
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Alguém tem que proteger sua última célula cerebral.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Not sure I'll fall asleep right away
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Não tenho certeza se vou adormecer imediatamente.
Feche os olhos e se comporte 😌
Não é à toa que você está exausto.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: So you can copy me and finally get some muscle
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Então você pode me copiar e finalmente ganhar um pouco de músculo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: I'm making the first post tonight
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Estou fazendo a primeira postagem esta noite

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: You better be the first like
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: É melhor você ser o primeiro a curtir.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: I finally made my fitness page
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Finalmente criei minha página de fitness

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: Or at least make it look like I have more than three followers
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Ou pelo menos fazer parecer que eu tenho mais de três seguidores.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: Is that a request or an order
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: É um pedido ou uma ordem?
As fotos estão boas de qualquer forma.

story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.translation: Está mais movimentado do que o esperado.

story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.source: I will be very late tonight
story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.translation: Eu vou me atrasar muito esta noite.

story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.source: Okay, be careful on your way back
story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.translation: Certo, tenha cuidado no seu caminho de volta.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: He looked at me strangely a few times
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Ele me olhou estranhamente algumas vezes.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: It was still quite a long day
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Ainda foi um dia bem longo

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: I slept as soon as I got home
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Eu dormi assim que cheguei em casa.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: I will make breakfast in a few minutes
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Vou fazer o café da manhã em alguns minutos.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Tell me if you want it brought to you
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Diga-me se você quer que eu traga para você

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Don't worry take your time, {{name:hailey}} already made me breakfast, just rest
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Não se preocupe, leve o seu tempo, {{name:hailey}} já me fez café da manhã, apenas descanse.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Thank you to both of you

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: E você, como foi o trabalho?

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: We had more people than expected
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Tivemos mais pessoas do que o esperado

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Still stiff when I get up, but I can feel it's getting better
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Ainda estou rígido quando me levanto, mas posso sentir que está melhorando.

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Someone has to keep you in one piece 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Alguém tem que te manter inteiro 😌
Então, o caos de sempre depois

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Only because you keep cheering me on
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Só porque você continua me incentivando

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Now that's the kind of answer I like
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Agora essa é o tipo de resposta que eu gosto

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Come on, only two more weeks and then you're free
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Vamos lá, só mais duas semanas e então você estará livre.
Vou te mandar uma mensagem no almoço 💕

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Did you sleep better at least?

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Um pouco mais do que ontem

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Como você está se sentindo esta manhã?

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: Move faster and I become nicer
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Mova-se mais rápido e eu fico mais legal.
Sem promessas de nenhum dos lados

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: I actually made it all the way to the bathroom and now I'm stuck here
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Na verdade, eu cheguei até o banheiro e agora estou preso aqui.

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: You said two minutes ten minutes ago
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Você disse dois minutos dez minutos atrás.
A manutenção da beleza leva tempo 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: And I still need to wash too
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: E eu ainda preciso lavar também

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: Also this is very rude for someone loitering outside a bathroom door 😭
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Além disso, isso é muito rude para alguém esperando do lado de fora da porta do banheiro 😭

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: Trabalho de meio período é bom

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: I get a lot of time for myself
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: Eu tenho muito tempo para mim.

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: And sorry I can't help much around the house
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: E desculpe, não consigo ajudar muito em casa.

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: I really need to save money for next year
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: Eu realmente preciso economizar dinheiro para o próximo ano.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Portuguese.

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: It's good when we talk sometimes
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: É bom quando conversamos às vezes

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: Said I should check if you actually ate
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: Disse que eu deveria verificar se você realmente comeu

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: And if you need anything brought up
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: E se você precisar que algo seja mencionado

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Não comece a agir com ciúmes 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Then I go straight to work
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Então eu vou direto para o trabalho

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Eat properly and not too many video games
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Coma adequadamente e não jogue muitos videogames.

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Sorry I can't read very well today
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Desculpe, não consigo ler muito bem hoje.

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: You're lucky that leg is already hurt
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Você tem sorte de que essa perna já está machucada.

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: See you when class is over ❤️
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Te vejo quando a aula acabar ❤️

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: He really has an effect on girls
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Ele realmente tem um efeito nas garotas

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: They laugh at everything he says
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Eles riem de tudo que ele diz

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Good thing you already have your man to make you laugh ❤️
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Ainda bem que você já tem seu homem para te fazer rir ❤️

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Mission completed 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Missão concluída 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Since the meeting me, myself and I had two days ago 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Desde a reunião que eu, eu mesmo e eu tivemos há dois dias 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: You're doing great in the role 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Você está se saindo muito bem no papel 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: You're impossible
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Você é impossível

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Thank you, see you tonight young Padawan 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Obrigado, até mais tarde jovem Padawan 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Wait, one more job for my emergency stylist 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Espera, mais uma missão para o meu cabeleireiro de emergência 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: For Saturday's party: loose waves or a high ponytail?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Para a festa de sábado: ondas soltas ou rabo de cavalo alto?

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Loose waves. You can't go wrong with those
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Ondas soltas. Não tem erro

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: High ponytail. Easier to dance with
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Rabo de cavalo alto. É mais fácil para dançar

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Loose waves it is. Soft, cute, and completely innocent 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Então vai ser ondas soltas. Suaves, fofas e completamente inocentes 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Thanks for warning {{name:mason}} about the ride 🤍
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Valeu por avisar o {{name:mason}} sobre a carona 🤍

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: High ponytail it is. Practical AND cute. Look at you thinking ahead 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Então vai ser rabo de cavalo alto. Prático E fofo. Olha só você pensando em tudo 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Styling crisis solved. My work here is done
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Crise capilar resolvida. Meu trabalho aqui terminou

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Thanks 🤍 Don't retire yet, I still need to choose the outfit
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Obrigada 🤍 Não se aposente ainda, ainda preciso escolher a roupa

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: {{mason:He}} did the full dramatic sigh, but {{mason:he}} got the message 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: {{mason:He}} fez um suspiro dramático completo, mas {{mason:he}} entendeu a mensagem 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Why not thank {{mason:him}} yourself?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Por que não agradece {{mason:him}} você mesmo?

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: I'm too shy 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Estou muito tímido 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Yes of course, shy to thank {{mason:him}} but not shy to ask for a ride
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Sim, claro, tímido para agradecer {{mason:him}}, mas não tímido para pedir uma carona.

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Touché 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Toque 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: But that's your job
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Mas esse é o seu trabalho

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: House logistics manager, remember?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Gerente de logística da casa, lembra?

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Since when?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Desde quando?

story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.source: I'll text you on my break 💕
story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem no meu intervalo 💕

story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.source: I barely survived that last class
story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.translation: Eu mal sobrevivi à última aula.

story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.source: My brain checked out halfway through
And now I'm on my way to work
story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.translation: E agora estou a caminho do trabalho

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Still playing video games I guess?

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Ou pelo menos tentando fazer isso
Você tem certeza de que está tudo bem?

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: You're going to hurt yourself if you're not careful
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Você vai se machucar se não tomar cuidado.

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'm almost done and I'm tired of not being able to move
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Estou quase terminando e estou cansado de não conseguir me mover.

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'm pushing a little but it doesn't hurt too much for now
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Estou empurrando um pouco, mas não dói muito por enquanto.
Eu vou estar em casa mais tarde

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'll text you when I can ❤️
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem quando puder ❤️

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: That was the plan, you stupid 😭
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Esse era o plano, seu idiota 😭

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Just enough to breathe a little
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Apenas o suficiente para respirar um pouco

story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Everything is prepared for tonight just like yesterday
story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Tudo está preparado para esta noite, assim como ontem.

story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Dinner is in the fridge in case you get hungry
story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: O jantar está na geladeira caso você fique com fome.

story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Try not to stay up too late
story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Tente não ficar acordado até muito tarde

story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Okay, good luck and be safe
story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Ok, boa sorte e fique seguro

story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: I will text you when I can
story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Eu vou te mandar uma mensagem quando eu puder

story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: And if someone starts acting weird around you again
story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: E se alguém começar a agir de forma estranha ao seu redor novamente

story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Tell me first before you try to handle it alone
story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Diga-me primeiro antes de tentar lidar com isso sozinho.

story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Update me later, even if it is just two words
story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Atualize-me depois, mesmo que sejam apenas duas palavras.
Você se preocupa como uma mãe?

story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I just stepped out for air anyway
story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Eu só saí para pegar um ar de qualquer forma.

story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Can swing by if you need anything
story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Posso passar se você precisar de algo.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: And now I really wish I was there
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: E agora eu realmente gostaria de estar lá

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: To take care of you properly
As much as you'd let me
I'd take care of all of you
I have time to make up for once I'm not injured anymore
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Eu tenho tempo para compensar assim que eu não estiver mais machucado.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: And what if I want to take care of you even before that?
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: E se eu quiser cuidar de você mesmo antes disso?

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Because you're already hard to resist
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Porque você já é difícil de resistir

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Maybe I like making it difficult for you 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Talvez eu goste de tornar isso difícil para você 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then I'm changing and going straight to bed
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Então eu vou me trocar e ir direto para a cama.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: You're doing a very good job
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Você está fazendo um trabalho muito bom

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: How about next time I come over
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Que tal da próxima vez eu ir aí?

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: You let me spoil you a little
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Você me deixou te mimar um pouco

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I would deserve all that attention?

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Obviamente, estritamente para fins de cura.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Even with one bad leg I could still eat you alive
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Mesmo com uma perna ruim, eu ainda poderia te devorar vivo.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Maybe I'll wear as little as possible so no clothes gets in the way
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Talvez eu use o mínimo possível para que nenhuma roupa atrapalhe.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: What kind of clothes would do that?
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Que tipo de roupa faria isso?

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm not used to doing things like this so don't say anything
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Não estou acostumado a fazer coisas assim, então não diga nada.
O que eu acabei de dizer??
Coma primeiro e não tenha pressa

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: That was just my inner voice
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Isso foi apenas minha voz interior

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Nothing would get in the way with that little on
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Nada iria atrapalhar com aquele pequeno.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'll need proof before I believe you
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Vou precisar de provas antes de acreditar em você.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: When you're free and on vacation we'll have all the time we want
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Quando você estiver livre e de férias, teremos todo o tempo que quisermos.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: We can take care of each other as much as we want
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Podemos cuidar um do outro tanto quanto quisermos.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: You must have been really tired 😌
Goodnight beautiful and thank you for tonight
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Boa noite, linda, e obrigado pela noite de hoje.
Vou te mandar uma mensagem depois.

story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..source: But it's the only gym in the area
story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..translation: Mas é a única academia na área

story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..source: I might have a few leads
Because the gym is getting annoying
story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..translation: Porque a academia está ficando irritante
Os mesmos caras continuam pairando por aqui.

story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..source: And I don't progress the way I want 😒
story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..translation: E eu não progresso da maneira que eu quero 😒

story/DAY6/DAY6_12_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_NO.source: You haven't answered in a while
story/DAY6/DAY6_12_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_NO.translation: Você não responde há um tempo.
Me manda uma mensagem quando puder

story/DAY6/DAY6_12_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_NO.source: That was {{name:evelyn}} in Sexminator's photo... I recognize the outfit I helped her choose. Why hasn't she answered?
story/DAY6/DAY6_12_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_NO.translation: Era {{name:evelyn}} na foto do Sexminator... Reconheço a roupa que ajudei ela a escolher. Por que ela não respondeu?

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: I felt bad when I woke up
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Eu me senti mal quando acordei

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: I thought it was cute that you fell asleep like that
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Achei fofo que você tenha adormecido assim.

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: I pictured you snoring and drooling on your pillow
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Eu te imaginei roncando e babando no seu travesseiro.

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: But I'll make it up to you, today
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Mas eu vou compensar você, hoje.

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: Two classes got cancelled this morning
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Duas aulas foram canceladas esta manhã.

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: So I'm coming to see you earlier than planned
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Então estou vindo te ver mais cedo do que o planejado.

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: Now that's a very good apology
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Agora isso é um pedido de desculpas muito bom

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: And don't even think about saying no
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: E nem pense em dizer não

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: I would never be that stupid
Why do you want to know?
Because I have cameras in your brain
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Porque eu tenho câmeras no seu cérebro

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: For falling asleep on you last night
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Por ter adormecido em você na noite passada

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: Right in the middle of our little sexy moment too
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Bem no meio do nosso pequeno momento sexy também.

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: That rarely happens and I ruined it
