story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Isso raramente acontece e eu estraguei.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: So it did not last long
Did he say or do something bad?
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Ele disse ou fez algo ruim?
E eu não sou facilmente intimidado.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: I will push back if he crosses the line
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Eu vou me opor se ele ultrapassar os limites.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: Sorry I did not answer yesterday
We will find another way if needed
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Nós encontraremos outro caminho se necessário.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: I just need a little time to settle things
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Eu só preciso de um tempinho para resolver as coisas.
O café da manhã está pronto

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: Can you come or do you want me to bring it to you?
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Você pode vir ou você quer que eu leve até você?

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: I need to move if I want my leg to heal
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Eu preciso me mover se eu quiser que minha perna cicatrize.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: Staying in bed will not help
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Ficar na cama não vai ajudar

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: It got complicated near the end of the shift
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Ficou complicado perto do final do turno

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: It can also hurt you more if you push too much
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Isso também pode te machucar mais se você pressionar demais.
Está tudo bem, não se preocupe.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: Just a long day and some issues with the staff
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Apenas um longo dia e alguns problemas com a equipe.

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: You want to do nothing faster?
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Você quer fazer nada mais rápido?

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: I'll see if I get out on time
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Vou ver se consigo sair a tempo.

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: I'm waiting on a delivery this morning
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Estou esperando uma entrega esta manhã.

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: Did anything show up or did {{name:hailey}} grab it first? 🙄
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Apareceu alguma coisa ou a {{name:hailey}} pegou primeiro? 🙄

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: I'll let you know if it shows up
Are you at work until lunch?
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Você está no trabalho até o almoço?

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: Can you stop by the store and get me an energy drink? 🥤
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Você pode passar na loja e me trazer uma bebida energética? 🥤

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Eu também estava morrendo de fome.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: But there will be a next time
You always make that very easy
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Você sempre torna isso muito fácil.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: It still means a lot that you stopped by
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Ainda significa muito que você tenha passado por aqui.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: Because you keep taking care of me
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Porque você continua cuidando de mim

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: By the way, I'm meeting a friend for lunch
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: A propósito, vou encontrar um amigo para almoçar.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: I might be a little busy
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Eu posso estar um pouco ocupado

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: But I'll keep you updated as much as I can
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Mas eu vou te manter atualizado o máximo que eu puder.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: Enjoy lunch with your friend and text me later
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Aproveite o almoço com seu amigo e me mande uma mensagem mais tarde.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: Even just for a little while
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Mesmo que seja por um tempinho

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Agora durma antes que eu mude de ideia e venha te incomodar mais.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Can I at least get a goodnight pic?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Posso pelo menos receber uma foto de boa noite?

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Only because you waited for me
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Apenas porque você esperou por mim

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Wow, harder and harder to fall asleep now
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Uau, cada vez mais difícil de adormecer agora.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I didn't want to end the day without hearing from you
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu não queria terminar o dia sem ouvir de você.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I thought you said I talk too much
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eu pensei que você disse que eu falo demais.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: That's the only thing keeping me alive 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Isso é a única coisa que me mantém vivo 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Pretty good, I'm feeling better and better
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Muito bom, estou me sentindo cada vez melhor.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Text me if you need me
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Me mande uma mensagem se precisar de mim

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: My body already knows it's the end of the week
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Meu corpo já sabe que é o fim da semana

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I'll text you when I can
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem quando eu puder.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Did you sleep okay at least?
But not enough to make me a morning person
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Mas não o suficiente para me fazer uma pessoa matutina.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We need to find a solution
Then tell me what you want me to do
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Então me diga o que você quer que eu faça

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a stable route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Escolha de compromisso detectada, sua resposta irá travar permanentemente {{name:evelyn}} em uma rota estável.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a shared tension route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Escolha de compromisso detectada, sua resposta irá bloquear permanentemente {{name:evelyn}} em uma rota de tensão compartilhada.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a high risk route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Escolha de compromisso detectada, sua resposta irá bloquear permanentemente {{name:evelyn}} em uma rota de alto risco.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We find a safer plan together
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Nós encontramos um plano mais seguro juntos.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will find a job, something I can do from home
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Eu vou encontrar um emprego, algo que eu possa fazer de casa.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: You should not do that alone
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Você não deveria fazer isso sozinho.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: You do not need to suffer there
If I bribe him a little he should find me something quickly
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Se eu subornar ele um pouco, ele deve me encontrar algo rapidamente.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I did not answer because it was too late
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Eu não respondi porque era muito tarde.
Então eu vou ficar em casa

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I will take care of you even more
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mas eu vou cuidar de você ainda mais

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Give me one or two days and I will find something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Dê-me um ou dois dias e eu encontrarei algo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: In the meantime, just say you are sick
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Enquanto isso, apenas diga que você está doente.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I do not want you to carry everything
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Eu não quero que você carregue tudo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: My manager is making it difficult for me
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Meu gerente está tornando as coisas difíceis para mim.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: A few days will not kill us
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Alguns dias não vão nos matar.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We are not that poor yet
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Ainda não somos tão pobres assim.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I still have the money I saved for the trip
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Ainda tenho o dinheiro que economizei para a viagem.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will use it if we need to
But I do not think we will
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mas eu não acho que nós vamos

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I just need the right opportunity
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Eu só preciso da oportunidade certa

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Then I will not go back tonight
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Então eu não vou voltar esta noite.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But tell me quickly when you find something for me
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mas me diga rapidamente quando você encontrar algo para mim

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I just have to bear with him
I know it is not the best
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Eu sei que não é o melhor

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I cannot help you yet
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mas eu ainda não posso te ajudar.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: As soon as I can walk again I will work
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Assim que eu puder andar novamente, eu vou trabalhar.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: And you will be able to leave
I am sorry you have to endure him
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Sinto muito que você tenha que suportá-lo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: If he gets too annoying just kick him in the balls
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Se ele ficar muito irritante, é só dar um chute nas bolas dele.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: He watches me like I owe him something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Ele me observa como se eu lhe devesse algo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I also hate feeling like a burden to you
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mas eu também odeio me sentir um fardo para você

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: If I find a few options, you might be forced to give your opinion later 🤍
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Se eu encontrar algumas opções, você pode ser obrigado a dar sua opinião mais tarde 🤍

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Too bad it wasn't a question 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Que pena que não era uma pergunta 😌
Como você está se sentindo hoje?

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Better than yesterday and the day before
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Melhor do que ontem e do que antes de ontem
Espero que eu me cure em breve.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Finally my room is going to get cleaned 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Finalmente meu quarto vai ser limpo 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: You're so sweet in the morning
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Você é tão doce de manhã

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: I might go shopping this afternoon
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Eu posso ir às compras esta tarde.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: I need to find an evening outfit for Saturday night
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Eu preciso encontrar uma roupa para a noite de sábado.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: So this is a fashion emergency?
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Então, isso é uma emergência de moda?

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: But still, how dare he try to steal my job and brag about it
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Mas ainda assim, como ele se atreve a tentar roubar meu emprego e se gabar disso?

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I'm going to break his leg too
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Eu também vou quebrar a perna dele.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I get it but that's not a good idea
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Eu entendo, mas isso não é uma boa ideia.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He'd make you nurse him too
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Ele faria você cuidar dele também.
Ele está com sorte desta vez

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He won't even know how close to death he was
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Ele nem saberá o quão perto da morte ele estava.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I have to go back now
I'm going straight to work after this
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Vou direto para o trabalho depois disso.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I guess he feels lonely without you
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Acho que ele se sente sozinho sem você

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: So now I have to put up with him instead
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Então agora eu tenho que aguentá-lo em vez disso.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He's telling everyone he's your nurse now
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Ele está dizendo a todos que agora é seu enfermeiro.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I never say no to gaming
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Eu nunca digo não para jogar.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Except when I kick your ass
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Exceto quando eu te dou uma surra

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: My setup is finally clean for once
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Meu setup está finalmente limpo pela primeira vez.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do not zoom in, my cable management is still criminal
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Não dê zoom, minha gestão de cabos ainda é criminosa.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: That is a generous lie but I'll take it
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Essa é uma mentira generosa, mas eu aceito.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How are you doing right now?
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Como você está se sentindo agora?

story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.source: If you need something else, ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} before they leave
story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.translation: Se precisar de mais alguma coisa, pergunta pra {{name:hailey}} ou {{name:evelyn}} antes delas irem
Se apressa antes que a {{name:hailey}} chegue lá primeiro

story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.source: Just enough to text you once 🙄
story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.translation: Só o suficiente para te mandar uma mensagem uma vez 🙄

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: For a moment you did sound like an adult 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Por um momento, você soou como um adulto 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Help me or I set your PC on fire 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Ajude-me ou eu coloco seu PC em chamas 😇
Certo, certo, eu vou te ajudar.

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Tell me which one suits me best 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Diga-me qual deles me serve melhor 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: All of them look good on you 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Todos eles ficam bons em você 😌
Eu sabia que você tinha bom gosto 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: So you admit I'm already a femme fatale 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Então você admite que eu já sou uma femme fatale 😇
Que pena que você não pode 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: One look is cute and safe, one is a little bolder, and one makes me look like I'm pretending to be older than I am
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Um olhar é fofo e seguro, um é um pouco mais ousado, e um me faz parecer que estou fingindo ser mais velha do que sou.

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: I'm keeping your answer in mind 🤍
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Estou mantendo sua resposta em mente 🤍

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Tomorrow's party is supposed to be fun, but suddenly it feels like everything means something
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: A festa de amanhã promete ser divertida, mas de repente parece que tudo significa algo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_07_LENA_TO_WORK.json::st.source: Text me if anything feels off
story/DAY8/DAY8_07_LENA_TO_WORK.json::st.translation: Me mande uma mensagem se algo parecer estranho.

story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It has been tense again today
So I want to be there early
story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Então eu quero estar lá cedo

story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: I will text when I can
story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Vou enviar uma mensagem quando puder.

story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.source: At least today was my last day before the weekend
story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.translation: Pelo menos hoje foi meu último dia antes do fim de semana.

story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.source: Take a shower, eat, all that
story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.translation: Tomar um banho, comer, tudo isso

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Portuguese.
Eu termino o trabalho por volta das 6

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: Want to play when I get home?
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Quer jogar quando eu chegar em casa?
Você tem certeza de que isso é {{name:mason}}? 😏
Você me diz, seu filho da puta

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: Alright, come get your ass kicked when you get home 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Certo, venha levar uma surra quando chegar em casa 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: And don't blame me if you cry after
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: E não me culpe se você chorar depois.

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: You really want to spend your life in a wheelchair?
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Você realmente quer passar sua vida em uma cadeira de rodas?
Eu preciso de algo concreto agora 😒

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: I just want to give you the real version, not the rushed one
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Eu só quero te dar a versão real, não a apressada.

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: It should be ready later tonight
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Deve estar pronto mais tarde esta noite.

story/DAY8/DAY8_11_ONLYFUN_POST_EVELYN_2.source: Touching reunion with an old friend
story/DAY8/DAY8_11_ONLYFUN_POST_EVELYN_2.translation: Reunião emocionante com um velho amigo

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Okay, real problem 😭
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Ok, problema real 😭

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: You're being dramatic
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Você está sendo dramático

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I'm trying to cope 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Estou tentando lidar 😇

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Direct intimacy path detected. Personal tutoring may deepen trust and emotional dependency
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Caminho de intimidade direta detectado. O tutoria pessoal pode aprofundar a confiança e a dependência emocional.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Structured distance path detected. A {{name:tutor}} at home or online may keep things controlled
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Caminho de distância estruturado detectado. Um {{name:tutor}} em casa ou online pode manter as coisas sob controle.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Authority exposure path detected. Keeping the main teacher involved may increase dependence and risky closeness
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Caminho de exposição à autoridade detectado. Manter o professor principal envolvido pode aumentar a dependência e a proximidade arriscada.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Do the private lessons with your main teacher
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Faça as aulas particulares com seu professor principal.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I'll find you a {{name:tutor}} at home or online
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Vou te encontrar um {{name:tutor}} em casa ou online.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I'll help you study myself
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Eu vou te ajudar a estudar eu mesmo

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: It might be the simplest way to fix this fast
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Pode ser o jeito mais simples de resolver isso rápido.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I got an email from my principal
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Recebi um e-mail do meu diretor.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: You really trust that option? 😒
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Você realmente confia nessa opção? 😒

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Not trust
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Não confio.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I just think it will push you more than anyone else would
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Só acho que isso vai te empurrar mais do que qualquer outra pessoa faria.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Mhm
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Mhm.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I hate that this might be the smart answer 😭
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Eu odeio que isso possa ser a resposta inteligente 😭.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: That way it stays simple and under control
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Assim fica simples e sob controle.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: My grades are apparently worse than I thought 😭
