story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: O que aconteceu?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: It was about the work I mentioned earlier
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Era sobre o trabalho que mencionei antes

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to explain what it actually is
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Queria explicar o que realmente é

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Yes finally, I was curious about it
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Sim, finalmente, estava curioso sobre isso

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: Honestly, I hope I can get the cast off soon
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Honestamente, espero conseguir tirar a gesso logo

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: But don't get stupid with it
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Mas não faça besteira com isso

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: That's exactly what someone stupid would say
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Isso é exatamente o que alguém estúpido diria

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: Don't go to bed too late
The game won't be ready tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: O jogo não vai estar pronto hoje à noite

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: It's downloading like it has somewhere better to be
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Está baixando como se tivesse algo melhor para fazer
Descansados para o treino de amanhã
Ainda tá tudo bem depois dessa manhã?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not start pacing like an old man
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Não comece a andar de um lado pro outro como um velho

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Start with what changes, then why it matters
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Comece com o que muda, depois por que isso importa

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: And you did a good job picking the outfit
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: E você fez um bom trabalho escolhendo a roupa

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not make it a thing

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Você vai ter que assumir a responsabilidade 😇

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Fofo e seguro, exatamente como você pediu

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Tell me how cute i am 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Me diz como eu tô fofa 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I was scared of how things would feel between us
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Eu estava com medo de como as coisas se sentiriam entre nós.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: But I think we handled it well
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Mas eu acho que lidamos bem com isso.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And I kept thinking about what you said this morning
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: E eu continuei pensando sobre o que você disse esta manhã.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Also I changed into one of your shirts
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Também me vesti com uma das suas camisas.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: That feels illegal when I'm not there
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Isso parece ilegal quando eu não estou lá.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Are you flirting with me, lady?
What a lucky man I am
And I'm a really lucky girl to have you ❤️
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: E eu sou uma garota realmente sortuda por ter você ❤️

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I'm going to wash my face and get in bed before I start missing you too loudly
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Vou lavar meu rosto e me deitar antes que eu comece a sentir sua falta muito alto.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And lay down staring at the ceiling for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: E deite-se olhando para o teto por um tempo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: Just letting you know I handled it myself
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Só para te avisar, eu cuidei disso sozinho.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: I'm going back to that gym on my own terms
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Estou voltando para aquela academia nos meus próprios termos.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: If they start bothering me again, we can settle it outside 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Se eles começarem a me incomodar de novo, podemos resolver isso lá fora 😒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: But you could also ask to have them kicked out of the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Mas você também poderia pedir para que eles fossem expulsos da academia.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: One of them owns the place
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Um deles é o dono do lugar.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Acorda 😭
Sim

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: He said I can stay after class and he will go through the assignment with me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ele disse que posso ficar depois da aula e ele vai revisar a tarefa comigo
Como uma verdadeira estudante em emergência 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That is probably the fastest way to make you learn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Essa é provavelmente a forma mais rápida de você aprender
Eu sei
Essa é a parte chata
Ele parecia calmo sobre isso

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Like I am not doomed, just badly organized
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Como se eu não estivesse condenada, só mal organizada
Isso soa preciso 😇
Grosseiro, mas preciso 😌
Pequena crise acadêmica
E também tem festa hoje à noite

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your outfit choice is still under investigation
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Sua escolha de roupa ainda tá sob investigação
Mesmo com o modo de resgate do professor?
Especialmente com o modo de resgate do professor

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If I have to suffer academically, I deserve to look amazing later
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Se eu tiver que sofrer academicamente, mereço ficar incrível depois

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I will update you after his help session 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou te atualizar depois da sessão de ajuda dele 😇
Na verdade, crise acadêmica média
A tarefa ainda tá feia

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Send it later and I will look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Manda depois que eu dou uma olhada
Esse era o plano

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But school already answered about the private lessons
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas a escola já respondeu sobre as aulas particulares

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: They want me with my main professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Eles querem que eu fique com meu professor principal
Começando amanhã 😭
Já?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom dia

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: New outfits or something like that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Novas roupas ou algo assim

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like it will be somthing stupid and i don't want to change outfit anyway
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sinto que vai ser algo estúpido e eu não quero trocar de roupa de qualquer maneira.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What should I do if he pushes that on me?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: O que eu devo fazer se ele me empurrar isso?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Your reply here can have effect in the near future
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sua resposta aqui pode ter efeito no futuro próximo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Wait to see the outfits, then talk to him if you do not like them
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Espere para ver as roupas, depois fale com ele se você não gostar delas.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Trust him, even if he is annoying he does run the bar well right?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Confie nele, mesmo que ele seja irritante, ele cuida bem do bar, certo?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If it is not okay, tell him calmly and set a boundary
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Se não estiver tudo bem, diga a ele calmamente e estabeleça um limite.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: So I do not refuse before I even know what it is
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Então eu não recuso antes mesmo de saber o que é.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Exatamente

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, so how did it go at the bar last night?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom dia, então como foi no bar ontem à noite?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You're right maybe im making a big fuse for nothing
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Você está certo, talvez eu esteja fazendo um grande alvoroço por nada.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Try to trust him on the work side
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Tente confiar nele no lado do trabalho.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: He is annoying, but the bar is still running, so he is doing something right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ele é irritante, mas o bar ainda está funcionando, então ele está fazendo algo certo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You really think so?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Você realmente acha isso?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Just stay calm and do not assume the worst too early
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Apenas fique calmo e não assuma o pior muito cedo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will try to give him the benefit of the doubt
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou tentar dar a ele o benefício da dúvida.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It was okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Foi ok

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Either way, don't worry about him that much, just work normally
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: De qualquer forma, não se preocupe tanto com ele, apenas trabalhe normalmente

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good time with your colleagues too
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Divirta-se com seus colegas também

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And text me the moment something feels wrong
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E me mande uma mensagem assim que algo parecer errado

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu vou

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for being in my corner
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigado por estar do meu lado

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It's normal don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: É normal, não se preocupe.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I kept my head down and did my work
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu mantive a cabeça baixa e fiz meu trabalho.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But the manager watched everything like a hawk, quit annoying
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas o gerente observava tudo como um falcão, irritante.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is going to be fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Vai ficar tudo bem

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You just have to endure him for a bit and he will leave you alone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Você só precisa aguentá-lo por um tempo e ele vai te deixar em paz.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes you're right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, você está certo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: At least I enjoy working with my colleagues
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pelo menos eu gosto de trabalhar com meus colegas

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Oh also, that bastard said he might bring new dress code rules soon
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ah, e aquele bastardo disse que pode trazer novas regras de dress code em breve.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: But I guess I needed the truth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Mas eu acho que eu precisava da verdade

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That doesn't mean it felt good
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Isso não significa que foi bom.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Knowing that you don't want me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Sabendo que você não me quer

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It's not that I don't want you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Não é que eu não te queira

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It's just that right now I'm not ready for that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: É só que neste momento eu não estou pronto para isso.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just need a little time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Eu só preciso de um pouco de tempo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I really didn't want to hurt you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Eu realmente não queria te machucar
É por isso que ainda estou aqui

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a bit and work from home for a while
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Vou limpar um pouco e trabalhar de casa por um tempo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I need to keep my mind busy
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Eu preciso manter minha mente ocupada
Vou te mandar uma mensagem mais tarde.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest last night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: E... obrigado por ser honesto na noite passada

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your room finally lost the fight
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Seu quarto finalmente perdeu a batalha

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Finally ! I always had hope in you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Finalmente! Sempre tive esperança em você

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you are supervising more than cleaning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você parece mais supervisionando do que limpando

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Hurry up and clean your room
Say that again and I am putting you in the donation bag
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fala isso de novo e eu te coloco na sacola de doação

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} found a box under my bed and gave me the mother look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} encontrou uma caixa debaixo da minha cama e me deu aquele olhar de mãe

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: My lawyer said I should stay silent
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Meu advogado disse que eu deveria ficar em silêncio

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I need to go before she finds more evidence 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Agora eu preciso ir antes que ela encontre mais provas 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} decided today is apparently war against dust
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} decidiu que hoje é aparentemente guerra contra a poeira

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: We are doing a huge cleaning session
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estamos fazendo uma grande sessão de limpeza

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Principalmente não é um termo médico.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Especially when you act like you're fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Especialmente quando você age como se estivesse bem
Eu não estou atuando tanto assim.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Você não confia em mim nem um pouco.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Eu simplesmente não confio nos seus instintos de sobrevivência.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Just take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Apenas fique tranquilo até eu terminar

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Okay, my break is almost over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Ok, minha pausa está quase acabando

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Eu preciso ir agir de forma útil novamente

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem depois do meu turno 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time feel slow
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Nada terrível, apenas o suficiente para fazer o tempo parecer lento

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Estou basicamente vivendo meu sonho agora.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Then you'd probably break the other one too 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Então você provavelmente quebraria o outro também 😒
Vou te mandar uma mensagem mais tarde

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm about to leave for the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Estou prestes a sair para a academia

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The sooner I go, the sooner it's over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Quanto mais cedo eu for, mais cedo acaba

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm still sorry I can't really help
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ainda sinto muito por não poder ajudar muito

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Just tell me if anything happens
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Só me avise se algo acontecer

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You'll run over there on one leg?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Você vai correr até lá com uma perna só?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Good news, I don't work tonight or tomorrow night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Boas notícias, não trabalho hoje à noite nem amanhã à noite

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Just focus on getting better, that's the most important thing right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Apenas foque em se recuperar, isso é o mais importante agora

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for everything you do
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Obrigada por tudo que você faz

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sorry for being such a burden right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Desculpe por ser um fardo agora

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't say that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não diga isso

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You are not a burden
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você não é um fardo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And none of this is your fault
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: E nada disso é sua culpa

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You just need time to recover, that's all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você só precisa de tempo para se recuperar, isso é tudo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: After dinner tonight, we can spend some time together if you want 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Depois do jantar hoje à noite, podemos passar um tempo juntos se você quiser 😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd love that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu adoraria isso

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we'll do that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então vamos fazer isso

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'll finally have some free time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Finalmente vou ter um tempo livre

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I think I'm going to use it to clean the house and do some laundry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Acho que vou aproveitar para limpar a casa e lavar roupa

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you have anything that needs washing too?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tem algo que precisa ser lavado também?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I have a few things
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, tenho algumas coisas

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But are you sure you don't need help?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mas você tem certeza de que não precisa de ajuda?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: No, don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Não, não se preocupe

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to rest until you're fully healed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você precisa descansar até estar completamente curada

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure ?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você tem certeza?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I know you want to help but I can handle this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sim, eu sei que você quer ajudar, mas eu consigo lidar com isso

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I might be a little late
Thank you for setting everything up
Take your time, i'm not starting without you 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Leve seu tempo, não vou começar sem você 😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:mason}} is using the bathroom right now
I can't even brush my teeth yet
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ainda não consigo escovar os dentes

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll come downstairs in about fifteen minutes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou descer em cerca de quinze minutos

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I prepared the movie and the popcorn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Preparei o filme e a pipoca

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now i'm only missing you and {{name:mason}}

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Are you almost done in the bathroom?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Você já está quase terminando no banheiro?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: And yet you keep talking to me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: E ainda assim você continua falando comigo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I'll come out when I'm done

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Você vai sobreviver mais um minuto

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Because you've been in there forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Porque você está lá dentro há uma eternidade

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I need to brush my teeth too
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Eu também preciso escovar os dentes

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: You don't need forty minutes to brush your teeth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Você não precisa de quarenta minutos para escovar os dentes

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Also yes I did the worksheet before leaving
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: E sim, eu fiz a atividade antes de sair

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Professor would probably materialize from the shadows if I skipped it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: O professor provavelmente ia materializar das sombras se eu faltasse

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But the party is actually at the principal's son's place 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas a festa é na casa do filho do diretor 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I just crossed paths with him
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu acabei de cruzar com ele

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He only gave me a little wave
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele só me deu uma acenada

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But now I feel weirdly shy because of the outfit
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mas agora estou me sentindo estranhamente tímida por causa da roupa

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Because I did not plan to be seen by him dressed like this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Porque eu não planejei ser vista por ele vestida assim

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Stop looking smug through the phone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Para de parecer tão satisfeito pelo telefone

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He said I look more mature than usual and now I am blaming both of you 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele disse que eu pareço mais madura do que o normal e agora estou culpando vocês duas 😇

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: My professor said it was nice too, which was weirdly stressful 💅
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Meu professor também disse que era legal, o que foi estranhamente estressante 💅

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Fofo e seguro, exatamente como você pediu

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Please say I look like a responsible student who definitely revises 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor, diz que eu pareço uma estudante responsável que definitivamente estuda 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: The party was actually really fun
I saw a bunch of people I had not seen in forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Vi um monte de gente que não via há séculos

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So now my social battery is fully dead
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Agora minha bateria social está completamente descarregada

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked a little with my professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Conversei um pouco com meu professor
Sobre lição de casa à meia-noite?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He asked if I was enjoying the party and said the outfit suited me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele perguntou se eu estava gostando da festa e disse que a roupa me caiu bem
O que foi um pouco estressante, na verdade

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was not expecting to run into him there

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Mas sinto que estou melhorando nisso.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Isso torna tudo um pouco mais valioso.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Posso te ver antes de você ir para a cama?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Vou tomar banho e ir para a cama.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Come play with me so i can kick your ass
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Venha brincar comigo para que eu possa te dar uma surra.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: So who is it and when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Então, quem é e quando eu começo?
Você provavelmente vai precisar de alguns equipamentos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Your coach should text me during the day if everything is good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Seu treinador deve me enviar uma mensagem durante o dia se tudo estiver bem.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Why won't you say his name?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Por que você não diz o nome dele?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Or is it because you have no one? 😒
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Ou é porque você não tem ninguém? 😒

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds way too dramatic for homework help 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso soa dramático demais para ajuda com lição de casa 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If this saves my grades and keeps me out of school humiliation then I owe you one 😇
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Se isso salvar minhas notas e me manter longe da humilhação na escola, então eu te devo uma 😇

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: So your {{name:tutor}} plan is becoming a real thing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Então seu plano de {{name:tutor}} está se tornando real

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I still can't believe I actually need help that badly 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ainda não consigo acreditar que realmente preciso de ajuda assim 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But having someone at home or online already sounds way less awful than staying after class with teachers
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas ter alguém em casa ou online já parece bem menos horrível do que ficar depois da aula com os professores

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu tenho boas ideias às vezes

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Sometimes is doing a lot of work there 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Às vezes é fazer muito trabalho aí 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Did you actually find someone serious or are you just improvising with confidence again?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Você realmente encontrou alguém sério ou está só improvisando com confiança de novo?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu te disse que ia dar conta

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your future is safe with me

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hey, are you awake?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ei, você está acordada?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I want to help
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Quero ajudar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You are not useless, you are the one keeping everything running here
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Você não é inútil, você é quem mantém tudo funcionando aqui

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Also I am looking for something we can do together
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Além disso, estou procurando algo que possamos fazer juntos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I might have a lead
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Talvez eu tenha uma pista

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I want to verify it before I commit you to anything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas quero verificar isso antes de te comprometer com algo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What kind of work?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Que tipo de trabalho?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Is it safe?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: É seguro?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And is it legal?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E é legal?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, claro

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is mostly scheduling and meeting people in public
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: É principalmente agendar e encontrar pessoas em público

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, yeah I woke up a few minutes ago
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Bom dia, sim, acordei há alguns minutos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No bar
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sem bar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No late nights forced by a manager
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sem noites tarde forçadas por um gerente

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Meeting people?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Encontrar pessoas?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pra quê?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Passive Insight says how you frame your next response can change her reaction
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: O Insight Passivo diz que como você estrutura sua próxima resposta pode mudar a reação dela

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is like being a friend for a day, they pay for your time and company
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: É como ser amigo por um dia, eles pagam pelo seu tempo e companhia

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is basically paid dates, but with strict rules and public places only
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Basicamente, são encontros pagos, mas com regras rígidas e apenas em lugares públicos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds strange
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso soa estranho

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: People pay just to talk?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: As pessoas pagam só pra conversar?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Some people feel really lonely
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Algumas pessoas se sentem muito solitárias

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling today?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Como você está se sentindo hoje?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: They want company without pressure
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Elas querem companhia sem pressão

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you are good at making people feel safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E você é boa em fazer as pessoas se sentirem seguras

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone you like
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E quem sabe, talvez você encontre alguém que goste

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Você cuidou de nós por muito tempo, é hora de você viver sua vida também

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sou velha demais pra isso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful and still young, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Não, você não é, você é linda e ainda jovem, só se dê uma chance

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hmm..I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hmm... Vou pensar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Paid dates?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Encontros pagos?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Melhor

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That is not really my world
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso não é bem o meu mundo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It does not mean you owe anything to anyone, it is more like acting for a day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Isso não significa que você deve nada a ninguém, é mais como atuar por um dia

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is time and conversation
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: É tempo e conversa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It pays really well
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Paga muito bem

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And we set boundaries before you accept any client so there is no risk
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E nós estabelecemos limites antes de você aceitar qualquer cliente, então não há risco

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E quem sabe, talvez você encontre alguém

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Você cuidou de nós por muito tempo, é hora de você viver sua vida também

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu sou velha demais pra isso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Não, você não é, você é linda, só se dê uma chance

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou pensar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I still feel guilty
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas ainda me sinto culpada

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But i do not like the idea of being judged
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas eu não gosto da ideia de ser julgada

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No one will judge you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ninguém vai te julgar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you will not be alone in this, I will check everything, check with the client and watch over you all day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E você não estará sozinha nisso, eu vou checar tudo, confirmar com o cliente e cuidar de você o dia todo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For now I will verify the platform and the rules
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Por enquanto, vou verificar a plataforma e as regras

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If anything feels wrong we drop it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Se algo parecer errado, a gente desiste

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I can try it and if I do not like it I will stop
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Posso tentar e, se não gostar, eu paro

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Of course, you only have a one week obligation anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Claro, você só tem uma obrigação de uma semana, de qualquer forma

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I stayed home like you said but I feel like I let my colleagues down
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Fiquei em casa como você disse, mas sinto que decepcionei meus colegas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright, when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo, quando eu começo?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will text you once I know more
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem assim que souber mais

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for taking care of me and finding me work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Obrigada por cuidar de mim e encontrar um trabalho pra mim

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is normal, go rest a little you deserve your day off
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: É normal, vai descansar um pouco, você merece seu dia de folga

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Do not feel guilty, working there was not good for you anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Não se sinta culpada, trabalhar lá não era bom pra você de qualquer forma

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it for the work, and for your coworkers it is fine, you can still see them outside work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Eu te disse que eu cuidaria disso pelo trabalho, e quanto aos seus colegas, tudo bem, você ainda pode vê-los fora do trabalho

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes that is true
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sim, isso é verdade

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I do not want to be useless
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mas eu não quero ser inútil

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It was a lot to hear
But I'm glad you told me instead of hiding it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Mas fico feliz que você me contou em vez de esconder.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I didn't want to lie to you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Eu não queria mentir para você

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just think I need a little time now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Acho que só preciso de um tempinho agora

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: To understand where I stand in all this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Para entender onde eu me encaixo em tudo isso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And where I stand with us 😕
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: E onde eu fico com nós 😕

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Not because I think you love me less
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Não porque eu acho que você me ama menos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: More because I didn't expect things to feel like that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Mais porque eu não esperava que as coisas se sentissem assim.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And you don't have to force anything for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: E você não precisa forçar nada por minha causa.
É por isso que não estou em pânico.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just want to move carefully
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Eu só quero me mover com cuidado

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Because this really matters to me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Porque isso realmente importa para mim
Você também é importante para mim.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Then give me a little time to figure out how I feel about all of this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Então me dê um tempinho para eu descobrir como me sinto sobre tudo isso.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Take all the time you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Leve todo o tempo que precisar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That helps more than you think 🥺
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Isso ajuda mais do que você pensa 🥺

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a little and work from home for a bit
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Vou limpar um pouco e trabalhar de casa por um tempo.
Vou te mandar uma mensagem mais tarde 💕

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Still a little foggy but better 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ainda um pouco nebuloso, mas melhor 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest with me last night
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: E... obrigado por ser honesto comigo na noite passada

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I walked past a clothing store after class
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Passei por uma loja de roupas depois da aula

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: And they had a huge sale 😭
Do you know how hard it was not to go inside?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você sabe como foi difícil não entrar?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that like it's a real struggle
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você fala isso como se fosse uma grande luta

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your shopping addiction needs professional treatment
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sua compulsão por compras precisa de tratamento profissional

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: At least my clothes look good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pelo menos minhas roupas são boas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You were definitely planning to buy it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Você definitivamente estava planejando comprar isso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Trying to enjoy a peaceful afternoon
I should have an answer sometime today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Devo ter uma resposta ainda hoje

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you know as soon as I hear back
Please don't hire some terrifying genius
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por favor, não contrate um gênio aterrorizante

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to get better soon
I miss making fun of the way you walk 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tô com saudade de zoar o jeito que você anda 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Hello
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Oi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That sounds like exactly what she needs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Isso parece exatamente o que ela precisa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I usually start by identifying the subjects causing the most trouble
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Eu geralmente começo identificando os assuntos que estão causando mais problemas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Then we create a study plan and work through it step by step
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Depois, criamos um plano de estudos e vamos trabalhando passo a passo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She's capable of doing well, but...
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ela é capaz de se sair bem, mas...

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She just struggles to stay motivated sometimes
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ela só tem dificuldade em se manter motivada às vezes

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That's very common
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Isso é bem comum

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Most students are more capable than they think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: A maioria dos alunos é mais capaz do que pensa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: They just need structure and consistency
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Eles só precisam de estrutura e consistência

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: When would you be available?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Quando você estaria disponível?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Tomorrow afternoon would work for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Amanhã à tarde funciona pra mim

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: It's Ethan
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: É o Ethan

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I can come by, meet her and evaluate where she currently stands
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Posso passar, conhecê-la e avaliar onde ela está atualmente

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Perfeito

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'll let her know
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Vou avisá-la

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ótimo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Feel free to message me if you have any questions before then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Fique à vontade para me mandar uma mensagem se tiver alguma dúvida antes disso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I received your tutoring request earlier today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Recebi seu pedido de tutoria mais cedo hoje

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Thanks for reaching out
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Obrigado por entrar em contato

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'm looking for someone who can help {{name:hailey}} prepare for her exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Estou procurando alguém que possa ajudar {{name:hailey}} a se preparar para as provas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: What students do you usually work with?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Com que tipo de alunos você costuma trabalhar?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I mainly work with high school and college students
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Eu trabalho principalmente com alunos do ensino médio e universitários

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Perfeito

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: And my goal isn't just to explain lessons
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: E meu objetivo não é apenas explicar as lições

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I also help students build study habits and stay focused
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Eu também ajudo os alunos a desenvolver hábitos de estudo e a se manterem focados

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Recebi uma resposta
Você já viu o corpo dele?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The guy clearly knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: O cara claramente sabe o que tá fazendo
Ok, justo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He does have a crazy body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ele realmente tem um corpo incrível

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Well that actually makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Bem, isso na verdade me faz sentir um pouco melhor

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: At least I already know him
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Pelo menos eu já o conheço

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: And I know he isn't some random creep you found online
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: E sei que ele não é um estranho aleatório que você encontrou online

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You really have no faith in me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Você realmente não confia em mim

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You wanted to keep his name a surprise
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Você queria manter o nome dele em segredo
Você trouxe isso para si mesma
Finalmente
Pequena ingrata

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Still more grateful than you deserve 🙂
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ainda sou mais grata do que você merece 🙂

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell {{name:aiden}} I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Diga a {{name:aiden}} que estou pronta quando ele estiver

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He's a young coach who just moved to town
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ele é um jovem treinador que acabou de se mudar para a cidade
Ele tem mais ou menos a sua idade
Quão disponível ele está?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Has he actually coached anyone before?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ele já treinou alguém antes?
Quem é?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: And where did you even find him?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: E onde você o encontrou?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He used to be one of {{name:aiden}}'s coaches
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ele costumava ser um dos treinadores do {{name:aiden}}
Oh

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Okay that sounds a lot less suspicious
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ok, isso soa bem menos suspeito

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: If he coached {{name:aiden}}, he probably knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Se ele treinou o {{name:aiden}}, provavelmente sabe o que está fazendo
Era isso que eu pensava
Então eu topo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm curious to see what he can do
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Tô curiosa pra ver o que ele pode fazer

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell that Chris I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Diz pro Chris que tô pronta quando ele estiver
É {{name:aiden}}
O nome dele é Chris
Espera
Você quer dizer seu melhor amigo?
Sim
Por que você perguntou a ele?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Principalmente não é um termo médico.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Especially when you pretend you're fine
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Especialmente quando você finge que está bem

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Você não confia em mim nem um pouco.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Eu simplesmente não confio nos seus instintos de sobrevivência.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Please take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Por favor, vá com calma até eu terminar.
Ok, o intervalo está quase acabando

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Eu preciso ir agir de forma útil novamente

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Vou te mandar uma mensagem depois do meu turno 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time move slowly
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Nada terrível, apenas o suficiente para fazer o tempo passar devagar.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Eu estou basicamente vivendo meu sonho agora.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, are you really sure I'll be able to do that job?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ei, você tem certeza de que eu vou conseguir fazer esse trabalho?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I can't help but worry about it a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mas eu não consigo deixar de me preocupar um pouco com isso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's perfectly normal, it's a big change after all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso é perfeitamente normal, é uma grande mudança, afinal

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I am confident that you will do great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mas estou confiante de que você vai se sair muito bem

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Right now I am mostly making sure everything is legitimate
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Agora, estou apenas garantindo que tudo seja legítimo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to verify all the details before I tell you to start
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quero verificar todos os detalhes antes de te dizer para começar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso me faz sentir um pouco melhor

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I should have all the answers tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalmente, eu deveria ter todas as respostas amanhã

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: If everything checks out, you will be able to begin after that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Se tudo estiver certo, você poderá começar depois disso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Already tomorrow?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Já amanhã?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is sooner than I expected
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso é mais cedo do que eu esperava

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claro

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will explain everything in more detail tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vou explicar tudo em mais detalhes amanhã

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you have my attention
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Agora você tem minha atenção

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I am curious to know what you found
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estou curiosa para saber o que você encontrou

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And maybe a little nervous too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: E talvez um pouco nervosa também

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is perfectly normal
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso é perfeitamente normal

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: We will take it one step at a time
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vamos fazer isso um passo de cada vez

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I will wait for your message later 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Então eu vou esperar sua mensagem mais tarde 😊

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Why are you asking?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por que você está perguntando?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I keep thinking about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque eu fico pensando nisso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not that smart and don't have much experience in those things
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu não sou tão inteligente e não tenho muita experiência nessas coisas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And I am wondering if I will actually be good enough
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: E eu estou me perguntando se realmente serei bom o suficiente

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's not true, you are more capable than you think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Isso não é verdade, você é mais capaz do que pensa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And even if you don't have experience, you can learn
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: E mesmo que você não tenha experiência, você pode aprender

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will be there to help you with everything you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estarei aqui para te ajudar com tudo que precisar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, and I really appreciate that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eu sei, e realmente aprecio isso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ei 😊 o jantar está quase pronto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I figured this might motivate you 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Achei que isso poderia te motivar 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I made steak and french fries
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu fiz bife com batatas fritas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I know how much you love that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu sei o quanto você ama isso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now I'm even more motivated to come downstairs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Agora estou ainda mais motivado a descer

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll see you in a minute then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Te vejo em um minuto então

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want to come downstairs?
Or should I bring your plate upstairs?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ou eu deveria trazer seu prato pra cima?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I should force myself to move a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu deveria me forçar a me mover um pouco

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Hey, just imagine how unfair this is going to be
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Ei, imagina como isso vai ser injusto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Careful or I'll cancel your coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Cuidado ou eu vou cancelar seu treinador

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Thanks for taking the time to look for someone and finding me a coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Obrigada por ter se dado ao trabalho de procurar alguém e me encontrar um treinador

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: That's one less thing I have to deal with
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: É uma coisa a menos com que eu tenho que me preocupar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: You dealing with anything by yourself would have been a miracle anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Você lidar com algo sozinho seria um milagre de qualquer forma

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: I'm about to get a dream body while you're stuck in bed with your broken body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Vou ficar com o corpo dos sonhos enquanto você tá deitado na cama com seu corpo quebrado

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: A dream body won't fix your face
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Um corpo dos sonhos não vai consertar seu rosto
Mas o rosto ainda tá ruim

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Jealousy doesn't look good on you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Inveja não fica bem em você

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Neither will all that muscle when you still lose to me at everything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Nem todos esses músculos vão ajudar quando você ainda perder pra mim em tudo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was hoping you'd forget about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu tava torcendo pra você esquecer disso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He wants to see where you're at and what needs work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele quer ver onde você está e o que precisa de trabalho

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He's going to discover how cooked you are 😔
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ele vai descobrir quão enrolada você está 😔

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: You're enjoying this way too much

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo, professor particular amanhã, festa hoje à noite 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to make a good first impression tomorrow 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Vou tentar causar uma boa impressão amanhã 😊
É só isso que eu peço

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'm heading to the party with the girls now. Goodnight, coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Estou indo para a festa com as meninas. Boa noite, treinador

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Have fun at the party, and get home safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Divirta-se na festa e volte para casa com cuidado

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked to him this afternoon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Eu conversei com ele esta tarde

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: And he knows how to work with students preparing for exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: E ele sabe como trabalhar com alunos se preparando para provas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So you're saying my academic rescue mission is officially happening 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Então você tá dizendo que minha missão de resgate acadêmico tá oficialmente acontecendo 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Mas sinto que estou melhorando nisso.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Isso torna tudo um pouco mais valioso.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Posso te ver antes de você ir para a cama?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Vou tomar banho e ir para a cama.

ui.auto.laurent_runs_his_own_consulting_.source: Laurent runs his own consulting firm and spends most of his time working. He values discretion, easy conversation, and a quiet hour without expectations.
ui.auto.laurent_runs_his_own_consulting_.translation: Laurent tem sua própria consultoria e passa a maior parte do tempo trabalhando. Ele valoriza discrição, conversas leves e uma hora tranquila sem expectativas.

ui.auto.laurent_runs_his_own_consulting_.source: Laurent runs his own consulting firm and values discretion. He prefers quiet meetings, good coffee, and women who understand boundaries.
ui.auto.laurent_runs_his_own_consulting_.translation: Laurent tem sua própria consultoria e valoriza discrição. Ele prefere reuniões silenciosas, um bom café e mulheres que entendem limites.

ui.auto.lena_and_hailey_are_free_evelyn_.source: Lena and Hailey are free. Evelyn Day 9-15 requires a Patreon/SubscribeStar code.
ui.auto.lena_and_hailey_are_free_evelyn_.translation: Lena e Hailey estão livres. Evelyn Dia 9-15 requer um código do Patreon/SubscribeStar.
